صَاحِبُهُ: ṣāḥib + -hu — ṣāḥib, owner, companion (m., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his master'
لِحَاجَةٍ: لِـ + حَاجَة — ḥāja, need (f., gen. indef.); 'for a need'
تَعْرِضُ: taʿriḍu — ʿaraḍa, to present itself, arise (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
وَيَرْجِعُ: وَ + يَرْجِعُ — rajaʿa, to return (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
حَالِهِ: ḥāl + -ihi — ḥāl, state, condition (f., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his state'
الثَّوْرَ: الـ + ثَوْر — thawr, bull, ox (m., acc.)
يَقُولُ: yaqūlu — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
لِلْحِمَارِ: لِـ + الـ + حِمَار — ḥimār, donkey (m., gen.); the article's alif is dropped in writing after li-
هَنِيًّا: hanīʾan — wholesome, may-it-do-you-good (elliptical acc. in the fixed exclamation hanīʾan laka)
تَعْبَانُ: taʿbān — weary, tired (adj., m., nom.; diptote pattern faʿlān)
تَأْكُلُ: taʾkulu — akala, to eat (verb I, imperf. 2ms)
مُغَرْبَلًا: mughrabal — sifted (pass. part.; m., acc. as ḥāl, 'sifted')
وَيَخْدُمُكَ: وَ + يَخْدُمُ + ـكَ — khadama, to serve (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 2ms object; 'he serves you'
يَرْكَبُكَ: yarkabu + -ka — rakiba, to ride (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 2ms object; 'he rides you'
دَائِمًا: dāʾim — lasting, continual (act. part. of dāma; m., acc. as adv., 'always')
لِلْحَرْثِ: لِـ + الـ + حَرْث — li-, for (prep.) + ḥarth, ploughing, tillage (m., gen.)
وَالطَّحِينِ: وَ + الـ + طَحِين — ṭaḥīn, flour, grinding (m., gen.)
تَخْرُجُ: takhruju — kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperf. 2ms)
الْغَيْطِ: الـ + غَيْط — ghayṭ, field (m., gen.; the everyday word for cultivated land)
وَيَجْعَلُونَ: وَ + يَجْعَلُونَ — jaʿala, to put, place (verb I, imperf. 3mp)
رَقَبَتِكَ: raqaba + -tika — raqaba, neck (f., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your neck'
فَارْقُدْ: فَـ + اِرْقُدْ — raqada, to lie down, sleep (verb I, imper. 2ms)
وَلَوْ: وَ + لَوْ — law, if, even if (conditional particle)
ضَرَبُوكَ: ḍarabū + -ka — ḍaraba, to strike, beat (verb I, perf. 3mp) + 2ms object; 'they beat you'
تَقُمْ: taqum — qāma, to rise, stand (verb I hollow, jussive 2ms after lā)
وَقُمْ: وَ + قُمْ — qāma, to rise (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms)
وَارْقُدْ: وَ + اِرْقُدْ — raqada, to lie down (verb I, imper. 2ms)
يَرْجِعُونَ: yarjiʿūna — rajaʿa, to return, bring back (verb I, imperf. 3mp)
بِكَ: بِـ + ـكَ — bi-, with + 2ms suffix; 'with you, bringing you'
وَيُوضَعُونَ: وَ + يُوضَعُونَ — waḍaʿa, to put, set down (verb I, imperf. pass. 3mp); a passive verb agreeing in the plural with the unstated agent rather than with its own singular subject
فَلَا: فَـ + لَا — lā, not (neg. particle, with the jussive)
تَأْكُلْهُ: taʾkul + -hu — akala, to eat (verb I, jussive 2ms after lā) + 3ms object; 'do not eat it'
كَأَنَّكَ: ka-anna + -ka — ka-anna, as though (particle) + 2ms pronoun as its subject; 'as though you'
ضَعِيفٌ: ḍaʿīf — weak, feeble (adj., m., nom. indef.)
وَامْتَنِعْ: وَ + اِمْتَنِعْ — imtanaʿa, to abstain, refrain (verb VIII, imper. 2ms)
وَالشُّرْبِ: وَ + الـ + شُرْب — shurb, drinking (m., gen.)
ثَلٰثَةً: thalātha — three (f. numeral, acc.); prints without its medial alif (ثلثة), pointed with a dagger alif
فَتَسْتَرِيحُ: فَـ + تَسْتَرِيحُ — istarāḥa, to rest (verb X, imperf. 2ms)
التَّعَبِ: الـ + تَعَب — taʿab, fatigue, weariness (m., gen.)
وَالْجَهْدِ: وَ + الـ + جَهْد — jahd, toil, exertion (m., gen.)
يَسْمَعُ: yasmaʿu — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
كَلَامَهُمَا: kalām + -humā — kalām, speech, talk (m., acc.) + 3md suffix; 'their (two) talk'
السَّوَّاقُ: الـ + سَوَّاق — sawwāq, drover, driver (intensive noun of agent, m., nom.)
بِعَشَاءِهِ: بِـ + عَشَاء + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.; atā/jāʾa bi- = come with, i.e. bring) + ʿashāʾ, evening meal, evening feed (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix
شَيْأً: shayʾan — shayʾ, thing (m., acc. indef.); 'a little, something' — prints without the usual supporting alif of the accusative ending (شيأ for شيئا)
يَسِيرًا: yasīr — small, slight (adj., m., acc. indef.); 'a little'
وَأَصْبَحَ: وَ + أَصْبَحَ — aṣbaḥa, to come to be, to do in the morning (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
يَأْخُذُ: yaʾkhudhu — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
فَوَجَادَهُ: فَـ + وَجَدَ + ـهُ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; prints with an extra plene alif (فوجاده) not seen in the identical phrase earlier, but read the same way
فَحَزِنَ: فَـ + حَزِنَ — ḥazina, to grieve (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَقَٰلَ: وَ + قَالَ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); printed defectively قل
قَدَرَ: qadara — to be able (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَشْغُلُ: yashghulu — shaghala, to work, be occupied (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
الْحَرْثِ: الـ + حَرْث — ḥarth, ploughing, tillage (m., gen.)
مُتَقَصِّرٌ: mutaqaṣṣir — falling short, remiss, off his feed (act. part. of V taqaṣṣara; m., nom. indef.)
يَأْكُلْ: yaʾkul — akala, to eat (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam)
اللَّيْلَةَ: الـ + لَيْلَة — layla, night (f., acc. as adv.); 'this night'
ذَاقَ: dhāqa — to taste (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
مَوْلَايَ: mawlā + -ya — mawlā, master, lord (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my master'
اِمْضِ: imḍi — maḍā, to go, proceed (verb I, imper. 2ms); 'go!'
وَخُذِ: وَ + خُذِ — akhadha, to take (verb I, imper. 2ms, irregular, without hamzat waṣl)
وَحَرْثُهُ: وَ + حَرْث + ـهُ — ḥarth, ploughing (m., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his ploughing' — a nominal clause, not a further imperative
مَكَانَهُ: makān + -ahu — makān, place (m., acc. as adv.) + 3ms suffix; 'in his place, his stead'
الْيَوْمَ: الـ + يَوْم — yawm, day (m., acc. as adv.); 'today'
كُلَّهُ: kull + -ahu — kull, all, whole (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'all of it'
آخِرَ: ākhir — end, last part (m., acc.); 'at the end of'
حَرَثَهُ: ḥaratha + -hu — ḥaratha, to plough (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he ploughed it'
شَكَرَهُ: shakara + -hu — shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he thanked him'
تَفَضُّلَاتِهِ: تَفَضُّلَات + ـهِ — tafaḍḍul, favor, kindness (m. pl. tafaḍḍulāt; gen.) + 3ms suffix
أَرَاحَهُ: arāḥa + -hu — arāḥa, to give rest, relieve (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; masculine although its antecedent تَفَضُّلَاتِهِ is a feminine plural
يَرُدَّ: yaruddu — radda, to return, give back (verb I geminate, jussive 3ms after lam)
وَنَدِمَ: وَ + نَدِمَ — nadima, to regret, repent (verb I, perf. 3ms)
شِدَّةَ: shidda — intensity (f., acc. as adv. intensifier); 'with the utmost of'
أَوْيَوْمَيْنِ: أَوْ + يَوْمَيْنِ — printed fused with no space in the edition (unlike its second occurrence right after, او ثلثة, printed separately); aw, 'or' + yawmayn, two days (dual, acc.); 'or two days'
فَلَمَّاكَانَ: فَـ + لَمَّا + كَانَ — fa-, so/then + lammā, when + kāna, to be, was (perf. 3ms); 'and when it was' (printed by the edition with no space between lammā and kāna, kept as printed)
ثَانِيَ: thānī, second (ordinal adj., m. acc. as khabar kāna, in idāfa with yawm); 'the second (of a)'
يَوْمٍ: yawm — day (m., gen. sg. as second term of the idāfa); ثاني يوم, 'the next day'
الزَّرَّاعُ: الـ + زَرَّاع — zarrāʿ, sower, ploughman, farmer (intensive noun of profession; m., nom.)
وَأَخَذَ: وَ + أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَحَرَثَهُ: وَ + حَرَثَ + ـهُ — ḥaratha, to plow (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix; 'and he plowed with him'
آخِرِ: ākhir — end, last part (m., gen. as first term of idāfa); 'the end of'
فَمَا: فَـ + مَا — fa-, so/and + mā, not (neg. particle)
مَسْلُوخَ: maslūkh — flayed, skinned (pass. part. of salakha; m. acc., first term of idāfa, no tanwīn since idāfa); 'flayed-of'
الرَّقَبَةِ: الـ + رَقَبَة — raqaba, neck (f., gen. as second term of idāfa); مَسْلُوخَ الرَّقَبَةِ, 'flayed-of-neck'
مَيِّتًا: mayyit — dead (act. part. of māta; m. acc. indef., ḥāl)
فَتَأَمَّلَهُ: فَـ + تَأَمَّلَ + ـهُ — taʾammala, to regard closely, contemplate (verb V, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix; 'so he regarded him closely'
فَشَكَرَهُ: فَـ + شَكَرَ + ـهُ — shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix
وَمَدَحَهُ: وَ + مَدَحَ + ـهُ — madaḥa, to praise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix
قَاعِدًا: qāʿid — sitting, seated (act. part. of qaʿada; m. acc. indef., khabar kāna)
بِطُولِي: بِـ + طُول + ـي — bi-, in/by + ṭūl, length, extent (m., gen.) + 1cs suffix; idiom 'sitting at my ease, minding my own time'
خَلَّانِي: khallā — to leave, let be (verb II); perf. 3ms + 1cs object suffix khallānī, 'it left me (alone)'
فُضُولِي: فُضُول + ـي — fuḍūl, meddling, nosiness, prying (m.) + 1cs suffix; 'my meddling'
أَنِّي: أَنَّ + ـِي — anna, that (particle governing the acc.) + 1cs suffix as its subject; 'that I'
نَاصِحٌ: nāṣiḥ — advisor, well-wisher (act. part. of naṣaḥa; m. nom. indef., khabar)
أُسْتَاذَنَا: أُسْتَاذ + ـنَا — ustādh, master, teacher (m., acc.) + 1cp suffix; 'our master'
يَقُمِ: yaqum — he rises, gets up (qāma, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam; -i- helping vowel before the following al-)
مَوْضِعِهِ: مَوْضِع + ـهِ — mawḍiʿ, place, spot (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his place'
أَعْطُوهُ: aʿṭū — give! (verb IV aʿṭā, imper. 2mp) + 3ms object suffix; 'give him!'
لِلْجَزَّارِ: لِـ + الـ + جَزَّار — jazzār, butcher (intensive noun of profession; m., gen.); 'to the butcher'
يَذْبَحُهُ: yadhbaḥu — he slaughters (dhabaḥa, imperf. 3ms) + 3ms object suffix
وَيَعْمَلُ: وَ + يَعْمَلُ — yaʿmalu, he makes, turns (ʿamila, imperf. 3ms)
جِلْدَهُ: جِلْد + ـهُ — jild, hide, skin (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his hide'
قِطَعًا: qiṭaʿ — pieces (m. pl. of qiṭʿa; acc. indef., second complement of yaʿmalu)
نَصَحْتُكَ: naṣaḥtu — I advised (naṣaḥa, perf. 1cs) + 2ms object suffix; 'I have advised you'
كَلَامَ: kalām — speech, words (m., acc., first term of idāfa)
بُكْرَهْ: bukrah — early morning, tomorrow morning (f. time-adverb; the edition prints the word with plain hāʾ, بكره, rather than the expected tāʾ marbūṭa of بُكْرَة, kept as printed); 'tomorrow'
أَسْرَحُ: asraḥu — I go out to pasture (saraḥa, imperf. 1cs)
مَعَهُمْ: مَعَ + ـهُمْ — maʿa, with + 3mp suffix; 'with them'
عَلَفَهُ: عَلَف + ـهُ — ʿalaf, fodder (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his fodder'
بِتَمَامِهِ: بِـ + تَمَام + ـهِ — bi-, with/in + tamām, completeness (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'in its entirety'
الْمِذْوَدَ: الـ + مِذْوَد — midhwad, manger, feeding-trough (m., acc.; instrument/place noun of pattern mifʿal)
بِلِسَانِهِ: بِـ + لِسَان + ـهِ — bi-, with + lisān, tongue (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix
وَصَاحِبُهُمْ: وَ + صَاحِب + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + ṣāḥib, companion, owner, master (m., nom.) + 3mp suffix; 'and their master'
كَلَامَهُمْ: كَلَام + ـهُمْ — kalām, speech (m., acc.) + 3mp suffix; 'their speech'
طَلَعَ: ṭalaʿa — to go up, climb, ascend, rise (verb I, perf. 3ms) — of a person climbing, or of the day breaking; with ilā + a person, idiomatically 'to go in to, be brought before'
خَرَجَ: kharaja — to go out (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَزَوْجَتُهُ: وَ + زَوْجَة + ـهُ — wa-, and + zawja, wife (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix
دَارِ: dār — house, dwelling (f., gen. as first term of idāfa)
الْبَقَرِ: الـ + بَقَر — baqar, cattle, oxen (coll., m., gen.); دَارِ الْبَقَرِ, 'the cattle-house, byre'
فَجَاءَ: فَـ + جَاءَ — fa-, then + jāʾa, to come (perf. 3ms)
أُسْتَاذَهُ: أُسْتَاذ + ـهُ — ustādh, master (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his master'
طَرْطَرَ: ṭarṭara — to flick, whisk (about) (quadriliteral verb I, perf. 3ms; of a tail)
ذَيْلَهُ: ذَيْل + ـهُ — dhayl, tail (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix
وَضَرَطَ: وَ + ضَرَطَ — wa-, and + ḍaraṭa, to fart (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَبَرْطَعَ: وَ + بَرْطَعَ — wa-, and + barṭaʿa, to caper, frisk about (quadriliteral verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَضَحِكَ: فَـ + ضَحِكَ — fa-, so + ḍaḥika, to laugh (verb I, perf. 3ms)
اسْتَلْقَى: istalqā — to lie back, fall backward (verb X, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl, initial alif unmarked)
قَفَاهُ: قَفَا + ـهُ — qafā, nape, back of the neck (m., defective noun) + 3ms suffix
زَوْجَتُهُ: زَوْجَة + ـهُ — zawja, wife (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his wife'
أَيِّ: ayy — which (interrog./indef. noun, gen. as first term of idāfa with shayʾ)
رَأَيْتُهُ: raʾaytu — I saw (raʾā, perf. 1cs; the edition already prints the hamza here, kept precomposed) + 3ms object suffix
وَسَمِعْتُهُ: وَ + سَمِعْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + samiʿtu, I heard (perf. 1cs) + 3ms object suffix
أَبُوحُ: abūḥu — I disclose, reveal (bāḥa, imperf. 1cs, measure I)
فَأَمُوتَ: فَـ + أَمُوتَ — fa-, so/or else + amūta, I die (māta, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after fa- of result)
تُخْبِرَنِي: tukhbira — you inform (akhbara, imperf. 2ms subjunctive, measure IV) + 1cs object suffix
وَبِسَبَبِ: وَ + بِـ + سَبَب — wa-, and + bi-, by reason of + sabab, cause, reason (m., gen.)
ضَحِكِكَ: ضَحِك + ـكَ — ḍaḥik, laughing, laughter (m., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your laughing'
تَمُوتُ: tamūtu — you die, dying (māta, imperf. 2ms, khabar kunta)
أُبِيحَ: ubīḥa — I disclose, reveal (abāḥa, imperf. 1cs subjunctive, measure IV)
خَوْفًا: khawf — fear (m., acc. indef., object for the sake of which); 'for fear'
إِنَّهَا: إِنَّ + ـهَا — inna, indeed (particle) + 3fs suffix as its subject; 'indeed she'
تَزَلْ: tazal — she ceases (zāla, imperf. 3fs jussive after lam; lam tazal, 'she did not cease')
تُلِحُّ: tuliḥḥu — she presses, insists (alaḥḥa, imperf. 3fs, measure IV of laḥḥa)
وَتَلِجُّ: وَ + تَلِجُّ — wa-, and + talijju, she persists stubbornly (lajja, imperf. 3fs)
غُلِبَ: ghuliba — he was overcome, overpowered (ghalaba, perf. 3ms pass.)
وَضَجِرَ: وَ + ضَجِرَ — wa-, and + ḍajira, to grow weary, exasperated (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَأَحْضَرَ: فَـ + أَحْضَرَ — fa-, so + aḥḍara, to summon, bring (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
أَوْلَادَهُ: أَوْلَاد + ـهُ — awlād, children, sons (m. pl.; acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'
وَأَرْسَلَ: وَ + أَرْسَلَ — wa-, and + arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
أَحْضِرِ: aḥḍir — bring! (verb IV aḥḍara, imper. 2ms; -i helping vowel before the following al-)
الْقَاضِيَ: الـ + قَاضِي — qāḍī, judge (m., defective noun, acc. as object of aḥḍir)
وَالشُّهُودَ: وَ + الـ + شُهُود — wa-, and + shuhūd, witnesses (m. pl. of shāhid; acc., coordinated with al-qāḍiya)
وَأَرَادَ: وَ + أَرَادَ — wa-, and + arāda, to wish, intend (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
يُوصِيَ: yūṣiya — he make his testament, bequeath (awṣā, imperf. 3ms subjunctive, measure IV)
وَيُبِيحَ: وَ + يُبِيحَ — wa-, and + yubīḥa, he disclose (abāḥa, imperf. 3ms subjunctive, measure IV)
بِالسِّرِّ: بِـ + الـ + سِرّ — bi-, with + sirr, secret (m., gen.)
وَيَمُوتَ: وَ + يَمُوتَ — wa-, and + yamūta, he die (māta, imperf. 3ms subjunctive)
لِأَنَّهُ: لِـ + أَنَّ + ـهُ — li-, because + anna, that (particle) + 3ms suffix as its subject; 'because he'
يُحِبُّهَا: yuḥibbu — he loves (aḥabba, imperf. 3ms, measure IV) + 3fs object suffix
مَحَبَّةً: maḥabba — love, affection (f., acc., cognate object of yuḥibbu)
عَظِيمَةً: ʿaẓīma — great, mighty (adj., f. sg. acc. agreeing with maḥabba)
بِنْتُ: bint — daughter (f., nom., first term of idāfa)
عَمِّهِ: عَمّ + ـهِ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his paternal uncle'
وَأُمُّ: وَ + أُمُّ — wa-, and + umm, mother (f., nom., first term of idāfa)
أَوْلَادِهِ: أَوْلَاد + ـهِ — awlād, children (m. pl., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'
عُمِّرَ: ʿummira — he was granted long life, he lived to (ʿammara, perf. 3ms pass., measure II)
الْعُمُرِ: الـ + عُمُر — ʿumur, age, lifetime (m., gen.)
مِأْيَةً: miʾya — hundred (f., acc. as a numeral in a time-duration phrase; the edition spells the word with the hamza on the alif rather than on the yāʾ, as in the ordinary spelling مِائَة/مِئَة — kept as printed and read as 'a hundred')
وَعِشْرِينَ: وَ + عِشْرِينَ — wa-, and + ʿishrīn, twenty (numeral, acc./gen. form)
أَبُو: abū — father of (m., nom. of the 'five nouns', first term of an iḍāfa, in apposition to zawjuki)
أَبِيهَا: أَب + ـهَا — ab, father (m.; one of the 'five nouns', oblique form abī) + 3fs poss.; 'her father'
أَحْضَرَ: aḥḍara — to have brought, cause to be present (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
أَرْجِعُ: arjiʿu — rajaʿa, to turn back, return (verb I, imperf. 1s)
أَسَرِّ: asarr — happiest, most delightful (elative of sārr; m., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); fī asarri l-aḥwāl = 'in the happiest of conditions', a fixed idiom
أَفْعَلُ: afʿalu — faʿala, to do (verb I, imperf. 1s); 'I will do' — not the imperative
أَقُولَ: aqūla — qāla, to say, tell (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 1s after ḥattā)
أَمْرَهُ: أَمْر + ـهُ — amr, affair, matter (m., acc. as object) + 3ms poss.; 'his affair'
أَهْلِهَا: أَهْل + ـهَا — ahl, people, family (m., gen. as second term of jamīʿ's iḍāfa) + 3fs poss.; 'her people'
أَوْلَادِكِ: أَوْلَاد + ـكِ — walad, child, son (m. pl. awlād; gen.) + 2fs poss.; 'your children'
أُرَاضِي: urāḍī — rāḍā, to please, keep content (verb III, imperf. 1s)
أُغْمِيَ: ughmiya — aghmā ʿalā, to overcome, cause to faint (verb IV, passive perf. 3ms); ughmiya ʿalayhā = 'she fainted'
ابْنَةُ: ibna — daughter (f., nom., hamzat waṣl, first term of an iḍāfa)
اتْرُكِي: تَرَكَ — taraka, to leave, abandon (verb I, imper. 2fs, hamzat waṣl); 'leave (it)!'
التَّاجِرَ: الـ + تَاجِر — tājir, merchant (m., acc. as subject of inna)
التُّوتِ: الـ + تُوت — tūt, mulberry (m., gen.); ʿīdān al-tūt = mulberry rods, switches for beating
الدَّوَابِّ: الـ + دَوَابّ — dābba, beast, animal (f. broken pl. dawābb; gen.); dār al-dawābb = the stable
الدِّيكَ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., acc. as object)
الدِّيكُ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., nom. as subject)
الدِّيكِ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., gen. after ʿalā)
الْأَحْوَالِ: الـ + أَحْوَال — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f. pl. aḥwāl; gen.)
الْجَمَاعَةُ: الـ + جَمَاعَة — jamāʿa, company, group, party (f., nom. as subject)
الْخِزَانَةَ: الـ + خِزَانَة — khizāna, closet, storeroom (f., acc. as object)
الْخِزَانَةِ: الـ + خِزَانَة — khizāna, closet, storeroom (f., gen.)
الْعَقْلِ: الـ + عَقْل — ʿaql, mind, reason, wit (m., gen.)
الْقِصَّةَ: الـ + قِصَّة — qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., acc. as object)
الْكَلْبَ: الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., acc. as object)
الْكَلْبُ: الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., nom. as subject)
الْمَمَاتِ: الـ + مَمَات — mamāt, death (m., gen. after ilā)
بَابَ: bāb — door, gate (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
بَاسَتْ: bāsat — bāsa, to kiss (verb I, perf. 3fs)
بِالضَّرْبِ: بِـ + الـ + ضَرْب — ḍarb, beating, striking (m., gen. after bi-)
بِزَوْجَتِهِ: بِـ + زَوْجَة + ـهِ — zawja, wife (f., gen. after bi-) + 3ms poss.; 'with his wife'
بِهَا: بِـ + ـهَا — bi-, with (prep.) + 3fs suffix; 'with her'
تَتُوبَ: tatūba — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3fs)
تَسْأَلُهُ: تَسْأَلُ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; the edition already prints the hamza seat here
تَعُودَ: taʿūda — ʿāda, to return, go back (to doing something) (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3fs)
تَمُوتَ: tamūta — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3fs after ḥattā)
تُبْتُ: tubtu — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I repent'
جَارَتِهِ: جَارَة + ـهِ — jāra, female neighbor (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his (female) neighbor'
جَمِيعُ: jamīʿ — all, the whole of (m., nom. as subject, first term of an iḍāfa)
حَضَرَهَا: حَضَرَ + ـهَا — ḥaḍara, to be present, attend (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'was present with her'
حِكَايَةٌ: ḥikāya — tale, story (f., nom. indef., delayed subject of the nominal sentence)
خِزَانَةٍ: khizāna — closet, storeroom, cabinet (f., gen. indef. after ilā)
دَجَاجَةً: dajāja — hen (f., acc. sg. as the counted noun after khamsūna)
دَخَلَ: dakhala — to enter, go in (verb I, perf. 3ms)
دِيكٌ: dīk — rooster, cock (m., nom. indef., subject of kāna)
رَائِحٌ: rāʾiḥ — going, departing (act. part. I of rāḥa; m. nom.); with a following imperfect, 'going to, about to'
زَوْجَةً: zawja — wife (f., acc. sg. as the counted noun after khamsīna)
زَوْجَةٍ: zawja — wife (f., gen. indef., second term of the iḍāfa with fardu)
زَوْجُكِ: زَوْج + ـكِ — zawj, husband (m., nom. as subject) + 2fs poss.; 'your husband'
سَمِعَتِ: samiʿati — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3fs; final vowel -i as liaison before the following hamzat waṣl)
سِرِّهِ: سِرّ + ـهِ — sirr, secret (m., gen. after ʿalā) + 3ms poss.; 'his secret'
شَهْرَزَادَ: Shahrazād — the vizier's daughter's name (proper name, diptote, gen. in apposition to ibnatihi)
شَيْ: shayʾ — thing, anything; the edition's colloquial spelling drops the word's final hamza entirely, shay for shayʾ
عَلَيْهَا: عَلَى + ـهَا — ʿalā, upon, against (prep.) + 3fs suffix; here 'for use against her'
عَنْهُ: عَنْ + ـهُ — ʿan, from, away from (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'from it'
عِنْدِهِمْ: عِنْدَ + ـهِمْ — ʿinda, at, with, among (prep.) + 3mp suffix; 'from among them'
عِيدَانِ: عِيدَان — ʿūd, stick, rod (m. pl. ʿīdān; gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
فَأَعَادَ: فَـ + أَعَادَ — aʿāda, to repeat, do again (verb IV, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'to recount to'
فَدَخَلَتْ: فَـ + دَخَلَتْ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'so she entered'
فَرْحَانُ: farḥān — joyful, glad (adj. of the faʿlān pattern, m. nom., predicate of anta)
فَرْدُ: fard — single, sole (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
فَسَكَتُوا: فَـ + سَكَتُوا — sakata, to fall silent (verb I, perf. 3mp)
فَسَمِعَ: فَـ + سَمِعَ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَامَ: qāma — to rise, get up (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
قَفَلَ: qafala — to lock, bolt (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَلِيلُ: qalīl — little, scant (adj., m. nom., first term of an iḍāfa, predicate of inna); qalīl al-ʿaql = 'scant of wit, foolish'
لِئَلَّا: لِـ + أَلَّا — li- + allā (an + lā), so that not; 'lest'
لِابْنَتِهِ: لِـ + ابْنَة + ـهِ — ibna, daughter (f., gen. after li-, hamzat waṣl) + 3ms poss.; 'to his daughter'
لِلْكَلْبِ: لِـ + الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., gen. after li-)
مَاتَ: māta — to die (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
مَعَكِ: مَعَ + ـكِ — maʿa, with (prep.) + 2fs suffix; 'with you'
مَقَالَةَ: maqāla — saying, speech, utterance (f., acc. as object, first term of an iḍāfa)
مِثْلَ: mithla — like, the equal of (adv. acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
وَأَدَعَهُ: وَ + أَدَعَ + ـهُ — wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let be (verb I, defective in the perfect, imperf. subjunctive 1s) + 3ms obj.; 'and I leave him'
وَأَمُوتَ: وَ + أَمُوتَ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 1s)
وَأَهْلَ: وَ + أَهْل — ahl, people, family (m., acc., coordinate object of aḥḍara, first term of its own iḍāfa)
وَأَهْلُهَا: وَ + أَهْل + ـهَا — ahl, people, family (m., nom.) + 3fs poss.; 'and her people'
وَأُسْتَاذُنَا: وَ + أُسْتَاذ + ـنَا — ustādh, master (m., nom. as topic) + 1pl poss.; 'and our master'
وَأُصَالِحُ: وَ + أُصَالِحُ — ṣālaḥa, to make peace with, reconcile with (verb III, imperf. 1s)
وَإِنَّهُ: وَ + إِنَّ + ـهُ — inna, indeed (particle) + 3ms subject; 'and indeed he/it'
وَإِيَّاهُ: وَ + إِيَّا + ـهُ — iyyā-, the independent object-pronoun base + 3ms suffix; 'and him'
وَتَابَتْ: وَ + تَابَتْ — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَتَحْتَهُ: وَ + تَحْتَ + ـهُ — taḥta, under, beneath (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'and under him'
وَتَوَجَّهَ: وَ + تَوَجَّهَ — tawajjaha, to make one's way, set out (verb V, perf. 3ms)
وَخَبَأَهُمْ: وَ + خَبَأَ + ـهُمْ — khabaʾa, to hide, conceal (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.; the edition already prints this hamza; 'and hid them'
وَخَرَجَتْ: وَ + خَرَجَتْ — kharaja, to go out, leave (verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَرِجْلَيْهِ: وَ + رِجْل (dual) + ـهِ — rijl, foot (f. dual acc. rijlayn) + 3ms poss.; 'and his two feet'
وَفَرِحُوا: وَ + فَرِحُوا — fariḥa, to rejoice, be glad (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَقَعَدُوا: وَ + قَعَدُوا — qaʿada, to sit, settle, remain (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَنَزَلَ: وَ + نَزَلَ — nazala, to come down, descend (verb I, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā bi-, 'to set upon with'
وَيَدْخُلْ: وَ + يَدْخُلْ — dakhala, to enter, go in (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms, coordinate with yaʾkhudh under lam)
وَيَسُبُّ: وَ + يَسُبُّ — sabba, to curse, revile (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms)
وَيَضْرِبْهَا: وَ + يَضْرِبْ + ـهَا — ḍaraba, to strike, beat (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and beat her'
وَيَقُولُ: وَ + يَقُولُ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
وَيَمُوتُ: وَ + يَمُوتُ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. indic. 3ms)
يَأْخُذْ: yaʾkhudh — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms after lam); the edition prints يأخذ with its hamza seat already in place
يَتَوَضَّى: tawaḍḍā — to perform ablution, wash (verb V, imperf. 3ms); the edition drops the verb's usual final hamza (Classical tawaḍḍaʾa), spelling it as a final-weak verb
يَسُوسُ: yasūsu — sāsa, to manage, govern, administer (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); here as a bare complement verb after yaʿrifu, 'know how to manage'
يَعْرِفُ: yaʿrifu — ʿarafa, to know (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
يَقُولَ: yaqūla — qāla, to say, tell (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after ḥattā)
يَمُوتَ: yamūta — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after li-allā)
يَمُوتُ: yamūtu — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. indic. 3ms); 'he dies'
يَنْظُرَنِي: yanẓuranī — naẓara, to look, see (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'see me'
يُخَاطِبُ: yukhāṭibu — khāṭaba, to address, speak to (verb III, imperf. 3ms)
يُنَادِي: yunādī — nādā, to call out, cry aloud (verb III, imperf. 3ms)
فَجَهَّزَهَا: فَ + جَهَّزَ + هَا — jahhaza, to make ready, equip, prepare (a bride) (v. II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'so he made her ready'
وَطَلَعَ: وَ + طَلَعَ — ṭalaʿa, to go up, ascend; here loosely 'go in to' (v. I, perf. 3ms)
أَوْصَتْ: awṣat — awṣā, to charge, instruct, enjoin (v. IV, perf. 3fs); 'she had instructed'
أُخْتَهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., acc.) + 3fs poss.; 'her sister'
الصَّغِيرَةَ: الـ + صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., acc.)
تَوَجَّهْتُ: tawajjahtu — tawajjaha, to set out, head toward, proceed (v. V, perf. 1cs); 'I have gone, I proceed'
أُرْسِلُ: ursilu — arsala, to send (v. IV, imperf. 1cs); 'I send, I will send'
أَطْلُبُكِ: أَطْلُبُ + كِ — ṭalaba, to seek, ask for, send for (v. I, imperf. 1cs) + 2fs obj.; 'I summon you'
فَإِذَا: فَ + إِذَا — fa-, so, then + idhā, when; 'then when'
جِئْتِ: jiʾti — jāʾa, to come (v. I, perf. 2fs); 'you have come'
وَرَأَيْتِ: وَ + رَأَيْتِ — raʾā, to see (v. I, perf. 2fs); 'and you have seen'
قَضَى: qaḍā — to accomplish, fulfill, finish (v. I, perf. 3ms)
حَاجَتَهُ: حَاجَة + هُ — ḥāja, need, want (f., acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his need'
تَقُولِي: taqūlī — qāla, to say (v. I, imperf./juss. 2fs, without the final nūn); 'you shall say'
أُخْتِي: أُخْت + ي — ukht, sister (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'my sister'
حَدِّثِينِي: حَدِّثِي + نِي — ḥaddatha, to tell, narrate, relate (v. II, imper. 2fs) + 1cs obj.; 'tell me'
حَدِيثًا: ḥadīthan — ḥadīth, an account, a tale, a discourse (m., indef. acc.)
وَكَلَامًا: وَ + كَلَامًا — kalām, speech, talk, conversation (m., indef. acc.)
نَقْطَعُ: naqṭaʿu — qaṭaʿa, to cut (v. I, imperf. 1pl); with bi-, 'we while away, pass (the time)'
وَالسَّهَرَ: وَ + الـ + سَهَر — sahar, wakefulness, sleeplessness (m., acc.)
أُحَدِّثُكِ: أُحَدِّثُ + كِ — ḥaddatha, to tell, relate (v. II, imperf. 1cs) + 2fs obj.; 'I shall tell you'
شَاءَ: shāʾa — to will, wish (v. I, perf. 3ms)
الْخَلَاصُ: الـ + خَلَاص — khalāṣ, deliverance, escape, release (m., nom.)
أَبَاهَا: أَب + هَا — ab, father (m., irregular noun, acc. as ism of inna) + 3fs poss.; 'her father'
رَآهُ: رَأَى + هُ — raʾā, to see (v. I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'he saw him'
فَرِحَ: fariḥa — to rejoice, be glad (v. I, perf. 3ms)
أَتَيْتَ: atayta — atā, to come, bring (v. I, perf. 2ms); 'you have brought'
بِحَاجَتِي: بِـ + حَاجَة + ي — ḥāja, need (f., gen. after bi-) + 1cs poss.; 'with my need'
يَدْخُلَ: yadkhula — dakhala, to enter, go in (v. I, imperf. subj. 3ms)
فَبَكَتْ: فَ + بَكَتْ — bakā, to weep (v. I, perf. 3fs)
مَالَكِ: مَا + لَـ + كِ — mā, what (interrog.) + li- + 2fs; 'what is with you, what ails you' (printed by the edition as one word)
أَيُّهَا: ayyuhā — O (vocative particle used before a following definite noun)
صَغِيرَةً: ṣaghīratan — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., indef. acc.)
وَأُرِيدُ: وَ + أُرِيدُ — arāda, to want, wish (v. IV, imperf. 1cs)
أُوَدِّعَهَا: وَدَّعَ + هَا — waddaʿa, to bid farewell to, take leave of (v. II, subj. 1cs after an) + 3fs obj.; 'that I bid her farewell'
فَأَرْسَلَ: فَ + أَرْسَلَ — arsala, to send (v. IV, perf. 3ms)
فَجَاءَتْ: فَ + جَاءَتْ — jāʾa, to come (v. I, perf. 3fs)
أُخْتِهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., gen.) + 3fs poss.
وَعَانَقَتْهَا: وَ + عَانَقَتْ + هَا — ʿānaqa, to embrace (v. III, perf. 3fs) + 3fs obj.
وَجَلَسَتْ: وَ + جَلَسَتْ — jalasa, to sit (v. I, perf. 3fs)
السَّرِيرِ: الـ + سَرِير — sarīr, bed, couch (m., gen.)
فَقَامَ: فَ + قَامَ — qāma, to rise, stand up (v. I, perf. 3ms)
بَكَارَتَهَا: بَكَارَة + هَا — bakāra, virginity, maidenhead (f., acc.) + 3fs poss.
يَتَحَدَّثُونَ: yataḥaddathūna — taḥaddatha, to converse, talk together (v. V, imperf. 3mp)
أُخْتُهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., nom.) + 3fs poss.
الصَّغِيرَةُ: الـ + صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., nom.)
حَدِّثِينَا: حَدِّثِي + نَا — ḥaddatha, to tell (v. II, imper. 2fs) + 1pl obj.; 'tell us'
سَهَرَ: sahara — sahar, wakefulness, sleeplessness (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
لَيْلَتِنَا: لَيْلَة + نَا — layla, night (f., gen.) + 1pl poss.; 'our night'
حُبًّا: ḥubban — ḥubb, love, fondness (m., indef. acc. of manner); with wa-karāmatan, the fixed idiom 'gladly'
أَذِنَ: adhina — to give leave, permit (v. I, perf. 3ms)
الْمُهَذَّبُ: الـ + مُهَذَّب — muhadhdhab, refined, courteous, well-bred (pass. part. of II hadhdhaba; m., nom.)
مِنْهُمَا: مِنْ + هُمَا — min, from (prep.) + 3rd dual pron.; 'from the two of them'
قَلِقًا: qaliqan — qaliq, restless, uneasy, anxious (adj., m., indef. acc.)
لِسَمَاعِ: لِـ + سَمَاعِ — li-, at, because of (prep. of cause) + samāʿ, hearing, listening (verbal noun of samiʿa; m., gen.)
الْحَدِيثِ: الـ + حَدِيث — ḥadīth, account, story, talk (m., gen.)
فَأَذِنَ: فَ + أَذِنَ — adhina, to give leave, permit (v. I, perf. 3ms)
وَالْجِنِّيِّ: وَ + الـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, jinni, genie (nisba noun from jinn; m., gen.)
و: wa- — 'and' (the plain coordinating conjunction, printed here as its own space-delimited token, at a line-break, rather than fused to the next word)
َكَرَامَةً: karāma — honor, generosity (f., indef. acc. of manner); ḥubban wa-karāmatan = 'gladly, with pleasure'
وَ: wa- — 'and' (the plain coordinating conjunction, printed here as its own space-delimited token, at a line-break, rather than fused to the next word)
كَرَامَةً: karāma — honor, generosity (f., indef. acc. of manner); ḥubban wa-karāmatan = 'gladly, with pleasure'
اللَّيْلَةُ: الـ + لَيْلَة — layla, night (f., nom.); 'the night'
الْأُولَى: الـ + أُولَى — ūlā, first (f. elative of awwal; nom.); 'the first'
السَّعِيدُ: الـ + سَعِيد — saʿīd, happy, fortunate (adj., m. sg., nom.)
تَاجِرٌ: tājir — merchant (m., nom. indef., subject of kāna)
كَثِيرَ: kathīr — much, abundant (adj., m. sg. acc. as predicate of kāna)
الْمَالِ: الـ + مَال — māl, wealth, property (m., gen.)
وَالْمُعَامَلَاتِ: وَ + الـ + مُعَامَلَات — muʿāmala, dealing, transaction (f. pl.; gen.)
الْبِلَادِ: الـ + بِلَاد — balad, country, land (m. pl. bilād; gen.)
فَرَكِبَ: فَـ + رَكِبَ — rakiba, to ride, mount (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يُطَالِبُ: ṭālaba — to seek payment (from), press a claim (verb III, imperf. 3ms; circumstantial, 'seeking payment')
فَجَلَسَ: فَـ + جَلَسَ — jalasa, to sit down (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَحَطَّ: وَ + حَطَّ — ḥaṭṭa, to put down, place (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَدَهُ: يَد + ـهُ — yad, hand (f., acc.) + 3ms; 'his hand'
خُرْجِهِ: خُرْج + ـهِ — khurj, saddlebag, travel-pouch (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'his saddlebag'
فَأَخْرَجَ: فَـ + أَخْرَجَ — akhraja, to take out, bring out (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
كِسْرَةً: kisra — piece, morsel (of bread) (f., acc. indef.)
وَتَمْرَةً: وَ + تَمْرَة — tamra, a date (fruit) (f., acc. indef.)
فَأَكَلَ: فَـ + أَكَلَ — akala, to eat (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْكِسْرَةَ: الـ + كِسْرَة — kisra, piece, morsel (f., acc.)
وَالتَّمْرَةَ: وَ + الـ + تَمْرَة — tamra, date (f., acc.)
فَرَغَ: faragha — to finish, be done (with) (verb I, perf. 3ms; with min)
أَكْلِ: akl — eating (verbal noun of akala; m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
رَمَى: ramā — to throw, cast away (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
النَّوَاةَ: الـ + نَوَاة — nawāh, stone, pit (of a date) (f., acc.)
بِعِفْرِيتٍ: بِـ + عِفْرِيت — bi-, with; after wa-idhā huwa it marks what suddenly appears ('and behold, there he was, faced with…') + ʿifrīt, ifrit, a powerful jinni (m., gen. indef.)
وَبِيَدِهِ: وَ + بِـ + يَد + ـهِ — yad, hand (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'and in his hand'
مَسْلُولٌ: maslūl — drawn, unsheathed (pass. part. of salla; m. nom. indef.)
فَدَنَى: فَـ + دَنَى — danā, to draw near, approach (verb I, perf. 3ms; the edition spells the final weak radical with ى rather than ا)
أَقْتُلَكَ: أَقْتُلَ + ـكَ — qatala, to kill (verb I, impf. subjunctive 1sg after ḥattā) + 2ms obj.; 'that I may kill you'
مَاقَتَلْتَ: مَا + قَتَلْتَ — mā, that which (rel. pron.) + qatalta, you killed (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'what/as you killed' (printed as one joined word)
وَلَدِي: وَلَد + ـي — walad, son, child (m., acc.) + 1s poss.; 'my son'
قَتَلْتُ: qatala — to kill (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I killed'
وَلَدَكَ: وَلَد + ـكَ — walad, son (m., acc.) + 2ms; 'your son'
أَكَلْتَ: akala — to eat (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you ate'
وَرَمَيْتَ: وَ + رَمَيْتَ — ramā, to throw (verb I defective, perf. 2ms); 'and you threw'
نَوَاتَهَا: نَوَاة + ـهَا — nawāh, stone, pit (f., acc.) + 3fs; 'its stone'
جَاءَتِ: jāʾa — to come (verb I, perf. 3fs jāʾat; -i is the linking vowel before the following hamzat waṣl)
النَّوَاةُ: الـ + نَوَاة — nawāh, stone, pit (f., nom.)
صَدْرِ: ṣadr — chest, breast (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
مَشَى: mashā — to walk, go on foot (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
فَمَاتَ: فَـ + مَاتَ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
إِنَّا: إِنَّ + ـا — inna, indeed, truly (particle) + 1pl; 'truly we'
وَإِنَّا: وَ + إِنَّ + ـا — inna, indeed, truly (particle) + 1pl; 'and truly we'
رَاجِعُونَ: rājiʿ — returning (act. part. of rajaʿa; m. sound pl., nom.)
حَوْلَ: ḥawl — power, might (m., acc., mabnī with no tanwin, after the lā of absolute negation)
قُوَّةَ: quwwa — strength, power (f., acc., mabnī with no tanwin, after the lā of absolute negation)
الْعَلِىِّ: الـ + عَلِيّ — ʿaliyy, most high, exalted (adj., m. sg., gen.; the edition spells the final radical with alif maqṣūra ى rather than ي)
الْعَظِيمِ: الـ + عَظِيم — al- + ʿaẓīm, mighty, great (adj., m. gen.)
قَتَلْتُهُ: قَتَلْتُ + ـهُ — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'I killed him'
خَطًا: khaṭaʾ — error, mistake (m., acc. indef.; the edition drops the root-final hamza of khaṭaʾan, spelling the word with a bare alif)
تَعْفُوَ: ʿafā — to pardon, forgive (verb I defective, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after an)
الْجِنِّىُّ: الـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, jinni (m. sg., nom.; the edition spells the final radical with alif maqṣūra ى rather than ي)
قَتْلِكَ: قَتْل + ـكَ — qatl, killing (verbal noun, m., gen.) + 2ms; 'your killing, killing you'
جَذَبَهُ: جَذَبَ + ـهُ — jadhaba, to pull, seize, drag (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'he seized him'
وَبَطَحَهُ: وَ + بَطَحَ + ـهُ — baṭaḥa, to throw flat, stretch out on the ground (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'and threw him down'
وَرَفَعَ: وَ + رَفَعَ — rafaʿa, to raise, lift (verb I, perf. 3ms)
لِيَضْرِبَهُ: لِـ + يَضْرِبَ + ـهُ — ḍaraba, to strike, hit (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after the lām of purpose) + 3ms obj.; 'to strike him'
فَبَكَى: فَـ + بَكَى — bakā, to weep (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
فَوَّضْتُ: fawwaḍa — to entrust, commit (a matter to someone) (verb II, perf. 1cs); 'I have committed'
أَمْرِي: أَمْر + ـي — amr, affair, matter (m., acc.) + 1cs; 'my affair'
وَأَنْشَدَ: وَ + أَنْشَدَ — anshada, to recite (verse) (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
اَلدَّهْرُ: الـ + دَهْر — dahr, time, fate, the age (m., nom.); 'time'
يَوْمَانِ: يَوْم (dual) — yawm, day (m. dual, nom.); 'two days'
وَذَا: وَ + ذَا — wa- + dhā, this (dem. pron.); 'and that one'
حَذَرٌ: ḥadhar — wariness, caution, fear (m., nom. indef.)
وَالْعَيْشُ: وَ + الـ + عَيْش — ʿaysh, life, living (m., nom.)
شَطْرَانِ: شَطْر (dual) — shaṭr, half, portion (m. dual, nom.)
صَفْوٌ: ṣafw — clarity, purity, ease (m., nom. indef.)
كَدَرٌ: kadar — turbidity, trouble, murkiness (m., nom. indef.)
لِلَّذِي: لِـ + الَّذِي — li- + alladhī, who, which (rel. pron., m. sg.); 'to the one who'
بِصُرُوفِ: بِـ + صُرُوف — ṣarf, turn, vicissitude (m. pl. ṣurūf; gen.); 'with the turns of'
الدَّهْرِ: الـ + دَهْر — dahr, time, fate (m., gen.)
عَيَّرَنَا: عَيَّرَ + ـنَا — ʿayyara, to reproach, taunt (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 1pl obj. suffix; 'he reproached us'
عَانَدَ: ʿānada — to oppose, contend with, defy stubbornly (verb III, perf. 3ms)
الدَّهْرَ: الـ + دَهْر — dahr, time, fate (m., acc.)
خَطَرٌ: khaṭar — standing, importance, worth, peril (m., nom. indef.)
اَمَا: a- + mā — interrogative hamza + negation, forming a rhetorical 'do you not…?'
هَبَّتْ: habbat — habba, to blow (of wind) (verb I, perf. 3fs)
عَوَاصِفُهَا: عَوَاصِف + ـهَا — ʿāṣifa, storm, squall (f. pl. ʿawāṣif, nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'its storms'
فَلَيْسَ: فَـ + لَيْسَ — fa- + laysa, is not (verb of negation)
تَعْصِفُ: taʿṣifu — ʿaṣafa, to blow violently, rage (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
الشَّجَرُ: الـ + شَجَر — shajar, tree(s) (coll., m., nom.)
تَرَي: tarā — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 2ms; edition's spelling with final yāʾ for alif maqṣūra)
تَعْلُو: taʿlū — ʿalā/yaʿlū, to rise, float above (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
فَوْقَهُ: فَوْقَ + ـهُ — fawqa, above (adv./prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'above it'
جِيَفٌ: jiyaf — jīfa, carcass, carrion (f. pl. jiyaf; nom. indef.)
وَتَسْتَقِرُّ: وَ + تَسْتَقِرُّ — istaqarra, to settle, become fixed (verb X, imperf. 3fs)
بِاَقْصَى: بِـ + اَقْصَى — aqṣā, farthest, utmost (elative, m., gen. after bi-); 'at the farthest of'
قَعْرِهِ: قَعْر + ـهِ — qaʿr, bottom, depth (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'its depth'
الدُّرَرُ: الـ + دُرَر — durra, pearl (f. pl. durar; nom.)
فَاِنْ: فَـ + اِنْ — fa- + in, so if (conditional particle)
يَكُنْ: yakun — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms jussive after in)
عَبَثَتْ: ʿabathat — ʿabatha, to toy with, trifle, play idly (verb I, perf. 3fs)
اَيْدِي: aydī — yad, hand (f. pl. aydī; nom., construct)
وَنَا: وَ + نَا — printed with a stray space for what is read as wa-nāla-, 'and it/harm reached'; نَا here belongs with the following لَنَا rather than standing as the independent pronoun
تَمَادِي: tamādī — tamādā, to persist, continue at length (verb VI, verbal noun in construct); 'the persisting of'
بُوسِهِ: بُوس + ـهِ — būs, misery, wretchedness (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'its misery'
الضَّرَرُ: الـ + ضَرَر — ḍarar, harm, damage (m., nom.)
فَفِي: فَـ + فِي — fa- + fī, so in (prep.)
نُجُومٌ: nujūm — najm, star (m. pl. nujūm; nom. indef.)
عِدَادَ: ʿidād — count, number, reckoning (m., acc., with absolute negation lā)
وَلَيْسَ: وَ + لَيْسَ — wa-, and + laysa, is not (defective negating verb, 3ms)
يُكْسَفُ: yuksafu — kasafa, to eclipse; pass. imperf. 3ms, 'is eclipsed'
وَالْقَمَرُ: وَ + الـ + قَمَر — qamar, moon (m., nom.)
وَكَمْ: وَ + كَمْ — wa- + kam, and how many! (exclamatory particle)
الْاَرْضِ: الـ + اَرْض — arḍ, earth, ground (f., gen.); edition prints without a hamza seat (الارض), supplied here as a combining mark
خَضْرَا: khaḍrā — khaḍrāʾ, a green (thing) (adj. used as noun, f. sg.; edition's spelling without the final hamza)
وَيَابِسَةٍ: وَ + يَابِسَة — yābis, dry, withered (act. part., f. sg. yābisa; gen. indef.)
يُرْجَمُ: yurjamu — rajama, to stone, pelt with stones; pass. imperf. 3ms
اَحْسَنْتَ: aḥsanta — aḥsana, to do well, make good (verb IV, perf. 2ms); 'you made good'
ظَنَّكَ: ظَنّ + ـكَ — ẓann, opinion, supposition (m., acc.) + 2ms suffix; 'your opinion'
بِالْاَيَّامِ: بِـ + الـ + اَيَّام — bi-, of, concerning (prep.; ẓann bi- = an opinion of) + yawm, day (m. pl. ayyām; gen.); edition prints without a hamza seat (الايام), supplied here as a combining mark
حَسُنَتْ: ḥasunat — ḥasuna, to be good, be fair (verb I, perf. 3fs)
تَخَفْ: takhaf — khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, imperf. 2ms jussive)
يَاتِي: yaʾtī — atā, to come, bring (verb I, imperf. 3ms; edition's spelling without a hamza seat, يأتي)
الْقَدَرُ: الـ + قَدَر — qadar, fate, decree, destiny (m., nom.)
شِعْرِهِ: شِعْر + ـهِ — shiʿr, verse, poetry (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his verse'
أَقْصِرْ: aqṣir — aqṣara, to cut short, desist from (verb IV, imper. 2ms)
كَلَامَكَ: كَلَام + ـكَ — kalām, speech, words (m., acc.) + 2ms suffix; 'your speech'
اِعْلَمْ: ʿalima/yaʿlamu — to know; ms imperative اِعْلَمْ (hamzat waṣl, carries no hamza mark)
الْعِفْرِيتُ: الـ + عِفْرِيت — ʿifrīt, demon, powerful jinni (m., nom.)
وَلِي: وَ + لِي — wa- + lī, and to me, and I have
كَثِيرٌ: kathīr — much, many, abundant (adj., m., nom. indef.)
وَزَوْجَةٌ: وَ + زَوْجَة — zawja, wife (f., nom. indef.)
وَرُهُونٌ: وَ + رُهُون — rahn, pledge, security, collateral (m. pl. ruhūn; nom. indef.)
فَدَعْنِي: فَـ + دَعْ + ـنِي — daʿa, to leave, let (verb I, imper. 2ms) + 1s obj. suffix; 'so let me'
أَرُوحُ: arūḥu — rāḥa, to go, depart (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s)
بَيْتِي: بَيْت + ـِي — bayt, house (m., gen.) + 1s suffix; 'my house'
وَأُوَصِّلُ: وَ + أُوَصِّلُ — waṣṣala, to convey, deliver (verb II, imperf. 1s); 'and I deliver'
ذِي: dhī — possessor of (construct noun, m., gen.); 'possessor of'
حَقٍّ: ḥaqq — right, due, claim (m., gen. indef.)
حَقَّهُ: حَقّ + ـهُ — ḥaqq, right, due (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his due'
وَأَعُودُ: وَ + أَعُودُ — ʿāda, to return (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s); 'and I return'
رَأْسِ: رَأْس — raʾs, head; here idiomatic, 'the start of' (m., gen.); edition prints without a hamza seat (راس), supplied here as a combining mark
وَلَكَ: وَ + لَكَ — wa- + laka, and to you, and you have
عَهْدُ: ʿahd — covenant, pledge (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
وَمِيثَاقُهُ: وَ + مِيثَاق + ـهُ — mīthāq, compact, solemn pledge (m., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'and His compact'
أَعُودُ: ʿāda — to return (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s)
تَفْعَلُ: tafʿalu — faʿala, to do (verb I, imperf. 2ms); 'you may do'
تُرِيدُ: turīdu — arāda, to want, wish (verb IV, imperf. 2ms)
أَقُولُ: aqūlu — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s)
وَكِيلٌ: wakīl — guarantor, trustee, one who stands surety (m., nom. indef.)
فَاسْتَوْثَقَ: فَـ + اِسْتَوْثَقَ — istawthaqa, to secure oneself firmly, obtain a binding pledge (verb X, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl)
وَأَطْلَقَهُ: وَ + أَطْلَقَ + ـهُ — aṭlaqa, to release, set free (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj. suffix; 'and he released him'
بَلَدِهِ: بَلَد + ـهِ — balad, town, country (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his town'
وَقَضَى: وَ + قَضَى — qaḍā, to settle, fulfil, discharge (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
تَعَلُّقَاتِهِ: تَعَلُّقَات + ـهِ — taʿalluq, attachment, claim, outstanding matter (verbal noun V, f. pl. taʿalluqāt; gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his affairs, his obligations'
وَأَوْصَلَ: وَ + أَوْصَلَ — awṣala, to convey, deliver (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
الْحُقُوقَ: الـ + حُقُوق — ḥaqq, right, due (m. pl. ḥuqūq; acc.)
وَأَعْلَمَ: وَ + أَعْلَمَ — aʿlama, to inform, let know (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
وَأَوْلَادَهُ: وَ + أَوْلَاد + ـهُ — walad, child (m. pl. awlād; acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his children'
وَأَوْصَى: وَ + أَوْصَى — awṣā, to enjoin, make one's testament, bequeath (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
وَقَعَدَ: وَ + قَعَدَ — qaʿada, to sit, stay, remain (verb I, perf. 3ms)
عِنْدَهُمْ: عِنْدَ + ـهُمْ — ʿinda, with, at the place of (prep.) + 3mp suffix; 'with them'
تَمَامِ: tamām — completion, fullness (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
وَتَوَضَّأَ: وَ + تَوَضَّأَ — tawaḍḍaʾa, to perform the ritual ablution (verb V, perf. 3ms); edition prints without a hamza seat (توضا), supplied here as a combining mark
كَفَنَهُ: كَفَن + ـهُ — kafan, shroud (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his shroud'
إِبْطِهِ: إِبْط + ـهِ — ibṭ, armpit (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his armpit'
وَوَدَّعَ: وَ + وَدَّعَ — waddaʿa, to bid farewell to (verb II, perf. 3ms)
أَهْلَهُ: أَهْل + ـهُ — ahl, family, people (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his family'
وَجِيرَانَهُ: وَ + جِيرَان + ـهُ — jār, neighbour (m. pl. jīrān; acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his neighbours'
وَجَمِيعَ: وَ + جَمِيعَ — jamīʿ, all, the whole of (acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
أَقَارِبِهِ: أَقَارِب + ـهِ — qarīb, relative, kinsman (m. pl. aqārib; gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his relatives'

أَنْفِهِ: أَنْف + ـهِ — anf, nose (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his nose'
فَأَقَامُوا: فَـ + أَقَامُوا — aqāma, to set up, raise (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'so they raised'
الْعِيَاطَ: الـ + عِيَاط — ʿiyāṭ, wailing, crying out (verbal noun, m., acc.)
وَالصُّرَاخَ: وَ + الـ + صُرَاخ — ṣurākh, shrieking, screaming (m., acc.)
فَتَمَشَّى: فَـ + تَمَشَّى — tamashshā, to walk on, proceed on foot (verb V, perf. 3ms)
الْجَدِيدَةِ: الـ + جَدِيدَة — jadīd, new (adj., f. sg. jadīda; gen.)
فَبَيْنَمَا: فَـ + بَيْنَمَا — baynamā, while, during the time that (temporal particle)
جَالِسٌ: jālis — sitting, seated (act. part. of جَلَسَ; m., nom. indef.)
يَبْكِي: yabkī — bakā, to weep (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms)
أَقْبَلَ: aqbala — to approach, come forward (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
شَيْخٌ: shaykh — old man, sheikh, elder (m., nom. indef.)
