الرَّأْفَةُ: الـ + رَأْفَة — raʾfah, pity, compassion (f.); nom.; one of this slice's five printed precomposed hamzas (أ), kept exactly as the edition prints it
فَوَقَفْتُ: فَـ + وَقَفْتُ — waqafa/yaqifu, to stop, hold back, stay one's hand; 1cs perfect
وَقُلْتُ: وَ + قُلْتُ — wa-, and + qultu (qāla, to say; verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'and I said'
اِيتِنِي: ītinī — bring me! (imperative); the edition prints ايتني with no hamza-mark at all, not even a bare alif standing in for one — read here as a colloquial-leaning smoothing of the classical اِئْتِنِي, vocalized as it stands rather than restored
بِغَيْرِهَا: بِـ + غَيْر + هَا — bi- + ghayr + -hā, 'with/by other than her'; after أَتَى 'come' the bāʾ makes 'bring' (أَتَى بِـ = come with: اِيتِنِي بِغَيْرِهَا 'bring me another'); after إِذَا of surprise it only marks what appears (وَإِذَا بِغَيْرِهَا 'and behold, another one')
فَصَاحَتِ: فَـ + صَاحَتِ — ṣāḥa/yaṣīḥu, to cry out, shriek; 3fs perfect (-i ending before the following hamzat waṣl)
اذْبَحْهَا: ذَبَحَ + هَا — dhabaḥa/yadhbaḥu, to slaughter + 'her'; ms imperative (hamzat waṣl, carries no hamza mark)
أَحْسَنُ: aḥsanu — aḥsan, better, finer (elative of ḥasan; m. nom., predicate)
أَسْمَنُ: asmanu — asman, fatter (elative of samīn; m. nom.)
فَتَقَدَّمْتُ: فَـ + تَقَدَّمْتُ — fa-, so + taqaddamtu (taqaddama, to step forward, approach; verb V, perf. 1cs); 'so I approached'
لِأَذْبَحَهَا: لِـ + أَذْبَحَ + ـهَا — li-, so that (purposive, governing the subj.) + adhbaḥa (dhabaḥa, to slaughter; verb I, subj. 1cs) + 3fs obj.; 'so that I might slaughter her'
فَقُمْتُ: فَـ + قُمْتُ — fa-, so + qumtu (qāma, to rise, stand up, draw back; verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'so I rose'
وَأَمَرْتُ: وَ + أَمَرْتُ — wa-, and + amartu (amara, to order, command; verb I, perf. 1cs, with bi- 'to do X'); 'and I ordered'
الرَّاعِيَ: الـ + رَاعِيَ — al- + rāʿī, shepherd, herdsman (act. part. of raʿā; m., acc. as object of amartu)
بِذَبْحِهَا: بِـ + ذَبْح + ـهَا — bi-, with (prep., after amara ... bi-, 'ordered to') + dhabḥ, slaughtering (verbal noun of dhabaḥa) + 3fs; 'to slaughter her'
وَسَلْخِهَا: وَ + سَلْخ + ـهَا — wa-, and + salkh, flaying, skinning (verbal noun of salakha) + 3fs; 'and to skin her'
فَذَبَحَهَا: فَـ + ذَبَحَ + ـهَا — fa-, so + dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'so he slaughtered her'
وَسَلَخَهَا: وَ + سَلَخَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + salakha, to skin, flay (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and skinned her'
شَحْمًا: شَحْم — shaḥm, fat, tallow (m., acc., indefinite)
لَحْمًا: لَحْم — laḥm, meat, flesh (m., acc., indefinite)
غَيْرَ: ghayra — ghayr, other than, without (noun used as a preposition; acc.); 'nothing but'
جِلْدٍ: جِلْد — jild, skin, hide (m., gen. after ghayr, indefinite)
وَعَظْمٍ: وَ + عَظْم — wa-, and + ʿaẓm, bone (m., gen., indefinite)
فَنَدِمْتُ: فَـ + نَدِمْتُ — fa-, so + nadimtu (nadima, to regret, repent; verb I, perf. 1cs); 'so I repented'
ذَبْحِهَا: ذَبْح + ـهَا — dhabḥ, slaughtering (verbal noun) + 3fs; 'her slaughter, slaughtering her'
يَنْفَعُنِي: يَنْفَعُ + نِي — yanfaʿu (nafaʿa, to benefit, profit; verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'it profits me'
النَّدَمُ: الـ + نَدَم — al- + nadam, regret, remorse (m., nom., subject of yanfaʿu)
وَأَعْطَيْتُهَا: وَ + أَعْطَيْتُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + aʿṭaytu (aʿṭā, to give; verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj.; 'and I gave her'
بِعِجْلٍ: بِـ + عِجْل — bi-, with (marking the thing brought, after ītinī) + ʿijl, calf (m., gen., indefinite); 'a calf'
سَمِينٍ: samīn — fat, well-fed (adj., m. gen., indefinite)
فَأَتَانِي: فَـ + أَتَانِي — fa-, so + atānī (atā, to come; verb I, perf. 3ms, atā bi- 'to bring') + 1cs obj.; 'so he brought me'
بِوَلَدِي: بِـ + وَلَد + ـي — bi-, with (marking the thing brought) + walad, child, son (m.) + 1cs; 'my son'
رَآنِي: رَأَى + ـنِي — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'he saw me' (the edition prints the contracted spelling رآني, with alif-madda for raʾā-nī, kept exactly as printed)
الْعِجْلُ: الـ + عِجْل — al- + ʿijl, calf (m., nom.)
حَبْلَهُ: حَبْل + ـهُ — ḥabl, rope, tether (m., acc.) + 3ms; 'its rope'
وَجَاءَنِي: وَ + جَاءَ + نِي — wa-, and + jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'and came to me'
وَتَمَرَّغَ: وَ + تَمَرَّغَ — wa-, and + tamarragha, to roll about, rub itself (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and rubbed itself'
وَوَلْوَلَ: وَ + وَلْوَلَ — wa-, and + walwala, to wail, lament (quadriliteral verb, perf. 3ms); 'and wailed'
فَأَخَذَتْنِي: فَـ + أَخَذَتْ + نِي — fa-, so + akhadhat (akhadha, to take, seize; verb I, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'so it seized me'
الرَّأْفَةُ: الـ + رَأْفَة — al- + raʾfa, compassion, tenderness, pity (f., nom.); the edition prints this word without a hamza-seat (الرافة), the hamza here supplied as a combining mark
فَقُلْتُ: فَـ + قُلْتُ — fa-, so + qultu (qāla, perf. 1cs); 'so I said'
وَدَعْ: وَ + دَعْ — wa-, and + daʿ (waḍaʿa/daʿa, to leave, let be; imper. 2ms); 'and leave'
ذَبْحِ: dhabḥi — dhabḥ, slaughtering (verbal noun, gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْعِجْلِ: الـ + عِجْل — al- + ʿijl, calf (m., gen.)
فَإِنَّهُ: فَـ + إِنَّ + ـهُ — fa-, for + inna, indeed (particle) + 3ms; 'for indeed it [is]'
يَوْمٌ: yawmun — yawm, day (m., nom., indefinite predicate)
شَرِيفٌ: sharīfun — sharīf, noble, honored (adj., m. nom., indefinite)
مُبَارَكٌ: mubārakun — mubārak, blessed (pass. part. of III bāraka; m. nom., indefinite)
يُذْبَحُ: yudhbaḥu — dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, pass. imperf. 3ms); 'is slaughtered'
الشَّيْءُ: الـ + شَيْء — al- + shayʾ, thing (m., nom.); al-shayʾ al-malīḥ = 'the fine thing, the choicest'
الْمَلِيحُ: الـ + مَلِيح — al- + malīḥ, fine, excellent, comely (adj., m. nom.)
عِنْدَنَا: عِنْدَ + نَا — ʿinda, at, with (adv.) + 1cp; 'we have'
الْعُجُولِ: الـ + عُجُول — al- + ʿujūl (pl. of ʿijl), calves (m. pl., gen. after bayna)
انْظُرِي: unẓurī — naẓara, to look, consider (verb I, imper. 2fs); 'look! consider!'
الْبَقَرَةِ: الـ + بَقَرَة — al- + baqara, cow (f., gen.)
ذُبِحَتْ: dhubiḥat — dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, pass. perf. 3fs); 'was slaughtered'
بِأَمْرِكِ: بِـ + أَمْر + ـكِ — bi-, by (prep.) + amr, order, command (m.) + 2fs; 'by your order'
طَلَعْنَا: ṭalaʿnā — ṭalaʿa, to go up, come out; to end up, turn out (verb I, perf. 1cp); 'we came away'
خَائِبِينَ: khāʾibīna — khāba, to be disappointed, fail (act. part.; m. pl. acc., circumstantial); 'disappointed, empty-handed'
انْتَفَعْنَا: intafaʿnā — intafaʿa, to profit, benefit (verb VIII, perf. 1cp); 'we profited'
بِشَيْءٍ: بِـ + شَيْء — bi-, in, with (prep.) + shayʾ, thing (m., gen., indefinite); 'in any way, at all'
أَصْلًا: aṣlan — at all, in the least (adv. acc. of aṣl, 'root, origin'); 'not at all'
وَنَدِمْتُ: وَ + نَدِمْتُ — wa-, and + nadimtu (nadima, perf. 1cs); 'and I repented'
وَالْآنَ: وَ + الـ + آنَ — wa-, and + al- + āna, now (adv., acc.); 'and now'
أَقْبَلُ: aqbalu — qabila, to accept (verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'I accept'
كَلَامًا: kalāman — kalām, speech, talk, word (m., acc., indefinite)
الْمَرَّةَ: الـ + مَرَّة — al- + marra, time, occasion (f., acc.); 'this time'
الرَّحْمَنِ: الـ + رَحْمَن — al- + Raḥmān, the Compassionate (divine epithet, m. gen.)
الرَّحِيمِ: الـ + رَحِيم — al- + Raḥīm, the Merciful (divine epithet, m. gen.)
ذَبْحِهِ: ذَبْح + ـهِ — dhabḥ, slaughtering (verbal noun) + 3ms; 'his/its slaughter'
الشَّرِيفِ: الـ + شَرِيف — al- + sharīf, noble (adj., m. gen.)
وَإِنْ: وَ + إِنْ — wa-, and + in, if (conditional particle)
تَذْبَحْهُ: تَذْبَحْ + ـهُ — tadhbaḥ (dhabaḥa, verb I, juss. 2ms after lam) + 3ms obj.; 'you do not slaughter him'
زَوْجِي: زَوْج + ـي — zawj, husband, spouse (m.) + 1cs; 'my husband'
الصَّعْبَ: الـ + صَعْب — al- + ṣaʿb, difficult, harsh (adj., m. acc.)
بِمَقْصِدِهَا: بِـ + مَقْصِد + ـهَا — bi-, with (marking the object of ʿalima) + maqṣid, intent, purpose (m.) + 3fs; 'her intent'
تَقَدَّمْتُ: taqaddamtu — taqaddama, to step forward, approach (verb V, perf. 1cs); 'I approached'
فَأَدْرَكَ: فَـ + أَدْرَكَ — fa-, then + adraka, to overtake, catch up with (verb IV, perf. 3ms); opens the fixed formula that closes every night, 'then dawn overtook her'
الصَّبَاحُ: الـ + صَبَاح — al- + ṣabāḥ, morning, dawn (m., nom., subject of adraka)
فَسَكَتَتْ: فَـ + سَكَتَتْ — fa-, so + sakatat (sakata, to fall silent, be quiet; verb I, perf. 3fs); 'so she fell silent'
عَنِ: ʿani — ʿan, from, away from (prep., with helping vowel before al-)
الْكَلَامِ: الـ + كَلَام — al- + kalām, speech (m., gen.)
الْمُبَاحِ: الـ + مُبَاح — al- + mubāḥ, permitted, licit (pass. part. of IV abāḥa; m. gen.); 'the [speech she is] permitted [to tell]'
أَحْسَنَ: aḥsana — aḥsan, how fine, how excellent (elative of ḥasan, acc., in the mā afʿala exclamation); 'how excellent!'
حَدِيثَكِ: حَدِيث + ـكِ — ḥadīth, story, discourse (m., acc.) + 2fs; 'your story'
وَأَطْيَبَهُ: وَ + أَطْيَبَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + aṭyab, how pleasant (elative of ṭayyib, acc.) + 3ms pron. standing for ḥadīth; 'and how pleasant it [is]!'
وَأَلَذَّهُ: وَ + أَلَذَّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + aladhdh, how delightful (elative of ladhīdh, acc.) + 3ms; 'and how delightful!'
وَأَعْذَبَهُ: وَ + أَعْذَبَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + aʿdhab, how sweet (elative of ʿadhb, acc.) + 3ms; 'and how sweet!'
وَأَيْنَ: وَ + أَيْنَ — wa-, and + ayna, where (interrog. adv.); 'and where'
أُحَدِّثُكُمْ: أُحَدِّثُ + كُمْ — uḥaddithu (ḥaddatha, to tell, relate; verb II, imperf. 1cs) + 2mp obj.; 'I shall tell you'
الْقَابِلَةَ: الـ + قَابِلَة — al- + qābila, coming, next (act. part. of qabila; f. acc.); al-layla al-qābila = 'the coming night, tomorrow night'
عِشْتُ: ʿishtu — ʿāsha, to live (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'I live'
وَأَبْقَانِي: وَ + أَبْقَى + نِي — wa-, and + abqā (baqiya, to remain; verb IV, perf. 3ms, 'to let remain, spare') + 1cs obj.; 'and lets me remain'
أَقْتُلُهَا: أَقْتُلُ + هَا — aqtulu (qatala, to kill; verb I, imperf. 1cs) + 3fs obj.; 'I will kill her'
أَسْمَعَ: asmaʿa — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, subj. 1cs after ḥattā); 'until I hear'
بَقِيَّةَ: baqiyyata — baqiyya, remainder, rest (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
حَدِيثِهَا: حَدِيث + ـهَا — ḥadīth, story (m., gen.) + 3fs; 'her story'
إِنَّهُمْ: إِنَّ + ـهُمْ — inna, indeed (particle) + 3mp; part of the narrative formula ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ, 'then indeed he...', here pluralized for the king and Shahrazad together
بَاتُوا: bātū — bāta, to spend the night (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp); 'they passed the night'
الصَّبَاحِ: الـ + صَبَاح — al- + ṣabāḥ, morning (m., gen.)
مُتَعَانِقِينَ: mutaʿāniqīna — mutaʿāniq, embracing one another (act. part. of VI taʿānaqa; m. pl. acc., circumstantial, used here of the pair)
مَحَلِّ: maḥalli — maḥall, place, seat, hall (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
حُكْمِهِ: حُكْم + ـهِ — ḥukm, judgment, rule (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'his judgment'
بِالْكَفَنِ: بِـ + الـ + كَفَن — bi-, with + al- + kafan, shroud, winding-sheet (m., gen.); 'with the shroud'
حَكَمَ: ḥakama — to judge, rule, decide (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَوَلَّى: وَ + وَلَّى — wa-, and + wallā, to appoint (to office) (verb II, perf. 3ms); here, 'appointed [officials]'
وَعَزَلَ: وَ + عَزَلَ — wa-, and + ʿazala, to dismiss, remove from office (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَأْمُرِ: yaʾmuri — amara, to order, command (verb I, juss. 3ms after lam, with the person commanded in the acc. and bi- 'to do X'); the edition prints this one word with its hamza on the alif-seat (يأمر), kept exactly as printed
وَانْفَضَّ: وَ + انْفَضَّ — wa-, and + infaḍḍa, to disperse, break up, adjourn (verb VII, perf. 3ms)
الدِّيوَانُ: الـ + دِيوَان — al- + dīwān, council, audience-hall, court session (m., nom.)
كَانَتِ: كَانَ — kāna, to be (verb I, hollow, perf. 3fs, linking vowel -i before al-); 'she/it was'
الثَّانِيَةُ: الـ + ثَانِيَة — thāniya, second (f. ordinal adj., nom.); 'the second'
لِأُخْتِهَا: لِـ + أُخْت + ـهَا — li-, to (prep.) + ukht, sister (f.) + 3fs suffix; 'to her sister'
أَتِمِّي: أَتَمَّ — atamma, form IV of t-m-m, to complete, finish; imperative 2fs; 'complete!, finish!'
وَكَرَامَةً: وَ + كَرَامَةً — wa-, and + karāmatan, honor, dignity (f., indef. acc. of manner); with ḥubban, the fixed idiom 'gladly, most willingly'
اِحْكِي: حَكَى — ḥakā, to narrate, tell (verb I, final-weak); imperative 2fs, hamzat waṣl; 'narrate!, tell it!'
بَلَغَنِي: بَلَغَ + ـنِي — balagha, to reach (verb I) + 1cs object; 'it has reached me'
وَالْوَلِيُّ: وَ + الـ + وَلِيّ — walī, custodian, one entrusted with authority (m., nom.)
الرَّشِيدُ: الـ + رَشِيد — rashīd, rightly-guided (adj., m. sg., nom.)
أَرَادَ: أَرَادَ — arāda, form IV of r-w-d, to want, intend, wish; perf. 3ms
حَنَّ: حَنَّ — ḥanna, to yearn, be moved with tenderness or compassion; verb I, perf. 3ms
قَابُهُ: rasm as printed (q-a-b-h, four letters); almost certainly قَلْبُهُ, qalb, heart (m.) + 3ms, with the lām lost in transmission; 'his heart' (see note)
أَبْقِ: أَبْقَى — abqā, form IV of b-q-y, to leave, let remain; imperative 2ms; 'leave!, let remain!'
الْبَهَائِمِ: الـ + بَهَائِم — bahīma, beast, dumb animal (f. pl. bahāʾim, gen.); the edition prints this plural's medial hamza precomposed (بهائم)
وَالشَّيْخُ: وَ + الـ + شَيْخ — shaykh, old man, elder (m., nom.)
يَحْكِي: يَحْكِي — ḥakā, to narrate (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
يَتَعَجَّبُ: يَتَعَجَّبُ — taʿajjaba, form V of ʿ-j-b, to marvel, be amazed; imperf. 3ms
الْعَجِيبِ: الـ + عَجِيب — ʿajīb, strange, wondrous (adj., m. sg., gen.)
وَابْنَةُ: وَ + ابْنَة — ibna, daughter (f., nom., hamzat waṣl); first term of an iḍāfa
تَنْظُرُ: تَنْظُرُ — naẓara, to look, watch (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
وَتَرَى: وَ + تَرَى — raʾā, to see (verb I, final-weak; the radical hamza drops in the imperfect); 3fs
وَتَقُولُ: وَ + تَقُولُ — qāla, to say (verb I, hollow, imperf. 3fs)
اِذْبَحِ: اِذْبَحْ — dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I); imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl, here with the liaison kasra before the following al-
يَهُونُ: يَهُونُ — hāna, to be easy, light (verb I, hollow, imperf. 3ms); kept in the indicative after lam rather than the classical jussive yahun (see note)
أَذْبَحَهُ: أَذْبَحَ + ـهُ — adhbaḥa (1cs subjunctive of dhabaḥa, to slaughter) + 3ms object; 'that I slaughter it'
يَأْخُذَهُ: يَأْخُذَ + ـهُ — yaʾkhudha (akhadha, to take; verb I, subjunctive 3ms) + 3ms object; 'that he take it' (edition prints the hamza precomposed, يأخذه)
فَأَخَذَهُ: فَ + أَخَذَ + ـهُ — fa-, so + akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'so he took it'
بِالرَّاعِي: بِـ + الـ + رَاعِي — bi-, with (prep.) + al- + rāʿī, herdsman; with idhā, 'and behold, the herdsman...'
مُقْبِلٌ: مُقْبِل — muqbil, approaching, coming (form IV act. part. of q-b-l; m., nom. indef.)
سَيِّدِي: سَيِّد + ـي — sayyid, master, lord (m.) + 1cs; 'my master'
شَيْئًا: شَيْء — shayʾ, thing (m., indef. acc.); the edition prints the hamza precomposed (شيئا)
تُسَرُّ: تُسَرُّ — surra, to be gladdened, made happy (pass. of sarra, verb I); imperf. 2ms passive; 'you will be gladdened'
الْبِشَارَةُ: الـ + بِشَارَة — bishāra, good news, glad tidings (f., nom.)
امْرَأَةٍ: اِمْرَأَة — imraʾa, woman (f., indef. gen.); root m-r-ʾ — the medial hamza is a true radical and is printed precomposed by the edition even though the initial alif is a mere hamzat waṣl
عَجُوزٍ: عَجُوز — ʿajūz, old woman (f., indef. gen.)
كَانَتْ: كَانَ — kāna, to be (verb I, hollow, perf. 3fs); 'she/it was'
بِالْأَمْسِ: بِـ + الـ + أَمْس — bi-, with (prep.) + al- + ams, yesterday (m., gen.); 'yesterday'
وَأَعْطَيْتَنِي: وَ + أَعْطَيْتَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + aʿṭayta (aʿṭā, form IV, to give; perf. 2ms) + 1cs object; 'and you gave me'
دَخَلْتُ: دَخَلَ — dakhala, to enter, go in (verb I, perf. 1cs); dakhala ʿalā, idiom, 'to go in to (someone)'
فَنَظَرَتْ: فَ + نَظَرَتْ — fa-, so + naẓarat (naẓara, to look; verb I, perf. 3fs); 'so she looked'
بِنْتِي: بِنْت + ـي — bint, daughter, girl (f.) + 1cs; 'my daughter'
وَغَطَّتْ: وَ + غَطَّتْ — wa-, and + ghaṭṭat (ghaṭṭā, form II of gh-ṭ-w, to cover; perf. 3fs); 'and she covered'
ضَحِكَتْ: ضَحِكَ — ḍaḥika, to laugh (verb I, perf. 3fs)
بَخْسُ: بَخْس — bakhs, undervaluing, cheapening, diminishing (m., verbal noun, nom.; subject of a nominal exclamation, see note)
قَدْرِي: قَدْر + ـي — qadr, worth, measure, standing (m.) + 1cs; 'my worth'
تُدْخِلُ: أَدْخَلَ — adkhala, form IV of d-kh-l, to bring in, cause to enter; imperf. 2ms
الْأَجَانِبَ: الـ + أَجَانِب — ajnabī, foreign, stranger (m. pl. ajānib, acc.)
الْأَجَانِبُ: الـ + أَجَانِب — ajnabī, foreign, stranger (m. pl. ajānib, nom.)
بَكَيْتِ: بَكَى — bakā, to weep (verb I, perf. 2fs); 'you (f.) wept'
وَضَحِكْتِ: وَ + ضَحِكْتِ — wa-, and + ḍaḥikti (ḍaḥika, to laugh; perf. 2fs); 'and you (f.) laughed'
مَسْحُورٌ: مَسْحُور — masḥūr, bewitched, enchanted (pass. part. of saḥara; m., nom. indef.)
سَحَرَتْهُ: سَحَرَتْ + ـهُ — saḥarat (saḥara, to bewitch; verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3ms object; 'she bewitched him'
أَبِيهِ: أَب + ـيهِ — ab, father (one of the 'five nouns', oblique form abī-) + 3ms suffix (-hi after ī); 'his father'
ضَحِكِي: ضَحِك + ـي — ḍaḥik, laughter (m., verbal noun) + 1cs; 'my laughter'
بُكَائِي: بُكَاء + ـي — bukāʾ, weeping (m., verbal noun) + 1cs; 'my weeping' (edition prints the hamza precomposed, بكائي)
أَجْلِ: أَجْل — ajl, sake, cause (m., gen.); min ajli, 'because of, for the sake of'
أَبُوهُ: أَب + ـوهُ — ab, father (nom. form abū-) + 3ms suffix; 'his father' (subject form; contrast أَبِيهِ)
غَابَةَ: rasm as printed (gh-a-b-h, 'forest'); almost certainly غَايَةَ, ghāya, utmost degree (f., acc. of manner), a bāʾ misprinted for a yāʾ; 'to the utmost degree' (see note)
صَدَّقْتُ: صَدَّقَ — ṣaddaqa, form II of ṣ-d-q, to believe, credit; perf. 1cs
بِطُلُوعِ: بِـ + طُلُوع — bi-, with (prep.) + ṭulūʿ, rising, breaking (m., verbal noun, gen.); 'with the breaking of'
أُعْلِمُكَ: أُعْلِمُ + ـكَ — uʿlimu (aʿlama, form IV of ʿ-l-m, to inform; imperf. 1cs) + 2ms object; 'that I inform you'
خَرَجْتُ: خَرَجَ — kharaja, to go out (verb I, perf. 1cs)
سَكْرَانُ: سَكْرَان — sakrān, drunk, intoxicated (adj., m., nom. indef.)
كَثْرَةِ: كَثْرَة — kathra, abundance, great quantity (f., gen.); min kathrati, 'from the abundance of'
وَالسُّرُورِ: وَ + الـ + سُرُور — surūr, gladness, joy (m., gen.)
حَصَلَ: حَصَلَ — ḥaṣala, to occur, come about, be obtained (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَتَرَحَّبَتْ: فَ + تَرَحَّبَتْ — fa-, so + taraḥḥabat (taraḥḥaba, form V, to welcome; perf. 3fs)
وَقَبَّلَتْ: وَ + قَبَّلَتْ — wa-, and + qabbalat (qabbala, form II of q-b-l, to kiss; perf. 3fs)
لِابْنَةِ: لِـ + ابْنَة — li-, to (prep.) + ibna, daughter (f., gen., hamzat waṣl)
أَحَقٌّ: أَ + حَقّ — a-, interrogative particle + ḥaqq, true, truth (m., nom. indef.); 'is it true?'
تَقُولِيهِ: تَقُولِي + ـهِ — taqūlī (qāla, to say; imperf. 2fs, Middle Arabic -ī ending in place of Classical تَقُولِينَ) + 3ms object; 'you (f.) say it' (see note)
ابْنُكَ: ابْن + ـكَ — ibn, son (m., nom., hamzat waṣl) + 2ms; 'your son'
كَبِدِكَ: كَبِد + ـكَ — kabid, liver (f.) + 2ms; ḥashāshatu kabidika, idiom, 'the very core of your heart' (see note)
أَيَّتُهَا: أَيَّتُهَا — ayyatuhā, O (fem. vocative particle used before a following definite noun)
خَلَّصْتِيهِ: خَلَّصْتِي + ـهِ — khallaṣtī (khallaṣa, form II of kh-l-ṣ, to free, rescue; perf. 2fs, Middle Arabic -tī ending in place of Classical خَلَّصْتِ) + 3ms object; 'you (f.) freed him' (see note)
فَلَكِ: فَـ + لِـ + ـكِ — fa-, then + li- + 2fs; 'then you shall have'
أَبِيكِ: أَب + ـيكِ — ab, father (oblique form abī-) + 2fs; 'your (f.) father'
الْمَوَاشِي: الـ + مَوَاشِي — māshiya, herd, livestock (f. pl. mawāshī, gen.)
وَالْأَمْوَالِ: وَ + الـ + أَمْوَال — māl, wealth, property (m. pl. amwāl, gen.)
فَتَبَسَّمَتْ: فَ + تَبَسَّمَتْ — fa-, so + tabassamat (tabassama, form V of b-s-m, to smile; perf. 3fs)
رَغْبَةٌ: رَغْبَة — raghba, desire, wish (f., nom. indef.)
بِشَرْطَيْنِ: بِـ + شَرْطَيْنِ — bi-, on (prep.) + sharṭ, condition (m. dual sharṭayn, obl.); 'on two conditions'
تُزَوِّجَنِي: تُزَوِّجَ + ـنِي — tuzawwija (zawwaja, form II of z-w-j, to give in marriage; subjunctive 2ms) + 1cs object; 'that you marry me [to him]' (see note)
وَالثَّانِي: وَ + الـ + ثَانِي — thānī, second (m. ordinal); 'and the second'
وَاحْبِسْهَا: وَ + احْبِسْ + ـهَا — wa-, and + iḥbis (ḥabasa, verb I, to imprison, confine; imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl) + 3fs object; 'and confine her!'
فَلَسْتُ: فَ + لَسْتُ — fa-, then + lastu (laysa, 1cs, negative copula); 'then I am not'
آمِنًا: آمِن — āmin, safe, secure (act. part. of amina; m., indef. acc.); edition prints the hamza with madda (آمنا)
مَكْرِهَا: مَكْر + ـهَا — makr, cunning, guile, trickery (m.) + 3fs; 'her cunning'
طَلَبْتِ: طَلَبَ — ṭalaba, to ask, request (verb I, perf. 2fs)
الْأَنْعَامِ: الـ + أَنْعَام — anʿām, cattle, livestock (m. pl., collective; gen.)
فَلَحْمُهَا: فَـ + لَحْم + ـهَا — fa-, as for... then + laḥm, flesh, meat (m., nom.) + 3fs; 'then her flesh'
مُبَاحٌ: مُبَاح — mubāḥ, permitted, licit (pass. part. of abāḥa; m., nom. indef.)
كَلَامِي: كَلَام + ـي — kalām, speech, words (m.) + 1cs; 'my words'
أَخَذَتْ: أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3fs)
طَاسَةً: طَاسَة — ṭāsa, basin, bowl (f., indef. acc.)
وَمَلَأَتْهَا: وَ + مَلَأَتْ + ـهَا — wa-, and + malaʾat (malaʾa, to fill; verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3fs object; 'and she filled it' (edition prints the hamza precomposed, وملأتها)
مَاءًا: مَاء — māʾ, water (m., indef. acc.); the edition writes an extra accusative alif after the hamza (ماءا)
عَزَمَتْ: عَزَمَ — ʿazamat (ʿazama, to resolve, and here technically 'to conjure, adjure'; verb I, perf. 3fs); ʿazama ʿalā, 'to recite a binding spell over'
وَرَشَّتْ: وَ + رَشَّتْ — wa-, and + rashshat (rashsha, verb I, to sprinkle; perf. 3fs)
خِلْقَةِ: khilqa, creation, natural constitution (f., gen. sg. after ʿalā, carried over from the previous slice); 'the creation of'
الصِّفَةِ: الـ + صِفَة — ṣifa, description, manner, quality (f., gen. sg. after ʿalā); 'this manner'
تَتَغَيَّرْ: taghayyara, to change, alter, be transformed (verb V, impf. jussive 3fs after lā); 'it does not change'
مَسْحُورًا: masḥūr, enchanted, bewitched (pass. part. I of سحر; m., acc. sg. indef.)
فَعُدْ: فَـ + عُدْ — ʿāda, to return, go back (verb I hollow, imperative 2ms); 'so return!'
خِلْقَتِكَ: خِلْقَة + ـكَ — khilqa, creation (f., gen. sg.) + 2ms suffix; 'your creation'
بِإِذْنِ: بِـ + إِذْن — idhn, permission, leave (m., gen. sg. after bi-); 'by the permission of'
انْتَفَضَ: intafaḍa, to shake, be shaken, give a start (verb VII of نفض, perf. 3ms)
إِنْسَانًا: insān, human being, man (m., acc. sg. indef., predicate of ṣāra)
فَوَقَعْتُ: فَـ + وَقَعْتُ — waqaʿa, to fall, fall upon (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'so I fell'
احْكِ: ḥakā, to relate, tell (verb I, imperative 2ms, defective); 'tell!'
صَنَعَتْ: ṣanaʿat, she did, made (verb I, perf. 3fs, from صنع)
وَبِآمِّكَ: وَ + بِـ + آمّ + ـكَ — bi-, to (prep.; faʿala bi- = do something to someone) + read here as a colloquial contraction of umm, 'mother' (f., gen. sg.) + 2ms suffix; 'and to your mother' (Middle Arabic spelling, kept precomposed as printed — see the unit's note)
فَحَكَى: فَـ + حَكَى — ḥakā, to relate, tell (verb I, perf. 3ms, defective); 'so he related'
بَعَثَ: baʿatha, to send, raise up, dispatch (verb I, perf. 3ms)
خَلَّصَكَ: خَلَّصَ + ـكَ — khallaṣa, to deliver, rescue, save (verb II of خلص, perf. 3ms) + 2ms suffix; 'delivered you'
وَخَلَّصَ: وَ + خَلَّصَ — khallaṣa, to deliver, rescue, save (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and delivered'
حَظَّكَ: حَظّ + ـكَ — ḥaẓẓ, fortune, luck, share, lot (m., acc. sg.) + 2ms suffix; 'your fortune'
زَوَّجْتُ: zawwaja, to marry off, give in marriage (verb II of زوج, perf. 1cs); 'I married [him] to'
سَحَرَتِ: saḥarat, she enchanted, bewitched (verb I, perf. 3fs, from سحر)
صُورَةٌ: ṣūra, form, shape, image (f., nom. sg. indef.)
جَمِيلَةٌ: jamīla, beautiful, fair (f. adj., nom. sg. indef.)
لَيْسَتْ: laysat, she/it is not (defective verb of negation, perf. 3fs)
بِصُورَةٍ: بِـ + صُورَة — ṣūra, form, shape (f., gen. sg. indef. after bi- of negated predicate); 'a form'
وَحْشِيَّةٍ: waḥshiyya, wild, savage, beastly (adj. of وَحْش; f., gen. sg. indef.)
يُكْرَهُ: yukrahu, is disliked, is hated (verb I pass., impf. 3ms, from كره)
النَّظَرُ: الـ + نَظَر — naẓar, looking, gaze (m., nom. sg., verbal noun of نظر; subject of yukrahu)
أَقَامَتْ: aqāmat, she dwelt, stayed, remained (verb IV of قوم, perf. 3fs)
وَأَيَّامًا: وَ + أَيَّامًا — yawm (pl. ayyām), day (m., acc. pl. indef., adverbial); 'and days'
اخْتَارَهَا: اخْتَارَ + ـهَا — ikhtāra, to choose, select (verb VIII of خير, perf. 3ms) + 3fs suffix; 'He chose her'
تُوُفِّيَتْ: tuwuffiyat, she died, was taken (verb V of وفي, pass. perf. 3fs); a euphemism for death
سَافَرَ: sāfara, to travel, set out on a journey (verb III, perf. 3ms)
ابْنِي: ابْن + ـي — ibn, son (m., nom. sg.) + 1cs suffix; 'my son'
الرَّجُلِ: الـ + رَجُل — rajul, man (m., gen. sg.)
أَخَذْتُ: akhadhtu, I took (verb I, perf. 1cs, from أخذ)
وَسِرْتُ: وَ + سِرْتُ — sāra, to journey, travel, set out (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'and I journeyed'
بَلَدٍ: balad, land, country, town (m., gen. sg. indef.)
أُبْصِرُ: ubṣiru, abṣara, to perceive, see, come to know (verb IV of بصر, impf. 1cs)
خَبَرَ: khabar, news, tidings, report (m., acc. sg. as object; first term of an iḍāfa)
سَاقَتْنِي: سَاقَتْ + ـنِي — sāqat, she/it drove, drove on (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs, from سوق) + 1cs object suffix; 'she drove me'
الْمَقَادِيرُ: الـ + مَقَادِير — maqādīr, fates, decrees of destiny (m. pl. of مِقْدَار; nom., subject of sāqatnī)
وَرَأَيْتُ: وَ + رَأَيْتُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I saw'
جَالِسًا: jālis, sitting (act. part. I of جلس; m., acc. sg. indef., circumstantial)
حَدِيثِي: حَدِيث + ـي — ḥadīth, story, account, narrative (m., nom. sg.) + 1cs suffix; 'my story'
عَجِيبٌ: ʿajīb, wondrous, marvelous, strange (adj., m., nom. sg. indef.)
تَقَدَّمَ: taqaddama, to come forward, advance, step up (verb V of قدم, perf. 3ms)
الثَّانِي: الـ + ثَانِي — thānī, second (ordinal adj., m., nom. sg.)
الْكَلْبَيْنِ: الـ + كَلْبَيْنِ — kalb (dual kalbayn), dog (m., gen./acc. dual)
السَّلُوقِيَّيْنِ: الـ + سَلُوقِيَّيْنِ — salūqī (dual salūqiyyayn), of Saluq, Saluki (nisba adj., m., gen./acc. dual)
لِلْجِنِّيِّ: لِـ + الـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, jinni (m., gen. sg.); 'to the jinni'
أَخَوَيَّ: أَخَوَيْ + ـيَ — akh (dual akhaway), brother (m., oblique dual) + 1cs suffix; 'my two brothers'
هَذَيْنِ: hādhayni, these two (dem. pron., m., oblique dual)
وَرَأَيْتَهَا: وَ + رَأَيْتَ + ـهَا — raʾā, to see, find (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3fs suffix; 'and you found it'
أَغْرَبَ: aghrab, stranger, more strange (elative of غريب, m., acc.)
وَأَعْجَبَ: وَ + أَعْجَبَ — aʿjab, more wondrous, more marvelous (elative of عجيب, m., acc.); 'and more wondrous'
ذَنْبِهِ: ذَنْب + ـهِ — dhanb, sin, guilt, crime (m., gen. sg.) + 3ms suffix; 'his guilt' (see the unit's note on this word)
حِكَايَتُكَ: حِكَايَة + ـكَ — ḥikāya, story, tale (f., nom. sg.) + 2ms suffix; 'your story'
أَعْجَبَ: aʿjab, more wondrous, more marvelous (elative of عجيب, m., acc.)
وَأَغْرَبَ: وَ + أَغْرَبَ — aghrab, stranger, more strange (elative of غريب, m., acc.); 'and stranger'
فَلَكَ: فَـ + لَكَ — li-, to, for (prep.) + 2ms suffix; 'then it is yours'
إِخْوَتِي: إِخْوَة + ـي — ikhwa, brothers (m. pl. of أخ) + 1cs suffix; 'my brothers'
ثَالِثُهُمْ: ثَالِث + ـهُمْ — thālith, third (ordinal noun, m., nom. sg.) + 3mp suffix; 'the third of them'
وَمَاتَ: وَ + مَاتَ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and he died'
وَالِدِي: وَالِد + ـي — wālid, father (act. part. I of ولد, m., nom. sg.) + 1cs suffix; 'my father'
وَخَلَّفَ: وَ + خَلَّفَ — khallafa, to leave behind, bequeath (verb II of خلف, perf. 3ms); 'and left behind'
آلَافِ: آلَاف — alf (pl. ālāf), thousand (m., gen. pl. after the numeral ثَلٰثَة)
دِينَارٍ: dīnār, dinar, gold coin (m., gen. sg. indef.)
فَفَتَحْتُ: فَـ + فَتَحْتُ — fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'so I opened'
دُكَّانًا: dukkān, shop, stall (m., acc. sg. indef.)
أَبِيعُ: abīʿu, bāʿa, to sell (verb I, impf. 1cs)
وَأَشْتَرِي: وَ + أَشْتَرِي — ashtarī, ishtarā, to buy (verb VIII of شرى, impf. 1cs); 'and I buy'
الْإِخْوَانُ: الـ + إِخْوَان — ikhwān, brothers (m. pl. of أخ, nom.)
تَعَلَّلْتُ: taʿallaltu, taʿallala, to linger, occupy oneself, make excuses (verb V of علل, perf. 1cs)
كَثِيرًا: kathīr, much, long, a great deal (adj., m., acc. sg. indef., adverbial); 'long'
وَأَخِي: وَ + أَخِي — akh, brother (m., nom. sg.) + 1cs suffix; 'and my brother'
بَاعَ: bāʿa, to sell (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
مَتَاعَ: matāʿ, goods, wares, stock-in-trade (m., acc. sg. as object; first term of an iḍāfa)
دُكَّانِهِ: دُكَّان + ـهِ — dukkān, shop (m., gen. sg.) + 3ms suffix; 'his shop'
بِأَلْفِ: بِـ + أَلْفِ — alf, thousand (m., gen. sg. after bi-)
وَاشْتَرَى: وَ + اشْتَرَى — ishtarā, to buy, purchase (verb VIII of شرى, perf. 3ms); 'and he bought'
بَضَائِعَ: baḍāʾiʿ, goods, merchandise (f. pl. of بِضَاعَة, acc. indef.)
وَمَتْجَرًا: وَ + مَتْجَرًا — matjar, trade-goods, merchandise (m., acc. sg. indef.); 'and trade-goods'
فَغَابَ: فَـ + غَابَ — ghāba, to be absent, be away (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and he was absent'
دُكَّانِي: دُكَّان + ـي — dukkān, shop (m. sg.) + 1cs suffix; 'my shop'
وَقَفَ: waqafa, to stop, halt, stand still (verb I, perf. 3ms)
سَائِلٌ: sāʾil, beggar, one who asks (act. part. I of سأل, m., nom. sg. indef.)
يَفْتَحُ: yaftaḥu, fataḥa, to open (verb I, impf. 3ms); in يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ, the set formula spoken in place of alms
بَكَى: bakā, to weep (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
بَقِيتَ: baqīta, baqiya, to remain, stay, continue (verb I, perf. 2ms)
تَعْرِفُنِي: تَعْرِفُ + ـنِي — taʿrifu, ʿarafa, to know, recognize (verb I, impf. 2ms) + 1cs suffix; 'you know me'
فَحَقَّقْتُهُ: فَـ + حَقَّقْتُ + ـهُ — ḥaqqaqa, to verify, ascertain, make certain of (verb II of حقق, perf. 1cs) + 3ms suffix; 'so I made certain of him'
وَرَحَّبْتُ: وَ + رَحَّبْتُ — raḥḥaba, to welcome (verb II of رحب, perf. 1cs); 'and I welcomed'
وَطَلَعْتُ: وَ + طَلَعْتُ — ṭalaʿa, to go up, ascend; here, to bring up (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I brought up'
الدُّكَّانِ: الـ + دُكَّان — dukkān, shop (m., gen. sg.)
فَسَأَلْتُهُ: فَـ + سَأَلْتُ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms suffix; 'so I asked him'
فَأَجَابَنِي: فَـ + أَجَابَ + ـنِي — ajāba, to answer, reply (verb IV of جوب, perf. 3ms) + 1cs suffix; 'so he answered me'
تَسْأَلْ: tasʾal, saʾala, to ask (verb I, jussive 2ms after negative lā); 'do not ask!'
لِأَنَّ: لِـ + أَنَّ — li-, because, for + anna, that/indeed (particle governing the acc.); 'because'
وَالْحَالَ: وَ + الـ + حَال — ḥāl, state, condition, circumstance (m./f., acc. sg. as predicate); 'and condition'
أَدْخَلْتُهُ: أَدْخَلْتُ + ـهُ — adkhala, to bring in, cause to enter (verb IV of دخل, perf. 1cs) + 3ms suffix; 'I brought him in'
الْحَمَّامَ: الـ + حَمَّام — ḥammām, bathhouse, bath (m., acc. sg.)
وَأَلْبَسْتُهُ: وَ + أَلْبَسْتُ + ـهُ — albasa, to clothe, dress (verb IV of لبس, perf. 1cs) + 3ms suffix; 'and I dressed him'
بَذْلَةً: badhla, suit (of clothes), garment-set (f., acc. sg. indef.)
مَلَابِسِي: مَلَابِس + ـي — malābis, clothes, garments (m. pl. of مَلْبَس) + 1cs suffix; 'my clothes'
وَأَطْلَعْتُهُ: وَ + أَطْلَعْتُ + ـهُ — aṭlaʿa, to bring up, take up, lodge (verb IV of طلع, perf. 1cs) + 3ms suffix; 'and I brought him up, to stay'
كَشَفْتُ: kashaftu, kashafa, to uncover, examine, disclose (verb I, perf. 1cs)
حِسَابِي: حِسَاب + ـي — ḥisāb, account, reckoning (m., acc. sg.) + 1cs suffix; 'my accounts'
وَبَيْعَ: وَ + بَيْعَ — bayʿ, selling, sale (m., acc. sg., verbal noun of بَاعَ); 'and the selling of'
كَسَبْتُ: kasabtu, kasaba, to earn, gain, profit (verb I, perf. 1cs)
وَرَأْسُ: وَ + رَأْسُ — raʾs, head; here, total, principal (m., nom. sg.); 'and the total of'
مَالِي: مَال + ـي — māl, wealth, property, capital (m., gen. sg.) + 1cs suffix; 'my capital'
أَلْفَيْ: alfay, two thousand (dual oblique/construct of أَلْف)
فَقَسَمْتُهُ: فَـ + قَسَمْتُ + ـهُ — qasama, to divide, share out, apportion (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms suffix; 'so I divided it'
وَبَيْنِي: وَ + بَيْنِي — bayna, between (prep.) + 1cs suffix; 'and myself'
احْسُبْ: iḥsub, ḥasaba, to reckon, count, consider (verb I, imperative 2ms)
سَافَرْتَ: sāfarta, sāfara, to travel, set out (verb III, perf. 2ms)
تَغَرَّبْتَ: tagharrabta, taghar-raba, to go abroad, become a stranger, be estranged (verb V of غرب, perf. 2ms)
فَأَخَذَهَا: فَـ + أَخَذَ + ـهَا — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs suffix; 'so he took it'
وَقُمْتُ: وَ + قُمْتُ — qumtu, qāma, to arise, stand; here used loosely for 'to remain, carry on' (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs) (see the unit's note)
الذَّٰهِبُ: الـ + ذَّاهِب — dhāhib, going, departing, one who travels (act. part. I of ذهب, m., nom. sg.); the medial alif is dropped in print (as in ثَلٰثَة), restored here with the dagger alif — see the unit's note on this reading
مَالِهِ: مَال + ـهِ — māl, wealth, property (m., gen. sg.) + 3ms suffix; 'his property'
فَمَنَعْنَاهُ: فَـ + مَنَعْنَا + ـهُ — manaʿa, to forbid, prevent (verb I, perf. 1cp) + 3ms suffix; 'so we forbade him'
يَمْتَنِعُ: يَمْتَنِعُ — imtanaʿa (verb VIII, root م-ن-ع), impf. 3ms; 'he refrains, will not desist' (the final word of a sentence begun before this slice)
فَاشْتَرَى: فَـ + اشْتَرَى — fa-, so + ishtarā (verb VIII, شرى, 'to buy'), perf. 3ms; 'so he bought'
الْأَسْفَارِ: الـ + أَسْفَار — asfār, journeys, caravans (m. pl. of سَفَر, gen.)
وَغَابَ: وَ + غَابَ — ghāba, to be absent (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
أَتَانِي: أَتَى + ـنِي — atā, to come (verb I defective, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj. suffix; 'he came to me'
أَتَى: atā — to come (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
آمَا: āmā — reproachful interrogative particle, 'now, did I not...?'; the edition spells this أما with a madda, kept precomposed as printed
بِأَنْ: بِـ + أَنْ — bi-, with (prep.) + an, that (subordinating particle governing the subjunctive); naṣaḥtuka bi-an lā tusāfir, 'I advised you not to travel'
مُقَدَّرُوهَا: obscure: apparently مُقَدَّر ('decreed, fated', pass. part. II) + a form of the 3fs suffix -hā, though the ر-و letter order (rather than مقدور's و-ر) matches no recognized pattern; vocalized as printed and read loosely as 'its allotted measure, its fate'
فَقِيرٌ: faqīr — poor, a poor man (adj./noun, m. nom. indef.)
أَمْلِكِ: amlik — malaka, to own, possess (verb I, impf. 1cs jussive after lam; -i linking vowel before the following hamzat waṣl)
الدِّرْهَمَ: الـ + دِرْهَم — dirham, a dirham (m., acc.)
الْفَرْدَ: الـ + فَرْد — fard, single, sole (adj., m. acc.); 'a single [dirham]'
فَأَخَذْتُهُ: فَـ + أَخَذْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + akhadhtu (akhadha, to take; perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I took him'
وَأَدْخَلْتُهُ: وَ + أَدْخَلْتُ + ـهُ — adkhaltu (form IV, دخل), perf. 1cs + 3ms obj.; 'and I brought him in'
فَأَكَلْنَا: فَـ + أَكَلْنَا — akalnā (akala, perf. 1pl); 'and we ate'
وَشَرِبْنَا: وَ + شَرِبْنَا — sharibnā (shariba, perf. 1pl); 'and we drank'
وَبَعْدَهُ: وَ + بَعْدَ + ـهُ — baʿda, after (adv.) + 3ms suffix; 'and after that'
قُلْتُ: qultu — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'I said'
أَعْمَلُ: aʿmalu — ʿamila, to do, make (verb I, impf. 1cs); 'I do, I keep [an account]'
حِسَابَ: ḥisāb — reckoning, accounting (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
مَرَّةً: marra — a time, once (f., acc. as adverb)
وَالَّذِي: وَ + الَّذِي — alladhī, who, which (rel. pron., m. sg.)
أَرَاهُ: أَرَى + ـهُ — arā, to see (verb I, impf. 1cs, from رأى — the medial hamza drops in the present-tense stem) + 3ms suffix; 'I see it'
زَائِدًا: zāʾid — surplus, excess (act. part. of زَادَ, m. acc. indef.); the edition drops the hamza sign from its correct ي seat (زايد), supplied here as a combining mark, as with رَأْس
بَيْنِي: بَيْنَ + ـي — bayna, between (prep.) + 1cs suffix; 'between me'
وَبَيْنَكَ: وَ + بَيْنَ + ـكَ — bayna, between (prep.) + 2ms suffix; 'and between you'
وَعَمِلْتُ: وَ + عَمِلْتُ — ʿamiltu (ʿamila, perf. 1cs); 'and I did'
فَرَأَيْتُ: فَـ + رَأَيْتُ — fa-, so + raʾaytu (raʾā, to see; perf. 1cs; the edition prints the hamza precomposed here, kept as printed); 'so I found'
فَحَمِدْتُ: فَـ + حَمِدْتُ — ḥamidtu (ḥamida, to praise; perf. 1cs)
الْبَارِيَ: الـ + بَارِئ — al-Bāriʾ, the Creator (act. part. of بَرَأَ, one of God's names; acc.; this common spelling drops the hamza before the final yāʾ)
سُبْحَانَهُ: سُبْحَانَ + ـهُ — subḥāna, glory be to (masdar used adverbially) + 3ms suffix; 'glory be to Him'
وَتَعَالَى: وَ + تَعَالَى — taʿālā, to be exalted (verb VI, perf. 3ms); 'and exalted [is He]'
فَأَعْطَيْتُ: فَـ + أَعْطَيْتُ — aʿṭaytu (aʿṭā, form IV, perf. 1cs); 'so I gave'
وَبَقِيَ: وَ + بَقِيَ — baqiya, to remain (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
وَقَعَدْنَا: وَ + قَعَدْنَا — qaʿadnā (qaʿada, to sit, remain; perf. 1pl)
جُمْلَةَ: jumla — sum, a good number of (f., acc. as adverbial, first term of iḍāfa); jumlata ayyāmin, 'a good while'
أَيَّامٍ: ayyām — days (m. pl. of yawm, gen. indef.)
قَامُوا: qāmū — qāma, to rise, to press (upon someone) (verb I hollow, perf. 3pl); qāmū ʿalayya, 'they pressed upon me'
وَأَرَادُوا: وَ + أَرَادُوا — arādū (form IV, رود, perf. 3pl); 'and they wanted'
أُسَافِرَ: usāfira — sāfara, to travel (verb III, impf. 1cs subjunctive after an)
وَإِيَّاهُمْ: وَ + إِيَّا + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + iyyā-, independent object-pronoun stem + 3mp suffix; 'and [together] with them'
أَيْشَ: aysh — what? (colloquial contraction of ayy shayʾ, 'which thing', standing here for Classical mādhā; recurs below)
كَسَبْتُمْ: kasabtum — kasaba, to earn, gain (verb I, perf. 2mp)
سَفَرِكُمْ: سَفَر + ـكُمْ — safar, journey (m.) + 2mp poss.; 'your journey'
أَكْسِبَ: aksiba — kasaba, to earn, gain (verb I, impf. 1cs subjunctive after ḥattā)
وَأَقَمْنَا: وَ + أَقَمْنَا — aqamnā (form IV أَقَامَ, 'to reside, remain'; perf. 1pl); 'and we stayed'
دَكَاكِينِنَا: دَكَاكِين + ـنَا — dakākīn, shops (m. pl. of dukkān) + 1pl poss.; 'our shops'
نَبِيعُ: nabīʿu — bāʿa, to sell (verb I hollow, impf. 1pl)
وَنَشْتَرِي: وَ + نَشْتَرِي — nashtarī (verb VIII شرى, impf. 1pl); 'and we buy'
وَهُمْ: وَ + هُمْ — wa-, while (circumstantial) + hum, they (3mp pron.)
يَعْرِضُونَ: yaʿriḍūna — ʿaraḍa, to propose, offer (verb I, impf. 3mp)
أَرْضَى: arḍā — raḍiya, to be content, to consent (verb I, impf. 1cs)
سِنِينَ: sinīn — years (m. sound pl. of sana, used with the numbers 11 and up, gen./acc.)
فَأَنْعَمْتُ: فَـ + أَنْعَمْتُ — anʿamtu (form IV نعم, 'to grant graciously, to consent'; perf. 1cs)
هَا: hā — here! behold! (presentative particle); hā anā, 'here I am'
مَعَكُمْ: مَعَ + ـكُمْ — maʿa, with (prep.) + 2mp suffix; 'with you'
هَاتُوا: hātū — bring! give! (a defective imperative verb with no full triliteral conjugation, 2mp)
لِكَيْ: li-kay — so that, in order that (purposive particle governing the subjunctive)
أَجِدِ: ajidi — wajada, to find (verb I, impf. 1cs jussive after lam; -i linking vowel before the following hamzat waṣl)
وَدَّرُوا: waddarū — waddara, to squander, to waste (money) (Egyptian colloquial verb, perf. 3pl, not a Classical root); vocalized as the text's own word
شَيْءٍ: shayʾ — thing (m., gen. indef.; the edition already prints the hamza itself here, kept as printed)
لِأَنَّهُمْ: لِـ + أَنَّ + ـهُمْ — li-, because (prep.) + anna, that (particle) + 3mp suffix as its subject; 'because they'
كَانُوا: kānū — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, perf. 3pl)
مُتَعَكِّفِينَ: mutaʿakkifīn — devoted, given over to (act. part. V, من عكف, m. acc. pl.)
الشُّرْبِ: الـ + شُرْب — shurb, drinking (verbal noun of shariba, m., gen.)
وَالْمَلَذَّاتِ: وَ + الـ + مَلَذَّات — malaḏḏāt, pleasures, delights (f. pl. of ladhdha, gen.)
كَلَّمْتُهُمْ: كَلَّمْتُ + ـهُمْ — kallamtu (form II كلم, 'to speak to'; perf. 1cs) + 3mp obj.; 'I spoke to them'
قُمْتُ: qumtu — qāma, to rise, get up (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs)
عَمِلْتُ: ʿamiltu — ʿamila, to do, make (verb I, perf. 1cs)
وَخَلَّيْتُ: وَ + خَلَّيْتُ — khallaytu (form II خلي, Classically 'to leave, set aside', here non-Classically 'to gather together, set apart'; perf. 1cs)
مَاكَانَ: مَا + كَانَ — mā, that which (rel. pron.) + kāna, to be (perf. 3ms); 'that which was'; the edition prints the two words fused as one (ماكان), kept as printed
الْبَضَائِعِ: الـ + بَضَائِع — baḍāʾiʿ, goods, merchandise (f. pl. of biḍāʿa, gen.)
سِتَّةَ: sitta — six (f. numeral, acc. as first term of an iḍāfa)
أَلَافِ: alāf — thousands (m. pl. of alf, gen.); the edition here spells it without the madda it uses elsewhere for the same word (آلاف), its hamza supplied as a combining mark on the bare alif
فَفَرِحْتُ: فَـ + فَرِحْتُ — fariḥtu (fariḥa, to rejoice; perf. 1cs)
قَسَمْتُهَا: قَسَمْتُ + ـهَا — qasamtu (qasama, to divide; perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj.; 'I divided it'
نِصْفَيْنِ: niṣfayn — niṣf, half (m., dual acc.); 'into two halves'
وَلَكُمْ: وَ + لِـ + ـكُمْ — wa-, and + li-, to, for (prep.) + 2mp suffix; 'and for you'
نَتَاجَرَ: natājara — tājara, to trade (verb III, impf. 1pl subjunctive after li-kay)
دَفَنْتُ: dafantu — dafana, to bury (verb I, perf. 1cs)
الْأُخْرَى: al-ukhrā — ukhrā, other (adj., f. sg. of ākhar, here def.); 'the other [three thousand]'
اِحْتِمَالًا: iḥtimāl — possibility, contingency (masdar of form VIII اِحْتَمَلَ, m. acc. as adverb of purpose); 'as a precaution'
فَاجِي: fa-ajī — colloquial Egyptian verb 'to come' (yijī/ajī), here loosely 'so I would come by, have on hand'; a distinct dialectal verb, not a spelling of Classical جاء
نَفْتَحُ: naftaḥu — fataḥa, to open (verb I, impf. 1pl)
دَكَاكِينَنَا: دَكَاكِين + ـنَا — dakākīn, shops (m. pl.) + 1pl poss.; 'our shops' (acc.)
وَاِرْتَضَوْا: وَ + اِرْتَضَوْا — irtaḍaw (verb VIII رضي, perf. 3pl); 'and they agreed'
مِثْلُهُمْ: مِثْلُ + ـهُمْ — mithl, the like (m., nom.) + 3mp suffix; 'the like of them, as much as they [had]'
فَتَحَوَّجْنَا: فَـ + تَحَوَّجْنَا — taḥawwajnā (verb V حوج, non-Classically 'to procure what is needed', from ḥāja, 'need'; perf. 1pl)
الْبَضَائِعَ: الـ + بَضَائِع — baḍāʾiʿ, goods (f. pl., acc.)
الْوَاجِبَةَ: الـ + وَاجِبَة — wājiba, necessary, required (act. part. I, f. acc.)
وَجَهَّزْنَا: وَ + جَهَّزْنَا — jahhaznā (form II جهز, 'to make ready, equip'; perf. 1pl)
الْمُسْفَرَ: al-musfar — obscure nominal from س-ف-ر ('journey'); apparently 'the travel-gear, the preparations for departure' (non-Classical usage, acc.)
أَكْرَيْنَا: akraynā — akrā (form IV كري, 'to hire out, rent'; perf. 1pl); 'we hired'
مَرْكَبًا: markaban — markab, a ship, vessel (m., acc. indef.)
وَنَقَلْنَا: وَ + نَقَلْنَا — naqalnā (naqala, to move, transport; perf. 1pl)
حَوَايِجَنَا: حَوَايِج + ـنَا — ḥawāyij, things, belongings (Egyptian colloquial pl. of ḥāja, not Classical ḥājāt) + 1pl poss.; 'our belongings'
وَسَافَرْنَا: وَ + سَافَرْنَا — sāfarnā (verb III, perf. 1pl); 'and we set out'
أَوَّلَ: awwal — first (adj., m. acc. as adverbial, first term of an iḍāfa)
وَثَانِيَ: وَ + ثَانِيَ — thānī, second (adj., m. acc.); 'and the second'
كَامِلٍ: kāmil — complete, whole (adj., m. gen. indef.)
فَدَخَلْنَا: فَـ + دَخَلْنَا — dakhalnā (dakhala, perf. 1pl); 'so we entered'
وَمَعَنَا: وَ + مَعَ + ـنَا — maʿa, with (prep.) + 1pl suffix; 'with us'
بَضَائِعُنَا: بَضَائِع + ـنَا — baḍāʾiʿ, goods (f. pl.) + 1pl poss.; 'our goods' (nom.)
فَرَبِحْنَا: فَـ + رَبِحْنَا — rabiḥnā (rabiḥa, to profit; perf. 1pl)
دَنَانِيرَ: danānīr — dinars (m. pl. of dīnār, acc.)
وَأَرَدْنَا: وَ + أَرَدْنَا — aradnā (form IV رود, perf. 1pl); 'and we wanted'
فَوَجَدْنَا: فَـ + وَجَدْنَا — wajadnā (wajada, perf. 1pl); 'so we found'
شَاطِئِ: shāṭiʾ — shore (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); the edition prints it without the hamza's mark on its ي seat (شاطي), supplied here as a combining mark, as with رَأْس elsewhere
خِلْقَةٌ: khilqa — a garment, a made thing (f. nom. indef.; lit. 'a creation, a fashioned thing')
مُقَطَّعَةٌ: muqaṭṭaʿa — cut up, torn to pieces (pass. part. II, f. nom. indef.)
فَقَبَّلَتْ: فَـ + قَبَّلَتْ — qabbalat (form II قبل, 'to kiss'; perf. 3fs)
فِيكَ: فِي + ـكَ — fī, in (prep.) + 2ms suffix; 'in you'
حَسَنَةٌ: ḥasana — a good deed, a kindness (f. nom. indef.)
وَمَعْرُوفٌ: وَ + مَعْرُوفٌ — maʿrūf, a kindness, a good turn (pass. part. I, m. nom. indef.)
أُجَازِيكَ: أُجَازِي + ـكَ — ujāzī (jāzā, form III, 'to reward, repay'; impf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I may reward you'
أُحِبُّ: uḥibbu — aḥabba, to love, like (form IV, impf. 1cs)
الْحَسَنَةَ: الـ + حَسَنَة — ḥasana, a good deed, kindness (f., acc.)
وَالْمَعْرُوفَ: وَ + الـ + مَعْرُوف — maʿrūf, kindness, a good turn (m., acc.)
تُجَازِينِي: تُجَازِي + ـنِي — tujāzī (jāzā, impf. 2fs) + 1cs obj.; 'you reward me'
تَزَوَّجْنِي: تَزَوَّجْ + ـنِي — tazawwaj (form V زوج, imperative 2ms) + 1cs obj.; 'marry me'
وَخُذْنِي: وَ + خُذْ + ـنِي — khudh (akhadha, imperative 2ms, irregular assimilated form dropping its hamza entirely) + 1cs obj.; 'and take me'
بِلَادَكَ: بِلَاد + ـكَ — bilād, country, land (f. pl. used as a collective) + 2ms poss.; 'your country'
فَإِنِّي: فَـ + إِنِّي — fa-, for (conj.) + innī, indeed I (inna + 1cs suffix)
نَفْسِي: نَفْس + ـي — nafs, self, soul (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'myself'
فَاِفْعَلْ: فَـ + اِفْعَلْ — fa-, so + ifʿal (faʿala, imperative 2ms); 'so do!'
مَعْرُوفًا: maʿrūfan — maʿrūf, a kindness (m., acc. indef.)
يَفْعَلُ: yafʿalu — faʿala, to do (verb I, impf. 3ms); yafʿalu maʿahu, 'is done to him'
وَالْحَسَنَةُ: وَ + الـ + حَسَنَة — ḥasana, kindness (f., nom.)

فَرْشًا: farshan — farsh, bedding, spread (m., acc. indef.); 'bedding'

فَصَارَتْ: فَـ + صَارَتْ — ṣāra, to become (v. I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'so she became'

قَلْبِي: قَلْب + ـي — qalb, heart (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my heart'

وَحَمَلَتْنِي: وَ + حَمَلَتْ + ـنِي — ḥamala, to carry (v. I, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'and she carried me'
وَحَمَلُونِي: وَ + حَمَلُوا + ـنِي — ḥamala, to carry (v. I, perf. 3mp) + 1cs obj.; 'and they carried me'

وَصِرْتُ: وَ + صِرْتُ — ṣāra, to become (v. I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'and I became'
وَطَارَتْ: وَ + طَارَتْ — ṭāra, to fly (v. I, perf. 3fs); 'and she flew'

وَمَنْ: وَ + مَنْ — man, who (interrog. pron.); 'and who'

بِكُوزٍ: بِـ + كُوز — kūz, jug, pitcher (m., gen. indef.); 'with a jug'

وَرَشَّتْنِي: وَ + رَشَّتْ + ـنِي — rashshat (rashsha, to sprinkle; verb I, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'and she sprinkled me'
اخْرُجْ: ukhruj — kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperative ms)
الصُّورَةِ: الـ + صُورَة — ṣūra, form, shape (f., gen.)
صُورَةِ: ṣūra — form, shape (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
فَصِرْتُ: فَـ + صِرْتُ — fa-, so + ṣirtu (ṣāra, to become; verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'so I became'
كَلْبًا: kalb — dog (m., acc. indef. as predicate)
فَطَرَدَتْنِي: فَـ + طَرَدَتْ + ـنِي — ṭaradat (ṭarada, to drive away, expel; verb I, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'so she drove me out'
أَزَلْ: azal — zāla, to cease (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs jussive after lam); lam azal, 'I did not cease'
أَسِيرُ: asīru — sāra, to travel, journey (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs, indicative predicate of zāla)
وَصَلْتُ: waṣaltu — waṣala, to arrive (verb I, perf. 1cs)
دُكَّانِ: dukkān — shop, stall (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
جَزَّارٍ: jazzār — butcher (m., gen. indef.; second term of an iḍāfa)
الْعِظَامِ: الـ + عِظَام — ʿaẓm, bone (m. pl. ʿiẓām; gen.)
رَأنِي: رَأَى + ـنِي — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'he saw me' (here the edition prints a bare alif with no hamza indication at all, unlike the precomposed رأتني/رأيتها elsewhere in this slice; vocalized with the supplied combining hamza)
أَخَذَنِي: أَخَذَ + ـنِي — akhadha, to take (verb I hamzated, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'he took me'
بَيْتَهُ: بَيْت + ـهُ — bayt, house (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his house'
الْجَزَّارِ: الـ + جَزَّار — jazzār, butcher (m., gen.; second term of an iḍāfa)
غَطَّتْ: ghaṭṭat — ghaṭṭā, to cover (verb II, perf. 3fs)
تَجِيءُ: tajīʾu — jāʾa, to come, bring (verb I final-hamzated, imperf. 2ms); with bi-, 'you bring'
بِرَجُلٍ: بِـ + رَجُل — rajul, man (m., gen. indef.); 'with a man'
