مُلْكِي: مُلْك + ـي — mulk, kingdom, dominion (m., gen.) + 1cs suffix; 'my kingdom'
لَكَانَ: لَـ + كَانَ — la-, emphatic particle + kāna, to be (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); introduces the apodosis of لو
أَظُنُّ: أَظُنُّ — ẓanna/aẓunnu, to think, suppose (verb I of ظ-ن-ن, impf. 1cs)
حَسَدًا: حَسَدًا — ḥasad, envy (m., acc. indef., adverbial of cause/exception)
السِّنْدِبَادِ: الـ + سِنْدِبَاد — al-Sindibād, proper name, a king referred to but not otherwise identified here (m., gen.)
فَسَكَتَ: فَ + سَكَتَ — sakata ʿan, to fall silent from (verb I of س-ك-ت, perf.); the archive prints a single ت where the feminine سَكَتَتْ (agreeing with Shahrazad) would need two, see note
أَيُّهَا: ayyuhā — vocative particle 'O' (used before a definite noun, e.g. ayyuhā al-malik, 'O king')
وَرَأَي: وَ + رَأَى — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms); this text spells the final long ā with ي instead of ى, kept as printed, matching the precedent already set for رَأَي; 'and he saw'
وَمَنَعَهُ: وَ + مَنَعَ + ـهُ — manaʿa, to prevent, bar, forbid (verb I of م-ن-ع, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'and it barred/prevented him'
الْخَامِسَةُ: الـ + خَامِسَة — khāmisa, fifth (f. ordinal, nom., agreeing with اللَّيْلَة)
لِوَزِيرِهِ: لِـ + وَزِير + ـهِ — li-, to (prep.) + wazīr, vizier (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'to his vizier'
دَاخَلَكَ: دَاخَلَ + ـكَ — dākhala, to enter into, come over (someone) (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 2ms obj.; idiom, 'it (envy) came over you'
الْحَسَدُ: الـ + حَسَد — ḥasad, envy (m., nom. as subject)
وَتُرِيدُ: وَ + تُرِيدُ — turīdu (< arāda), to want, wish (verb IV, impf. 2ms); 'and you want'
قَتْلَهُ: قَتْل + ـهُ — qatl, killing (m. verbal noun, acc. as object of 'want') + 3ms obj.; 'his killing' = 'to kill him'
أَنْدَمُ: nadima, to regret (verb I, impf. 1cs); 'I will regret' (the hamza of the 1st-person prefix is supplied editorially, the edition printing none)
السِّنْدِبَادُ: الـ + سِنْدِبَاد — al-Sindibād, proper name (m., nom., in apposition to الملك)
قَتْلِ: qatl, killing (m. verbal noun, gen. as object of عَلَى)
الْعَفْوَ: الـ + عَفْو — ʿafw, pardon (m., acc.); elliptical exclamatory request, '[I ask] pardon!'
السِّنْدِبَانِ: الـ + سِنْدِبَان — al-Sindibān, proper name (m., gen.); the edition's own variant spelling of السِّنْدِبَاد found elsewhere in this same tale, kept as printed rather than harmonized
الْفَرَحَ: الـ + فَرَح — faraḥ, joy, delight (m., acc.)
وَالتَّنَزُّهَ: وَ + الـ + تَنَزُّه — tanazzuh, recreation, going out for pleasure (m. verbal noun of verb V, acc.)
وَالصَّيْدَ: وَ + الـ + صَيْد — ṣayd, hunting (m., acc.)
وَالْقَنَصَ: وَ + الـ + قَنَص — qanaṣ, the chase, hunting (m., acc.); a near-synonym of صَيْد paired with it for emphasis
مُرَبِّيَ: مُرَبِّي — murabbī, one who raises, trains (m. act. part. II of رَبَّى, acc., construct); 'a raiser/trainer of'
يُفَارِقُهُ: يُفَارِقُ + ـهُ — fāraqa/yufāriqu, to part from, leave (verb III, impf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
شَائِلَهُ: شَائِل + ـهُ — shāʾil, holding aloft, keeping raised (m. act. part. I of شَالَ 'to lift, raise', acc. as predicate of كَانَ, construct) + 3ms obj.; 'keeping it perched'
يَدِهِ: يَد + ـهِ — yad, hand (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.
يَأْخُذُهُ: يَأْخُذُ + ـهُ — akhadha/yaʾkhudhu, to take (verb I, impf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
وَعَامَلَ: وَ + عَامَلَ — ʿāmala, Classically 'to deal with, treat' (verb III, perf. 3ms); used here in the colloquial sense 'to have (something) made/fixed up for him' still current in spoken Arabic
مُعَلَّقَةً: muʿallaqa, hung, suspended (f. pass. part. II of عَلَّقَ, acc. as adjective)
رَقَبَتِهِ: رَقَبَة + ـهِ — raqaba, neck (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.
يَسْقِيهِ: يَسْقِي + ـهِ — saqā/yasqī, to give to drink, water (verb I defective, impf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
بِأَمِيرِ: بِـ + أَمِير — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after wa-idhā 'and behold' (no English word of its own) + amīr, commander, officer (m., gen.); here in the obscure title أَمِيرُ الرَّخَةِ, see note on الرَّخَة
الرَّخَةِ: الـ + رَخَة — rakha(h), of uncertain meaning here, apparently a court or hunting title (f., gen.); see note
أَوَانُ: awān, time, season, moment (m., nom. as predicate)
الْخُرُوجِ: الـ + خُرُوج — khurūj, going out, departure (m. verbal noun, gen.)
بِالْخُرُوجِ: بِـ + الـ + خُرُوج — khurūj, departure (m., gen. after بِ); 'for departure'
وَسَارُوا: وَ + سَارُوا — sāra/sārū, to travel, set out (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp)
وَادٍ: wādin, a valley (m., gen. indef., defective/manqūṣ noun)
وَضَرَبُوا: وَ + ضَرَبُوا — ḍaraba, to strike; with حَلْقَة, 'to pitch/form (a ring)' (verb I, perf. 3mp)
حَلْقَةَ: ḥalqa, ring, circle; here the hunting-ring formed by beaters (f., acc.)
بِغَزَالَةٍ: بِـ + غَزَالَة — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after wa-idhā 'and behold' (no English word of its own) + ghazāla, gazelle (f., gen. indef.)
وَقَعَتْ: وَ + وَقَعَتْ — waqaʿa/waqaʿat, to fall, land, be caught (verb I, perf. 3fs)
نَطَّتِ: naṭṭat, to jump, leap (verb I geminate, perf. 3fs; -i is a helping vowel before the following hamzat waṣl)
دِمَاغِهِ: دِمَاغ + ـهِ — dimāgh, head, brain (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
فَضَيَّقُوا: فَـ + ضَيَّقُوا — ḍayyaqa, to narrow, tighten (verb II, perf. 3mp)
لِبَيْتِ: لِـ + بَيْت — li-, to, into (prep.) + bayt, tent, house (m., gen.); لِ here stands for إِلَى, 'into', as often in this register
وَثَبَتَتْ: وَ + ثَبَتَتْ — thabatat, she stood firm, steadied herself (verb I, perf. 3fs)
رِجْلَيْهَا: رِجْل + ـَيْ + ـهَا — rijl, leg, foot (f., dual obl.) + 3fs poss.; 'her two legs'
وَحَطَّتْ: وَ + حَطَّتْ — ḥaṭṭat, she set down, placed (verb I, perf. 3fs)
صَدْرِهَا: صَدْر + ـهَا — ṣadr, chest, breast (m., gen.) + 3fs poss.
تَبُوسُ: tabūsu, she kisses (verb I, impf. 3fs; colloquial بَاسَ/يَبُوسُ 'to kiss', beside Classical قَبَّلَ)
فَطَاطَاءَ: فَـ + طَاطَاءَ — ṭāṭaʾa, to bow, lower (the head) (quadriliteral verb, perf. 3ms); a vernacular-shifted spelling of Classical طَأْطَأَ, the medial hamza-sukūn having weakened to a long vowel
لِلْغَزَالَةِ: لِـ + الـ + غَزَالَة — ghazāla, gazelle (f., gen.); 'to the gazelle'
فَفَرَّتْ: فَـ + فَرَّتْ — farrat, she fled, escaped (verb I, perf. 3fs)
فَوْقِ: fawq, above, over (adv./prep., gen. as muḍāf)
رَاحَتْ: rāḥat, she went, departed (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs)
فَظَلَّ: فَـ + ظَلَّ — ẓalla, to remain, continue [doing] (verb I hollow/geminate, perf. 3ms); here loosely followed by a perfect verb rather than the Classical imperfect
يَتَغَامَزُونَ: yataghāmazūna, to wink or exchange glances at one another (verb VI of غَمَزَ, impf. 3mp)
الْعَسْكَرُ: الـ + عَسْكَر — ʿaskar, army, troops (m., nom.)
يَقُولُونَ: yaqūlūna, they say (verb I hollow, impf. 3mp)
قُلْتَ: qulta, you said (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms)
يُقْتَلُ: yuqtalu, he is/shall be killed (verb I, impf. 3ms, passive)
وَحَيَاةِ: وَ + حَيَاة — ḥayāt, life (f., gen., muḍāf after the oath-wāw); 'by the life of'
رَأْسِي: رَأْس + ـِي — raʾs, head (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my head'
لَأَتْبَعُهَا: لَـ + أَتْبَعُ + ـهَا — tabiʿa/atbaʿu, to follow (verb I, impf. 1cs) + 3fs obj., with the emphatic lām of an oath's response; 'I will surely follow her'
أَجِي: ajī, I come (verb I, impf. 1cs); a colloquial/Middle Arabic form of Classical أَجِيءُ, the final hamza having weakened away, as commonly in spoken Arabic
تَابِعَ: تَابِع — tābiʿ, following, a follower of (m. act. part. I of تَبِعَ, acc. as predicate of ظَلَّ, construct); 'kept following'
وَرَاءَهَا: وَرَاء + ـهَا — warāʾ, behind (adv./prep.) + 3fs; 'behind her, after her'
الْجِبَالِ: الـ + جِبَال — jibāl, mountains (m. pl. of جَبَل, gen.)
فَأَرَادَتْ: فَـ + أَرَادَتْ — arādat, she wanted, intended (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
تَعْبُرَ: taʿbura, that she cross (verb I, subj. 3fs, after أَنْ)
فَسَيَّبَ: فَـ + سَيَّبَ — sayyaba, to release, let loose (an animal) (verb II, perf. 3ms)
يَلْطُشُهَا: يَلْطُشُ + ـهَا — laṭasha/yalṭushu, to strike, peck at (colloquial verb I, impf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
عَيْنَيْهَا: عَيْن + ـَيْ + ـهَا — ʿayn, eye (f., dual obl.) + 3fs poss.; 'her two eyes'
أَعْمَاهَا: أَعْمَى + ـهَا — aʿmā, to blind (verb IV of عَمِيَ, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَدَوَّخَهَا: وَ + دَوَّخَ + ـهَا — dawwakha, to make dizzy, daze (verb II of دَاخَ, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
فَسَحَبَ: فَـ + سَحَبَ — saḥaba, to draw, pull out (verb I, perf. 3ms)
دَبُّوسًا: dabbūs, mace, club (m., acc. indef.; Persian loanword)
قَلْبَهَا: قَلْب + ـهَا — qalb, heart (m., acc.) + 3fs poss.
ذَبَحَهَا: ذَبَحَ + ـهَا — dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَعَلَّقَهَا: وَ + عَلَّقَ + ـهَا — ʿallaqa, to hang, suspend (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
سَاعَةَ: sāʿa, hour, time (f., acc. as predicate of كَانَتْ)
قَيَالَةٍ: qayāla(h), midday rest, siesta (f., gen. indef.); an uncertain form, apparently related to Classical قَيْلُولَة, see note
الْغَابَةُ: الـ + غَابَة — ghāba, forest, wilderness (f., nom.)
مُقْفِرَةً: muqfira, desolate, uninhabited (f. act. part. IV of أَقْفَرَ, acc. as predicate)
يُوجَدْ: yūjad, is found (verb I, passive jussive after لَمْ)
فَعَطِشَ: فَـ + عَطِشَ — ʿaṭisha, to become thirsty (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَعَطِشَ: وَ + عَطِشَ — ʿaṭisha, to become thirsty (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْحِصَانُ: الـ + حِصَان — ḥiṣān, horse, stallion (m., nom.)
فَدَوَّرَ: فَـ + دَوَّرَ — dawwara, to search around, look about (verb II of دَارَ, perf. 3ms)
فَرَأَى: فَـ + رَأَى — raʾā, to see (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
نَازِلًا: nāzil, descending, dripping down (m. act. part. I of نَزَلَ, acc., circumstantial)
السَّمْنِ: الـ + سَمْن — samn, clarified butter, ghee (m., gen.)
لَابِسَ: lābis, wearing (m. act. part. I of لَبِسَ, acc. as predicate of كَانَ, construct)
كُفُوفٍ: kufūf, gloves (m. pl. of كَفّ 'palm', gen. indef.)
السُّرَادِقِ: الـ + سُرَادِق — surādiq, a large tent, pavilion (m., gen.)
فَأَخَذَ: فَـ + أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الطَّاسَةَ: الـ + طَاسَة — ṭāsa, cup, bowl (f., acc.; Persian loanword)
وَمَلَأَهَا: وَ + مَلَأَ + ـهَا — malaʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَوَضَعَ: وَ + وَضَعَ — waḍaʿa, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قُدَّامَهُ: قُدَّام + ـهُ — quddām, in front of, before (adv./prep.) + 3ms; 'before him'
بِالْبَازِ: بِـ + الـ + بَاز — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after wa-idhā 'and behold' (no English word of its own) + bāz, falcon (m., gen.)
لَطَسَ: laṭasa, to knock, strike (colloquial verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَلَبَهَا: qalaba, to overturn, upset (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
ثَانِيًا: thāniyan, a second time (m., acc. adverbial)
النَّفْطَ: الـ + نَفْط — naft, naphtha, an oily substance (m., acc.); here describing the oily-looking liquid dripping from the tree — possibly a misprint for النُّقْطَة, 'the drop' (ف/ق are easily confused), see note
النَّازِلَةَ: الـ + نَازِلَة — nāzila, descending, dripping (f. act. part. I of نَزَلَ, acc.)
مَلَأَهَا: malaʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَظَنَّ: وَ + ظَنَّ — ẓanna, to think, suppose (verb I geminate, perf. 3ms)
فَوَضَعَهَا: فَـ + وَضَعَ + ـهَا — waḍaʿa, to place (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
فَلَطَسَهَا: فَـ + لَطَسَ + ـهَا — laṭasa, to knock, strike (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
فَانْقَبَضَ: فَـ + اِنْقَبَضَ — inqabaḍa, to be vexed, put out (verb VII of قَبَضَ, perf. 3ms)
وَقَامَ: وَ + قَامَ — qāma, to rise, stand up (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
وَمَلَاءَ: وَ + مَلَاءَ — malāʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3ms); a lengthened vernacular spelling of Classical مَلَأَ (compare فَطَاطَاءَ above), with the hamza written bare after an extra long alif
وَقَدَّمَهَا: وَ + قَدَّمَ + ـهَا — qaddama, to offer, present (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
لِلْحِصَانِ: لِـ + الـ + حِصَان — ḥiṣān, horse (m., gen.); 'to the horse'
فَقَلَبَهَا: فَـ + قَلَبَ + ـهَا — qalaba, to overturn (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
بِجَنَاحِهِ: بِـ + جَنَاح + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + janāḥ, wing (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
يُشَيِّبُكَ: يُشَيِّبُ + ـكَ — shayyaba, to make grey-haired, age (someone) (verb II of شَابَ, jussive/optative 3ms 'may he...') + 2ms obj.; imprecation, 'may God age you [with grief]!'
أَيْشَمَ: أَيْشَم — ashʾam, most ill-omened (elative of شُؤْم, construct/vocative form); the ي stands in for the expected medial hamza (compare نَايِمَة), a colloquial hamza-weakening
الطُّيُورِ: الـ + طُيُور — ṭuyūr, birds (m. pl. of طَيْر, gen.)
أَحْرَمْتَنِي: أَحْرَمْتَ + ـنِي — aḥrama, to deprive (verb IV of حَرَمَ, perf. 2ms) + 1cs obj.
وَأَحْرَمْتَ: وَ + أَحْرَمْتَ — aḥramta, you deprived (verb IV, perf. 2ms)
نَفْسَكَ: نَفْس + ـكَ — nafs, self, soul (f., acc.) + 2ms poss.; 'yourself'
بِالسَّيْفِ: بِـ + الـ + سَيْف — bi-, with (prep.) + sayf, sword (m., gen.)
أَجْنِحَتَهُ: أَجْنِحَة + ـهُ — ajniḥa, wings (m. broken pl. of جَنَاح, acc.) + 3ms poss.
يُقِيمُ: yuqīmu, he raises, lifts (verb IV of قَامَ, impf. 3ms)
انْظُرْ: unẓur, look! (verb I imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl — no hamza mark is added, as the alif carries no true glottal stop)
عَيْنَهُ: عَيْن + ـهُ — ʿayn, eye (f., acc.) + 3ms poss.
فَرْخَ: farkh, the young (of a bird or creature), a chick (m., acc., construct)
آفَةٍ: āfa, a pest, a blight, a harmful creature; here concretely 'a viper, a snake' (f., gen. indef.)
سَمُّهَا: سَمّ + ـهَا — samm, poison, venom (m., nom.) + 3fs poss.
فَنَدِمَ: فَـ + نَدِمَ — nadima, to regret (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَصِّ: qaṣṣ, cutting, clipping (m. verbal noun of قَصَّ, gen.)
أَجْنِحَةِ: ajniḥa, wings (m. broken pl. of جَنَاح, gen.)
حِصَانَهُ: حِصَان + ـهُ — ḥiṣān, horse (m., acc.) + 3ms poss.
الْوَطَاقِ: الـ + وَطَاق — waṭāq, camp, tent-enclosure (m., gen.; loanword)
بِمَتَاعِهِ: بِـ + مَتَاع + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + matāʿ, gear, belongings (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
فَأَعْطَى: فَـ + أَعْطَى — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
شَوِّهَا: شَوِّ + ـهَا — shawwā/shawwi, to roast, grill (verb II, imperative 2ms) + 3fs obj.
الْكُرْسِيِّ: الـ + كُرْسِيّ — kursī, chair, seat (m., gen.)
وَالْبَازُ: وَ + الـ + بَاز — bāz, falcon (m., nom.)
فَتَحَقَّقَ: فَـ + تَحَقَّقَ — taḥaqqaqa, to be verified, ascertained (verb V of حَقَّ, perf. 3ms)
فَصَرَخَ: فَـ + صَرَخَ — ṣarakha, to cry out, shout (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَأَسَفًا: وَ + أَسَفًا — asaf, sorrow, regret (m., acc. adverbial); the edition prints the hamza here, kept as given
وَكَوْنِهِ: وَ + كَوْن + ـهِ — kawn, being (m. verbal noun of كَانَ, gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'and its/his being [that it had...]'
الْهَلَاكِ: الـ + هَلَاك — halāk, destruction, ruin (m., gen.)
الْعَظِيمُ: الـ + عَظِيم — ʿaẓīm, great, mighty (adj., m. nom.); in apposition to الملك
الشَّأْنِ: الـ + شَأْن — shaʾn, affair, rank, importance (m., gen.); in عَظِيمُ الشَّأْنِ, 'great of rank'; the edition prints its hamza-seat alif bare, so a combining hamza is supplied
رَأَيْتُ: raʾaytu — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I saw'
سُوْءًا: سُوء — sūʾ, evil, harm (m., acc. indef.); 'any evil'
وَإِنَّمَا: وَ + إِنَّمَا — wa-innamā, and only, but rather (restrictive particle)
شَفَقَةً: shafaqa — pity, compassion, concern (f., acc. of cause/manner); 'out of compassion'
وَلِأَجْلِ: وَ + لِـ + أَجْل — ajl, sake, reason (m., gen.); li-ajli, 'for the sake of'
تَعْلَمَ: taʿlama — ʿalima, to know (verb I, subjunctive 2ms after أَنْ)
صِحَّةَ: ṣiḥḥa — soundness, correctness, truth (f., acc.); 'the truth of that'
هَلَكْتَ: halakta — halaka, to perish (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you would perish'
هَلَكَ: halaka — to perish, die (verb I, perf. 3ms)
اِحْتَالَ: iḥtāla — form VIII of حول/حيل, 'to scheme, use a stratagem' (perf. 3ms, hamzat waṣl)
اِبْنِ: اِبْن — ibn, son (m., gen., hamzat waṣl); first term of iḍāfa
الْمُحْتَالِ: الـ + مُحْتَال — muḥtāl, scheming, crafty (act. part. of اِحْتَالَ, m. gen.); 'the scheming [vizier]'
وَلَدٌ: walad — son, boy, child (m., nom. indef.)
مُولَعٌ: mūlaʿ — devoted, addicted (pass. part. of form IV وَلِعَ, m. nom. indef.)
بِالصَّيْدِ: بِـ + الـ + صَيْد — bi-, with, to (prep.; mūlaʿ bi- = devoted to) + ṣayd, hunting (m., gen.)
لِأَبِيهِ: لِـ + أَبِيهِ — li-, to/of + abīhi, his father (oblique of أب + 3ms); 'belonging to his father'
أَمَرَهُ: amarahu — amara, to command, order (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'he commanded him'
يَكُونَ: yakūna — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, subjunctive 3ms after أَنْ)
تَوَجَّهَ: tawajjaha — form V, 'to set off, head [somewhere]' (perf. 3ms)
الْوَلَدُ: الـ + وَلَد — walad, boy, son (m., nom.)
فَسَارُوا: فَـ + سَارُوا — sāra, to travel, set off (verb I, perf. 3mp)
فَنَظَرُوا: فَـ + نَظَرُوا — naẓara, to look, catch sight of (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَحْشِيٍّ: waḥshiyy — wild (nisba adj. used substantively for 'a wild beast'; m. gen. indef.)
كَبِيرٍ: kabīr — great, large (adj., m. gen. indef.)
لِاِبْنِ: لِـ + اِبْن — li- + ibn, son; 'to the son [of the king]'
الْوَحْشِيَّ: الـ + وَحْشِيّ — waḥshiyy, wild beast (m., acc., definite)
فَاُطْلُبْهُ: فَـ + اُطْلُبْ + ـهُ — ṭalaba, to seek, pursue (verb I imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl) + 3ms obj.; 'so pursue it!'
فَقَصَدَ: فَـ + قَصَدَ — qaṣada, to head for, make for (verb I, perf. 3ms)
اِبْنُ: اِبْن — ibn, son (m., nom., hamzat waṣl); first term of iḍāfa
غَابَ: ghāba — to be absent, disappear, vanish (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
الْوَحْشِيُّ: الـ + وَحْشِيّ — waḥshiyy, wild beast (m., nom.)
يَرُوحُ: yarūḥu — rāḥa, to go, depart (verb I, impf. 3ms)
يَسِيرُ: yasīru — sāra, to travel, go (verb I, impf. 3ms)
بِجَارِيَةٍ: بِـ + جَارِيَة — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after wa-idhā 'and behold' (no English word of its own) + jāriya, girl, young woman (f., gen. indef.)
رَأْسِ: raʾs — head, top (m., gen.); 'at the head of the road'
الطَّرِيقِ: الـ + طَرِيق — ṭarīq, road, way (m./f., gen.)
تَبْكِي: tabkī — bakā, to weep (verb I, impf. 3fs)
فَأَدْرَكَنِي: فَـ + أَدْرَكَ + ـنِي — adraka, to overtake, reach (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'it overtook me'
الدَّابَّةِ: الـ + دَابَّة — dābba, mount, riding beast (f., gen.)
بِنَفْسِي: بِـ + نَفْس + ـي — nafs, self (f., gen.) + 1cs; 'of myself'
مُنْقَطِعَةً: munqaṭiʿa — cut off, stranded (act. part. of form VII اِنْقَطَعَ, f. acc. indef.)
حَائِرَةً: ḥāʾira — bewildered, at a loss (act. part. of حَارَ, f. acc. indef.)
رَثَى: rathā — to pity, feel compassion for (verb I, perf. 3ms; here with لِـ)
لِحَالِهَا: لِـ + حَال + ـهَا — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f.) + 3fs; 'for/at her state'
وَحَمَلَهَا: وَ + حَمَلَ + ـهَا — ḥamala, to carry (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
ظَهْرِ: ẓahr — back (m., gen.); first term of iḍāfa
دَابَّتِهِ: dābba — mount, riding beast (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his mount'
وَأَرْدَفَهَا: وَ + أَرْدَفَ + ـهَا — ardafa, form IV, 'to seat behind oneself [on a mount]' (perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
مَرَّ: marra — to pass by (verb I, perf. 3ms)
بِخَرَابَةٍ: بِـ + خَرَابَة — bi-, by (prep.; marra bi- = pass by) + kharāba, ruin, ruined place (f., gen. indef.)
أُزِيلَ: uzīla — form IV of زَالَ, 'to remove' (subjunctive 1cs after أَنْ)
ضَرُورَةً: ḍarūra — necessity, pressing need (f., acc. indef.); the text's euphemism for relieving oneself
فَأَنْزَلَهَا: فَـ + أَنْزَلَ + ـهَا — anzala, form IV, 'to bring/set down' (perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
فَعَوَّقَتْ: فَـ + عَوَّقَتْ — ʿawwaqat, form II of عاق, 'she held [herself] up, delayed' (perf. 3fs)
فَاِسْتَبْطَأَهَا: فَـ + اِسْتَبْطَأَ + ـهَا — istabṭaʾa, form X, 'to deem someone slow/tardy' (perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
يَعْلَمُ: يَعْلَمُ — ʿalima/yaʿlamu, to know (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he knows'
غُولَةٌ: ghūla — ghouleh, a man-eating female demon (f., nom. indef.); spelling kept as the edition prints it
لِأَوْلَادِهَا: لِـ + أَوْلَاد + ـهَا — li-, to (prep.) + awlād, children (pl. of وَلَد, gen.) + 3fs poss.
أَتَيْتُكُمُ: ataytukumu — atā, to come, bring (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 2mp obj.; 'I have brought you'
بِغُلَامٍ: بِـ + غُلَام — bi-, with (prep.; atā/jāʾa bi- = come with, i.e. bring) + ghulām, boy, lad (m., gen. indef.)
فَقَالُوا: فَـ + قَالُوا — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp)
اِئْتِينَا: اِئْتِ + ـينَا — atā, imperative 2fs (form I, hamzat waṣl) + 'to us' obj. suffix; 'bring him to us' (see note)
نَرْعَاهُ: narʿāhu — raʿā, to graze, feed on (verb I, impf. 1cp) + 3ms obj.
بُطُونِنَا: buṭūn — bellies (pl. of بَطْن, gen.) + 1cp poss.
بِالْهَلَاكِ: بِـ + الـ + هَلَاك — bi-, of (prep.; ayqana bi- = be certain of) + halāk, destruction, ruin (m., gen.)
وَارْتَعَدَتْ: وَ + اِرْتَعَدَتْ — irtaʿadat, form VIII of رعد, 'to tremble, shudder' (perf. 3fs)
وَخَشِيَ: وَ + خَشِيَ — khashiya, to fear (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَرَأَتْهُ: فَـ + رَأَتْ + ـهُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.
كَالْخَائِفِ: كَـ + الـ + خَائِف — khāʾif, fearful (act. part., m. gen.); 'like the fearful one'
الْوَجِلِ: الـ + وَجِل — wajil, terrified, apprehensive (adj., m. gen.)
بَالُكَ: bāl — mind, state, concern (m., nom.) + 2ms poss.; 'your state, what ails you'
فَقَالَتِ: فَـ + قَالَتْ — qāla, to say (perf. 3fs; -ti before al-)
تَدْفَعُ: tadfaʿu — dafaʿa, to give, hand over, pay (verb I, impf. 2ms)
لِعَدُوِّكَ: لِـ + عَدُوّ + ـكَ — ʿaduww, enemy (m., gen.) + 2ms poss.; 'to your enemy'
تُرْضِيهِ: turḍīhi — arḍā, form IV of رضي, 'to satisfy, content' (impf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.
يَرْضَى: yarḍā — raḍiya, to be satisfied, content (verb I, impf. 3ms)
بِمَالٍ: بِـ + مَال — bi-, with (prep.; raḍiya bi- = be satisfied with) + māl, wealth, property (m., gen. indef.)
بِالرُّوحِ: بِـ + الـ + رُوح — bi-, with (prep.; raḍiya bi- = be satisfied with) + rūḥ, soul, life, spirit (m./f., gen.)
مَظْلُومٌ: maẓlūm — wronged (pass. part. of ظَلَمَ, m. nom. indef.)
مَظْلُومًا: maẓlūm — wronged (pass. part. of ظَلَمَ, m. acc. indef.)
لِمَا: لِـ + مَا — li-, for (prep.) + mā, what (interrog.); 'for what' — printed as two words, لِمَا ذَا, together giving 'why'
تَزْعُمُ: tazʿumu — zaʿama, to claim, allege (verb I, impf. 2ms)
اِسْتَعِنْ: istaʿin — form X of عون, 'to seek help' (imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl)
يَكْفِيكَ: yakfīka — kafā, to suffice, be enough for (verb I, impf. 3ms) + 2ms obj.
شَرَّهُ: شَرّ + ـهُ — sharr, evil, mischief (m., acc.) + 3ms; 'his evil'
وَ شَرَّ: وَ + شَرَّ — sharr, evil, harm (m., acc.); 'and the evil of'
تَخَافُ: takhāfu — khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, impf. 2ms)
فَرَفَعَ: فَـ + رَفَعَ — rafaʿa, to raise, lift (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يُجِيبُ: yujību — ajāba, form IV of جوب, 'to answer' (impf. 3ms)
الْمُضْطَرَّ: الـ + مُضْطَرّ — muḍṭarr, one in distress, compelled (act. part. of form VIII اِضْطَرَّ, m. acc.); echoes Qur'an 27:62
دَعَاهُ: daʿāhu — daʿā, to call, invoke (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'he called upon Him'
وَ يَكْشِفُ: وَ + يَكْشِفُ — kashafa, to remove, lift, uncover (verb I, impf. 3ms)
اُنْصُرْنِي: unṣurnī — naṣara, to help, grant victory (verb I imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl) + 1cs obj.
عَدُوِّي: عَدُوّ + ـي — ʿaduww, enemy (m., gen.) + 1cs poss.; 'my enemy'
وَ اِصْرِفْهُ: وَ + اِصْرِفْ + ـهُ — ṣarafa, to turn away, avert (verb I imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl) + 3ms obj.
تَشَاءُ: tashāʾu — shāʾa, to will, wish (verb I hollow, impf. 2ms)
قَدِيرٌ: qadīr — able, omnipotent (intensive adj. of qadara, m. nom. indef.)
دُعَاءَهُ: duʿāʾ — prayer, supplication (m., acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his prayer'
انْصَرَفَتْ: inṣarafat — form VII of صرف, 'to turn away, depart' (perf. 3fs)
وَ انْصَرَفَ: وَ + اِنْصَرَفَ — inṣarafa, form VII, 'to turn away, depart' (perf. 3ms)
وَ حَدَّثَهُ: وَ + حَدَّثَ + ـهُ — ḥaddatha, form II of حدث, 'to tell, relate to' (perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
بِحَدِيثِ: بِـ + حَدِيث — bi-, of (prep.; ḥaddatha bi- = tell someone of) + ḥadīth, story, account (m., gen.); first term of iḍāfa
فَأَدْعَى: فَـ + أَدْعَى — non-classical spelling of دَعَا بِـ, 'to call for, send for' (perf. 3ms), with a prosthetic initial hamza on the pattern of form IV (cf. أَخْلَعَ for خَلَعَ in nights-04); see note
بِالْوَزِيرِ: بِـ + الـ + وَزِير — wazīr, vizier (m., gen.); with دَعَا بِـ, 'sent for the vizier'
وَ قَتَلَهُ: وَ + قَتَلَ + ـهُ — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
أَمِنْتَ: أَمِنَ + ـتَ — amina/yaʾmanu, to feel safe, trust (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you trusted'
لِهَذَا: لِـ + هَذَا — li-, to, for (prep.) + hādhā, this (m. dem.); 'to this'
قَتْلُكَ: قَتْل + ـكَ — qatl, killing, slaying (m. verbal noun, nom.) + 2ms; 'your killing'
شَرُّ: شَرّ — sharr, worse, worst, evil (elative/noun, nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the worst of'
الْقَتَلَاتِ: الـ + قَتَلَات — qatalāt, killings, manners of death (f. pl. of qatla, gen.); 'the killings'
أَحْسَنْتَ: أَحْسَنَ + ـتَ — aḥsana/yuḥsinu, to do good, treat kindly (verb IV, perf. 2ms); 'you did good, you were kind'
وَ قَرَّبْتَهُ: و + قَرَّبَ + ـتَ + ـهُ — qarraba/yuqarribu, to bring near (verb II, perf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.; 'and you drew him near'
يَعْمَلُ: يَعْمَلُ — ʿamila/yaʿmalu, to work, act (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he works'
هَلَاكِكَ: هَلَاك + ـكَ — halāk, destruction, ruin (m., gen.) + 2ms; 'your destruction'
أَمَا: أَمَا — amā, do you not…? (interrogative particle, negative-expecting); 'do you not'
أَبْرَأَكَ: أَبْرَأَ + ـكَ — abraʾa/yubriʾu, to cure, heal (verb IV) + 2ms obj.; 'he cured you'
مَسَكْتَهُ: مَسَكَ + ـتَ + ـهُ — masaka/yamsuku, to hold, grasp (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.; 'you held it'
بِيَدِكَ: بِـ + يَد + ـكَ — bi-, with, in (prep.) + yad, hand (f.) + 2ms; 'in your hand'
يُهْلِكَكَ: يُهْلِكَ + ـكَ — ahlaka/yuhliku, to destroy (verb IV, imperf. 3ms subj., after an) + 2ms obj.; 'he destroy you'
تَمْسِكُهُ: تَمْسِكُ + ـهُ — masaka/yamsiku, to hold, grasp (verb I, imperf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.; 'you hold it'
صَدَقْتَ: صَدَقَ + ـتَ — ṣadaqa/yaṣduqu, to speak truly (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you spoke truly'
ذَكَرْتَ: ذَكَرَ + ـتَ — dhakara/yadhkuru, to mention, relate (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you mentioned, you said'
النَّاصِحُ: الـ + نَاصِح — nāṣiḥ, sincere, giving sound counsel (part./adj., m., nom.)
جَاسُوسًا: جَاسُوس + ـًا — jāsūs, spy (m., acc. indef., ḥāl); 'as a spy'
طَلَبِ: طَلَب — ṭalab, seeking, pursuit (m. verbal noun, gen., first term of iḍāfa)
هَلَاكِي: هَلَاك + ـي — halāk, destruction (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'my destruction'
أَبْرَأَنِي: أَبْرَأَ + ـنِي — abraʾa/yubriʾu, to cure, heal (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'he cured me'
مَسَكْتُهُ: مَسَكَ + ـتُ + ـهُ — masaka/yamsuku, to hold, grasp (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'I held it'
يَقْدِرُ: يَقْدِرُ — qadara/yaqdiru, to be able (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he is able'
يُهْلِكَنِي: يُهْلِكَ + ـنِي — ahlaka/yuhliku, to destroy (verb IV, imperf. 3ms subj., after an) + 1cs obj.; 'he destroy me'
أَشُمُّهُ: أَشُمُّ + ـهُ — shamma/yashummu, to smell (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'I smell it'
الْعَمَلُ: الـ + عَمَل — ʿamal, work, action, what is to be done (m., nom.)
أَرْسِلْ: أَرْسِلْ — arsala/yursilu, to send (verb IV, imper. 2ms); 'send!'
خَلْفَهُ: خَلْفَ + ـهُ — khalfa, behind, after (adv., acc.) + 3ms; 'after him'
الْوَقْتِ: الـ + وَقْت — waqt, time, moment (m., gen.)
وَ اطْلُبْهُ: و + اُطْلُبْ + ـهُ — ṭalaba/yaṭlubu, to seek, summon (verb I, imper. 2ms, hamzat waṣl) + 3ms obj.; 'and summon him'
حَضَرَ: حَضَرَ — ḥaḍara/yaḥḍuru, to be present, come, appear (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he came, presented himself'
فَاضْرِبْ: فَـ + اِضْرِبْ — ḍaraba/yaḍribu, to strike (verb I, imper. 2ms, hamzat waṣl); 'then strike!'
عُنُقَهُ: عُنُق + ـهُ — ʿunuq, neck (m./f., acc.) + 3ms; 'his neck'
فَتَكْفِي: فَـ + تَكْفِي — kafā/yakfī, to suffice, be enough against (verb I, imperf. 2ms); 'then you will be rid of, be quit of'
وَ تَسْتَرِيحُ: و + تَسْتَرِيحُ — istarāḥa/yastarīḥu, to rest, be at ease (verb X, imperf. 2ms); 'and you will be at rest'
وَ اغْدِرْ: و + اِغْدِرْ — ghadara/yaghdiru, to betray, act treacherously (verb I, imper. 2ms, hamzat waṣl); 'and betray!'
قَبْلَ: qabla — before (adv., acc., governs a following clause with أَنْ)
يَغْدِرَ: يَغْدِرَ — ghadara/yaghdiru, to betray (verb I, imperf. 3ms subj., after an); 'he betray'
قَدَّرَهُ: قَدَّرَ + ـهُ — qaddara/yuqaddiru, to decree, ordain, decide (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'He decreed it'
الرَّحْمَنُ: الـ + رَحْمَن — al-Raḥmān, the All-Merciful (divine epithet, nom.)
الْبَقَاءَ: الـ + بَقَاء — baqāʾ, continuance, permanence, survival (m., acc.)
كَائِنٌ: كَائِن + ـٌ — kāʾin, existing, being a real thing (part. of kāna, m., nom. indef.)
الْاَمَانُ: الـ + أَمَان — amān, safety, security (m., nom.); printed without the hamza mark, as in the edition's verse
قَدَرَا: قَدَرَ + ا — qadara/yaqdiru, to decree, ordain (verb I, perf. 3ms); pausal spelling with final alif for qadara
اَتِمَّ: اَتِمَّ — atamma/yutimmu, to complete, fulfill (verb IV, imperf. 1cs subj., after lam); printed without the hamza mark; 'I fulfill, complete'
بِالشُّكْرِ: بِـ + الـ + شُكْر — bi-, with (prep.) + shukr, thanks, gratitude (m., gen.); 'with thanks'
اَعْدَدْتُ: اَعْدَدْتُ — aʿadda/yuʿiddu, to prepare, make ready (verb IV, perf. 1cs); printed without the hamza mark; 'I prepared'
نَظْمِي: نَظْم + ـي — naẓm, verse, poetry (lit. 'stringing together') (m.) + 1cs; 'my verse'
جُدْتَ: جُدْتَ — jāda/yajūdu, to be generous, bountiful (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms); 'you were generous'
السُّؤَالِ: الـ + سُؤَال — suʾāl, asking, request (m. verbal noun, gen.)
بِانْعُمِ: بِـ + اَنْعُم — bi-, with (prep.) + anʿum, favors, bounties (irreg. pl. of niʿma, gen.); printed without the hamza mark
اَتَيَقَّنُ: اَتَيَقَّنُ — tayaqqana/yatayaqqanu, to be certain (verb V, imperf. 1cs); printed without the hamza mark; 'I am certain'
مَطْلٍ: مَطْل — maṭl, delaying, procrastination (m. verbal noun, gen. indef.)
اُعْطِي: اُعْطِي — aʿṭā/yuʿṭī, to give (verb IV, imperf. 1cs); printed without the hamza mark; 'I give'
ثَنَاءَكَ: ثَنَاء + ـكَ — thanāʾ, praise (m., acc.) + 2ms; 'your praise'

يَشَا: يَشَا — shāʾa/yashāʾu, to will, wish (verb I, imperf. 3ms); pausal spelling for yashāʾu
تَكُنْ: تَكُنْ — kāna/yakūnu, to be (verb I hollow, imperf. 2ms juss., after lā); 'you be'

سَلِّمْ: سَلِّمْ — sallama/yusallimu, to hand over, surrender (verb II, imper. 2ms); 'surrender!'

وَارِحْ: و + اَرِحْ — arāḥa/yurīḥu, to give rest (verb IV, imper. 2ms); printed without the hamza mark; 'and give rest!'

بِاَنَّ: بِـ + اَنَّ — bi-, by (prep.) + anna, that (subordinating particle); printed without the hamza mark; 'that'
الْاَمْرَ: الـ + اَمْر — amr, matter, affair (m., acc.); printed without the hamza mark
تَشَا: تَشَا — shāʾa/yashāʾu, to will, wish (verb I, imperf. 2ms); pausal spelling for tashāʾu
يَشَاءُ: يَشَاءُ — shāʾa/yashāʾu, to will, wish (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
اللّٰهُ: اللّٰهُ — Allāh, God (proper n., nom.); the edition's dagger-alif ligature over the doubled lām, mid-clause after a vowel, so the initial hamzat waṣl is not separately marked
اَحْكَمُ: اَحْكَمُ — ḥakama/yaḥkumu, to judge, rule (elative of ḥākim, m., nom.); printed without the hamza mark; 'the most judicious, the wisest of'
حَاكِمِ: حَاكِم — ḥākim, judge, ruler (part. of ḥakama, m., gen.)
طِبْ: طِبْ — ṭāba/yaṭību, to be well, be pleasant (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms); 'be well!'

وَانْسَ: و + اِنْسَ — nasiya/yansā, to forget (verb I, apocopated imper. 2ms, hamzat waṣl); 'and forget!'
الْهُمُومَ: الـ + هُمُوم — humūm, cares, worries (pl. of hamm, acc.)
جَمِيعَهَا: جَمِيع + ـهَا — jamīʿ, all, the whole of (m., acc.) + 3fs; 'all of them, entirely'

تَسَلَّمْ: تَسَلَّمْ — tasallama/yatasallamu, to be safe, come through safely (verb V, imperf. 2ms juss.); 'you will be safe'
نَعِيمٍ: نَعِيم — naʿīm, bliss, felicity (m., gen. indef.)
دَائِمِ: دَائِم — dāʾim, everlasting, lasting (part. of dāma, m., gen.)
لِلْحَكِيمِ: لِـ + الـ + حَكِيم — li-, to (prep.) + ḥakīm, sage (m., gen.); 'to the sage'

أَحْضَرْتُكَ: أَحْضَرَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — aḥḍara/yuḥḍiru, to bring, summon (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I have brought/summoned you'

بِالْحَكِيمِ: بِـ + الـ + حَكِيم — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after wa-idhā 'and behold' (no English word of its own) + ḥakīm, sage (m., gen.); with wa-idhā, 'and then, the sage...'
لِلدِّيوَانِ: لِـ + الـ + دِيوَان — li-, to (prep.; here standing for ilā) + dīwān, audience-hall, council-chamber (m., gen.)
وَوَقَفَ: وَ + وَقَفَ — waqafa, to stand, halt (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قُدَّامَ: quddāma, before, in front of (adv., acc.)
عَتِيقٌ: ʿatīq, ancient, old (adj., m., nom. indef.)
وَسِلْسِلَةٌ: وَ + سِلْسِلَة — silsila, chain (f., nom. indef.)
ذَرُورٌ: dharūr, a fine medicinal powder sprinkled on a wound to stanch bleeding (m., nom. indef.)
اِئْتُونِي: اِئْتُوا + ـنِي — atā (bi-), to bring (verb I, imper. m.pl.; hamzat waṣl) + 1cs obj.; 'bring me!'
بِطَبَقٍ: بِـ + طَبَقٍ — bi-, with (prep.; atā/jāʾa bi- = come with, i.e. bring) + ṭabaq, dish, tray (m., gen. indef.)
فَأَتَوْهُ: فَ + أَتَوْا + ـهُ — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 3mpl) + 3ms obj.; 'so they came to him, brought him'
وَكَبَّ: وَ + كَبَّ — kabba, to pour out, tip over (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الذَّرُورَ: الـ + ذَرُور — dharūr, the powder (m., acc.)
وَفَرَشَهُ: وَ + فَرَشَهُ — farasha, to spread out (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
تَفْتَحْهُ: taftaḥhu — fataḥa, to open (verb I, imperf. jussive 2ms after lā) + 3ms obj.
تَقْطَعَ: taqṭaʿa — qaṭaʿa, to cut (verb I, imperf. subj. 2ms after ḥattā)
قَطَعْتَهُ: قَطَعْتَ + ـهُ — qaṭaʿa, to cut (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.
فَاِجْعَلْهُ: فَ + اِجْعَلْ + ـهُ — jaʿala, to put, place (verb I, imper. m.sg.; hamzat waṣl) + 3ms obj.
بِكَبْسِهِ: بِـ + كَبْس + ـهِ — bi-, marks the thing commanded (amara bi- = order, bid someone do) + kabs, pressing down (verbal noun of kabasa, m., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'that it be pressed'
الذَّرُورِ: الـ + ذَرُور — dharūr, the powder (m., gen.)
فَعَلْتَ: faʿalta — faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 2ms)
دَمَهُ: دَم + ـهُ — dam, blood (m., acc., ism of inna) + 3ms poss.
يَنْقَطِعُ: yanqaṭiʿu — inqaṭaʿa, to be cut off, stop (verb VII of qaṭaʿa, imperf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl)
اِفْتَحِ: iftaḥi — fataḥa, to open (verb I, imper. m.sg.; hamzat waṣl)
بِضَرْبِ: بِـ + ضَرْب — bi-, marks the thing commanded (amara bi- = order, bid someone do) + ḍarb, striking (verbal noun of ḍaraba, m., gen.)
السَّيَّافُ: الـ + سَيَّاف — sayyāf, executioner, swordsman (m., nom.)
رَقَبَتَهُ: رَقَبَة + ـهُ — raqaba, neck (f., acc.) + 3ms poss.
فَطَاحَ: فَ + طَاحَ — ṭāḥa, to fall, drop (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
وَكَبَسَهُ: وَ + كَبَسَهُ — kabasa, to press down (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
فَاِنْقَطَعَ: فَ + اِنْقَطَعَ — inqaṭaʿa, to be cut off, stop (verb VII, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl)
دَمُهُ: دَم + ـهُ — dam, blood (m., nom.) + 3ms poss.
فَفَتَحَ: فَ + فَتَحَ — fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَفَتَحَهُ: فَ + فَتَحَ + ـهُ — fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
مَلْصُوقًا: malṣūq, stuck, glued together (pass. part. of I laṣiqa; m., acc. indef.)
فَحَطَّ: فَ + حَطَّ — ḥaṭṭa, to put, set down (verb I, perf. 3ms)
إِصْبَعَهُ: إِصْبَع + ـهُ — iṣbaʿ, finger (m./f., acc.) + 3ms poss.
فَمِهِ: فَم + ـهِ — fam, mouth (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
رِيقَهُ: رِيق + ـهُ — rīq, spittle, saliva (m., acc.) + 3ms poss.
وَرَقَةٍ: وَرَقَة — waraqa, leaf, sheet (f., gen. indef.)
وَ الْوَرَقُ: وَ + الـ + وَرَق — waraq, paper, leaves (m. coll., nom.)
يَنْفَتِحُ: yanfatiḥu — infataḥa, to open (intrans.) (verb VII, imperf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl)
بِجَهْدٍ: بِـ + جَهْد — bi-, with (prep.) + jahd, effort, exertion (m., gen. indef.)
أَوْرَاقٍ: awrāq — waraq, leaf, sheet (m. pl., gen. indef. as tamyīz after sitta)
مَكْتُوبٌ: maktūb, written (pass. part. of I kataba; m., nom. indef.)
زِيَادَةً: ziyādatan — ziyāda, increase, addition (f., acc. adverbial); 'more, further'
ثَلَٰثَةً: ثَلَاثَة (defective spelling, dagger alif) — thalātha, three (f. numeral, acc. indef.)
أُخَرَ: ukhar — ākhar, other (f. broken pl., diptote; acc./gen. alike)
قَلِيلٌ: qalīl, little, a small amount (m., nom. indef.)
وَالدَّوَاءُ: وَ + الـ + دَوَاء — dawāʾ, medicine, remedy, drug (m., nom.)
حَاقَ: ḥāqa, to befall, take effect, come to pass (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
لِوَقْتِهِ: لِـ + وَقْت + ـهِ — waqt, time, moment (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.; li-waqtihi wa-sāʿatihi, 'at once, that very moment'
مَسْمُومًا: masmūm, poisoned (pass. part. of I samma; m., acc. indef.)
تَزَعْزَعَ: tazaʿzaʿa, to be shaken, reel, totter (verb of quadriliteral zaʿzaʿa, perf. 3ms)
وَصَاحَ: وَ + صَاحَ — ṣāḥa, to cry out, shout (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
اِنْشَلَّ: inshalla (verb VII of ش-ل-ل, 'to become paralysed'; perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl) — the required sense ('recited') suggests a misprint for أَنْشَدَ, 'he recited'; see note
رَأْسُ: raʾs, head (m., nom., first term of construct)
فَاعْلَمْ: فَ + اِعْلَمْ — ʿalima, to know (verb I, imper. m.sg.; hamzat waṣl); 'so know!'
أَبْقَى: abqā, to leave remaining, spare (verb IV of baqiya, perf. 3ms)
لَأَبْقَاهُ: لَ + أَبْقَاهُ — la-, emphatic particle opening the apodosis of a law-conditional + abqāhu, 'he would have spared him'
وَطَلَبَ: وَ + طَلَبَ — ṭalaba, to seek, demand (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَقَتَلَهُ: فَ + قَتَلَ + ـهُ — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
أَبْقَيْتَنِي: أَبْقَيْتَ + ـنِي — abqā, to spare (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + 1cs obj.; 'you spared me'
أَبْقَاكَ: أَبْقَى + ـكَ — abqā, to spare (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 2ms obj.; 'he spared you'; see note
تَحَكَّمُوا: taḥakkamū — taḥakkama, to wield absolute power (verb V, perf. 3mpl)
وَاسْتَطَالُوا: وَ + اِسْتَطَالُوا — istaṭāla, to overreach, act tyrannically (verb X of ṭāla, perf. 3mpl; hamzat waṣl)
تَحَكُّمِهِمْ: تَحَكُّم + ـهِمْ — taḥakkum, exercise of absolute power (verbal noun of V, m., gen.) + 3mpl poss.
وَعَنْ: وَ + عَنْ — ʿan, after (prep., of time); wa-ʿan qalīlin, 'and after a little while'
قَلِيلٍ: qalīl, a little, a short while (m., gen. indef.)
الْحُكْمُ: الـ + حُكْم — ḥukm, rule, dominion (m., nom.)
يَكُنِ: yakuni — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, imperf. jussive 3ms after lam)
أَنْصَفُوا: anṣafū — anṣafa, to act justly, be equitable (verb IV of naṣafa, perf. 3mpl)
لٰكِنْ: lākin (dagger alif, printed) — but, however (adversative particle)
بَغَوْا: baghaw — baghā, to transgress, oppress, act tyrannically (verb I, perf. 3mpl)
فَبَغَى: فَ + بَغَى — baghā, to oppress, transgress (verb I, perf. 3ms)
بِالْأَحْزَانِ: بِـ + الـ + أَحْزَان — bi-, with (prep.) + ḥuzn, grief, sorrow (m. pl., gen.)
وَالْمِحَنِ: وَ + الـ + مِحَن — miḥna, trial, ordeal (f. pl., gen.)
وَأَصْبَحُوا: وَ + أَصْبَحُوا — aṣbaḥa, to become, wake to find oneself (verb IV, perf. 3mpl)
وَلِسَانُ: وَ + لِسَان — lisān, tongue (m., nom.); lisān al-ḥāl, 'the tongue of circumstance'
يُنْشِدُهُمْ: yunshiduhum — anshada, to recite (verse) (verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + 3mpl obj.
بِذَاكَ: بِـ + ذَاكَ — dhāka, that (dem. pron., m.); 'with that, for that'
اطْلُبْهُ: ṭalaba/yaṭlubu, to seek, summon (verb I imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl) + 3ms obj.; 'summon him!'
اغْدِرْ: ghadara/yaghdiru, to betray (verb I imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl); 'betray!'
النُّصْحِ: الـ + نُصْح — nuṣḥ, sincere counsel, honest advice (m., gen.)
الْوَرَقُ: الـ + وَرَق — waraq, paper, leaves (m. coll., nom.)
الْوُزَرَاءُ: الـ + وُزَرَاء — wuzarāʾ, viziers (m. pl. of وَزِير, nom.)
اَنْصَحْ: naṣaḥa/yanṣaḥu, to give sincere counsel, advise (verb I, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ); 'I counsel'
اُفْلِحْ: aflaḥa/yufliḥu, to prosper, succeed (verb IV, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ); 'I prospered'
اِصْرِفْهُ: ṣarafa/yaṣrifu, to turn away, avert (verb I imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl) + 3ms obj.; 'turn him away!'
بَعْدِيْ: بَعْد + ـِي — baʿd, after (adv., gen.) + 1cs poss.; 'after me'
بِكُلِّ: بِـ + كُلّ — kull, every, all (m., gen.); 'with every'
تَدْبِيْرٍ: tadbīr, forethought, planning, contrivance (m. verbal noun, gen. indef.)
تَسْتَرِيحُ: istarāḥa/yastarīḥu, to rest, be at ease (verb X, imperf. 2ms); 'you will be at rest'
تَنَصَّحْتُ: tanaṣṣaḥa/yatanaṣṣaḥu, to give sincere counsel (verb V of نَصَحَ, perf. 1cs); 'I gave sincere counsel'
ثِقَهْ: thiqa(h), trusted, trustworthy (f. verbal noun/adj. used as predicate; pausal spelling with tāʾ marbūṭa written ه, for the rhyme)
حَدَّثَهُ: ḥaddatha/yuḥaddithu, to tell, relate to (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'he told him'
خُلِقْ: khuliqa/yukhlaqu, to be created (verb I passive, perf. 3ms); pausal spelling for خُلِقَ, for the rhyme
ذَوِي: dhawī, possessors of, people of (construct pl. of ذُو, gen.)
زلق: zalaq, a slippery place, slippery ground (m., gen. indef.); left undotted/unpointed in the source, unlike its rhyme-twin زَلِقْ two words later
زَلِقْ: zaliqa/yazlaqu, to slip, slide (verb I, perf. 3ms); pausal spelling for زَلِقَ, for the rhyme; 'he slips'
عَقْلَ: عَقْل — ʿaql, sense, reason, intelligence (m., acc.)
فَالْعَنُوْا: فَـ + اُلْعَنُوا — laʿana/yalʿanu, to curse (verb I imperative 2mp, hamzat waṣl); 'then curse!'
فَاَفْلَحُوْا: فَـ + اَفْلَحُوا — aflaḥa/yufliḥu, to prosper, succeed (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'and they prospered'
قَرَّبْتَهُ: qarraba/yuqarribu, to bring near (verb II, perf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.; 'you drew him near'
لِدَارِ: لِـ + دَار — dār, house, abode (f., gen.); 'to a house of'
مَيْمُونَةَ: Maymūna, proper name (f., acc.); apparently a stock example of someone trusted despite lacking judgment, see note
مُتُّ: muttu — māta/yamūtu, to die (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'I die'
نُصْحِيْ: نُصْح + ـِي — nuṣḥ, sincere counsel (m., nom.) + 1cs poss.; 'my counsel'
وَابُوهَا: وَ + أَبُوهَا — ab, father (m., nom.) + 3fs poss.; 'and her father'
وَاَوْثَقَنِيْ: وَ + اَوْثَقَنِي — awthaqa/yūthiqu, to bind fast, tie firmly (verb IV of وَثَقَ, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'and it bound me fast'
وَخَانُوْا: وَ + خَانُوا — khāna/yakhūnu, to betray (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they betrayed'
يَابِسٍ: yābis, dry, firm (ground) (act. part. of يَبِسَ, m., gen. indef.)
يَكْشِفُ: kashafa/yakshifu, to remove, lift, uncover (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he removes'
أَذِنَ: أَذِنَ — root أ-ذ-ن, 'he permitted, gave leave'
أَرَدْتَ: أَرَادَ + تَ — Form IV arāda, 'to want'; 2ms past — 'you wanted'
أَقْتُلُكَ: أَقْتُلُ + كَ — 1cs impf. of قَتَلَ + 'you' — 'I kill you'
بِحَبْسِكَ: بِـ + حَبْس + كَ — ḥabs, 'imprisonment' (m.); 'by your imprisonment'
وَأُلْقِيكَ: وَ + أُلْقِي + كَ — Form IV alqā, 1cs impf. + 'you' — 'and I cast you'
تُوَاخِذْنِي: تُوَاخِذْ + نِي — non-standard spelling (for تُؤَاخِذْنِي, Form III wāxadha, 'to hold accountable') + 'me' — 'you hold me to account'
بِعَمَلِي: بِـ + عَمَل + ي — ʿamal, 'deed' (m.); 'for my deed'
مُسِيًا: for مُسِيء (Form IV active participle of سَاءَ), 'one who does wrong', spelled here without its hamza letter
مُحْسِنًا: مُحْسِن — Form IV active participle of حَسَنَ, 'one who does good, benefactor' (acc. indef.)
الْأَمْثَالِ: الـ + أَمْثَال — pl. of مَثَل, 'proverb'; 'the proverbs'
السَّايِرَةِ: الـ + سَايِرَة — non-standard spelling for السَّائِرَة, 'current, well-known' (f. active participle of سَارَ)
أَسَاءَ: أَسَاءَ — Form IV of سَاءَ, 'he did evil, did wrong'
الْمُسِئَ: الـ + مُسِئ — non-standard spelling for المُسِيء, 'the wrongdoer' (acc.)
أَمَانَةً: أَمَانَة — amāna, 'trust, good faith, a good turn' (f.); indef. acc.
عَائِكَةَ: obscure/uncertain word, possibly a proper name; acc.
تُطْلِقَنِي: تُطْلِقُ + نِي — Form IV impf. of طَلَقَ (subjunctive after ḥattā) + 'me' — 'you release me'
أُحَدِّثُكَ: أُحَدِّثُ + كَ — Form II ḥaddatha, 1cs impf. + 'you' — 'I tell/relate to you'
خَلِّ: imperative of Form II خَلَّى — 'leave! let go!'
إِلْقَائِكَ: إِلْقَاء + كَ — masdar of Form IV alqā, 'casting, throwing' + 'you' — 'your being cast'
إِخْرَاجِكَ: إِخْرَاج + كَ — masdar of Form IV akhraja, 'taking out, releasing' + 'you' — 'your release'
أَتَدَخَّلُ: أَتَدَخَّلُ — Form V tadakhkhala, 1cs impf. — 'I intrude, come in'
وَأَتَضَرَّعُ: وَ + أَتَضَرَّعُ — Form V taḍarraʿa, 1cs impf. — 'and I plead, beseech'
بِغَيْرِ: بِـ + غَيْر — bi-, with (prep.); bi-ghayr = 'with other than', i.e. 'without' + ghayr, 'other than, without'
اِسْتَوْجَبَهُ: اِسْتَوْجَبَ + هُ — Form X istawjaba (hamzat waṣl), 'to deserve, merit' + 'it' — 'it deserved it, would merit it'
لِكَوْنِي: لِـ + كَوْن + ي — masdar of كَانَ, 'being' + 1cs — 'for my being, in that I'
أَخْرَجْتُكَ: أَخْرَجْتُ + كَ — Form IV akhraja, 1cs past + 'you' — 'I took you out'
رَدِيُّ: for رَدِيء ('bad, evil'), non-standard spelling without hamza letter; construct form 'evil of...'
رَمَيْتُكَ: رَمَيْتُ + كَ — رَمَى, 'to throw', 1cs past + 'you' — 'I threw you'
ظَلَمَكَ: ظَلَمَ + كَ — ẕalama, 'he wronged' + 'you' — 'he wronged you'
يَرْمِيكَ: يَرْمِي + كَ — impf. of رَمَى + 'you' — 'he will throw you'
أُخْبِرُهُ: أُخْبِرُ + هُ — Form IV akhbara, 1cs impf. + 'him' — 'I inform him'
وَأُحَذِّرُهُ: وَ + أُحَذِّرُ + هُ — Form II ḥadhdhara, 1cs impf. + 'him' — 'and I warn him'
وَتُقِيمُ: وَ + تُقِيمُ — Form IV aqāma, 2ms impf. — 'and you will remain'
أٰخِرِ: ākhir — 'last, end' (gen., in construct 'the end of time')
تَهْلِكَ: tahlika — subjunctive of هَلَكَ (after ḥattā), 'you perish'
أَطْلِقْنِي: أَطْلِقْ + نِي — Form IV imperative of طَلَقَ + 'me' — 'release me!'
أَبْقِنِي: أَبْقِ + نِي — imperative of Form IV abqā + 'me' — 'spare me!'
فَإِنَّهُ: فَـ + إِنَّ + هُ — fa- + inna, for indeed + 'he/it'; 'for indeed he/it'
فَهٰذَا: فَـ + هٰذَا — hādhā, this (demonstrative, with dagger alif for the elided medial ā); 'so this'
وَقْتُ: وَقْت — waqt, time, moment (m.); nominative, first term of an iḍāfa
الْمُرُوءَةِ: الـ + مُرُوءَة — murūʾah, manliness, chivalrous virtue (f.); genitive, second term of the iḍāfa
أُعَاهِدُكَ: أُعَاهِدُ + كَ — form III ʿāhada/yuʿāhidu, to make a covenant with; 1st sing. + 'you' (m.); 'I make a covenant with you'
أَعْصِ: أَعْصِ — form I ʿaṣā/yaʿṣī, to disobey; 1st sing. jussive (after لم); 'I do/did not disobey'
أَنْفَعُكَ: أَنْفَعُ + كَ — form IV nafaʿa/yanfaʿu (anfaʿu for form IV), to benefit; 1st sing. + 'you'; 'I will benefit you'
يُغْنِيكَ: يُغْنِي + كَ — form IV ghaniya/yughnī, to suffice, enrich; 3rd sing. m. + 'you'; 'that will suffice/content you'
الْعَهْدَ: الـ + عَهْد — ʿahd, covenant, pledge (m.); accusative, object of took/fulfil
أَنَّهُ: أَنَّ + هُ — anna, that (subordinating particle) + 'he'; introduces a noun clause: 'that he'
أَطْلَقَهُ: أَطْلَقَ + هُ — form IV aṭlaqa/yuṭliqu, to release; 3rd sing. m. + 'him'; 'he released him'
يُوذِيهِ: يُوذِي + هِ — form IV āʾ-dh-y/yuʾdhī, to harm; 3rd sing. m. + 'him'; here spelled with a plain wāw where Classical usage has a hamza-bearing wāw (يؤذيه); 'he would harm him'
الْجَمِيلَ: الـ + جَمِيل — jamīl, a kindness, a good turn (m., lit. 'the beautiful/good [deed]'); accusative object of يعمل
اسْتَوْثَقَ: اسْتَوْثَقَ — form X wathiqa/yastawthiqu, to make certain of, secure; 3rd sing. m. past (initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl, unmarked); 'he made himself sure'
حَلَفَهُ: حَلَفَ + هُ — form I ḥalafa/yaḥlifu, to swear; 3rd sing. m. + 'him' (causative use, 'made him swear'); 'he made him swear'
بِاسْمِ: بِـ + اسْم — ism, name (m.; initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl, elided after bi-); genitive; 'by the name'
الْأَعْظَمِ: الـ + أَعْظَم — aʿẕam, greatest (elative of ʿaẕīm); genitive, agreeing with اللّٰه; 'the Greatest'
فَتَصَاعَدَ: فَـ + تَصَاعَدَ — form VI ṣāʿada/yataṣāʿadu, to rise up (repeatedly/gradually); 3rd sing. m. past; 'then it rose up'
سَوِيًّا: سَوِيّ — sawiyy, whole, well-formed, sound; indefinite accusative adjective
فَرَفَسَ: فَـ + رَفَسَ — form I rafasa/yarfusu, to kick; 3rd sing. m. past
رَمَاهُ: رَمَى + هُ — form I ramā/yarmī, to throw; 3rd sing. m. + 'it'; 'he threw it'
شَرْشَرَ: شَرْشَرَ — quadriliteral sharshara, to tear/rend repeatedly; 3rd sing. m. past; 'he tore'
عَلَامَةَ: عَلَامَة — ʿalāmah, a sign, mark (f.); accusative predicate of ليس, first term of iḍāfa
إِنَّهُ: إِنَّ + هُ — inna, indeed (emphatic particle) + 'he'; here the common narrative formula 'thumma innahu', 'then he...'
قَوِيَ: قَوِيَ — form I qawiya/yaqwā, to become strong; 3rd sing. m. past
قَلْبُهُ: قَلْب + هُ — qalb, heart (m.) + 'his'; nominative subject; 'his heart'
أَوْفُوا: أَوْفُوا — form IV wafā/yūfī, to fulfil; 2nd pl. m. imperative; 'fulfil!' (Qur'anic quotation)
بِالْعَهْدِ: بِـ + الـ + عَهْد — bi-, marks the object of awfā (awfā bi- = fulfil, keep) + ʿahd, covenant (m.); genitive; 'the covenant'
إِنَّ: إِنَّ — inna, indeed, verily (emphatic particle introducing a nominal clause)
مَسُولًا: مَسُولًا — masʾūlan, asked about, answerable for (passive participle of سَأَلَ, 'to ask'); here written مسولا, its medial hamza smoothed onto a plain wāw; indefinite accusative predicate of كان
عَاهَدْتَنِي: عَاهَدْتَ + نِي — form III ʿāhada/yuʿāhidu, to make a covenant with; 2nd sing. m. past + 'me'; 'you made a covenant with me'
حَلَفْتَ: حَلَفْتَ — form I ḥalafa/yaḥlifu, to swear; 2nd sing. m. past; 'you swore'
تَغْدُرْنِي: تَغْدُرْ + نِي — form I ghadara/yaghduru, to betray; 2nd sing. m. jussive (after لم) + 'me'; 'you would betray me'
يَغْدُرْكَ: يَغْدُرْ + كَ — form I ghadara/yaghduru, to betray; 3rd sing. m. jussive (optative, 'may He...') + 'you' (m.); 'may He betray you'
غَيُورٌ: غَيُور — ghayūr, jealous, protective (intensive adjective from ghāra); indefinite nominative predicate
يُمْهِلُ: يُمْهِلُ — form IV mahala/yumhilu, to grant respite, delay; 3rd sing. m.
يُهْمِلُ: يُهْمِلُ — form IV hamala/yuhmilu, to neglect, be remiss; 3rd sing. m.
اتَّبِعْنِي: اتَّبِعْ + نِي — form VIII tabiʿa/yatbaʿu (ittabaʿa/yattabiʿu), to follow; 2nd sing. m. imperative (initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl) + 'me'; 'follow me!'
فَمَشَى: فَـ + مَشَى — mashā, he walked; 'so he walked'
يُصَدِّقْ: يُصَدِّقْ — form II ṣaddaqa/yuṣaddiqu, to believe, credit; 3rd sing. m. jussive (after لم)
بِالنَّجَاةِ: بِـ + الـ + نَجَاة — najāh, deliverance, escape (f.); genitive; 'in deliverance'
أَنْ: أَنْ — an, that/so that (subordinating particle taking the subjunctive; also used in إلى أن, 'until')
خَرَجُوا: خَرَجُوا — kharaja/yakhruju, to go out; 3rd pl. m. past; 'they went out'
بَرِّيَّةٍ: بَرِّيَّة — barriyyah, wilderness, open country (f.); indefinite genitive
مُتَّسِعَةٍ: مُتَّسِعَة — muttasiʿah, spacious, extensive (active participle of form VIII ittasaʿa); indefinite genitive adjective
بِبِرْكَةِ: بِـ + بِرْكَة — bi-, at; after wa-idhā humā it marks what suddenly appears ('and behold, the two of them were at…') + birkah, pool (f.); genitive, first term of iḍāfa
وَسَطِهَا: وَسَطِ + هَا — wasaṭ, middle (m.) + 'its' (f.); genitive after في; 'its middle'
لِلصَّيَّادِ: لِـ + الـ + صَيَّاد — ṣayyād, fisherman (m.); genitive; 'to the fisherman'
فَتَبِعَهُ: فَـ + تَبِعَ + هُ — form I tabiʿa/yatbaʿu, to follow; 3rd sing. m. + 'him'; 'so he followed him'
فَوَقَفَ: فَـ + وَقَفَ — form I waqafa/yaqifu, to stop, stand; 3rd sing. m. past
أَمَرَ: أَمَرَ — form I amara/yaʾmuru, to order; 3rd sing. m. past; 'he ordered'
يَطْرَحَ: يَطْرَحَ — form I ṭaraḥa/yaṭraḥu, to cast, throw; 3rd sing. m. subjunctive (after أن)
فَرَأَى: فَـ + رَأَى — form I raʾā/yarā, to see; 3rd sing. m. past; printed here with its hamza already on the alif (رأى); 'and he saw'
السَّمَكَ: الـ + سَمَك — samak, fish (collective, m.); accusative, object of رأى
الْمُلَوَّنَ: الـ + مُلَوَّن — mulawwan, colored (passive participle of form II lawwana); accusative adjective
الْأَبْيَضَ: الـ + أَبْيَض — abyaḍ, white (m.); accusative, in apposition listing the colors
أَخْرَجَ: أَخْرَجَ — form IV kharaja/yukhriju, to take out, bring out; 3rd sing. m. past
طَرَحَهَا: طَرَحَ + هَا — ṭaraḥa, to cast; 3rd sing. m. + 'it' (f.); 'he cast it'
جَذَبَهَا: جَذَبَ + هَا — form I jadhaba/yajdhibu, to draw, pull; 3rd sing. m. + 'it' (f.); 'he drew it in'
أَرْبَعَ: أَرْبَعَ — arbaʿ, four; accusative, first term of iḍāfa with سمكات
سَمَكَاتٍ: سَمَكَات — samakāt, fish (pl. of samakah); indefinite genitive, second term of the iḍāfa
كُلٌّ: كُلٌّ — kull, each, every one; indefinite nominative, 'each one'
بِلَوْنٍ: بِـ + لَوْنٍ — lawn, color (m.); indefinite genitive; 'of a color'
رَأَهُمْ: رَأَى + هُمْ — form I raʾā/yarā, to see; 3rd sing. m. + 'them'; printed here with hamza already on the alif and without the medial long vowel of Classical رآهم; 'he saw them'
ادْخُلْ: ادْخُلْ — form I dakhala/yadkhulu, to enter; 2nd sing. m. imperative (initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl); 'enter!'
السُّلْطَانِ: الـ + سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan (m.); genitive after إلى
قَدِّمْهُمْ: قَدِّمْ + هُمْ — form II qaddama/yuqaddimu, to present, offer; 2nd sing. m. imperative + 'them'; 'present them'
اقْبَلْ: اقْبَلْ — form I qabila/yaqbalu, to accept; 2nd sing. m. imperative (initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl); 'accept!'
عُذْرِي: عُذْر + ي — ʿudhr, excuse (m.) + 'my'; accusative object of اقبل
فَإِنِّي: فَـ + إِنَّ + ي — inna, indeed + 'I'; 'for indeed I'
أَعْرِفْ: أَعْرِفْ — form I ʿarafa/yaʿrifu, to know; 1st sing. jussive (after لم)
طَرِيقًا: طَرِيقًا — ṭarīq, way, road (m./f.); indefinite accusative object
أَلْفٍ: أَلْفٍ — alf, thousand (m.); indefinite genitive, second term of the iḍāfa
ثَمَانِمِايَةِ: ثَمَانِ + مِائَةِ — thamān, eight, + miʾah, hundred (f.); genitive; here spelled ثمانماية, its medial hamza smoothed onto a plain yāʾ; 'eight hundred'
ظَاهِرَ: ظَاهِرَ — ẕāhir, outer surface, face (m.); accusative object of رأيت
تَصْطَادْ: تَصْطَادْ — form VIII ṣāda/yaṣṭādu, to fish; 2nd sing. m. jussive (prohibition after لا); 'you may not fish'
وَاحِدَةً: وَاحِدَةً — wāḥidah, one, single (f.); indefinite accusative adjective
وَدَّعَهُ: وَدَّعَ + هُ — form II waddaʿa/yuwaddiʿu, to bid farewell; 3rd sing. m. + 'him'; 'he bade him farewell'
تُوحِشْنِي: تُوحِشْ + نِي — form IV waḥasha/yūḥishu, to bereave, make desolate; jussive-optative 3rd sing. + 'me', with اللّٰه as its (delayed) subject; 'may [He] not bereave me'
دَقَّ: دَقَّ — form I daqqa/yadiqqu, to strike, pound; 3rd sing. m. past
الْأَرْضَ: الـ + أَرْض — arḍ, earth, ground (f.); accusative, object of دق
بِرِجْلِهِ: بِـ + رِجْل + هِ — rijl, foot (f.) + 'his'; 'with his foot'
فَانْشَقَّتِ: فَـ + انْشَقَّتِ — form VII shaqqa/yanshaqqu, to split open; 3rd sing. f. past (initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl); 'and it split open'
الْأَرْضُ: الـ + أَرْض — arḍ, earth, ground (f.); nominative subject
بَلَعَتْهُ: بَلَعَتْ + هُ — form I balaʿa/yablaʿu, to swallow; 3rd sing. f. + 'him'; 'it swallowed him'
المَدِينَةِ: الـ + مَدِينَة + ِ (gen., after ilā) — madīna, city (f.); 'the city'
مُتَعَجِّبٌ: مُتَعَجِّب + ٌ (indef. nom.) — Form V active participle of ع-ج-ب; 'astonished'
العِفْرِيتِ: الـ + عِفْرِيت + ِ (gen., after maʿa) — ʿifrīt, efrit/demon (m.)
مَاجُورًا: مَاجُور + ًا (indef. acc.) — mājūr, large basin (m., non-Classical loanword); 'a basin'
مَلَأَهُ: مَلَأَ + هُ — malaʼa, to fill; 'he filled it' (edition prints hamza here precomposed, as أ)
حَطَّ: ḥaṭṭa (verb I, to set down/put) — "he put/set down"
فَاخْتَبَطَ: فَ + اخْتَبَطَ — Form VIII of خ-ب-ط; 'then it thrashed about'
رَأْسِهِ: رَأْس + ِهِ — raʼs, head (m.) + hi; 'his head' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'راسه')
قَصَدَ: qaṣada (verb I, to head for/intend) — "he made for"
رَأَي: رَأَى — raʼā, to see; 'he had seen' (hamza supplied; edition prints 'راي' with final yāʼ where Classical spelling has alif maqṣūra ى — kept as printed)
أَعْطُوا: أَعْطُوا — Form IV imperative pl. of ع-ط-و; 'give!' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'اعطوا')
لِلْجَارِيَةِ: لِـ + الـ + جَارِيَة + ِ — jāriya, slave-girl/handmaid (f.); 'to the girl'
أَهْدَاهَا: أَهْدَى + هَا — Form IV of ه-د-ي, 'to give as a gift'; 'he had given her (as a gift)' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'اهداها')
أَيَّامٍ: أَيَّام + ٍ (indef. gen. pl.) — yawm, day (m.), pl. ayyām (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'ايام')
يُجَرِّبْهَا: يُجَرِّبْ + هَا — Form II of ج-ر-ب, 'to try/test'; 'he had tried her'
فَأَمَرَ: فَ + أَمَرَ — 'so he commanded' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'امر')
تَقْلِيَهُنَّ: تَقْلِيَ + هُنَّ — subjunctive of قَلَى (to fry) + hunna, 'them' (f. pl.); 'that she fry them'
جَارِيَهْ: جَارِيَة (vocative, spelled with hāʼ for tāʼ marbūṭa as printed — pausal pronunciation) — jāriya, slave-girl (f.); 'girl!'
نَبْتَلِيكِ: نَبْتَلِي + كِ — Form VIII of ب-ل-و, 'to test/afflict'; 'we test you (f.)'
دُمْعَتِي: دُمْعَة + ِي — dumʿa, teardrop (f.) + ī; 'my teardrop' (obscure endearment, uncertain)
لِشِدَّتِي: لِـ + شِدَّة + ِي — shidda, severity/hardship/need (f.) + ī; 'for my need' (obscure, uncertain)
فَرِّحِينَا: فَرِّحِي + نَا — Form II imperative f.sg. of ف-ر-ح ('to gladden') + nā, 'us'; 'gladden us'
وَأَنَّ: وَ + أَنَّ — 'and that' (subordinator introducing a noun clause; hamza supplied)
أَنَى: أَنَى — obscure verb form, perhaps a variant of أَتَى/جَاءَ ('to come'); 'came' (uncertain, vocalized on its bare printed letters)
بِهَدِيَّةٍ: بِـ + هَدِيَّة + ٍ (indef. gen.) — bi-, with (prep.; atā/jāʾa bi- = come with, i.e. bring) + hadiyya, gift (f.)
أَوْصَاهَا: أَوْصَى + هَا — Form IV of و-ص-ي, 'to instruct/enjoin'; 'he had instructed her' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'اوصاها')
وَأَمَرَهُ: وَ + أَمَرَ + هُ — 'and he ordered him' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'امره')
يُعْطِيَ: يُعْطِيَ — Form IV subjunctive of ع-ط-و; 'that he give'
أَرْبَعَمَايَةَ: أَرْبَعْ + مَاية + َ (acc.) — 'four hundred' (colloquial spelling of arbaʿ-mi'ah, with ي for the medial hamza-letter as printed; initial hamza supplied)
فَأَعْطَاهُ: فَ + أَعْطَى + هُ — 'so he gave him' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'فاعطاه')
إِيَّاهَا: إِيَّا + هَا — independent object pronoun + hā; 'it/them' (f.) (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'اياها')
فَأَخَذَهَا: فَ + أَخَذَ + هَا — 'so he took it' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'فاخذها')
حُجْرَةٍ: حُجْرَة + ٍ (indef. gen.) — ḥujra, fold of a garment/pocket (f.); read colloquially, not 'room'
وَرَاحَ: وَ + رَاحَ — rāḥa, to go off/set about; 'and he went off'
يَقُومُ: yaqūmu (verb I, qāma, imperf.) — "he rises/gets up"
اشْتَرَى: اِشْتَرَى — Form VIII of ش-ر-ي; 'he bought' (hamzat al-waṣl, unmarked, not a supplied consonant hamza)
لِعِيَالِهِ: لِـ + عِيَال + ِهِ — ʿiyāl, family/dependents (m. pl.) + hi; 'for his family'
يَحْتَاجُونَ: يَحْتَاجُونَ — Form VIII of ح-و-ج; 'they need'
مَسْرُورٌ: مَسْرُور + ٌ (indef. nom.) — passive participle of س-ر-ر; 'delighted'
أَمْرِ: أَمْر + ِ (gen., construct) — amr, matter/affair (m.) (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'امر')
أَمَّا: وَ + أَمَّا — 'and as for' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'اما')
فَإِنَّهَا: فَـ + إِنَّ + هَا — 'then/so indeed she' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'فانها')
أَخَذَتِ: أَخَذَتْ + ِ (liaison kasra before al-) — 'she took' (hamza supplied; edition prints bare 'اخذت')
نَظَّفَتْهَا: naẓẓafat (verb II of ن-ظ-ف, to clean) + ـهَا (it/them, f.) — "she cleaned it/them"
نَصَبَتِ: naṣaba, to set up / pitch (verb I, perf. 3fs) + ـِ liaison vowel; "she set up"
الطَّاجِنَ: الـ + طَاجِن (acc.) — ṭājin, frying-pan (m.), a loanword; 'the frying-pan' (object)
إِنَّهَا: إِنَّ (indeed, emphatic) + ـهَا (she/her) — 'ثم إنها' = 'then indeed she'
أَرْخَتِ: أَرْخَى (IV) + ـَتْ (fem.) + ـِ (liaison) — arkhā, to let down / loosen; 'she let (it) down'
اسْتَوَى: اِسْتَوَى (VIII) — istawā, to become even, i.e. done/cooked; 'it became done'
قَلَبَتْهُ: qalaba (verb I, to turn over) + ـهُ (it, m.); "she turned it over"
بِحَايِطِ: بِـ + حَايِط (gen.) — ḥāʾiṭ, wall (m.), here spelled with ي instead of the hamza-seat (colloquial); 'in/by the wall of'
إِنْشَقَّ: اِنْشَقَّ (VII, from شَقَّ) — inshaqqa, to split open; 'it split open'
خَرَجَتْ: kharaja (verb I, to go out) — 3fs perf.; "she/it came out"
مَلِيحَةُ: مَلِيحَة (nom., idafa) — malīḥ, beautiful, comely; fem. of an idafa: 'beautiful of...'
الْقَدِّ: الـ + قَدّ (gen.) — qadd, stature, figure (m.); 'the stature' — with مَلِيحَةُ: 'beautiful of stature'
أَسِيلَةُ: أَسِيلَة (nom., idafa) — asīl, smooth, soft; fem.: 'smooth of...'
كَحِيلَةُ: كَحِيلَة (nom., idafa) — kaḥīl, dark-lidded, kohl-black; fem.: 'dark-eyed of...'
الطَّرْفِ: الـ + طَرْف (gen.) — ṭarf, eye, glance (m.); 'the eye/glance' — 'dark-eyed'
لَابِسَةٌ: لَابِسَة (nom., indef., act. part. of لَبِسَ) — lābis, wearing; fem.: 'wearing'
كُوفِيَّةَ: كُوفِيَّة (acc., idafa) — kūfiyyah, a kerchief/headcloth (f.); object of لابسة: 'a kerchief of...'
بِهُدَّابٍ: بِـ + هُدَّاب (gen., indef.) — huddāb, fringe (m.); 'with a fringe'
أُذُنَيْهَا: أُذُنَيْ (dual, gen.) + ـهَا — udhun, ear (f.); 'her two ears'
حَلَقٌ: حَلَق (nom., indef.) — ḥalaq, ring(s), earring(s) (coll., m.); 'rings'
مَعَاصِمِهَا: مَعَاصِم (gen. pl.) + ـهَا — miʿṣam, wrist (m.); 'her wrists'
زَوْجُ: زَوْج (nom., idafa) — zawj, pair (m.); 'a pair of'
أَسَاوِرَ: أَسَاوِر (gen., diptote pl.) — siwār, bracelet (m.), pl.; 'bracelets'
أَصَابِعِهَا: أَصَابِع (gen. pl.) + ـهَا — iṣbaʿ/uṣbuʿ, finger (f.); 'her fingers'
خَوَاتِمُ: خَوَاتِم (nom., diptote pl., indef.) — khātim, ring (m.), pl.; 'rings'
بِالْفُصُوصِ: بِـ + الـ + فُصُوص (gen. pl.) — faṣṣ, bezel, gem-setting (m.), pl.; 'with the settings'
الْجَوَاهِرِ: الـ + جَوَاهِر (gen. pl.) — jawhar, jewel, gem (m.), pl.; 'the jewels' (in loose apposition to الفصوص, not strict idafa)
الثَّمِينَةِ: الـ + ثَمِينَة (gen., fem. agreement) — thamīn, precious; 'the precious'
الْخَيْزُرَانِ: الـ + خَيْزُرَان (gen.) — khayzurān, cane, rattan (m.); 'the cane'
فَغَرَزَتِ: فَـ + غَرَزَتْ (+ ـِ liaison) — gharaza, to thrust, plant, drive in (I); 'and she thrust'
الْقَضِيبَ: الـ + قَضِيب (acc.) — qaḍīb, rod, wand (m.); 'the rod'
الطَّاجِنِ: الـ + طَاجِن (gen.) — ṭājin, frying-pan (m.); 'the frying-pan' (genitive, after فِي/مِن)
سَمَكُ: سَمَك (voc., bare/mabnī) — samak, fish (coll., m.); 'O fish' (vocative drops the article)
الْعَهْدِ: الـ + عَهْد (gen.) — ʿahd, covenant, pact (m.); 'the covenant'
مُقِيمٌ: مُقِيم (nom., indef., act. part. of أَقَامَ IV) — 'one abiding, dwelling'; 'مقيم على العهد' = 'abiding by the covenant'
رَأَتِ: رَأَتْ (+ ـِ liaison) — raʾā, to see (I); 'she saw' (spelled here with the hamza the edition itself prints)
غُشِيَ: غُشِيَ (pass. of I غَشِيَ, 'to cover/overcome') — 'غُشِيَ عَلَيْهَا' = 'she was overcome, fainted'
أَعَادَتِ: أَعَادَتْ (+ ـِ liaison, IV of عَادَ) — aʿāda, to repeat; 'she repeated'
ثَالِثًا: thālith, third; here adverbial acc., "a third time"
شَالُوا: شَالُوا — shāla (dialectal/colloquial verb), to lift, raise; 'they raised' — colloquial for Classical رَفَعُوا, kept as a feature of the text
رُؤُسَهُمْ: رُ[waw+combining hamza above]ُس (acc. pl., defective/contracted spelling) + ـهُمْ — raʾs, head (m.), pl. رُؤُوس; 'their heads', the plural's hamza-bearing و contracted to one
قَالُوا: qāla (verb I, to say) — 3mp perf.; "they said"
بِلِسَانٍ: بِـ + لِسَان (gen., indef.) — lisān, tongue, speech (m.); 'in a tongue/speech'
عُلْتِ: عُلْتِ — from عَالَ يَعُولُ (hollow I), 'to support, sustain, provide for'; 2nd f. sg. past: 'you sustained (us)' — not from عَلَا 'to rise', despite the resemblance
عُلْنَا: عُلْنَا — same verb, 1st pl. past: 'we sustained (you)'
وَافَيْتِ: وَافَيْتِ (III, وَافَى, 'to keep faith, fulfil') — 2nd f. sg. past: 'you kept faith'
وَافَيْنَا: وَافَيْنَا — same verb, 1st pl. past: 'we kept faith'
هَجَرْتِ: هَجَرْتِ (I, هَجَرَ, 'to forsake, abandon') — 2nd f. sg. past: 'you forsook (us)'
فَاَنَا: فَـ + أَنَا [as printed, without hamza mark] — 'so I'
تَهَافَيْنَا: تَهَافَيْنَا (VI, تَهَافَتَ/تَهَافَى, 'to throw oneself down, rush to ruin') — 1st pl. past: 'we have thrown ourselves down, perished'
أَقْلَبَتِ: أَقْلَبَتْ (+ ـِ liaison, IV of قَلَبَ) — aqlaba, to overturn; 'she overturned'
وَالْتَأَمَ: و + اِلْتَأَمَ (VIII of لَأَمَ, 'to mend, close up') — 'and it closed up' (spelled with the hamza the edition itself prints)
الْحَائِطُ: الـ + حَائِط (nom.) — ḥāʾiṭ, wall (m.); 'the wall' (spelled here with the edition's own hamza, contrast بحايط above)
أَفَاقَتِ: أَفَاقَتْ (+ ـِ liaison, IV of فَاقَ) — afāqa, to awake, recover; 'she awoke'
غَشْوَتِهَا: غَشْوَة (gen.) + ـهَا — ghashwah, swoon, faint (f.); 'her swoon'
فَرَأَتِ: فَـ + رَأَتْ (+ ـِ liaison) — raʾā, to see (I); here spelled bare in the archive, hamza supplied; 'and she saw'
مُحْتَرِقِينَ: مُحْتَرِقِين (acc./gen. pl., act. part. VIII of حَرَقَ) — iḥtaraqa, to be burnt; 'burnt (ones)'
الْفَحْمِ: الـ + فَحْم (gen.) — faḥm, charcoal, coal (m.); 'the charcoal'
أَوَّلِ: أَوَّل (gen., idafa) — awwal, first; 'the first of'
غَزَوَاتِهِ: غَزَوَات (gen. pl.) + ـهِ — ghazwah, raid, foray (f.), pl.; 'his raids' (obscure — see note)
إِنْكَسَرَتْ: اِنْكَسَرَتْ (VII of كَسَرَ) — inkasara, to be broken; 'it broke'
عَصَانَهُ: عَصَا (?) + ـنَهُ — ʿaṣā, staff, stick (f.) (?); 'his staff' (obscure — see note)
الْأَرْضِ: الـ + أَرْض (gen.) — arḍ, ground, earth (f.); 'the ground'
مَغْشِيًّا: مَغْشِيًّا (acc., pass. part., adverbial ḥāl) — from غَشِيَ عَلَيْهِ, 'to be overcome'; 'fainted, overcome' (cf. غُشِيَ above)
فَرَأَهَا: فَـ + رَأَى (+ ـهَا) — raʾā, to see (I); 'and he saw her'
الدَّرْدِيسَ: الدَّرْدِيس (acc.) — obscure word, of uncertain etymology; rendered by evident sense as 'utterly dazed/stupefied' — see note
فَحَرَّكَهَا: فَـ + حَرَّكَ (II, حَرَّكَ, 'to move, stir') + ـهَا — 'so he stirred her'
فَفَاقَتْ: فَـ + فَاقَتْ (I, فَاقَ, 'to awake, come to') — 'so she awoke' (distinct from IV أَفَاقَ used earlier in the same sense)
وَأَعْلَمَتِ: و + أَعْلَمَتْ (+ ـِ liaison, IV of عَلِمَ) — aʿlama, to inform; 'and she informed'
بِالْقِصَّهْ: بِـ + الـ + قِصَّة [spelled with هـ for ة] — qiṣṣah, story, tale (f.); 'with the story' — tāʾ marbūṭah written as plain hāʾ, a Middle Arabic/dialectal orthographic habit
وَبِالَّذِي: و + بِـ + الَّذِي — 'and with that which'
أَرْسَلَ: أَرْسَلَ (IV, رَسَلَ) — arsala, to send; 'he sent'
فَأَتَوْا: فَـ + أَتَوْا (I, أَتَى, 3rd pl.) — 'and they came' (i.e. brought him)
جِي: جِي — Middle Arabic imperative, 'come!/bring!', for Classical جِئْ; kept as printed
الْتَأَمَ: اِلْتَأَمَ — form VIII of ل-أ-م (laʾama, to close up/heal/join together); "it closed up" (said of the kitchen wall, closing after the maiden passes back through it)
جِئْتَ: جِئْتَ — jāʾa (form I, hollow), 2nd m. sg. past + تَ; 'you came, you brought' (hamza printed precomposed on yāʾ-seat, ئ, kept as in the source)
بِأَرْبَعِ: بِـ + أَرْبَع — bi- 'with' + arbaʿ, 'four' (numeral, genitive after بِ); hamza supplied, printed bare as اربع
مِثْلِهِمْ: مِثْلِ + هِمْ — mithl 'like' + -him 'them (m. pl.)'; genitive, agreeing loosely with the preceding fem. pl. سَمَكَات — a gender-agreement laxity typical of this text
فَأَخَذَهُمْ: فَ + أَخَذَ + هُمْ — fa- + akhadha (form I) 'to take' + -hum 'them'; hamza supplied, printed bare as اخذهم
وَجَابَهُمْ: وَ + جَابَ + هُمْ — wa- + jāba 'to bring' (colloquial/Middle Arabic verb) + -hum 'them'
الْجَارِيَةِ: الـ + جَارِيَة — al- + jāriya, 'slave-girl, maiden' (f.); genitive after إلى
قُومِي: قُومِي — qūmī, fem. sg. imperative of قَامَ (form I, hollow) 'to rise, stand up'
اِقْلِبِيهِمْ: اِقْلِبِي + هِمْ — iqlibī, fem. sg. imperative of قَلَبَ (form I) 'to turn over, flip' (i.e. fry) + -him 'them'; hamzat al-waṣl, no true hamza
قُدَّامِي: قُدَّامِ + ي — quddām 'in front of, before' + -ī 'my, me'; 'before me'
أَرَى: أَرَى — arā, 1st sg. present of رَأَى (form I) 'to see'; hamza supplied, printed bare as ارى
الْقَضِيَّةَ: الـ + قَضِيَّة — al- + qaḍiyya, 'matter, case, affair' (f.); accusative object of أرى
فَقَامَتِ: فَ + قَامَتِ — fa- + qāmat (form I, hollow) 3rd f. sg. past of قَامَ 'to rise, get up'
وَأَصْلَحَتْهُمْ: وَ + أَصْلَحَتْ + هُمْ — wa- + aṣlaḥat (form IV) 3rd f. sg. past of أَصْلَحَ 'to make right, prepare' + -hum 'them'; hamza supplied, printed bare as اصلحتهم
وَعَلَّقَتِ: وَ + عَلَّقَتِ — wa- + ʿallaqat (form II) 3rd f. sg. past of عَلَّقَ 'to hang up'; i.e. set the pan on the fire
وَطَرَحَتْهُمْ: وَ + طَرَحَتْ + هُمْ — wa- + ṭaraḥat (form I) 3rd f. sg. past of طَرَحَ 'to throw, put' + -hum 'them'
إِلَّا: إِلَّا — illā, here in the idiom فَلَمَّا...إِلَّا وَ... 'no sooner had X happened than...'; hamza supplied, printed bare as الا
وَالْحَائِطُ: وَ + الـ + حَائِط — wa- + al- + ḥāʾiṭ, 'wall' (m., active participle of حَاطَ 'to surround'); nominative subject of انشق. Hamza printed precomposed (ئ) in the source, kept as such
اِنْشَقَّ: اِنْشَقَّ — inshaqqa, form VII (اِنْفَعَلَ) of ش-ق-ق 'to split, crack open'; hamzat al-waṣl, no true hamza
وَالصَّبِيَّةُ: وَ + الـ + صَبِيَّة — wa- + al- + ṣabiyya, 'girl, young maiden' (f.); nominative subject of ظهرت
ظَهَرَتْ: ظَهَرَتْ — ẓaharat, 3rd f. sg. past of ظَهَرَ (form I) 'to appear, become visible'
هَيْئَتِهَا: هَيْئَةِ + هَا — hayʾa 'shape, form, guise' (f.) + -hā 'her'; hamza printed precomposed (ئ) in the source, kept as such
الْأُولَى: الـ + أُولَى — al- + ūlā, 'first, former' (f. elative of أَوَّل); hamza supplied, printed bare as الاولى
الْقَضِيبُ: الـ + قَضِيب — al- + qaḍīb, 'rod, wand, staff' (m.); subject of the nominal sentence وفي يدها القضيب
فَغَرَزَتْهُ: فَ + غَرَزَتْ + هُ — fa- + gharazat (form I) 3rd f. sg. past of غَرَزَ 'to thrust, stick in' + -hu 'it (m.)'
أَنْتُمْ: أَنْتُمْ — antum, 2nd m. pl. independent pronoun 'you'; hamza supplied, printed bare as انتم
الْقَدِيمِ: الـ + قَدِيم — al- + qadīm, 'old, ancient'; genitive, modifying العهد
بِالسَّمَكِ: بِـ + الـ + سَمَك — bi- 'with' + al- + samak, 'the fish' (collective, m.); in وَإِذَا بِـ... idiomatic 'and behold, the fish...'
الْجَمِيعِ: الـ + جَمِيع — al- + jamīʿ, 'all, entirety'; in apposition to السمك, genitive
رُؤُسَهُمْ: رُؤُوس + هُمْ — ruʾūs, broken pl. of رَأْس 'head' (m.) + -hum 'their'; spelled defectively in the source (رؤسهم, without the plene و of رؤوس); hamza printed precomposed (ؤ), kept as such
الْبَيْتُ: الـ + بَيْت — al- + bayt, here 'verse, line of poetry' (lit. 'house'; a bayt of poetry, m.); nominative
السَّابِقُ: الـ + سَابِق — al- + sābiq, active participle (m.) of سَبَقَ 'to precede'; 'the previous (one)'
عُدْتِ: عُدْتِ — ʿudti, 2nd f. sg. past of عَادَ (form I, hollow) 'to return'
عُدْنَا: عُدْنَا — ʿudnā, 1st pl. past of عَادَ (form I, hollow) 'to return'
هَجَرْتُمْ: هَجَرْتُمْ — hajartum, 2nd m. pl. past of هَجَرَ (form I) 'to forsake, abandon'; the verse's earlier occurrence (not in this slice) has singular هَجَرْتِ instead — a textual variant
فَانَا: فَانَا — probably فَأَنَا 'then I' (fa- + anā), or part of a corrupted/rearranged rhyme sequence with the following تَدْفَيْنَا; printed and vocalized here exactly as in the source, sense uncertain (see the verse's note)
تَدْفَيْنَا: تَدْفَيْنَا — possibly from د-ف-ا/د-ف-أ 'to grow warm' ('we would keep each other warm'), or a corrupted/rearranged form of the earlier verse's تَهَافَيْنَا 'we would perish, rush upon one another'; sense uncertain, see note
وَأَدْرَكَ: وَ + أَدْرَكَ — wa- + adraka (form IV) 'to overtake, reach, attain'; hamza supplied, printed bare as وادرك
وَقَلَبَتِ: وَ + قَلَبَتْ — qalaba (f.), 'to overturn, turn over'; 'and she overturned'
بِالْقَضِيبِ: بِـ + الـ + قَضِيب — qaḍīb, rod, wand; 'with the rod'
إِخْفَاؤُهُ: إِخْفَاء + هُ — ikhfāʾ, concealing (vb. noun of IV أَخْفَى) + 3ms pronoun, its subject; 'its concealment, to conceal it'
وَأَخْبَرَهُ: وَ + أَخْبَرَ + هُ — akhbara, form IV, 'to inform' + 3ms object; 'and he informed him'
شَاهَدَهُ: شَاهَدَ + هُ — shāhada, form III, 'to witness' + 3ms object; 'he had witnessed it'
أَنْظُرَ: أَنْظُرَ — anẓura, subjunctive of نَظَرَ, 'to look'; 'that I look, I must look'
فَأَرْسَلَ: فَـ + أَرْسَلَ — arsala, form IV, 'to send'; 'so he sent'
يَأْتِيَ: يَأْتِيَ — yaʾtiya, subjunctive of أَتَى, 'to come, bring'; 'he should bring'
الْأَوَّلِ: الـ + أَوَّل — awwal, first, former; 'the first (batch)'
رَسَمَ: رَسَمَ — rasama, 'to issue a decree'; 'he decreed'
وَأُذِنَ: وَ + أُذِنَ — udhina, passive of أَذِنَ, 'to give leave'; 'and leave was given'
فَأَمْضَي: فَـ + أَمْضَى — amḍā, form IV of م-ض-ي, 'to carry into effect, order'; 'so he ordered'
يُعْطُوهُ: يُعْطُوا + هُ — yuʿṭū, subjunctive pl. of أَعْطَى, 'to give' + 3ms object; 'that they give him'
الْتَفَتَ: اِلْتَفَتَ — iltafata, form VIII of ل-ف-ت, 'to turn (toward)'; 'he turned'
وَاقْلِ: وَ + اِقْلِ — imperative of قَلَى, 'to fry'; 'and fry!'
وَرَكَّبَ: وَ + رَكَّبَ — rakkaba, form II of ر-ك-ب, 'to set up, put in place'; 'and he set up'
وَإِذَا: وَ + إِذَا — 'and behold, and suddenly' (idhā al-mufājaʾa)
بِالْحَائِطِ: بِـ + الـ + حَائِط — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after wa-idhā 'and behold' (no English word of its own) + ḥāʾiṭ, wall; topic of the وإذا construction, 'the wall'
انْشَقَّ: اِنْشَقَّ — inshaqqa, form VII of ش-ق-ق, 'to split open'; 'it had split'
كَأَنَّهُ: كَأَنَّ + هُ — kaʾanna, 'as if' + 3ms pronoun; 'as if he'
الْأَطْوَادِ: الـ + أَطْوَاد — aṭwād, mountain-masses (pl. of طَوْد, gen.); 'the mountain-masses'
بَقِيَّةِ: بَقِيَّة — baqiyya, remnant, remainder (construct); 'the remnant of'
عَادٍ: عَادٍ — ʿĀd, the ancient tribe of ʿĀd (proper name, indef. gen.); proverbial for gigantic stature
فَرْعٌ: فَرْعٌ — farʿ, branch, bough (indef. nom.); 'a branch'
مُقِيمِينَ: مُقِيمِينَ — muqīmīn, pl. active participle of أَقَامَ, 'abiding, remaining'; 'abiding'
وَالسَّمَكُ: وَ + الـ + سَمَك — samak, fish; 'and the fish'
عُدْتَ: عُدْتَ — ʿudta, perfect 2ms of عَادَ, 'to return'; 'you returned'
وَافَيْتَ: وَافَيْتَ — wāfayta, perfect 2ms of وَافَى, 'to keep faith, be true'; 'you kept faith'
تَكَافَيْنَا: تَكَافَيْنَا — takāfaynā, perfect 1p, form VI of ك-ف-ي, 'to requite one another'; 'we have matched (you) in kind'
وَأَقْبَلَ: وَ + أَقْبَلَ — aqbala, form IV of ق-ب-ل, 'to come forward, turn (to)'; 'and he turned'
وَقَلَبَهُ: وَ + قَلَبَ + هُ — qalaba, 'to overturn' + 3ms object; 'and overturned it'
بِالْغُصْنِ: بِـ + الـ + غُصْن — ghuṣn, branch, bough; 'with the branch'
فَرَأَوْهُ: فَـ + رَأَوْا + هُ — raʾaw, 'they saw' + 3ms object; 'and they saw it'
الْفَحِيمِ: الـ + فَحِيم — faḥīm, charcoal (an intensive/variant form of فَحْم); 'the charcoal'
فَتَدَهَّلَ: فَـ + تَدَهَّلَ — tadahhala, form V, 'to be astounded, thrown into confusion'; 'then he was astounded'
السُّكُوتُ: الـ + سُكُوت — sukūt, silence; 'silence' (subject of يُمْكِنُ)
شَأْنٌ: شَأْنٌ — shaʾn, matter, affair, significance (indef. nom.); 'a matter (of its own)'
بِإِحْضَارِ: بِـ + إِحْضَارِ — iḥḍār, bringing (vb. noun of IV أَحْضَرَ); 'the bringing of'
جِبَالٍ: جِبَالٍ — jibāl, mountains (indef. gen. pl. of جَبَل); 'mountains'
بِظَاهِرِ: بِـ + ظَاهِرِ — ẓāhir, outskirts, outer part (construct); 'at the outskirts of'
مَدِينَتِكَ: مَدِينَة + كَ — madīna, city + 2ms pronoun; 'your city'
فَالْتَفَتَ: فَـ + اِلْتَفَتَ — iltafata, 'to turn (toward)'; 'then he turned'
مَسِيرَةُ: مَسِيرَةُ — masīra, a journey's distance (nom.); 'a journey of'
مَوْلَانَا: مَوْلَى + نَا — mawlā, lord, master + 1p pronoun; 'our lord'
وَأَمَرَ: وَ + أَمَرَ — amara, 'to order'; 'and he ordered'
بِخُرُوجِ: بِـ + خُرُوجِ — khurūj, going-out (vb. noun of خَرَجَ, construct); 'the going-out of'
وَرُكُوبِ: وَ + رُكُوبِ — rukūb, mounting (vb. noun of رَكِبَ, construct); 'and the mounting of'
الْجَيْشِ: الـ + جَيْش — jaysh, troops, host (gen.); 'the troops'
وَالصَّيَّادُ: وَ + الـ + صَيَّاد — ṣayyād, fisherman; 'with the fisherman'
يَلْعَنُ: يَلْعَنُ — yalʿanu, imperfect of لَعَنَ, 'to curse'; 'cursing'
وَنَزَلُوا: وَ + نَزَلُوا — nazalū, 'they went down'; 'and they went down'
يَرَوْهَا: يَرَوْا + هَا — yaraw, jussive pl. of رَأَى, 'to see' + 3fs object; 'they had (not) seen it'
عُمْرِهِمْ: عُمْر + هِمْ — ʿumr, lifetime + 3mp pronoun; 'their lives'
وَالسُّلْطَانُ: وَ + الـ + سُلْطَان — sulṭān, Sultan; 'and the Sultan'
وَجَمِيعُ: وَ + جَمِيعُ — jamīʿ, all, the whole of (construct); 'and all of'
يَتَعَجَّبُونَ: يَتَعَجَّبُونَ — yataʿajjabūna, imperfect pl. of تَعَجَّبَ, 'to marvel'; 'marveling'
وَالْبِرْكَةَ: وَ + الـ + بِرْكَة — birka, pool (acc.); 'and the pool'
أَلْوَانٍ: أَلْوَانٍ — alwān, colors (indef. gen. pl. of لَوْن); 'colors'
وَتَعَجَّبَ: وَ + تَعَجَّبَ — taʿajjaba, 'to marvel'; 'and he marveled'
لِلْعَسْكَرِ: لِـ + الـ + عَسْكَرِ — ʿaskar, army; 'to the army'
وَلِمَنْ: وَ + لِـ + مَنْ — man, 'whoever' + لِـ; 'and to whoever'

مُرْخًى: murkhan, let down, hung, passive participle (of أَرْخَى), accusative; 'let down, hanging'
مَجْلِسٍ: مَجْلِس + ٍ — majlis, sitting-room, chamber (m.), genitive indefinite; 'a chamber'
فَشَالَ: فَ + شَالَ — shāla, to lift, raise (Middle Arabic for رَفَعَ), verb perfect 3ms; 'so he lifted'
السِّتْرَ: الـ + سِتْر — sitr, curtain (m.), accusative definite; 'the curtain'
شَابًّا: شَابّ + ً — shābb, young man, active participle (m.), accusative indefinite; 'a young man'
سَرِيرٍ: سَرِير + ٍ — sarīr, couch, bed, dais (m.), genitive indefinite; 'a couch'
مُرْتَفِعٍ: مُرْتَفِع + ٍ — murtafiʿ, raised, elevated, active participle (of اِرْتَفَعَ), genitive; 'raised'
مِقْدَارَ: مِقْدَار + َ — miqdār, measure, amount (m.), accusative (adverbial); 'the measure of'
ذِرَاعٍ: ذِرَاع + ٍ — dhirāʿ, cubit, forearm (m./f.), genitive indefinite; 'a cubit'
شَبٌّ: شَبّ + ٌ — shabb, young man, youth (m.), nominative indefinite (variant spelling of شَابّ); 'a youth'
مَلِيحٌ: مَلِيح + ٌ — malīḥ, handsome, comely (adj.), nominative indefinite; 'handsome'
بِقَدٍّ: بِـ + قَدّ + ٍ — qadd, stature, figure (m.), genitive indefinite; 'of stature'
رَجِيحٍ: رَجِيح + ٍ — rajīḥ, well-balanced, graceful (adj., from رَجَحَ 'to outweigh, be evenly balanced'), genitive indefinite; 'well-balanced'
وَلِسَانٍ: وَ + لِسَان + ٍ — lisān, tongue (m.), genitive indefinite; 'and a tongue'
أَزْهَرَ: أَزْهَر + َ — azhar, radiant, bright (color/defect-pattern adj., diptote), genitive; 'radiant' — hamza supplied editorially, printed bare alif in the archive
وَخَدٍّ: وَ + خَدّ + ٍ — khadd, cheek (m.), genitive indefinite; 'and a cheek'
أَحْمَرَ: أَحْمَر + َ — aḥmar, red (color adj., diptote), genitive; 'red' — hamza supplied editorially, printed bare alif in the archive
كُرْسِيِّ: كُرْسِيّ — kursī, seat, throne (m.), genitive (construct); 'the throne/seat of'
كَقُرْصِ: كَـ + قُرْص — qurṣ, disc, round cake (m.), genitive; 'like a disc of'
تَبِعَ: tabiʿa, to follow, verb perfect 3ms; 'he followed'
جَبِينٍ: جَبِين + ٍ — jabīn, brow, forehead (m.), genitive indefinite; 'a brow'
شَامَةٍ: شَامَة + ٍ — shāma, mole, beauty-mark (f.), genitive indefinite; 'a mole'
وَالصَّبِيُّ: وَ + الـ + صَبِيّ — ṣabiyy, boy, youth (m.); 'and the youth' (nom.)
قَبَاءُ: قَبَاء — qabāʾ, a robe, caftan (m.); 'a robe' (nom.)
بِطَرَائِزَ: بِـ + طَرَائِز — ṭarāʾiz, borders, embroidered bands (pl.); 'with borders/trimmings'
تَاجٌ: تَاج — tāj, crown (m., indef. nom.); 'a crown'
مُكَلَّلٌ: مُكَلَّل — mukallal, crowned, studded (pass. participle, indef. nom.); 'studded'
بِالْجَوَاهِرِ: بِـ + الـ + جَوَاهِر — jawāhir, jewels (pl. of jawhara); 'with the jewels'
وَلَكِنَّهُ: وَ + لَكِنَّ + هُ — lākinna, but (particle) + hu, he/it; 'but he'
أَثَرُ: أَثَر — athar, trace, mark (m., nom.); 'the trace of'
الْحُزْنِ: الـ + حُزْن — ḥuzn, sorrow, grief (m.); 'the grief'
فَرَدَّ: فَـ + رَدَّ — radda, to reply, return (pf. 3ms); 'so he replied'
بِأَحْسَنِ: بِـ + أَحْسَن — aḥsan, best, most gracious (elative); 'with the best of'
سَلَامٍ: سَلَام — salām, greeting, peace (m., indef. gen.); 'a greeting'
أَعَزُّ: أَعَزُّ — aʿazz, more/most precious, mightier (elative of ʿazza); 'more precious'
وَلِيَ: وَ + لِـ + يَ — li-, to/for + ya, me; 'and to me (belongs)'
الْمَعْذِرَةُ: الـ + مَعْذِرَة — maʿdhira, excuse, pardon (f., nom.); 'the excuse'
عَذَرْتُكَ: عَذَرَ + تُ + كَ — ʿadhara, to excuse (pf.) + tu, I + ka, you; 'I have excused you'
وَأَنَا: وَ + أَنَا — anā, I (1s pron.); 'and I'
ضَيْفٌ: ضَيْف — ḍayf, guest (m., indef. nom.); 'a guest'
وَأَتَيْتُكَ: وَ + أَتَيْتُ + كَ — atā, to come (pf. 1s ataytu) + ka, you; 'and I have come to you'
حَاجَةٍ: حَاجَة — ḥāja, need, errand (f., indef. gen.); 'a need'
مُهِمَّةٍ: مُهِمَّة — muhimma, important, urgent (adj., f. indef. gen.); 'urgent'
أُرِيدُ: أُرِيدُ — arāda, to want (form IV, impf. 1s); 'I want'
سَبَبِ: سَبَب — sabab, cause, reason (m.); 'the reason for'
وَحْدَتِكَ: وَحْدَة + كَ — waḥda, solitude (f.) + ka, your; 'your solitude'
بُكَاكَ: بُكَاء + كَ — bukāʾ, weeping (m.) + ka, your; 'your weeping' (the hamza of bukāʾ is dropped in this spelling, a colloquial contraction, not an editorially supplied form)
الشَّابُّ: الـ + شَابّ — shābb, young man (m.); 'the young man'
دُمُوعُهُ: دُمُوع + هُ — dumūʿ, tears (pl. of damʿa) + hu, his; 'his tears'
خُدُودِهِ: خُدُود + هِ — khudūd, cheeks (pl. of khadd) + hi, his; 'his cheeks'
غَرِقَ: غَرِقَ — gharaqa, to be drowned, flooded (pf. 3ms); 'was drowned'
تَنَفَّسَ: تَنَفَّسَ — tanaffasa, to sigh, breathe deeply (form V, pf. 3ms); 'he sighed'
تَنَفُّسَ: تَنَفُّس — tanaffus, a sighing, breathing (verbal noun, acc., cognate object); 'the breathing of'
الصُّعَدَاءِ: الـ + صُعَدَاء — ṣuʿadāʾ, a deep/laboured sighing, lit. the toil of ascent; 'the deep sigh'
الْأَيَّامُ: الـ + أَيَّام — ayyām, days (pl. of yawm); 'the Days' (nom.)
رَامَتْ: رَامَتْ — rāmat, to aim, scheme, seek (pf. 3fs of rāma); 'has schemed'
أَقْعَدَتْ: أَقْعَدَتْ — aqʿadat, to make sit down (form IV, pf. 3fs); 'has made to sit'
نَائِبَاتُ: نَائِبَات — nāʾibāt, misfortunes, calamities (pl. of nāʾiba); 'the misfortunes of' (nom.)
نِمْتَ: نِمْتَ — nimta, you slept (pf. 2ms of nāma)
فَعَيْنُ: فَـ + عَيْن — ʿayn, eye (f.); 'then the eye of'
وَالدُّنْيَا: وَ + الـ + دُنْيَا — dunyā, world (f.); 'and the world'
