دَامَتْ: دَامَتْ — dāmat, to last, endure (pf. 3fs); 'has lasted'
سَلِّمِ: سَلِّمِ — sallim, hand over, surrender! (form II imperative 2ms)
الْأَمْرَ: الـ + أَمْر — amr, matter, affair (m., acc.); 'the matter'
وَانْزِلِ: وَ + انْزِلِ — anzil, put down, lay aside! (form IV imperative 2ms of anzala); 'and lay aside'
الْهَمَّ: الـ + هَمّ — hamm, worry, care (m., acc.); 'the worry'
الْفِكَرْ: الـ + فِكَر — fikar, thoughts (pl. of fikra); 'the [anxious] thoughts'
تَقُلْ: تَقُلْ — taqul, say! (negative jussive 2ms of qāla); 'say'
بِقَضَاءٍ: بِـ + قَضَاء — qaḍāʾ, decree (m., indef. gen.); 'by decree'
وَقَدَرْ: وَ + قَدَر — qadar, destiny, predestination (m.); 'and destiny'
يُبْكِيكَ: يُبْكِي + كَ — Form IV yubkī, 'makes weep' + 'you' (obj.); 'what makes-you-weep'
أَبْكِي: abkī, Form I imperfect 1sg of بكى, 'I weep'
وَمَدَّ: وَ + مَدَّ — madda, 'he stretched out'; 'and he stretched out'
أَذْيَالِهِ: أَذْيَال + هِ — adhyāl, pl. of ذَيْل (hem, skirt, train of a garment) + 'his'; 'his skirts/robes'
فَرَفَعَهَا: فَـ + رَفَعَ + هَا — rafaʿa, 'he lifted' + 'it/them' (f., referring to أذياله); 'and he lifted them'
وَتَأَسَّفَ: وَ + تَأَسَّفَ — Form V taʾassafa, 'he was sorrowful'; 'and he grieved'
وَتَأَوَّهَ: وَ + تَأَوَّهَ — Form V taʾawwaha (root أوه), 'he sighed/groaned'; 'and he sighed'
لَقَدْ: la- + qad — emphatic perfect marker, 'indeed already'
زِدْتَنِي: زِدْتَ + نِي — zāda, 'you increased' (2ms perf.) + 'me'; 'you have increased-me'
أَطْلُبُ: aṭlubu, Form I imperfect 1sg of طَلَبَ, 'I seek'
وَخَبَرَهُ: وَ + خَبَر + هُ — khabar, news/story (m.) + 'its'; 'and its story' (acc.)
أَسْأَلُ: asʾalu, Form I imperfect 1sg of سَأَلَ, 'I ask'
عَجِّلْ: ʿajjil, Form II imperative of عَجَّلَ, 'hasten!'
بِبَثِّ: بِـ + بَثّ — bathth, spreading/pouring-out (of news) (m.); 'with the telling of'
أَعْطِنِي: أَعْطِ + نِي — Form IV imperative of أَعْطَى, 'give!' + 'me'; 'give me'
السَّبَبِ: الـ + سَبَب — sabab, reason/cause (m., gen.); 'the reason'
كُتِبَ: kutiba, passive perfect of كَتَبَ, 'it was written'
بِالْإِبَرِ: بِـ + الـ + إِبَر — ibar, pl. of إِبْرَة, needle (f.); 'with the needles'
أَمَاقِ: āmāq, pl. of مَأْق/مُؤْق, corner of the eye; 'the corners of'
الْجَزَائِرِ: الـ + جَزَائِر — jazāʾir, pl. of جَزِيرَة, island (f., gen.); 'the isles'
الْمُلْكِ: الـ + مُلْك — mulk, kingship/dominion (m., gen.); 'the kingship'
عَامًا: ʿām, year (m., indef., acc. of specification); 'a year'
تُوُفِّيَ: tuwuffiya, passive perfect of وَفَّى, lit. 'he was made to die'; 'he passed away'
تَسَلْطَنْتُ: تَسَلْطَنْتُ — denominal verb from سُلْطَان; "I became sultan"
بِابْنَةِ: بِـ + ابْنَة — ibna, daughter (f., gen.); 'the daughter of'
تُحِبُّنِي: تُحِبُّ + نِي — Form IV tuḥibbu, 'she loves' + 'me'
بِحَيْثُ: bi-ḥaythu, 'such that, to the extent that'
غِبْتُ: ghibtu, Form I perfect 1sg of غَابَ, 'I was absent'
تَأْكُلُ: taʾkulu, Form I imperfect 3fs of أَكَلَ, 'she eats'
تَشْرَبُ: tashrabu, Form I imperfect 3fs of شَرِبَ, 'she drinks'
عِنْدَهَا: عِنْدَ + هَا — 'with her, at her side'
فَتَعَلَّقَتْ: فَـ + تَعَلَّقَتْ — Form V taʿallaqat, 'she clung, remained attached'
الْأَيَّامِ: الـ + أَيَّام — ayyām, pl. of يَوْم, day (gen.); 'the days'
فَأَمَرَتِ: فَـ + أَمَرَتِ — amarat, Form I perfect 3fs of أَمَرَ, 'she ordered'
الطَّبَّاخَ: الـ + طَبَّاخ — ṭabbākh, cook (m., acc.); 'the cook'
يُسْرِعَ: yusriʿa, Form IV subjunctive of أَسْرَعَ, 'he hasten'
يُجَهِّزَ: يُجَهِّزَ — Form II subjunctive of جَهَّزَ; "prepare"
الْقَصْرَ: الـ + قَصْر — qaṣr, castle/palace (m., acc.); 'the castle'
مَوْضِعَ: mawḍiʿ, place (m., acc. of place, construct); 'the place of'
نَنَامُ: nanāmu, Form I imperfect 1pl of نَامَ, 'we sleep'
أَمَرْتُ: أَمَرْتُ — amartu, Form I perfect 1sg of أَمَرَ; "I ordered"
جَارِيَتَيْنِ: جَارِيَة + َيْنِ — jāriya, slave-girl (f.), dual acc.; 'two slave-girls'
تَجْلِسَ: tajlisa, Form I subjunctive 3fs of جَلَسَ, 'she sit'
رِجْلَايَ: رِجْل + َا + يَ — rijl, foot (f.), dual + 'my' (Middle Arabic case-leveled ending, for expected رِجْلَيَّ); 'my (two) feet'
تَشَوَّشْتُ: tashawwashtu, Form V perfect 1sg of شَوَّشَ, 'I was troubled/unsettled'
لِغِيَابِهَا: لِـ + غِيَاب + هَا — li-, at, because of (prep. of cause) + ghiyāb, absence (m.) + 'her'; 'by her absence'
يَأْخُذْنِي: يَأْخُذْ + نِي — Form I jussive of أَخَذَ, 'it take' + 'me'; 'take me'
مُغْمَضَةٌ: mughmaḍa, closed (Form IV passive participle, f., indef.); 'closed'
فَسَمِعْتُ: فَـ + سَمِعْتُ — samiʿtu, Form I perfect 1sg of سَمِعَ, 'I heard'
مَسْعُودَةُ: Masʿūdatu — proper name (f.), fem. of Masʿūd; vocative, 'O Masʿūda'
مِسْكِينٌ: miskīnun — miskīn, poor, wretched, pitiable (adj., indef. nom.)
سَيِّدُنَا: سَيِّد + نَا — sayyid, master, lord (m.) + -nā, our; 'our master' (nom.)
شَبَابُهُ: شَبَاب + هُ — shabāb, youth (m.) + -hu, his; 'his youth' (nom.)
خَسَارَتَهُ: خَسَارَة + هُ — khasāra, loss, waste (f.) + -hu, his; 'his waste!' (exclamatory)
سِتِّنَا: سِتّ + نَا — sitt, lady, mistress (colloquial, f.) + -nā, our; 'our mistress'
الْقَحْبَةِ: الـ + قَحْبَة — al-, the + qaḥba, whore (f.); 'the whore' (gen.)
النِّسَاءَ: الـ + نِسَاء — al- + nisāʾ, women (pl. of imraʾa/marʾa); 'the women' (acc.)
الْخَائِنَاتِ: الـ + خَائِنَات — al- + khāʾināt, treacherous, unfaithful (act. part. f. pl. of khāna); 'the unfaithful (women)' (acc.)
الزَّانِيَاتِ: الـ + زَانِيَات — al- + zāniyāt, adulterous, fornicating (act. part. f. pl. of zanā); 'the adulterous (women)' (acc.)
وَلَٰكِنْ: وَ + لَٰكِنْ — wa-, and + lākin, but
وَشَبَابِهِ: وَ + شَبَاب + هِ — wa-, and + shabāb, youth + -hi, his; 'and his youth' (gen.)
يَصْلُحُ: yaṣluḥu — it is fitting, it befits (3ms impf. of ṣalaḥa)
لِهَٰذِهِ: لِـ + هَٰذِهِ — li-, for + hādhihi, this (f. dem.); 'for this'
تَنَامُ: tanāmu — she sleeps (3fs impf. of nāma)
رَأْسِي: رَأْس + ي — raʾs, head (m.) + -ī, my; 'my head'
مَطْعُومٌ: maṭʿūmun — fed, well-fed (pass. part. of ṭaʿima, indef. nom.)
يَسْأَلُ: yasʾalu — he asks (3ms impf. of saʾala)
وَيْلَكِ: وَيْل + كِ — wayl, woe + -ki, to you (f.); 'woe to you!'
تُخَلِّيهِ: تُخَلِّي + هِ — tukhallī, she lets be, leaves (3fs impf. Form II of khalā) + -hi, him; 'she leaves him'
اخْتِيَارِهِ: اِخْتِيَار + هِ — ikhtiyār, choice, own will (Form VIII masdar of khāra, hamzat waṣl — no true hamza sound) + -hi, his; 'his own choosing'
أَلَا: alā — does...not? is it not that...? (interrog.-neg. particle, hamza + lā)
تَعْمَلُ: taʿmalu — she does, makes, works (3fs impf. of ʿamila)
قَدَحِ: qadaḥi — qadaḥ, cup, goblet (m., gen. construct)
الشَّرَابِ: الـ + شَرَاب — al- + sharāb, drink, beverage (m., gen.)
تَشْرَبُهُ: تَشْرَبُ + هُ — tashrabu, she/you drink (impf. of shariba) + -hu, it; here understood, by sense, of the master drinking it
الْمَنَامِ: الـ + مَنَام — al- + manām, sleep (m., gen.)
وَتَضَعُ: وَ + تَضَعُ — wa-, and + taḍaʿu, she puts (3fs impf. of waḍaʿa)
الْبَنْجَ: الـ + بَنْج — al- + banj, the banj — a sedative, knock-out drug (m., acc.)
فَيَنَامُ: فَ + يَنَامُ — fa-, so + yanāmu, he sleeps (3ms impf. of nāma)
يَشْعُرْ: yashʿur — he perceives, notices (3ms juss. of shaʿara)
يَذْهَبُ: yadhhabu — he goes (3ms impf. of dhahaba)
تَرُوحُ: tarūḥu — she goes, departs (3fs impf. of rāḥa)
فَبَعْدَ: فَ + بَعْدَ — fa-, then + baʿda, after
تَسْقِيهِ: تَسْقِي + هِ — tasqī, she gives to drink (3fs impf. of saqā) + -hi, him; 'she gives him to drink'
الشَّرَابَ: الـ + شَرَاب — al- + sharāb, the drink (m., acc.)
تَلْبَسُ: talbasu — she puts on, wears (3fs impf. of labisa)
أَثْوَابَهَا: أَثْوَاب + هَا — athwāb, garments (pl. of thawb) + -hā, her; 'her garments'
وَتَعَطَّرَتْ: وَ + تَعَطَّرَتْ — wa-, and + taʿaṭṭarat, she perfumed herself (3fs perf. Form V of ʿaṭira)
وَتَخْرُجُ: وَ + تَخْرُجُ — wa-, and + takhruju, she goes out (3fs impf. of kharaja)
عِنْدِهِ: عِنْدِ + هِ — ʿindi, from beside (gen. after min) + -hi, him; 'from beside him'
تَغِيبُ: taghību — she stays away, is absent (3fs impf. of ghāba)
الْفَجْرِ: الـ + فَجْر — al- + fajr, dawn (m., gen.)
وَتَأْتِي: وَ + تَأْتِي — wa-, and + taʾtī, she comes (3fs impf. of atā)
وَتُبَخِّرُ: وَ + تُبَخِّرُ — wa-, and + tubakhkhiru, she fumigates, smokes (3fs impf. Form II of bakhkhara)
أَنْفَهُ: أَنْف + هُ — anf, nose (m.) + -hu, his; 'his nose'
بِشَيٍّ: بِـ + شَيٍّ — bi-, with + shayyin, something (for shayʾin; the archive drops the final hamza-letter of shayʾ, read here with the hamza smoothed into a doubled final yāʾ)
فَيَسْتَيْقِظُ: فَ + يَسْتَيْقِظُ — istayqaẓa (X), to wake up; imperfect 3ms; 'so he wakes up'
مَنَامِهِ: مَنَام + هِ — manām, sleep, place of sleeping (m.); + hi 'his'; 'his sleep'
الضِّيَاءُ: الـ + ضِيَاء — ḍiyāʾ, light, brightness (m.); nominative subject; 'the light'
وَجْهِي: وَجْه + ي — wajh, face (m.); + ī 'my'; 'my face'
ظَلَامَهُ: ظَلَام + هُ — ẓalām, darkness (m.); + hu 'its'; 'its darkness'
أَقْبَلَ: أَقْبَلَ — aqbala (IV), to come, arrive; 3ms perfect; 'had come'
فَمَدَدْنَا: فَ + مَدَدْنَا — madda, to spread, stretch out; 1st pl. perfect; 'so we spread'
السِّمَاطَ: الـ + سِمَاط — simāṭ, dining-cloth, spread table (m.); 'the table-cloth'
وَأَكَلْنَا: وَ + أَكَلْنَا — akala, to eat; 1st pl. perfect; 'and we ate'
وَجَلَسْنَا: وَ + جَلَسْنَا — jalasa, to sit; 1st pl. perfect; 'and we sat'
زَمَانِيَّةً: زَمَانِيَّةً — zamāniyya, 'of some duration, lengthy' (adj. from zamān, time), accusative; 'a good long (while)'
نَتَنَادَمُ: نَتَنَادَمُ — tanādama (VI), to keep one another company (as drinking- or table-companions); 1st pl. imperfect, circumstantial; 'conversing together'
كَالْعَادَةِ: كَـ + الـ + عَادَة — ʿāda, custom, habit (f.); 'as usual'
دَعَتْ: دَعَتْ — daʿat, from daʿā, to call for; 3fs perfect; 'she called for'
بِالشَّرَابِ: بِـ + الـ + شَرَاب — sharāb, drink (m.); 'for the drink'
أَشْرَبُهُ: أَشْرَبُ + هُ — sharaba, to drink; 1st sg. imperfect + hu 'it'; 'I drink it'
فَنَاوَلَتْنِي: فَ + نَاوَلَتْ + نِي — nāwala (III), to hand something to someone; 3fs perfect + nī 'me'; 'so she handed me'
الْكَأْسَ: الـ + كَأْس — kaʾs, cup (f.), accusative; 'the cup'
فَهَرَقْتُهَا: فَ + هَرَقْتُ + هَا — haraqa, to pour out, spill; 1st sg. perfect + hā 'it'; 'so I poured it out'
وَجَعَلْتُ: وَ + جَعَلْتُ — jaʿala, 'to make as though, act as if'; 1st sg. perfect; 'and I made as though'
عَادَتِي: عَادَة + ي — ʿāda, custom, habit (f.); + ī 'my'; 'my custom'
وَدَلَقْتُهُ: وَ + دَلَقْتُ + هُ — dalaqa, to pour out, tip out; 1st sg. perfect + hu 'it'; 'and I poured it'
جَيْبِي: جَيْب + ي — jayb, bosom, breast-fold of a garment (m.); + ī 'my'; 'my bosom'
وَرَقَدْتُ: وَ + رَقَدْتُ — raqada, to lie down, sleep; 1st sg. perfect; 'and I lay down'
أَخْطُرُ: أَخْطُرُ — akhṭuru, from khaṭara, uncertain sense here ('to stir, sway, pass through the mind'); 1st sg. imperfect; 'I stir'
نَمْ: نَمْ — nam, imperative ms of nāma, 'to sleep'; 'sleep!'
لَيْلَتَكَ: لَيْلَة + كَ — layla, night (f.); + ka 'your'; accusative of duration; 'your night (away)'
كَرِهْتُكَ: كَرِهْتُ + كَ — kariha, to hate, detest; 1st sg. perfect + ka 'you'; 'I hate you'
وَكَرِهْتُ: وَ + كَرِهْتُ — kariha; 1st sg. perfect; 'and I hate'
صُورَتَكَ: صُورَة + كَ — ṣūra, form, appearance (f.); + ka 'your'; 'your form'
وَمَلَّتْ: وَ + مَلَّتْ — malla, to grow weary, sick (of); 3fs perfect; 'and (my soul) grew weary'
عِشْرَتِكَ: عِشْرَة + كَ — ʿishra, companionship, intimacy (f.); + ka 'your'; 'your company'
أَدْرِي: أَدْرِي — adrī, from darā, to know; 1st sg. imperfect; 'I know'
يَقْبِضُ: يَقْبِضُ — yaqbiḍu, from qabaḍa, to seize, take; 3ms imperfect; 'will seize'
وَلَبِسَتْ: وَ + لَبِسَتْ — labisat, from labisa, to wear, put on; 3fs perfect; 'and she put on'
أَفْخَرَ: أَفْخَرَ — afkhara, elative, 'finer, finest' (from fakhr, splendor), accusative; 'the finest (of)'
ثِيَابِهَا: ثِيَاب + هَا — thiyāb, pl. of thawb, clothes (m.pl.); + hā 'her'; 'her clothes'
تَبَخَّرَتْ: تَبَخَّرَتْ — tabakhkharat (form V), from bakhkhara, to perfume/fumigate oneself with incense; 3fs perfect; "she perfumed herself"
وَأَخَذَتْ: وَ + أَخَذَتْ — akhadhat, from akhadha, to take; 3fs perfect; 'and she took'
سَيْفِي: سَيْف + ي — sayf, sword (m.); + ī 'my'; 'my sword'
وَتَقَلَّدَتْ: وَ + تَقَلَّدَتْ — taqalladat (V), 'to gird oneself (with)'; 3fs perfect; 'and she girded herself'
وَفَتَحَتْ: وَ + فَتَحَتْ — fataḥat, from fataḥa, to open; 3fs perfect; 'and she opened'
أَبْوَابَ: أَبْوَاب — abwāb, pl. of bāb, door, gate (m.), accusative; 'the doors (of)'
وَتَبِعْتُهَا: وَ + تَبِعْتُ + هَا — tabiʿa, to follow; 1st sg. perfect + hā 'her'; 'and I followed her'
وَشَقَّتْ: وَ + شَقَّتْ — shaqqat, from shaqqa, to cut through, cross; 3fs perfect; 'and she cut through'
أَسْوَاقِ: أَسْوَاق — aswāq, pl. of sūq, market (m.); 'the markets (of)'
أَنِ: أَنِ — an, subordinating particle 'that,' here temporal ('until that'); kasra before hamzat-waṣl
انْتَهَتْ: انْتَهَتْ — intahat (VIII), from intahā, to arrive at, reach; 3fs perfect; 'she reached'
أَفْهَمُهُ: أَفْهَمُ + هُ — fahima, to understand; 1st sg. imperfect + hu 'it'; 'I understand it'
فَتَسَاقَطَتِ: فَ + تَسَاقَطَتِ — tasāqaṭat (VI), from saqaṭa, to fall; 3fs perfect, 'to fall one after another'; 'then (they) fell away'
الْأَقْفَالُ: الـ + أَقْفَال — aqfāl, pl. of qufl, lock (m.); nominative; 'the locks'
وَانْفَتَحَ: وَ + انْفَتَحَ — infataḥa (VII), from fataḥa, to open; 3ms perfect; 'and (it) opened'
الْبَابُ: الـ + بَاب — bāb, gate, door (m.); nominative; 'the gate'
تَشْعُرُ: تَشْعُرُ — tashʿuru, from shaʿara, to perceive, be aware; 3fs imperfect; 'perceiving'
الْكِيمَانِ: الـ + كِيمَان — kīmān, pl. of kawm, mound, rubble-heap (m.); 'the mounds'
وَأَتَتْ: وَ + أَتَتْ — atat, from atā, to come; 3fs perfect; 'and she came'
خُصٍّ: خُصٍّ — khuṣṣ, a hut of reeds or wattle (m.), genitive indefinite; 'a hut'
قُبَّةٌ: قُبَّةٌ — qubba, dome (f.), nominative indefinite; 'a dome'
بِطُوبٍ: بِـ + طُوب — ṭūb, brick, baked clay (m.); 'of brick'
وَلَهَا: وَ + لَهَا — 'and it had' (lit. 'and to it (was)')
بَابٌ: بَابٌ — bāb, door (m.), nominative indefinite; 'a door'
وَتَسَلَّقْتُ: وَ + تَسَلَّقْتُ — tasallaqtu (V), from sallaqa, to climb; 1st sg. perfect; 'and I climbed'
وَأَشْرَفْتُ: وَ + أَشْرَفْتُ — ashraftu (IV), from ashrafa, to look down upon, overlook; 1st sg. perfect; 'and I looked down'
بِبِنْتِ: بِـ + بِنْتِ — bint, daughter (f.), here in 'bint ʿammī'; 'at the daughter of' (i.e. 'at my cousin')
عَبْدٍ: عَبْدٍ — ʿabd, slave (m.), genitive indefinite; 'a slave'
شَفَةٌ: شَفَةٌ — shafa, lip (f.), nominative indefinite; 'a lip'
كَالْقَطَا: كَـ + الـ + قَطَا — qaṭā, sand-grouse (a desert bird, collective); 'like the sand-grouse'
كَالْوَطَا: كَـ + الـ + وَطَا — waṭā, trodden, low ground (m.); 'like the trodden ground'
تَلْقُطُ: تَلْقُطُ — talquṭu, from laqaṭa, to pick up, gather; 3fs imperfect; 'gathers'
الرَّمْلَ: الـ + رَمْل — raml, sand (m.), accusative; 'the sand'
مُبْتَلًى: مُبْتَلًى — mubtalan, 'afflicted, stricken' (passive participle VIII of balā); 'afflicted'
وَرَاقِدٌ: وَ + رَاقِدٌ — rāqid, 'lying down' (active participle of raqada); 'and lying'
قَشِّ: قَشِّ — qashsh, chaff, straw (m.), construct genitive; 'the chaff of'
قَصَبٍ: قَصَبٍ — qaṣab, reed, cane (m.), genitive indefinite; 'cane'
هِدْمَةً: هِدْمَةً — hidma, a worn-out, ragged garment (f.), accusative indefinite; 'a ragged garment'
وَشَرَامِيطَ: وَ + شَرَامِيطَ — sharāmīṭ, pl. of shurmūṭ, rag, tatter (m.), accusative; 'and tatters'
فَقَبَّلَتِ: فَ + قَبَّلَتِ — qabbalat (II), from qabbala, to kiss; 3fs perfect; 'then she kissed'
وَيْلَكِي: وَيْلَ + كِي — wayl, woe (m.); + ki 'to you (f.)'; 'woe to you'
أَيْشْ: أَيْشْ — aysh, colloquial for ayyu shayʾin, 'what'; 'what'
قُعَادُكِ: قُعَاد + كِ — quʿād, sitting, tarrying (verbal noun); + ki 'your (f.)'; 'your sitting, tarrying'
الْحَصَا: الـ + حَصَى — ḥaṣā, pebbles, gravel (collective); 'the pebbles'
الْمَدِينَهْ: الـ + مَدِينَهْ — madīna, city (f.), here spelled with plain hāʾ instead of tāʾ marbūṭa; 'the city'
بَنُوا: بَنُو, construct pl. of اِبْن ('son'); 'sons of' — the edition spells the construct plural with a trailing silent alif, as with the verb ending وا
أَعْمَامِنَا: أَعْمَام (pl. of عَمّ, 'paternal uncle') + نَا (1pl suffix); 'our paternal uncles' — بنو اعمامنا is a kinship idiom of solidarity, 'our own kind', not literal cousinhood
وَشَرِبُوا: وَ + شَرِبَ (shariba, 'to drink') + وا (3mpl perfect); 'and they drank'
بِصَبِيَّتِهِ: بِـ + صَبِيَّة (ṣabiyya, 'girl') + هِ (3ms suffix); 'with his girl'
رَضِيتُ: رَضِيَ (raḍiya, 'to consent, be pleased') + تُ (1sg perfect); 'I consented'
أَشْرَبَ: أَ- (1sg imperfect prefix) + شرب (shariba, 'to drink'), subjunctive after رضيت with أن omitted; 'that I drink'
شَأْنِكِ: شَأْن (shaʾn, 'affair, matter') + كِ (2fs suffix); idiom 'for your sake, on your account'
قُرَّةَ: قُرَّةَ — qurra, "coolness, delight" (construct); "the coolness of" — قرة عيني, "the coolness of my eye", is a standing endearment
مُتَزَوِّجَةٌ: مُتَزَوِّجَة, fem. active participle, form V of زَوَّجَ ('to marry'); 'married'
بِابْنِ: بِـ + اِبْن (ibn, 'son', construct); 'to the son of'
أَكْرَهُ: أَكْرَهُ, 1sg imperfect of كَرِهَ (kariha, 'to hate'); 'I hate'
صُورَتَهُ: صُورَة (ṣūra, 'form, appearance') + هُ (3ms suffix); 'his form, his appearance'
وَأَبْغُضُ: وَ + أَبْغُضُ, 1sg imperfect of بَغُضَ (baghuḍa, 'to be hateful, detest'); 'and I detest'
وَلَوْلَا: وَ + لَوْلَا (lawlā, 'were it not that'), conditional particle
تَرَكْتُ: تَرَكَ (taraka, 'to leave, let') + تُ (1sg perfect); 'I left, I let'
وَمَدِينَتُهُ: وَ + مَدِينَة (madīna, 'city') + هُ (3ms suffix); 'and his city'
يَزْعَقُ: يَزْعَقُ, 3ms imperfect of زَعَقَ (za'aqa, 'to shriek, cry out'); 'shrieks'
وَيَأْوِيهَا: وَ + يَأْوِي (yaʾwī, 3ms imperfect of أَوَى, 'to shelter, den') + هَا (3fs suffix); 'and dens in it'
الْذِّئَابُ: الذِّئَابُ — الـ + ذِئَاب, dhiʾāb, wolves (pl.); "the wolves"
وَأَنْقُلُ: وَ + أَنْقُلُ, 1sg imperfect of نَقَلَ (naqala, 'to move, transport'); 'and I carry off'
قَافٍ: قَاف (Qāf), the fabled mountain ringing the world in Islamic cosmology, byword for the ends of the earth
تَكْذِبِي: تَكْذِبِينَ (2fs imperfect of كَذَبَ, 'to lie'), with the final نَ dropped, as regularly in this text's Middle Arabic; 'you lie'
مَلْعُونَةُ: مَلْعُونَة, fem. passive participle of لَعَنَ (la'ana, 'to curse'); 'accursed woman'
حَقِّ: حَقِّ — ḥaqq, "right, truth" (construct), oath particle; "by the truth of"
نَظَرَتْ: نَظَرَتْ, 3fs perfect of نَظَرَ ('to look'); here, after an oath, an idiom for an emphatic vow — 'shall never look'
الْبِيضَانَ: الـ + بِيضَان (pl. of أَبْيَض, 'white'); 'the whites' (i.e. white women), picking up السودان 'the blacks'
بَقِيتِ: بَقِيَ (baqiya, 'to remain') + تِ (2fs perfect); 'you remained, you kept (on)'
تَقْعُدِي: تَقْعُدِينَ (2fs imperfect of قَعَدَ, 'to sit'), نَ dropped; 'sitting, tarrying'
أُصَاحِبُكِ: أُصَاحِبُ (1sg imperfect, form III of صَاحَبَ, 'to consort with') + كِ (2fs suffix); 'I will consort with you'
أُلْزِقُ: أُلْزِقُ, 1sg imperfect, form IV of لَزِقَ ('to stick, cling'); 'I will stick, I will press'
تَلْعَبِي: تَلْعَبِينَ (2fs imperfect of لَعِبَ, 'to play, toy'), نَ dropped; 'you play, you toy'
نَشُفُّ: نَشُفُّ, 1pl imperfect of نَشَفَ ('to dry up, go dry') [obscure/uncertain in this clause — see note]; 'we go dry'
أَكُفَّ: أَكُفّ, broken pl. of كَفّ ('palm, hand'), accusative; 'hands'
مُسْتَهْزِئَةُ: مُسْتَهْزِئَة, fem. active participle, form X of هَزِئَ ('to mock'); 'mocking woman'
أَنْظُرُ: أَنْظُرُ, 1sg imperfect of نَظَرَ ('to look'); 'I watch'
وَأَرَي: وَ + أَرَى, 1sg imperfect of رَأَى ('to see') — the edition spells the final long ā with a plain يا here rather than alif maqṣūra; 'and I see'
وَأَسْمَعُ: وَ + أَسْمَعُ, 1sg imperfect of سَمِعَ ('to hear'); 'and I hear'
بَيْنَهُمَا: بَيْنَ ('between') + هُمَا (3dual suffix); 'between the two of them'
صَارَتِ: صَارَتْ, 3fs perfect of صَارَ ('to become, turn'); 'turned, became'
وَحْشَتِي: وَحْشَة (waḥsha, 'dread, desolation') + ي (1sg suffix); 'my dread' — echoes اسودت الدنيا في وجهه, 'the world turned black', from the frame story's opening
عَرَفْتُ: عَرَفَ ('arafa, 'to know, recognize') + تُ (1sg perfect); 'I knew, I recognized'
وَبِنْتُ: وَ + بِنْت (bint, 'daughter', construct); 'and the daughter of'
وَتَتَذَلَّلُ: وَ + تَتَذَلَّلُ, 3fs imperfect, form V of ذَلَّ ('to abase oneself'); 'and abasing herself'
وَثَمَرَةَ: وَ + ثَمَرَة (thamara, 'fruit', construct); 'and the fruit of'
غَضِبْتَ: غَضِبَ (ghaḍiba, 'to be angry') + تَ (2ms perfect); 'you are angry, you become angry'
يُبْقِينِي: يُبْقِي (yubqī, 3ms imperfect, form IV of بَقِيَ, 'to keep, leave remaining') + نِي (1sg object suffix); 'will keep me'
طَرَدْتَنِي: طَرَدَ (ṭarada, 'to drive away') + تَ (2ms perfect) + نِي (1sg object suffix); 'you drive me away'
يُؤْوِينِي: يُؤْوِي (yu'wī, 3ms imperfect, form IV of أَوَى, 'to shelter') + نِي (1sg object suffix); 'will shelter me'
وَمَازَالَتْ: وَ + مَا; here with a following perfect verb, negation 'did not'
زَالَتْ, 3fs perfect of زَالَ, verb of continuance; with مَا, 'did not cease'
وَتَتَضَرَّعُ: وَ + تَتَضَرَّعُ, 3fs imperfect, form V of ضَرَعَ ('to implore, entreat'); 'and imploring'
رَضِيَ: رَضِيَ (raḍiya), 'he was pleased, he relented' (3ms perfect)
فَفَرِحَتْ: فَـ + فَرِحَتْ, 3fs perfect of فَرِحَ ('to rejoice'); 'and she rejoiced'
وَقَلَعَتْ: وَ + قَلَعَتْ, 3fs perfect of قَلَعَ ('to pull off, strip off'); 'and she stripped off'
وَلِبَاسَهَا: وَ + لِبَاس (libās, 'garment') + هَا (3fs suffix); 'and her garment'
اكْشِفِي: اِكْشِفِي, 2fs imperative of كَشَفَ ('to uncover, lift'); 'lift! uncover!'
اللَّقَنَ: الـ + لَقَن (laqan, 'basin, tub'); 'the basin', here evidently used as a lid over the food
فِيرَانٍ: فِيرَان, pl. of فَأْر/فَار ('rat, mouse'), here in its colloquial hamza-less form; 'of rats'
مَطْبُوخَةٌ: مَطْبُوخَة, fem. passive participle of طَبَخَ ('to cook'); 'cooked'
فَكُلِيهَا: فَـ + كُلِي (irregular 2fs imperative of أَكَلَ, 'to eat') + هَا (3fs object suffix); 'so eat them'
الْقَدَارَةِ: الـ + قَدَارَة (qadāra), 'the cooking-pot' (a Middle Arabic form beside قِدْر)
مَرَارٍ: مَرَار (marār), 'bitter dregs, leavings' (from مرارة 'bitterness', not مرق 'broth')
فَاشْرَبِيهَا: فَـ + اِشْرَبِي (2fs imperative of شَرِبَ, 'to drink') + هَا (3fs object suffix); 'so drink it'
وَأَكَلَتْ: وَ + أَكَلَتْ, 3fs perfect of أَكَلَ ('to eat'); 'and she ate'
شَرِبَتْ: شَرِبَتْ — 3fs perfect of شَرِبَ ("to drink"); "she drank"
وَغَسَلَتْ: وَ + غَسَلَتْ, 3fs perfect of غَسَلَ ('to wash'); 'and she washed'
وَفَمَهَا: وَ + فَم (fam, 'mouth') + هَا (3fs suffix); 'and her mouth'
وَجَاءَتْ: وَ + جَاءَتْ, 3fs perfect of جَاءَ ('to come'); 'and she came' — the edition prints this hamza (جاءت) rather than leaving it bare, and it is kept exactly as printed
رَقَدَتْ: رَقَدَتْ, 3fs perfect of رَقَدَ ('to lie down, sleep'); 'she lay down'
وَتَعَرَّتْ: وَ + تَعَرَّتْ, 3fs perfect, form V of عَرِيَ ('to strip oneself naked'); 'and she stripped naked'
وَدَخَلَتْ: وَ + دَخَلَتْ, 3fs perfect of دَخَلَ ('to enter, go in'); 'and she went in'
وَالشَّرَامِيطِ: وَ + الـ + شَرَامِيط (pl. of شِرْمِيط, 'rag, tatter'); 'and the tatters'
فَعَلَتْهَا: فَعَلَتْ (fa'alat, 3fs perfect of فَعَلَ, 'to do') + هَا (3fs object suffix); 'she had done [them]'
فَنَزَلْتُ: فَـ + نَزَلَ (nazala, 'to descend') + تُ (1sg perfect); 'so I came down'
سَبَتُّ: سَبَتُّ — [root and exact sense uncertain, see note], 1sg perfect; contextually "I resolved, I determined"
أَقْتُلَ: أَقْتُلَ, 1sg subjunctive of قَتَلَ ('to kill'); 'I should kill'
فَضَرَبْتُ: فَـ + ضَرَبَ (ḍaraba, 'to strike') + تُ (1sg perfect); 'so I struck'
فَظَنَنْتُ: فَـ + ظَنَّ (ẓanna, 'to think, suppose') + تُ (1sg perfect); 'and I supposed'
قُضِيَ: قُضِيَ, passive perfect of قَضَى ('to decree, decide'); idiom قضي عليه, 'it was decided against him, he was finished'
وَأَدْرَكَ: وَ + أَدْرَكَ, 3ms perfect, form IV of دَرَكَ/أَدْرَكَ ('to overtake, catch up with'); 'and overtook'
مَحْمُودَ: Maḥmūd, proper name, diptote accusative (fatḥa only, no tanwīn, no extra alif); "Mahmoud"
سَأَلَ: saʾala, "to ask" (verb I, perfect 3ms); "who asked" (من سأل, "whoever asked")
عَشَاءًا: ʿashāʾ, dinner/evening meal (m., indef., acc. with the edition’s own extra tanwīn-alif after the hamza)
فَسَأَلُوا: fa- + saʾalū, "to ask" (verb I, perfect 3mp); "so they asked"
وَشَفَةٌ: wa- + shafa, lip (f.), nom. indef.; "and a lip"
الثَّامِنَةُ: الـ + ثَامِنَة — thāmin, eighth (ord. adj., f., nom.)
الْمَسْحُورَ: الـ + مَسْحُور — masḥūr, bewitched, enchanted (pass. part. I of سحر, m., acc.)
ضَرَبْتُ: ḍaraba — to strike (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I struck'
أَقْطَعَ: qaṭaʿa, to cut (verb I, imperf. 1cs subjunctive); 'that I cut off'
أَقْطَعِ: qaṭaʿa, to cut (verb I, imperf. 1cs jussive, kasra before the article's elidable hamza); 'I did not cut'
الْوَرِيدَيْنِ: الـ + وَرِيدَيْن — warīd, jugular vein (m. dual, acc.); 'the two jugular-veins'
قَطَعْتُ: qaṭaʿa — to cut (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I cut'
الْحُلْقُومَ: الـ + حُلْقُوم — ḥulqūm, windpipe, gullet (m., acc.)
وَالْجِلْدَ: وَ + الـ + جِلْد — jild, skin, hide (m., acc.)
وَاللَّحْمَ: وَ + الـ + لَحْم — laḥm, flesh, meat (m., acc.)
فَشَخَرَ: فَـ + شَخَرَ — shakhara, to snore (verb I, perf. 3ms)
شَخِيرًا: shakhīr — a snore, snoring (m., acc. as cognate object)
عَالِيًا: ʿālin — high, loud (act. part. of عَلَا, m., acc.)
فَتَحَرَّكَتْ: فَـ + تَحَرَّكَتْ — taḥarraka, to move, stir (verb V, perf. 3fs)
خَلْفِي: خَلْف + ـِي — khalf, back, behind (m.) + 1cs; 'behind me'
رَدَّيْتُ: radda — to put back, return something (verb I geminate, here conjugated as final-weak, Middle Arabic; Classical raddadtu); 'I put back'
أَنَيْتُ: anā / yaʾnī — to arrive, draw near (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I arrived'
رَقَدْتُ: raqada — to lie down, sleep (verb I, perf. 1cs)
نَبَّهَتْنِي: نَبَّهَتْ + ـنِي — nabbaha, to wake, rouse (verb II, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.
لَبِسَتْ: labisa — to wear, put on (verb I, perf. 3fs)
ثِيَابَ: thiyāb — garments, clothes (m. pl., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
تُعَارِضْنِي: تُعَارِضْ + ـنِي — ʿārada, to oppose, contradict (verb III, imperf. 2ms jussive) + 1cs obj.; 'you should not oppose me'
أَفْعَلُ: afʿalu — I do (verb I, imperf. 1cs indic.)
وَالِدَتِي: وَالِدَة + ـي — wālida, mother (f., act. part. of ولد) + 1cs; 'my mother'
قُتِلَ: qutila — was killed (verb I, pass. perf. 3ms)
الْجِهَادِ: الـ + جِهَاد — jihād, struggle, holy war (m., gen.)
إِخْوَتِي: إِخْوَة + ـي — ikhwa, brothers, siblings (m. pl. broken of أخ) + 1cs
أَحَدُهُمْ: أَحَد + ـهُمْ — aḥad, one (m., nom.) + 3mp; 'one of them'
مَلْسُوعًا: malsūʿ — stung, bitten (pass. part. of لسع, m., acc. as ḥāl)
الْآخَرُ: الـ + آخَر — ākhar, other, another (m., nom.); the edition prints a bare alif for the hamza-madda here, supplied as a combining mark
مُرْتَدِيًا: murtadin (murtadiyan) — most likely 'perished, fallen to ruin' (act. part. VIII, root ردي, merging with تَرَدَّى); an uncertain reading, see note
فَيَحِقُّ: فَـ + يَحِقُّ — ḥaqqa, to be right, fitting (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'so it is right/fitting'
أَبْكِيَ: abkiya — I weep (verb I, imperf. 1cs subj.)
أَحْزَنَ: ḥazina — to grieve (verb I, imperf. 1cs subj.)
سَكَتْتُ: sakata — to fall silent (verb I, perf. 1cs); spelled here with the doubled ت written as two separate letters rather than contracted with a shadda
افْعَلِي: ifʿalī — do! (verb I, imper. 2fs; hamzat al-waṣl, not a true hamza); idiom 'do as you please'
أُخَالِفْكِ: أُخَالِفْ + ـكِ — khālafa, to oppose (verb III, imperf. 1cs jussive) + 2fs obj.
فَقَعَدَتْ: فَـ + قَعَدَتْ — qaʿada, to sit, remain (verb I, perf. 3fs)
بُكًى: bukan — weeping (m., a recognised variant spelling of bukāʾ)
عَلِيلٍ: ʿalīl — sick, ailing (adj., gen. indef., used loosely as a noun here)
الْحَوْلِ: الـ + حَوْل — ḥawl, year, full cycle (m., gen.)
تَبْنِيَ: tabniya — you build (verb I, imperf. 2ms subj.)
مَدْفَنًا: madfan — burial-place, tomb (m., acc., noun of place from دفن)
أُفْرِدُهُ: أُفْرِدُ + ـهُ — afrada, to set apart, devote exclusively (verb IV, imperf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
لِلْحُزْنِ: لِـ + الـ + حُزْن — ḥuzn, grief (m., gen.); 'for mourning'
أُسَمِّيهِ: أُسَمِّي + ـهِ — sammā, to name (verb II, imperf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
بَيْتَ: bayt — house (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْأَحْزَانِ: الـ + أَحْزَان — ḥuzn pl. aḥzān, sorrows (m. pl., gen.)
فَبَنَتُ: فَـ + بَنَتُ — printed as the regular 3fs بَنَتْ but read as 1cs 'so I built' here (see note on this sentence); banā, to build, verb I
بَيْنًا: printed ب ي ن ا — as it stands, baynan, 'an interval, a between'; the sense plainly wants بَيْتًا, 'a house' (see note), but the rasm is kept exactly as printed
بَنَتُ: printed as the regular 3fs بَنَتْ but read as 1cs 'I built' here (see note); banā, to build, verb I
وَسَطِهِ: وَسَط + ـهِ — wasaṭ, middle, midst (m., gen.) + 3ms
الضَّرِيحِ: الـ + ضَرِيح — ḍarīḥ, tomb, shrine (m., gen.)
نَقَلْتُ: naqala — to move, transfer (verb I, perf. 1cs)
أَنْزَلْتُهُ: أَنْزَلْتُ + ـهُ — anzala, to bring down, lodge (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
بَقِيَ: baqiya — to remain, stay (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَنْفَعُهَا: يَنْفَعُ + هَا — nafaʿa, to benefit (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
بِنَافِعَةٍ: بِـ + نَافِعَة — bi-, the bāʾ that strengthens a negation (no English word of its own) + nāfiʿa, a benefit, a useful thing (act. part. f., gen.); emphatic intensifier of the negation
جَرَحْتُهُ: جَرَحْتُ + ـهُ — jaraḥa, to wound (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
أَجَلَهُ: أَجَل + ـهُ — ajal, appointed term, lifespan (m., acc. as subject of li-anna) + 3ms
تَأْتِيهِ: تَأْتِي + ـهِ — atā / yaʾtī, to come (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.
تَنْزِلُ: tanzilu — she goes down (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
تُعَدِّدُ: ʿaddada — to count out, recount, enumerate one's grievances (verb II, imperf. 3fs)
الْمَسَالِيقَ: الـ + مَسَالِيق — maslūq pl. masālīq, boiled meats, broths (m. pl., acc.; from سلق, 'to boil')
أُطَوِّلُ: uṭawwilu — I lengthen, extend (verb II, imperf. 1cs); idiom أُطَوِّلُ رُوحِي عَلَيْهَا, 'I am patient, long-suffering, toward her'
الْتَفَتُّ: iltafata — to turn, pay heed (verb VIII, perf. 1cs)
تَغَيَّبْتَ: taghayyaba — to be absent, vanish (verb V, perf. 2ms)
نَاظِرِي: نَاظِر + ـِي — nāẓir, sight, eye (act. part. of نظر, m.) + 1cs
نُزْهَةَ: nuzha — delight, pleasure, diversion (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
حَدِّثْنِي: حَدِّثْ + نِي — ḥaddatha, to speak, tell (verb II, imper. 2ms) + 1cs obj.
كَلِّمْنِي: كَلِّمْ + نِي — kallama, to speak to, address (verb II, imper. 2ms) + 1cs obj.
أَنْشَدَتْ: anshada — to recite, chant a verse (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
اِصْطِبَارِي: اِصْطِبَار + ـِي — iṣṭibār, endurance, patience (verbal noun VIII of صبر; hamzat al-waṣl, unmarked) + 1cs
سَلَوْتُمُ: salawtum — you (m. pl.) forgot, grew consoled in love (verb I, perf. 2mp, from سلا / يسلو)
فُؤَادِي: فُؤَاد + ـِي — fuʾād, heart, mind (m.) + 1cs; the edition prints the hamza seated on the wāw (ؤ) and it is kept as printed
سِوَاكُمُ: سِوَى + ـكُمُ — siwā, other than, except (noun/prep.) + 2mp; 'other than you'
خَلُّوا: khallū — leave, let be! (verb II imper. 2mp, from خَلَّى)
وَالرُّوحَ: وَ + الـ + رُّوح — rūḥ, soul, spirit (acc.)
وَأَيْنَ: وَ + أَيْنَ — ayna, where(ver), here fused with a preceding wa- as printed in the verse
سَرَيْتُمُ: saraytum — you (m. pl.) journeyed by night (verb I, perf. 2mp, from سرى / يسري)
حَلَلْتُمُ: ḥalaltum — you (m. pl.) alighted, settled (verb I, perf. 2mp, from حلّ / يحلّ)
فَادْفِنُونِي: فَـ + ادْفِنُوا + ـنِي — dafana, to bury (verb I, imper. 2mp; hamzat al-waṣl, unmarked) + 1cs obj.
حِذَاكُمُ: حِذَاء + ـكُمُ — ḥidhāʾ, opposite, beside (noun/prep.) + 2mp; 'beside you'
وَنَادَوْا: وَ + نَادَوْا — nādā, to call out (verb III, perf. 3mp)
بِاسْمِي: بِـ + اسْم + ـِي — bi-, marks what is called out (nādā bi- = call out, call by) + ism, name (m.; hamzat al-waṣl, unmarked) + 1cs
بِحَبِيبِكُمْ: بِـ + حَبِيب + ـكُمْ — ḥabīb, beloved (m.) + 2mp; 'by/through your beloved'
أَنِينَ: anīn — moaning, groaning (m., acc.); the edition prints the hamza seated on the alif (أ) and it is kept as printed
عِظَامِي: عِظَام + ـِي — ʿaẓm pl. ʿiẓām, bones (m. pl.) + 1cs
إِصْغَا: iṣghā — the edition's defective spelling of إِصْغَاء, a listening, a hearkening (verbal noun IV of صغو)
الْأَمَانِي: الـ + أَمَانِي (pl. of أُمْنِيَة) — amānī, wishes/hopes; 'the hopes'
إِعْرَاضِكُمْ: إِعْرَاض (masdar of form IV أَعْرَضَ, 'to turn away') + كُمْ — iʿrāḍ, turning-away; 'your turning-away'
أَشُدُّ: أَشُدُّ (1st sg. impf. of شَدَّ, form I) — ashuddu, 'I bind/tie'
الْأَمَنِ: الـ + أَمَن — al-amanu, safety, security; 'to safety'
يَوْمُ: يَوْمُ — yawm, day (m.); construct form 'day of'
بِقُرْبِكُمْ: بِـ + قُرْب + كُمْ — qurb, nearness; 'in your nearness'
الْمَنَايَا: الـ + مَنَايَا (pl. of مَنِيَّة) — manāyā, deaths/fates; 'the deaths'
بِتُّ: بَاتَ/بِتُّ — bāta, to spend the night; 1st sg. past, 'I spent the night'
بِالسُّرَى: بِـ + الـ + سُرَى — surā, night-travel; 'by night-journeying'
مُوصِلَكُمْ: مُوصِل (active part. form IV of وَصَلَ) + كُمْ — mūṣil, one who brings/delivers; 'bringing you'
وَأَنْشَدْتُ: وَ + أَنْشَدَ (form IV) + تُ — anshadtu, 'I recited' (1st sg. past)
الْأَكَاسِرَه۟: الـ + أَكَاسِرَة (broken pl. of كِسْرَى) — akāsirah, the Chosroes, Persian emperors; the ۟ mark reproduces the archive's own rhyme-notation
أَنَّنِي: أَنَّ + نِي — annanī, 'that I' (emphatic 1st person); printed precomposed in the archive's own verse pointing
أَحْبَبْتُ: أَحَبَّ (form IV of حَبَّ) + تُ — aḥbabtu, 'I loved'; printed precomposed in the archive
وَمُلْكُ: وَ + مُلْك — mulk, kingship/dominion; 'and the kingship of'
لَمَا: لَـ + مَا — la-, the lām that opens the answer to a law-condition + mā, not (negation); law … la-mā = 'then … would not'
سَوَّيْتُ: سَوَّى (form II of سَوِيَ) + تُ — sawwaytu, 'I made equal/valued'
لِشَخْصِكَ: لِـ + شَخْص + كَ — shakhṣ, person/figure; 'for your figure'
نَاظِرَه۟: نَاظِرَة (active part. fem. of نَظَرَ) — nāẓirah, one who gazes/looks
فَرَغَتْ: فَرَغَ/فَرَغَتْ — faragha, to finish/be free of; 3rd fem. past, 'she finished'
وَبُكَاءِهَا: وَ + بُكَاء + هَا — bukāʾ, weeping; 'and her weeping'
يَكْفِيكِي: يَكْفِي (impf. of كَفَى) + كِي — kafā, to suffice; 'it suffices you (fem.)'; archive spells the fem. object suffix -كِي rather than -كِ
يُغْنِيكِي: يُغْنِي (impf. of أَغْنَى form IV) + كِي — aghnā, to avail/benefit; 'it avails you'; archive spells the fem. object suffix -كِي rather than -كِ
تَتَعَرَّضْ: تَعَرَّضَ (form V of عَرَضَ) — taʿarraḍa, to interfere/meddle; 2nd sg. jussive (neg. imperative), 'do not interfere'
أَعْمَلُهُ: أَعْمَلُ (1st sg. impf. of عَمِلَ) + هُ — aʿmaluhu, 'I do it'
وَإِنِ: وَ + إِنْ — in, 'if' (conditional; vowelled with helping kasra before the following hamzat-waṣl verb)
اِعْتَرَضْتِ: اِعْتَرَضَ (form VIII of عَرَضَ, hamzat waṣl) + تِ — iʿtaraḍa, to object/interfere; 2nd fem. sg. past, 'you interfered'
فَسَكَتْتُ: فَـ + سَكَتَ/سَكَتُّ — sakata, to fall silent; 1st sg. past, 'I fell silent' (archive spells the doubled ت unassimilated)
وَسَلَّمْتُ: وَ + سَلَّمَ (form II of سَلِمَ) + تُ — sallama, to hand over/deliver; 'and I handed over'
وَتَعْدِيدِ: وَ + تَعْدِيد (masdar form II of عَدَّ) — taʿdīd, counting/tallying
مُغْتَاظٌ: مُغْتَاظ (pass. part. form VIII of غَاظَ) — mughtāẓ, enraged
لِحَادِثٍ: لِـ + حَادِث — li-, at, because of (prep. of cause) + ḥādith, incident/event (indef. genitive)
عَرَضَ: عَرَضَ — ʿaraḍa, to occur/befall; 3rd masc. past, 'it occurred'
طَالَ: طَالَ — ṭāla, to grow long; 3rd masc. past
أَسْمَعُ: أَسْمَعُ (1st sg. impf. of سَمِعَ) — asmaʿu, 'I hear'
تَرُدُّ: رَدَّ/تَرُدُّ — radda, to return/answer; impf., 'you/she return'
زَالَتْ: زَالَ/زَالَتْ — zāla, to depart/cease; 3rd fem. past
مَحَاسِنُه۟: مَحَاسِن (pl. of حُسْن) + هُ — maḥāsin, beauties/charms; 'its beauties'
ضِيَاكَ: ضِيَاء (elided hamza in this spelling) + كَ — ḍiyāʾ, light/radiance; 'your radiance'
يَجْمَعُ: جَمَعَ/يَجْمَعُ — jamaʿa, to gather; 3rd masc. impf.
وَشِعْرَهَا: وَ + شِعْر + هَا — shiʿr, verse/poetry; 'and her verse'
اِزْدَدْتُ: اِزْدَادَ (form VIII, hamzat waṣl, of زَادَ) + تُ — izdāda, to increase; 1st sg. past, 'I increased'
غَيْظِى: غَيْظ + ي — 'my wrath'; archive spells the 1st-person suffix with ى (alif maqṣūrah) rather than ي
أَقُولُ: أَقُولُ (1st sg. impf. of قَالَ) — aqūlu, 'I say'
مَسَاخِمُه۟: مَسَاخِم (pl., soot/blackness-root) + هُ — masākhim, blacknesses/soot-marks; 'its blacknesses'
سَمِعَتْ: سَمِعَ (سمع, to hear) + تْ (3f.sg. past); 'she heard'
وَثَبَتْ: وَ + ثَبَتَ (وثب, to leap/spring up) + تْ (3f.sg.); 'and she sprang up'
قَائِمَةً: قَائِمَة (qāʾima, act. part. f. of قام, 'standing') + ً (acc., ḥāl); 'standing' — edition prints bare قايمة; hamza is our editorial addition
مَعْشُوقَ: مَعْشُوق (maʿshūq, pass. part. of عشق, 'beloved') + acc., construct; 'the beloved of'
أَوْجَعَتْنِي: أَوْجَعَ (form IV of وجع, 'to cause pain') + تْ (3f.sg.) + نِي (me); 'she pained me'
ثَلٰثُ: ثَلَاث (thalāth, three; printed defectively ثلث, pointed with dagger alif) + ُ (construct); 'three [of]'
مَيِّتٌ: مَيِّت (mayyit, act. part. of مات/موت, 'dead') + ٌ (nom. indef.); 'dead'
أَفْنَرَ: elative (أفعل) of uncertain root, printed افنر; likely a corrupt or dialectal spelling of أَفْجَر (afjar, 'most depraved/wanton'), vocalised here accordingly; vocative-construct acc.; 'most depraved [of]'
الْقَحْبَاتِ: الـ + قَحْبَات, pl. of قَحْبَة (qaḥba, whore) + genitive; 'the whores'
الْمَنْيُوكَاتِ: الـ + مَنْيُوكَات, pl. of مَنْيُوك (colloquial pass. part. of ناك/ينيك, vulgar 'to fuck'); 'the fucked women' — a coarse insult, kept coarse
الْعَشَّاقَاتِ: الـ + عَشَّاقَات, pl. of عَشَّاقَة (intensive of عاشق, 'female lover/paramour'); 'the lovers'
الْمَبَرْطَلَاتِ: الـ + مَبَرْطَلَات, pl. of مُبَرْطَلَة (pass. part. of بَرْطَلَ, colloquial 'to bribe'); 'the bribed ones' (i.e. bribed procuresses)
إِنّي: إِنَّ (inna, emphatic 'indeed/verily') + ي (I, as its pronominal subject); 'indeed I'
أَخَذْتُ: أَخَذَ (akhadha, to take) + تُ (1sg. past); 'I took'
جَرْدَتُهُ: جَرَدَ (jarada, to strip/bare [a blade]) + تُ (1sg.) + هُ (it); 'I bared it'
صَوَّبَتُ: صَوَّبَ (form II of صوب, 'to aim/direct') + تُ (1sg. past); 'I aimed [it]'
لِأَقْتُلَهَا: لِـ + أَقْتُلَ (1sg. subjunctive of قتل, to kill) + هَا (her); 'to kill her'
مُصَمِّمًا: مُصَمِّم (act. part., form II of صمم, 'resolved/determined') + ً (acc., ḥāl); 'resolved'
تَخْسَأْ: خَسَأَ (khasaʾa, 'to be driven off/despised' — said of dogs); imperative-like curse; 'be off, be despised'
هَيْهَاتَ: hayhāta, fixed exclamation of impossibility; 'far be it! how unlikely!'
يَرْجِعُ: يَرْجِعُ (رجع, to return), 3m.sg. impf.; 'it should return'
الْأَمْواتُ: الـ + أَمْوَات, pl. of مَيِّت/مَيْت (dead) + nom.; 'the dead'
أَمْكَنَنِي: أَمْكَنَ (form IV of مكن, 'to enable/empower') + نِي (me); 'gave me power (over)'
تُطْفَى: تُطْفَى, passive impf. of أَطْفَأَ/طفأ ('to extinguish'); 'is put out'
قَدَمَيْهَا: قَدَم (qadam, foot), dual + هَا (her); 'her two feet'
تَكَلَّمَتْ: تَكَلَّمَ (form V of كلم, 'to speak') + تْ (3f.sg.); 'she spoke'
اُخْرُجْ: اُخْرُجْ, imperative of خرج ('to go out/emerge'); hamzat waṣl (never marked); 'come forth!'
بِسِحْرِي: بِـ + سِحْر (siḥr, sorcery) + ي (my); 'by my sorcery'
صِرْتُ: صِرْتُ (صار, to become) + تُ (1sg. past); 'I became'
بَقِيتُ: بَقِيَ (baqiya, to remain) + تُ (1sg. past); 'I remained'
أَقُومُ: أَقُومُ, 1sg. impf. of قام ('to stand up'); 'I stand'
أَقْعُدُ: أَقْعُدُ, 1sg. impf. of قعد ('to sit'); 'I sit'
الْأَسْواقِ: الـ + أَسْوَاق, pl. of سُوق (sūq, market) + genitive; 'the markets'
الْغِيطَانِ: الـ + غِيطَان (Egyptian dial. pl. of غَيْط, 'field/garden') + genitive; 'the gardens/fields'
صُنُوفٍ: صُنُوف, pl. of صِنْف (ṣinf, kind/category) + genitive tanwīn; 'kinds'
فَسَحَرَتْهُمْ: فَ + سَحَرَتْ (she enchanted) + هُمْ (them); 'so she enchanted them'
فَالْأَبْيضُ: فَ + الْأَبْيَض — al-abyaḍ, the white (one) + nom.; 'and the white one'
الْمُسْلِمُونَ: الـ + مُسْلِمُونَ, sound m. pl. nom.; 'the Muslims'
الْأَرْزَقُ: الـ + أَرْزَق — a metathesised spelling of أَزْرَق (azraq, blue), kept as printed + nom.; 'the blue'
الْجَزَائرَ: الـ + جَزَائِر, pl. of جَزِيرَة (jazīra, island) + acc.; 'the islands' — hamza on the yāʾ-seat is our editorial addition, the edition prints bare الجزاير
جَبَالً: جِبَال, pl. of جَبَل (jabal, mountain) + tanwīn acc.; 'mountains'
مُحِيطَةً: مُحِيطَة (act. part. f. of أحاط, 'surrounding') + tanwīn acc.; 'surrounding'
بَالْبِرْكَةِ: بِـ + الـ + بِرْكَة — bi-, marks what is surrounded (muḥīṭ bi- = surrounding) + birka, pool, pond (f., gen.); 'the pool'
إِنّهَا: إِنَّ (inna, 'indeed') + هَا (she, as its subject); 'indeed she'
يَومٍ: يَوْم (yawm, day) + genitive tanwīn (mudāf ilayh of كل); 'day'
تَضْرِبُنِي: تَضْرِبُ (impf. of ضرب, 'to beat'), 3f.sg. + نِي (me); 'she beats me'
تُعَذِّبُنِي: تُعَذِّبُ (impf., form II of عذب, 'to torture'), 3f.sg. + نِي (me); 'she tortures me'
بِالسَّوْطِ: بِـ + الـ + سَوْط (sawṭ, whip) + genitive; 'with the whip'
مِائْةً: مِائَة (miʾa, hundred) + tanwīn acc. (tamyīz); 'a hundred' — edition prints defectively ماية, hamza on the yāʾ-seat is our editorial addition
تَنْهَرِي: root ن-ه-ر (nahr, 'river/channel'); the form as printed (5 letters) is irregular and not a standard paradigm — vocalised and rendered by sense, 'streams/is furrowed', with real uncertainty
أَكْتَافِي: أَكْتَاف, pl. of كَتِف (katif, shoulder) + ي (my); 'my shoulders'
تُلْبِسُنِي: تُلْبِسُ (impf., form IV of لبس, 'to clothe'), 3f.sg. + نِي (me); 'she clothes me'
ثَوبَ: ثَوْب (thawb, garment) + acc., construct; 'a garment of'
صِفَةَ: صِفَة (ṣifa, manner/description) + acc. (adverbial); 'in the manner of'
الثِّيابَ: الـ + ثِيَاب, pl. of ثَوْب (thawb, garment) + acc.; 'the garments'
الْفَاخِرَةَ: الـ + فَاخِرَة (fākhira, f. of fākhir, 'fine/splendid') + acc.; 'the fine/splendid'
فَوْقُ: fawqu, above/on top (indeclinable adverb, mabnī ʿalā al-ḍamm when cut off from its object); 'from above'
إِنَّ: inna, emphatic particle introducing a nominal clause ('indeed'); 'indeed'
الشَّابَ: الـ + شَابّ (shābb, young man) + acc. (subject of إنّ); 'the young man'
لِحُكْمِكَ: لِـ + حُكْم (ḥukm, judgment/decree) + كَ (your); 'for your judgment'
اِلٰهِي: إِلٰه (ilāh, god), spelled with the dagger alif of the traditional Qurʾānic orthography, + ي (my); 'my God'
وَالْقَضَا: وَ + الـ + قَضَا — al-qaḍāʾ (the decree/decision), printed defectively without its final hamza; 'and the decree'
اَنَا: anā, I (independent pronoun; the verse prints it without the editorial hamza mark used elsewhere); 'I'
الرِّضَا: الـ + رِضَا (riḍā, good pleasure/contentment); 'the good pleasure'
وَاعْتَدَوْا: وَ + اعْتَدَوْا, form VIII of عدو ('to transgress'), 3m.pl. past; 'and they transgressed'
وَتَجَبَّرُوا: وَ + تَجَبَّرُوا, form V of جبر ('to act tyrannically/haughtily'), 3m.pl. past; 'and they were tyrannical'
فَلَعَلَّنِي: فَ + لَعَلَّ (laʿalla, 'perhaps') + نِي (I, as its subject); 'so perhaps I'
الْفِرْدَوْسَ: الـ + فِرْدَوْس (firdaws, Paradise/the highest Garden) + acc.; 'Paradise'
اَنْ: an, that (subordinating particle before a subjunctive verb; the verse prints it without the editorial hamza mark used in prose); 'that'
نَتَعَوَّضَا: نَتَعَوَّضُ, form V/VI of عوض ('to be recompensed'), 1pl. impf. (poetic ending in alif for the rhyme); 'we be recompensed'
قَلَّ: قَلَّ (qalla, 'to become little/rare'), used idiomatically before a verb = 'seldom, rarely'; vocalised thus rather than as a defective spelling of qāla ('said'), which does not fit the sense here — the edition prints قل
ضِقْتُ: ضِقْتُ (ضاق/يضيق, 'to become narrow/straitened') + تُ (1sg. past); 'I became straitened'
بِالْاَمْرِ: بِـ + الـ + أَمْر (amr, matter/affair) + genitive; 'by the matter'
فَوَسِيلَتِي: فَ + وَسِيلَة (wasīla, means/recourse) + ي (my); 'so my recourse'
بِالْمُصْطَفَى: بِـ + الـ + مُصْطَفَى (al-Muṣṭafā, 'the Chosen One' — epithet of the Prophet Muhammad); 'by the Chosen One'
وَالْمُرْتَضَى: وَ + الـ + مُرْتَضَى (al-Murtaḍā, 'the Well-Pleasing/Approved One' — epithet of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib); 'and the Well-Pleasing One'
الْأَبْيَاتَ: الـ + أَبْيَات (pl. of بَيْت in the sense 'verse-line') — bayt, verse; 'the verses' (acc.)
اِلْتَفَتَ: اِلْتَفَتَ (Form VIII of ل‑ف‑ت) — iltafata, to turn around; 'he turned'
أَيُّهَا: vocative particle used before a definite noun — ayyuhā, 'O...'
هَمًّا: هَمّ — hamm, worry, grief (acc. indef.); 'a worry'
فَرَّجْتَ: فَرَّجَ (Form II of ف‑ر‑ج) + تَ (2nd masc. sg. past) — farraja, to relieve, dispel (grief); 'you relieved'
غَمِّي: غَمّ + ي (my) — ghamm, anguish, distress; 'my anguish'
الْمَجْرُوحُ: الـ + مَجْرُوح (pass. part. of جَرَحَ) — majrūḥ, wounded (nom.)
الْقُبَّةِ: الـ + قُبَّة — qubba, dome, domed tomb-chamber (gen.)
مَدْفَنِهِ: مَدْفَن (place-noun of دَفَنَ, to bury) + هِ (his) — 'his burial-place'
الْمَجْلِسِ: الـ + مَجْلِس (place-noun of جَلَسَ) — majlis, sitting-room, chamber (gen.)
بِحَاذِي: بِـ + حَاذِي (from حَاذَى, to be alongside) — bi-, at (prep.) + Middle Arabic for 'opposite, facing'
تِجِي: colloquial present of جَاءَ/يَجِيءُ (to come), without the classical hamza — 'she comes'
مَرَّةً: مَرَّة — marra, one time, once (acc. of adverbial specification)
فَأَوَّلُ: فَ + أَوَّل — awwal, first; 'so the first (thing)'
تَانِي: colloquial for ثَانِي, 'second, next' — used here as a sequencer, 'next, then' (see note; sense uncertain)
وَتُجَرِّدُنِي: وَ + تُجَرِّدُ (Form II of ج‑ر‑د) + نِي (me) — jarrada, to strip; 'and she strips me'
أَثْوَابِي: أَثْوَاب (pl. of ثَوْب) + ي (my) — thawb, garment; 'my garments'
وَتَضْرِبُنِي: وَ + تَضْرِبُ (Form I of ض‑ر‑ب) + نِي (me) — ḍaraba, to strike; 'and she strikes me'
مِائَةَ: مِائَة — mi'a, hundred (acc., in construct with what follows)
جَلْدَةٍ: جَلْدَة — jaldah, a stroke of the lash (gen. indef., specifying مِائَة)
وَأَصِيحُ: وَ + أَصِيحُ (صَاحَ/يَصِيحُ, 1st sg.) — ṣāḥa, to cry out; 'and I cry out'
أَدْفَعُهَا: دَفَعَ/أَدْفَعُ (1st sg. imperf.) + هَا (it) — dafaʿa, to push away; 'I fend it off'
تُعَانِبُنِي: تُعَانِبُ (Form III of ع‑ن‑ب, sense uncertain) + نِي (me) — printed thus; possibly for تُعَانِقُنِي, 'she embraces me' (see note)
بِالشَّرَابِ: بِـ + الـ + شَرَاب — bi-, with (prep.) + sharāb, drink (gen.)
وَالْمَسْلُوقَةِ: وَ + الـ + مَسْلُوقَة (pass. part. of سَلَقَ, to boil) — 'and the boiled dish, the broth'
وَغَدًا: وَ + غَدًا — ghadan, tomorrow, the next morning (acc. adv.)
لَأَفْعَلَنَّ: لَـ (emphatic) + أَفْعَلَنَّ (1st sg. energetic imperf. of فَعَلَ) — 'I will surely do'
أُذْكَرُ: ذَكَرَ/أُذْكَرُ (1st sg. imperf. passive) — dhakara, to mention, remember; 'I am remembered'
يُؤَرِّخُونَهُ: يُؤَرِّخُ (Form II of أ‑ر‑خ) + ونَ (they) + هُ (it) — arrakha, to date, record in a chronicle; 'they will chronicle it'
يَتَحَدَّثُ: تَحَدَّثَ/يَتَحَدَّثُ (Form V) — taḥaddatha, to converse; 'he converses'
وَنَامَا: وَ + نَامَا (dual past of نَامَ) — nāma, to sleep; 'and the two of them slept'
السَّحَرِ: الـ + سَحَر — saḥar, the last part of the night before dawn (gen.)
وَتَجَرَّدَ: وَ + تَجَرَّدَ (Form V of ج‑ر‑د) — tajarrada, to strip oneself, undress
وَسَلَّ: وَ + سَلَّ (Form I) — salla, to draw (a sword)
وَنَهَضَ: وَ + نَهَضَ — nahaḍa, to rise up, get up
وَالْقَنَادِيلِ: وَ + الـ + قَنَادِيل (pl. of قِنْدِيل) — qindīl, lamp; 'and the lamps' (gen.)
وَبَخُورَاتٍ: وَ + بَخُورَات (pl. of بَخُور) — bakhūr, incense; 'and incense' (gen. indef.)
وَأَدْهَانٍ: وَ + أَدْهَان (pl. of دُهْن) — duhn, oil; 'and oils' (gen. indef.)
يَقْصِدُ: قَصَدَ/يَقْصِدُ — qaṣada, to head for, make for
أَتَاهُ: أَتَى/يَأْتِي (Form I) + هُ (him) — atā, to come to, reach; 'he came to him'
وَضَرَبَهُ: وَ + ضَرَبَ + هُ (him) — 'and he struck him'
ضَرْبَةً: ضَرْبَة (noun of single instance from ضَرَبَ) — 'a blow' (acc.)
وَحَمَلَهُ: وَ + حَمَلَ + هُ (him) — ḥamala, to carry; 'and carried him'
وَرَمَاهُ: وَ + رَمَى + هُ (him) — ramā, to throw; 'and threw him'
وَالْتَفَّ: وَ + اِلْتَفَّ (Form VIII of ل‑ف‑ف) — iltaffa, to wrap oneself
وَرَقَدَ: وَ + رَقَدَ — raqada, to lie down, sleep
الْمَلْعُونَةُ: الـ + مَلْعُونَة (pass. part. fem. of لَعَنَ) — 'the accursed woman' (nom.)
السَّاحِرَةُ: الـ + سَاحِرَة (act. part. fem. of سَحَرَ) — 'the sorceress' (nom.)
جَرَّدَتْ: جَرَّدَ (Form II) + تْ (she) — jarrada, to strip; 'she stripped'
اِبْنَ: اِبْن — ibn, son (of); acc., in 'ابن عمّها'
عَمِّهَا: عَمّ + هَا (her) — ʿamm, paternal uncle; 'her uncle' (i.e. her cousin, in ابن عمها)
وَضَرَبَتْهُ: وَ + ضَرَبَتْ + هُ (him) — 'and she struck him'
يَكْفِينِي: كَفَى/يَكْفِي + نِي (me) — kafā, to suffice; 'it suffices me, is enough for me'
اِرْحَمِينِي: اِرْحَمِي (Form I fem. imperative of رَحِمَ) + نِي (me) — 'have mercy on me!'
رَحِمْتَنِي: رَحِمَ (2nd masc. sg. past) + نِي (me) — 'you had mercy on me'
وَأَبْقَيْتَ: وَ + أَبْقَيْتَ (Form IV of ب‑ق‑ي, 2nd masc. sg.) — abqā, to leave, preserve; 'and you left/spared'
مَعْشُوقِي: مَعْشُوق (pass. part. of عَشِقَ) + ي (my) — 'my beloved'
وَسَالَ: وَ + سَالَ (Form I of س‑ي‑ل) — sāla, to flow
جُنُوبِهِ: جُنُوب (pl. of جَنْب) + هِ (his) — janb, side; 'his sides'
أَلْبَسَتْهُ: أَلْبَسَتْ (Form IV of ل‑ب‑س) + هُ (him) — albasa, to clothe; 'she clothed him'
الشَّعْرَانِيَّ: الـ + شَعْرَانِيّ (nisba of شَعْر) — 'made of hair, haircloth' (acc.)
وَالْقُمَاشَ: وَ + الـ + قُمَاش — qumāsh, cloth, fabric (acc.)
سَيِّدِي: سَيِّد + ي (my) — sayyid, master, lord; 'my lord'
كَلِّمْنِي: كَلِّمْ (Form II imperative of ك‑ل‑م) + نِي (me) — kallama, to speak to; 'speak to me!'
حَدِّثْنِي: حَدِّثْ (Form II imperative of ح‑د‑ث) + نِي (me) — ḥaddatha, to tell; 'tell me!'
الصُّدُودُ: الـ + صُدُود (verbal noun of صَدَّ) — 'turning away, aversion' (nom.)
أَدْمُعِي: أَدْمُع (pl. of دَمْع) + ي (my) — damʿ, tear; 'my tears'
كَفَا: كَفَى (spelled here with plain alif, a rhyme-spelling) — kafā, to suffice, be enough
فَلَكُمْ: فَ + لَكُمْ — 'to/for you' (the number does not match the following singular verb; see note)
تُطِيلُ: أَطَالَ/تُطِيلُ (Form IV of ط‑و‑ل) — aṭāla, to prolong; 'you prolong'
مُتَعَمِّدًا: مُتَعَمِّد (act. part. of Form V تَعَمَّدَ) — 'intentionally, deliberately' (acc. of state)
اِن: in, if (conditional particle; distinct from أَنْ 'that' and إِنَّ 'indeed')
قَصْدُكَ: قَصْد + كَ (your) — qaṣd, aim, intent; 'your intent'
حَاسِدِي: حَاسِد (act. part. of حَسَدَ) + ي (my) — 'my envier'
اِشتَفَى: اِشتَفَى (Form VIII of ش‑ف‑ي) — ishtafā, to be satisfied, have one's fill (of a grudge)
إِنَّهَا: إِنَّ + هَا — inna, "verily, indeed" + hā, "she"; narrative formula "ثم إنها", "then she indeed..."
حَادِثْنِي: حَادِثْ + نِي — Form III imperative of ح-د-ث (ḥādatha, "to converse with"), masc. sing. + nī, "me"; "converse with me!"
خَفَّضَ: خَفَّضَ, Form II of خ-ف-ض (khaffaḍa, "to lower"); 3ms past, "he lowered"
عَقَلَ: عَقَلَ, Form I of ع-ق-ل ("to bind, restrain"); 3ms past, "he restrained" — idiom "عقل لسانه", "he held his tongue"
تَكَلَّمَ: تَكَلَّمَ, Form V of ك-ل-م (takallama, "to speak"); 3ms past, "he spoke"
بِكَلَامِ: بِـ + كَلَام — bi-, "with, in" + kalām, "speech"; "with the speech of"
السُّودانِ: الـ + سُودَان — al-, "the" + Sūdān, "the Blacks" (period term for Black Africans)
أَوَّاهْ: awwāh, exclamation "alas!" (lit. "one who laments/groans greatly," cf. Q11:75)
حَولَ: ḥawl, "power, might" (in the set phrase "لا حول ولا قوة")
بِاللّٰهِ: بِـ + الله — bi-, "in, by" + Allāh, "God"; "in God"
الْعَلِيِّ: الـ + عَلِيّ — al-, "the" + ʿaliyy, "high, exalted" (divine epithet)
صَرَخَتْ: صَرَخَ, "to cry out, scream"; 3fs past, "she cried out"
اسْتَفَاقَتْ: اِسْتَفَاقَ, Form X of ف-ي-ق ("to wake, come to"); 3fs past, "she awoke"
أَضْعَفَ: أَضْعَفَ, Form IV of ض-ع-ف ("to weaken"); 3ms past, "he weakened, made faint"
تَسْتَأْهِلِي: تَسْتَأْهِلِي(نَ), Form X of أ-ه-ل ("to deserve, merit"); 2fs imperfect (colloquial, final -na dropped), "you deserve"
يُكَلِّمُكِ: يُكَلِّمُ + كِ — Form II imperfect of ك-ل-م, 3ms, "he speaks to" + ki, "you" (f.); "speaks to you"
يُحَدِّثُكِ: يُحَدِّثُ + كِ — Form II imperfect of ح-د-ث, 3ms, "he converses with" + ki, "you" (f.); "converses with you"
سَبَبُهُ: سَبَب + هُ — sabab, "cause, reason" (m.) + hu, "its"; "its cause"
بِطُولِ: بِـ + طُول — bi-, "with, through" + ṭūl, "length"; "throughout" — "بطول النهار", "all day long"
تُعَاقِبِي: تُعَاقِبِي(نَ), Form III imperfect of ع-ق-ب ("to punish"); 2fs (final -na dropped), "you punish, torment"
يَسْتَغِيثُ: يَسْتَغِيثُ, Form X imperfect of غ-و-ث ("to cry for help"); 3ms, "he cries for help"
أَحْرَمَنِي: أَحْرَمَ + نِي — Form IV of ح-ر-م ("to deprive"), 3ms past + nī, "me"; "he deprived me"
الْعَشَا: الـ + عَشَا — al-, "the" + ʿashā (colloquial for ʿashāʾ), "evening, suppertime"; "the evening"
يَتَضَرَّعُ: يَتَضَرَّعُ, Form V imperfect of ض-ر-ع ("to plead, entreat humbly"); 3ms, "he pleads"
يَدْعُو: يَدْعُو, "to call, pray, invoke (against)"; 3ms imperfect, "he prays, calls"
عَلَيَّ: عَلَى + ي — ʿalā, "upon, against" + ī, "me"; "against me"
عَلَيْكِي: عَلَى + كِي — ʿalā, "upon, against" + ki (+ extra ي, colloquial), "you" (f.); "against you"
أَقْلَقَنِي: أَقْلَقَ + نِي — Form IV of ق-ل-ق ("to disturb, trouble"), 3ms past + nī, "me"; "it has troubled me"
أَضْرَّنِي: أَضَرَّ + نِي — Form IV of ض-ر-ر ("to harm"), 3ms past + nī, "me"; "it has harmed me"
وَلَولَا: وَ + لَوْلَا — wa-, "and" + lawlā, "were it not for, if not for"
لَكُنْتُ: لَـ + كُنْتُ — la-, emphatic particle + kuntu, "I was, would have been"; "I would [have]"
تَعَافَيتُ: تَعَافَيْتُ, Form VI of ع-ف-و ("to recover, be restored to health"); 1cs past, "I would have recovered"
مَنَعَنِي: مَنَعَ + نِي — manaʿa, "to prevent," 3ms past + nī, "me"; "it prevented me"
أُخَلِّصُهُ: أُخَلِّصُ + هُ — Form II imperfect of خ-ل-ص ("to free, rescue"), 1cs + hu, "him"; "I will free him"
خَلِّصِيهِ: خَلِّصِي + هِ — Form II imperative of خ-ل-ص, fem. sing. + hi, "him"; "free him!"
رَيِّحِينَا: رَيِّحِي + نَا — colloquial Form II of ر-و-ح ("to give rest," standing for Classical أريحي), fem. imperative + nā, "us"; "give us rest!"
طَاعَةً: ṭāʿatan, "obedience" (accusative); together "سمعا وطاعة", "hearing and obedience," i.e. willing compliance
مَلَأَتْهَا: مَلَأَتْ + هَا — malaʾa, "to fill," 3fs past + hā, "it"; "she filled it"
فَغَلَتْ: فَـ + غَلَتْ — fa-, "so, and then" + ghalat, "it boiled" (3fs past); "so it boiled"
بَقْبَقَتْ: بَقْبَقَ, quadriliteral onomatopoetic verb, "to bubble"; 3fs past, "it bubbled"
صَارتْ: صَارَ, "to become, start to"; 3fs past, "it began [to]"
طَرَشَتْهُ: طَرَشَتْ + هُ — ṭarashat, "she sprinkled, splashed" (colloquial, for rashshat) + hu, "him"; "she sprinkled him"
بِيَحَقْ: probably بِـ + حَقّ, "by the truth, right of" (oath formula); intrusive ي unexplained, kept as printed
تَلَوتُهُ: تَلَوْتُ + هُ — talawtu, "I recited," 1cs past + hu, "it"; "I recited it"
قُلْتُهُ: قُلْتُ + هُ — qultu, "I said," 1cs past + hu, "it"; "I said it"
سُكْرِي: سُكْر + ي — sukr, "intoxication" (m.) + ī, "my"; "my intoxication" (paired with بسحري for the rhyme)
فَاُخْرُجْ: فَـ + اُخْرُجْ — fa-, "so, then" + ukhruj, imperative of خَرَجَ ("to go, come out"), masc. sing.; "so come out!"
هَذِةْ: hādhihi, "this" (f.), spelled here with ة for ه — a spelling variant
بِالشَّابِ: بِـ + الـ + شَابّ — bi-, "with, at" + al-, "the" + shābb, "young man"; completes "وإذا بالشاب", "and behold, the young man"
اِنْتَفَضَ: اِنْتَفَضَ, Form VIII of ن-ف-ض ("to shake, give a start"); 3ms past, "he shook, started"
بِخَلَاصِهِ: بِـ + خَلَاص + هِ — bi-, "at" + khalāṣ, "deliverance" (m.) + hi, "his"; "at his deliverance"
أَشْهَدُ: أَشْهَدُ, Form I imperfect of ش-ه-د ("to testify, bear witness"); 1cs, "I testify"
صَلَّى: ṣallā, "he blessed" (3ms past, Form II of ص-ل-و)
سَلَّمَ: sallama, "he gave peace, greeted" (Form II of س-ل-م)
تَرْجِعْ: تَرْجِعْ, jussive imperfect of رَجَعَ ("to return"), 2ms, "you return" — after لا, "do not return"
قَتَلْتُكَ: قَتَلْتُ + كَ — qataltu, "I killed," 1cs past + ka, "you" (m.); here future sense, "I will kill you"
عَمَلْتِي: عَمَلْتِي, colloquial 2fs past of عَمِلَ ("to do") with extra ي; "you did"
أَرَحْتِينِي: أَرَحْتِي + نِي — Form IV of ر-و-ح ("to give rest"), 2fs past (colloquial, extra ي) + nī, "me"; "you relieved me"
تُرِيحِينِي: تُرِيحِي + نِي — Form IV imperfect of ر-و-ح, 2fs (final -na dropped) + nī, "me"; "you [do not] relieve me"
الْأَحَلُّ: الـ + أَحَلّ — al-, "the" + aḥall, elative of حَلَال ("lawful"), lit. "the most lawful thing" — printed with ح where "الاصل" ("the root," with ص) is meant in context; see note
وَبَلَا: probably for وَيْلًا, "woe!" (curse formula), with ب printed for ي; kept as printed
اِنْتَصَفَ: اِنْتَصَفَ, Form VIII of ن-ص-ف ("to reach the middle"); 3ms past, "it reached its middle"
تَشِيلُ: تَشِيلُ, colloquial for تَرْفَعُ ("to lift, raise"); 3fs imperfect, "it raises"
رُؤُسَهَا: رُؤُوس (defectively spelled رؤس) + هَا — ruʾūs, "heads" + hā, "their"; "their heads"
تَسْغِيثُ: for تَسْتَغِيثُ ("cries for help"), missing the ت of the pattern; kept as printed, read tastaghīthu
تَدْعُوا: تَدْعُو (with orthographic alif), "to call, pray (against)"; 3fs imperfect, "it prays, calls"
عَلَيْلِي: likely for عَلَيْكِي, "against you" (f.), with ل printed for ك; kept as printed
عَافِيتِي: عَافِيَة + ي — ʿāfiyah, "health, wellness" (f.) + ī, "my"; "my wellness"
فَرُوحِي: فَـ + رُوحِي — fa-, "so" + rūḥī, colloquial imperative "go!" (fem., from rāḥa/yarūḥu); "so go!"
خَلِّصِيهُمْ: خَلِّصِي + هُمْ — Form II imperative of خ-ل-ص, fem. sing. + hum, "them"; "free them!"
نُعَانِي: نُعَانِي, Form III imperfect of ع-ن-ي ("to suffer"); 1cp, "we suffer"
خُذِي: khudhī, imperative of أَخَذَ ("to take"), fem. sing.; "take!"
بِيدِي: بِـ + يَد + ي — bi-, "by" + yad, "hand" (f.) + ī, "my"; "by my hand"
أَقِيمِينِي: أَقِيمِي + نِي — Form IV imperative of ق-و-م ("to set upright, raise"), fem. sing. + nī, "me"; "raise me up!"
تَوَجَّهَتْ: تَوَجَّهَتْ, Form V of و-ج-ه ("to turn toward"); 3fs past, "it turned toward"
وَهِي: وَ + هِي — wa-, "and, while" + hiya, "she"; "while she"
نَظُنُّهُ: نَظُنُّ + هُ — naẓunnu, "we suppose," 1cp imperfect (printed for the expected تَظُنُّ, "she supposes") + hu, "him"; see note
وَعَيْنِي: وَ + عَيْن + ي — wa-, "and" + ʿayn, "eye" (f.) + ī, "my"; "and my eye"
نَهَضَتْ: نَهَضَتْ, "to rise up"; 3fs past, "she rose up"
وَقَامَتْ: وَ + قَامَتْ — wa-, "and" + qāmat, "she stood," 3fs past
مَسُرورةٌ: for مَسْرُورَة, "joyful, delighted" (f., passive participle of سَرَّ)
فَأَدْرَكَ: فَـ + أَدْرَكَ — fa-, "then" + adraka, Form IV of د-ر-ك ("to reach, overtake"), 3ms past; "then it overtook"
الْ: al-, "the-"; the archive itself breaks off here mid-word, where dawn cuts Shahrazad's telling short
التَّاسِعَةُ: الـ + تَاسِعَة — tāsiʿa, ninth (ordinal adj., f.); 'the ninth'
الصَّبِيَّةَ: الـ + صَبِيَّة — ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f.); 'the girl'
السَّاحِرَةَ: الـ + سَاحِرَة — sāḥira, sorceress (f. active participle of سَحَرَ, 'to enchant'); 'the sorceress'
مَاءِ: مَاء — māʾ, water (m.), construct, genitive; 'the water of'
تَكَلَّمَتْ: تَكَلَّمَ — takallama, to speak (form V, 3fs past); 'she spoke'
يُفْهَمُ: فَهِمَ — fahima, to understand (passive impf. 3ms); 'is understood'
تَرَاقَصَتِ: تَرَاقَصَ — tarāqaṣa, to dance together (form VI of رَقَصَ, 3fs past, agreeing with the collective noun السمك); 'began to dance'
شَالَتْ: شَالَ — shāla, to raise, lift (3fs past); 'it raised'
أَهْلِ: أَهْل — ahl, people, folk (m.), construct; 'the people of'
السِّحْرُ: الـ + سِحْر — siḥr, magic, enchantment (m.); 'the enchantment'
الْمَدِينَةُ: الـ + مَدِينَة — madīna, city (f.), nominative; 'the city'
عَامِرَةً: عَامِرَة — ʿāmira, inhabited, flourishing (f. active participle of عَمَرَ); 'inhabited'
الْبَيَّاعُونَ: الـ + بَيَّاع — bayyāʿ, seller, merchant (intensive noun of بَاعَ), pl.; 'the sellers'
تَبِيعُ: بَاعَ — bāʿa, to sell (impf.); left in the singular-looking form here though its subject البياعون is plural — a Middle Arabic looseness of number agreement; 'sells'
تَشْتَرِي: اِشْتَرَى — ishtarā, to buy (form VIII, impf.); 'buys'
صِنَاعَتِهِ: صِنَاعَة + هِ — ṣināʿa, craft, trade (f.) + 3ms poss.; 'his trade'
رَجَعَتِ: رَجَعَ — rajaʿa, to return, go back (3fs past); 'it went back'
الْجَزَايِرُ: الـ + جَزَايِر — jazāʾir, islands (pl. of جَزِيرَة); spelled here jazāyir, without the hamza classical جزائر takes — the same word later names 'the Black Islands' (الجزائر السود), the young man's kingdom
نَاوِلْنِي: نَاوَلَ + نِي — nāwala, to hand, pass (form III imperative fs) + 1cs obj.; 'hand me'
الْكَرِيمَةَ: الـ + كَرِيمَة — karīma, noble, generous (adj. f.); 'noble'
خَفِيٍّ: خَفِيّ — khafiyy, hidden, faint, low (adj.), genitive; بكلام خفي, 'in a hushed voice'
تَقَرَّبِي: تَقَرَّبَ — taqarraba, to draw near (form V imperative fs); 'draw near'
فَدَنَتْ: فَ + دَنَا — fa- + danā, to draw near (3fs past); 'so she drew near'
الْتَصَقَتْ: اِلْتَصَقَ — iltaṣaqa, to be pressed close, cling (form VIII of لَصِقَ, 3fs past); 'she was pressed close'
سَلَّ: سَلَّ — salla, to draw (a blade) (3ms past); 'he drew'
ضَرَبَهَا: ضَرَبَ + هَا — ḍaraba, to strike (3ms past) + 3fs obj.; 'he struck her'
ظَهْرِهَا: ظَهْر + هَا — ẓahr, back (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'her back'
شَقَّهَا: شَقَّ + هَا — shaqqa, to split, cleave (3ms past) + 3fs obj.; 'he split her'
رَمَيْهَا: رَمَى + هَا — ramā, to throw (3ms past) + 3fs obj.; spelled here رَمَيْهَا with ي where classical رَمَاهَا takes ا before the suffix — a Middle Arabic defective-verb spelling; 'and threw her'
شَطْرَيْنِ: شَطْر — shaṭr, half, portion (m.), dual accusative; 'into two pieces'
وَاقِفًا: وَاقِف — wāqif, standing (active participle of وَقَفَ), accusative (circumstantial); 'standing'
انْتِظَارِهِ: اِنْتِظَار + هِ — intiẓār, waiting (verbal noun of form VIII اِنْتَظَرَ) + 3ms poss.; 'waiting for him'
فَهَنَّأَهُ: فَ + هَنَّأَ + هُ — fa- + hannaʾa, to congratulate (form II, 3ms past) + 3ms obj.; 'so he congratulated him'
قَبَّلَ: قَبَّلَ — qabbala, to kiss (form II, 3ms past); 'he kissed'
تَقْعُدُ: قَعَدَ — qaʿada, to sit, stay, remain (impf. 2ms); 'will you stay'
أَ: interrogative particle 'a-', prefixed to a verb to form a yes/no question — printed here as its own word rather than attached to تدري; 'do...?'
تَدْرِي: دَرَى — darā, to know (impf. 2ms); 'do you know'
نَائِمًا: نَائِم — nāʾim, asleep, sleeping (active participle of نَامَ), accusative; 'asleep'
كَامِلَةٌ: كَامِلَة — kāmila, complete, whole (adj. f.), nominative; 'a whole'
لِلْمُجِدِّ: لِـ + الـ + مُجِدّ — li-, for (prep.) + mujidd, one who presses on, drives himself hard (active participle of أَجَدَّ / جَدَّ في السير); 'for the hard-driving [traveler]'
الْمُسَافِرِ: الـ + مُسَافِر — musāfir, traveler (active participle of سَافَرَ); 'traveler'
أَتَيْتُ: أَتَى — atā, to come (1cs past); 'I came'
مَسْحُورَةً: مَسْحُورَة — masḥūra, enchanted (passive participle f.), accusative; 'enchanted'
أُفَارِقُكَ: فَارَقَ + كَ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (form III, impf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I will leave you'
لَحْظَةَ: لَحْظَة — laḥẓa, moment, blink (f.), construct; 'the blink of'
فَقَرِحَ: فَ + قَرِحَ — fa- + qariḥa, to be wounded, afflicted (3ms past) — the letters printed for what context makes almost certainly فَفَرِحَ, 'and he rejoiced'; kept as spelled and read accordingly
مَنَّ: مَنَّ — manna, to bestow favor (3ms past, with عَلَى, 'to favor someone'); 'has favored'
وَأَنْتَ: وَ + أَنْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + anta, you; 'and you'
عُمْرِي: عُمْر + ي — ʿumr, lifetime (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my life'
أُرْزَقْ: رُزِقَ — ruziqa, to be granted, provided with (passive, 1cs jussive); 'I was granted'
وَلَدًا: وَلَد — walad, son, child (m.), accusative; 'a son'
تَعَانَقَا: تَعَانَقَ — taʿānaqa, to embrace one another (form VI of عَنَقَ, 3md past); 'the two embraced'
وَفَرِحَا: وَ + فَرِحَ — wa-, and (conj.) + fariḥa, to rejoice (3md past); 'and rejoiced'
فَرَحًا: فَرَح — faraḥ, joy (m.), accusative (cognate object); فرحا شديدا, 'greatly'
مَشَيَا: مَشَى — mashā, to walk (3md past); 'the two walked'
أَرْبَابَ: أَرْبَاب — arbāb, lords, masters (pl. of رَبّ), accusative construct; 'the lords of'
يَتَجَهَّزُوا: تَجَهَّزَ — tajahhaza, to prepare, make ready (form V, subjunctive 3mp); 'they should prepare'
لِلْمَسْفَرِ: لِـ + الـ + مَسْفَر — li-, for (prep.) + masfar, a noun of time/place from سَافَرَ ('the journey, the departure'); 'for the journey'
وَيُهَيُّوا: وَ + هَيَّأَ — wa-, and (conj.) + hayyaʾa, to make ready, prepare (form II of هيأ, subjunctive 3mp) — printed without the hamza classical يُهَيِّئُوا takes, a Middle Arabic softening; 'and make ready'
أَسْبَابَهُ: أَسْبَاب + هُ — asbāb, provisions, means (pl. of سَبَب) + 3ms poss.; 'its provisions'
يَحْتَاجُ: اِحْتَاجَ — iḥtāja, to need (form VIII of حَاجَ, impf. 3ms); 'is needed'
الْحَالُ: الـ + حَال — ḥāl, state, occasion, situation (m.); 'the occasion'
فَشَرَعُوا: فَ + شَرَعَ — fa-, so (conj.) + sharaʿa, to begin, set about (3mp past); 'so they set about'
بِالتَّجْهِيزِ: بِـ + الـ + تَجْهِيز — bi-, with (prep.) + tajhīz, preparation (verbal noun of form II جَهَّزَ); 'the preparation'
وَقَلْبُهُ: وَ + قَلْب + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qalb, heart (m.) + 3ms poss.; 'and his heart'
مُلْتَهِبٌ: مُلْتَهِب — multahib, aflame, ablaze (active participle of form VIII اِلْتَهَبَ), nominative; 'aflame'
مَدِينَتِهِ: مَدِينَة + هِ — madīna, city (f.) + 3ms poss.; 'his city'
يَغِيبُ: غَابَ — ghāba, to be absent (impf. 3ms); 'could he be absent'
سَافَرُوا: سَافَرَ — sāfara, to travel, journey (3mp past); 'they journeyed'
مَمْلُوكًا: مَمْلُوك — mamlūk, mamluk, slave-soldier (m.), accusative; 'a mamluk'
وَهَدَايَا: وَ + هَدَايَا — wa-, and (conj.) + hadāyā, gifts (pl. of هَدِيَّة); 'and gifts'
زَالُوا: زَالَ — zāla, to cease (3mp past, negated by ما = 'kept on'); 'they ceased'
مُسَافِرِينَ: مُسَافِر — musāfir, traveling (active participle of سَافَرَ), accusative pl.; 'traveling'
وَنَهَارًا: وَ + نَهَار — wa-, and (conj.) + nahār, daytime (m.), accusative (adv.); 'and by day'
وَكَتَبَ: وَ + كَتَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + kataba, to write, decree (3ms past); 'and decreed'
وَأَرْسَلُوا: وَ + أَرْسَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + arsala, to send (3mp past); 'and they sent'
أَعْلِمُوا: أَعْلَمَ — aʿlama, to inform (form IV of عَلِمَ, imperative mp); 'inform!'
بِوُصُولِ: بِـ + وُصُول — bi-, with, of (prep.) + wuṣūl, arrival (verbal noun of وَصَلَ); 'of the arrival of'
سَلَامَتِهِ: سَلَامَة + هِ — salāma, safety (f.) + 3ms poss.; 'his safety'
وَالْعَسَاكِرُ: وَ + الـ + عَسَاكِر — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿasākir, troops (pl. of عَسْكَر); 'and the troops'
قَطَعُوا: قَطَعَ — qaṭaʿa, to cut (3mp past, with الإياس = 'to give up hope'); 'they cut off'
الْإِيَاسَ: الـ + إِيَاس — iyās, despair (verbal noun of يَئِسَ), accusative; قطع الإياس, 'to give up hope'
فَانْبَلَّ: fa-, then (conj.) + an obscure form matching no verb that fits the sense; most likely a compositor's slip for فَأَقْبَلَ, 'then he/they came forward' (compare the correctly printed فَأَقْبَلَ two lines later); kept exactly as printed
وَقَبَّلُوا: وَ + قَبَّلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qabbala, to kiss (3mp past); 'and they kissed'
وَهَنُّوهُ: وَ + هَنَّأَ — wa-, and (conj.) + hannaʾa, to congratulate (3mp past) + 3ms obj. — printed without the hamza classical هَنَّأُوهُ takes; 'and they congratulated him'
فَأَقْبَلَ: فَ + أَقْبَلَ — fa-, then (conj.) + aqbala, to come forward, approach (form IV of قَبَلَ, 3ms past); 'then he came forward'
فَأَعْلَمَهُ: فَ + أَعْلَمَ + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + aʿlama, to inform (3ms past) + 3ms obj.; 'so he told him'
الشَّابِّ: الـ + شَابّ — shābb, young man (m.), genitive; 'the young man'
هَنَّأَهُ: هَنَّأَ + هُ — hannaʾa, to congratulate (3ms past) + 3ms obj.; 'he congratulated him'
وَاسْتَقَرَّ: وَ + اِسْتَقَرَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + istaqarra, to settle down (form X of قَرَّ); 'and matters settled'
فَأَنْعَمَ: فَ + أَنْعَمَ — fa-, then (conj.) + anʿama, to bestow favor (form IV of نَعِمَ); 'then he bestowed favor'
لِلْوَزِيرِ: لِـ + الـ + وَزِير — li-, to (prep.) + wazīr, vizier; 'to the vizier'
أَتَانَا: أَتَى + نَا — atā, to come, bring (3ms past) + 1cp obj.; 'brought us'
فَأُرْسِلَ: فَ + أُرْسِلَ — fa-, so (conj.) + ursila, to be sent (passive, 3ms past); 'so [word] was sent'
سَبَبًا: سَبَب — sabab, cause, reason (m.), accusative; 'the cause'
لِخَلَاصِ: لِـ + خَلَاص — li-, for (prep.) + khalāṣ, deliverance, rescue (verbal noun of خَلَصَ); 'for the deliverance of'
فَأُحْضِرَ: فَ + أُحْضِرَ — fa-, so (conj.) + uḥḍira, to be brought (passive, form IV of حَضَرَ); 'so he was brought'
وَأُخْلِعَ: وَ + أُخْلِعَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ukhliʿa, to be invested with a robe of honor (passive, form IV of خَلَعَ); 'and a robe of honor was bestowed'
وَسَأَلَهُ: وَ + سَأَلَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + saʾala, to ask (3ms past) + 3ms obj.; 'and he asked him'
وَهَلْ: وَ + هَلْ — wa-, and (conj.) + hal, whether (interrog. particle); 'and whether'
أَوْلَادٌ: وَلَد — walad, son, child, pl. أَوْلَاد, nominative; 'children'
فَأَخْبَرَهُ: فَ + أَخْبَرَ + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + akhbara, to tell, inform (form IV of خَبَرَ) + 3ms obj.; 'so he told him'
بِنْتَيْنِ: بِنْت — bint, daughter (f.), dual accusative; 'two daughters'
وَوَلَدٍ: وَ + وَلَد — wa-, and (conj.) + walad, son, child (m.), genitive; 'and a son'
أَحْضَرَهُمْ: أَحْضَرَ + هُمْ — aḥḍara, to bring, fetch (form IV of حَضَرَ, 3ms past) + 3mp obj.; 'had them brought'
وَتَزَوَّجَ: وَ + تَزَوَّجَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tazawwaja, to marry (form V); 'and he married'
وَأَعْطَى: وَ + أَعْطَى — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿṭā, to give (form IV); 'and he gave'
الْبِنْتَ: الـ + بِنْت — bint, daughter (f.), accusative; 'the daughter'
الْأُخْرَى: الـ + أُخْرَى — ukhrā, other (f. of آخَر); 'the other'
خَازِنْدَارَ: khāzindār, treasurer (Persian loanword, 'keeper of the treasury'); 'treasurer'
قَلَّدَ: قَلَّدَ — qallada, to invest with office (3ms past); 'he invested'
وَأَرْسَلَهُ: وَ + أَرْسَلَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + arsala, to send (3ms past) + 3ms obj.; 'and sent him'
السُّودُ: الـ + سُود — sūd, black (adj., pl. of أَسْوَد), nominative; الجزائر السود, 'the Black Islands'
وَأَرْسَلَ: وَ + أَرْسَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + arsala, to send (3ms past); 'and he sent'
جَاؤُا: جَاءُوا — jāʾū, they came (3mp past); spelled here compressed as جاؤا, one letter short of the full جاءوا; 'who had come'
وَأَعْطَاهُ: وَ + أَعْطَى + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿṭā, to give (3ms past) + 3ms obj.; 'and gave him'
لِسَائِرِ: لِـ + سَائِر — li-, for, to (prep.) + sāʾir, the rest of, all the other (n.); 'for all the rest of'
الْأُمَرَاءِ: الـ + أُمَرَاء — umarāʾ, emirs, princes (pl. of أَمِير), genitive; 'the emirs'
فَتَقَبَّلَ: فَ + تَقَبَّلَ — fa-, then (conj.) + taqabbala, to kiss (a hand, in homage) (form V of قَبِلَ); 'then he kissed'
وَالشَّابُّ: وَ + الـ + شَابّ — wa-, and (conj.) + shābb, young man (m.); 'and the young man'
أَغْنَى: أَغْنَى — aghnā, richer, wealthiest (elative of غَنِيّ); 'the richest'
زَمَانِهِ: زَمَان + هِ — zamān, time, age (m.) + 3ms poss.; 'his age'
وَأَوْلَادُهُ: وَ + أَوْلَاد + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + awlād, children (pl. of وَلَد) + 3ms poss.; 'and his children'
زَوْجَاتِ: زَوْجَات — zawjāt, wives (pl. of زَوْجَة), construct; 'wives of'
أَتَاهُمُ: أَتَى + هُمُ — atā, to come (3ms past) + 3mp obj.; 'came to them'
الْمَمَاتُ: الـ + مَمَات — mamāt, death (verbal noun of مَاتَ); 'death'
بِأَعْجَبَ: بِـ + أَعْجَب — bi-, than (used with the elative after a negated comparison, 'no more...than') + aʿjab, more wondrous (elative of عَجِيب); 'more wondrous'
لِلْحَمَّالِ: لِـ + الـ + حَمَّال — li-, to, for (prep.) + ḥammāl, porter (intensive noun of حَمَلَ, 'to carry'); 'the porter'
التَّوْفِيقِ: الـ + تَوْفِيق — al-, the (article) + tawfīq, success, good fortune (verbal noun of وَفَّقَ); 'the good fortune'
الثَّلْٰثِ: الـ + ثَلَاث — al-, the + thalāth, three (fem.); the archive spells this defectively, without the medial alif (الثلث), pointed here with a dagger alif rather than corrected
الثَّمَنَ: الـ + ثَمَن — al-, the + thaman, price; 'the price'
الدَّرْقَتَيْنِ: الـ + دَرْقَتَيْنِ — al-, the + darqa, leaf/panel (of a door), dual; 'the two panels'
السَّعَادَةِ: الـ + سَعَادَة — al-, the + saʿāda, happiness, good fortune; 'the happiness'
السُّوقِ: الـ + سُوق — al-, the + sūq, market; 'the market'
النَّقْلِيِّ: الـ + نَقْلِيّ — al-, the + naqlī, seller of nuts and dried fruit (nisba from نَقْل, snacks served with drink); 'the nut-seller'
النَّهْدِ: الـ + نَهْد — al-, the + nahd, breast, bosom; 'the bosom'
النُّعْمَانِ: الـ + نُعْمَان — al-, the + Nuʿmān, a proper name; شَقَايِق النُّعْمَان, 'anemones' (lit. 'the wounds of Nuʿmān'), is a fixed plant-name
النِّقَابَ: الـ + نِقَاب — al-, the + niqāb, face-veil; 'the veil'
الْأَبَنُوسِ: الـ + أَبَنُوس — al-, the + abanūs, ebony (loanword); 'the ebony'
الْأَرْكَانِ: الـ + أَرْكَان — al-, the + rukn, corner/pillar, pl. arkān; 'the corners'
الْأَطْرَافِ: الـ + أَطْرَاف — al-, the + ṭaraf, edge/extremity, pl. aṭrāf; 'the edges'
الْأَوْصَافِ: الـ + أَوْصَاف — al-, the + waṣf, description, quality, pl. awṣāf; 'the qualities'
الْبَابَ: الـ + بَاب — al-, the + bāb, door (acc.); 'the door'
الْبَانِ: الـ + بَان — al-, the + bān, the ban-tree (Moringa), source of a fragrant oil; 'the ban-tree'
الْبُنْيَانِ: الـ + بُنْيَان — al-, the + bunyān, construction, structure; 'the construction'
الْحَلَاوَةِ: الـ + حَلَاوَة — al-, the + ḥalāwa, sweets, confectionery; 'the sweets'
الْحَلْوَانِيِّ: الـ + حَلْوَانِيّ — al-, the + ḥalwānī, confectioner, sweet-seller (nisba from حَلْوَى, sweets); 'the confectioner'
الْحَمَّالُ: الـ + حَمَّال — al-, the + ḥammāl, porter, carrier (intensive noun of حَمَلَ, to carry); nom., 'the porter'
الْحَمَّالِ: الـ + حَمَّال — al-, the + ḥammāl, porter; gen./acc., 'the porter'
الْحَمَّالِينَ: الـ + حَمَّالِينَ — al-, the + ḥammāl, porter, pl. ḥammālīn; 'the porters'
الْخُوشْكَاتِ: الـ + خُوشْكَات — al-, the + khushkāt, a colloquial term for miscellaneous dry goods or sundries — here, the porter's mounting pile of purchases; 'these sundries'
الْعَطَّارِ: الـ + عَطَّار — al-, the + ʿaṭṭār, perfumer, druggist; 'the perfumer'
الْقَاضِي: الـ + قَاضِي — al-, the + qāḍī, judge; 'the judge'
الْقَفَصَ: الـ + قَفَص — al-, the + qafaṣ, basket, pannier (lit. 'cage'); acc., 'the basket'
الْقَفَصِ: الـ + قَفَص — al-, the + qafaṣ, basket, pannier; gen., 'the basket'
الْكَثِيرَ: الـ + كَثِير — al-, the + kathīr, much, a great deal; 'the great deal (of talk)'
الْكَرِيشَ: الـ + كَرِيش — al-, the + karīsh, a colloquial term (related to كَرِش, paunch/belly) used here for a large pack-animal; 'the pack-beast'
الْمَهَا: الـ + مَهَا — al-, the + mahā, the wild oryx (used poetically of large, dark eyes)
الْمُنَضَّدِ: الـ + مُنَضَّد — al-, the + munaḍḍad, arranged in rows, well-strung (of pearls)
اِشْتَرَتْ: اِشْتَرَتْ — ishtarat (Form VIII of شَرَى, to buy), she bought
اِمْرَأَةٌ: اِمْرَأَة — imraʾa, woman; indef. nom., 'a woman'
أَبْلُوجَيْنِ: أَبْلُوجَيْنِ — ablūj, a loaf of refined sugar (loanword), dual; 'two sugar-loaves'
أَجْفَانٍ: أَجْفَانٍ — jafn, eyelid, pl. ajfān; gen. indef., 'eyelids'
أَرْطَالٍ: أَرْطَالٍ — raṭl, a pound-weight, pl. arṭāl; gen. indef. after the numeral 'ten'; 'pounds'
أَسْرَعَ: أَسْرَعَ — asraʿa (Form IV of سَرُعَ), to hurry; 'he hurried'
أَصْنَافِ: أَصْنَافِ — ṣinf, kind, sort, pl. aṣnāf; construct gen., 'kinds of'
أَعْطَتْهُ: أَعْطَتْ + هُ — aʿṭat (Form IV of عَطَا, to give), she gave + -hu, him; 'she gave him'
أَعْلِمِينِي: أَعْلِمِي + نِي — aʿlimī (Form IV imper. fem. of عَلِمَ, to know), 'inform!' + -nī, me; used here colloquially in a counterfactual sense, 'had you told me'
أَقْلَامِيًّا: أَقْلَامِيًّا — aqlāmiyyan, 'pen-like' (nisba adj. from أَقْلَام, pens/reeds), describing slender, pen-shaped cucumbers; acc. indef.
أَمْوَاهٍ: أَمْوَاهٍ — māʾ, water, pl. amwāh; gen. indef. after 'ten'; 'waters'
أُقْحُوَانًا: أُقْحُوَانًا — uqḥuwān, chamomile, marguerite; acc. indef.
أُوقِيَّةً: أُوقِيَّةً — ūqiyya, an ounce (unit of weight, loanword); acc. indef.
إِسْكَنْدَرَانِيًّا: إِسْكَنْدَرَانِيًّا — iskandarāniyyan, Alexandrian (nisba adj. from الإِسْكَنْدَرِيَّة, Alexandria); acc. indef.
بَابُهَا: بَاب + هَا — bāb, door + -hā, its (fem. suffix); 'its door'
بَارِزَةُ: bāriza, prominent, jutting (act. part. fem. of بَرَزَ); nom.
بَانِيسَكَ: bāniyusak, a kind of stuffed pastry (a market sweet-name); acc. indef.
بَغْدَادَ: Baghdād, Baghdad (proper name, diptote — gen. takes fatḥa, no tanwīn)
بَنَاتِ: banāt, girls, daughters (pl. of بِنْت); construct gen., 'of-girls' — الثَّلٰثِ بَنَاتِ, 'the three girls'
بَنَفَشْ: banafash, violet-colored — a Persian color-word used directly as an adjective, without the usual Arabic nisba ending; describes the silk of the woman's mantle
بِالْبَابِ: بِـ + الـ + بَاب — bi- marks what appears after إِذَا of surprise (see وَإِذَا بِغَزَالَةٍ, 'and behold, a gazelle') + al-bāb, the door; 'and behold, the door...'
بِالْقَبُولِ: بِـ + الـ + قَبُول — bi-, with (prep.) + al-, the + qabūl, acceptance, welcome; 'graciously accepted'
بِإِزَارٍ: بِـ + إِزَار — bi-, in (prep., governed by مُلَفَّعَة, 'wrapped') + izār, a wrap, mantle; gen. indef.
بِجَبِينٍ: بِـ + جَبِين — bi-, with (prep.) + jabīn, brow, forehead; gen. indef.
بِحَاشِيَةِ: بِـ + حَاشِيَة — bi-, with (prep.) + ḥāshiya, border, hem; construct gen.
بِحَرِيرٍ: بِـ + حَرِير — bi-, of (prep., specifying material) + ḥarīr, silk; gen. indef.
بِدَرْقَتَيْنِ: بِـ + دَرْقَتَيْنِ — bi-, with (prep.) + darqa, door-panel, dual; 'with two panels'
بِشَرِيطٍ: بِـ + شَرِيط — bi-, with (prep.) + sharīṭ, ribbon, band; gen. indef.
بِصَفَائِحِ: بِـ + صَفَائِحِ — bi-, with (prep.) + ṣafīḥa, sheet, plate, pl. ṣafāʾiḥ; construct gen.
بِهُدْبِ: بِـ + هُدْب — bi-, with (prep.) + hudb, fringe, lash; construct gen.
بِيَدِهَا: بِـ + يَد + هَا — bi-, with (prep.) + yad, hand + -hā, her; 'with her hand'
تَبِعَهَا: تَبِعَ + هَا — tabiʿa, to follow + -hā, her; 'he followed her'
تَحْتِهَا: تَحْت + هَا — taḥt, beneath (prep./noun) + -hā, it; 'beneath it'
تَسَعُ: tasaʿu (from وَسِعَ, to hold, contain), 'it holds, is wide enough for'
تَمْرَحِنًا: tamraḥin, 'tamar ḥinnā' — henna-blossom (a fixed two-word plant-name written here as one token); acc. indef.
تُحَاكِي: tuḥākī (Form III of حَكَى, to imitate), 'it (fem.) resembles, rivals'
تِهَامِيٍّ: tihāmiyy, of Tihāma (nisba adj., the coastal Hejaz region); gen. indef., describing raisins
جَعَلَتْهُ: جَعَلَتْ + هُ — jaʿalat, she put, made + -hu, it; 'she put it'
حَاصِلٌ: ḥāṣil, obtained, secured (pass. part. of حَصَلَ); nom., 'assured'
حَطَّتِ: ḥaṭṭat (from حَطَّ, to set down), she set down, put
حُسْنِهَا: حُسْن + هَا — ḥusn, beauty + -hā, her; 'her beauty'
حُمْرٍ: ḥumr, red (pl. of أَحْمَر); gen. indef.
خُمَاسِيَّةُ: khumāsiyya, 'of five [spans]' (nisba from خَمْسَة, five), a stock phrase for an ideal, well-proportioned stature; nom.
خِلَافٍ: khilāf, willow (tree); gen. indef., in مَاء خِلَاف, 'willow-flower water'
دِينَارًا: dīnār, a dinar (gold coin); acc. indef.
ذَاتُ: dhāt, possessor of (fem.), lit. 'she of...'; nom. construct
رَيْحَانِيًّا: rayḥāniyyan, fragrant, sweet-scented (nisba adj. from رَيْحَان, sweet basil); acc. indef.
زَهْرٍ: zahr, blossom; gen. indef., in مَاء زَهْر, 'orange-blossom water'
زَيْتُونِيَّةً: zaytūniyya, of olives (nisba adj. from زَيْتُون, olive); acc. indef., describing the jar
زَيْنَبَ: Zaynab, a woman's proper name (diptote — gen. takes fatḥa); in أَمْشَاط زَيْنَب, 'Zaynab's-combs', a sweet-name
سُلْطَانِيًّا: sulṭāniyyan, royal, 'sultan's' (nisba adj. from سُلْطَان, sultan); acc. indef., describing bitter-oranges
شَاتْ: printed thus; read here as شَالَتْ, 'she lifted' (see the note on this sentence), and kept as printed
شَامِيًّا: shāmiyyan, Damascene, Syrian (nisba adj. from الشَّام, Damascus/Syria); acc. indef.
شَعْبَانَ: Shaʿbān, the eighth month of the Islamic calendar (diptote — gen. takes fatḥa)
شَعْرِيَّتَهَا: شَعْرِيَّة + هَا — shaʿriyya, a light mesh or gauze face-veil + -hā, her; 'her gauze veil'
شَقَايِقَ: shaqāyiq, anemones (pl. of شَقِيقَة, lit. 'little sister/fissure'); diptote, no tanwīn — شَقَايِق النُّعْمَان, 'anemones'
شِلْ: shil, a colloquial imperative, 'lift!, carry!' (standing in for classical اِحْمِلْ), recurring through this scene
صَدَّقَ: ṣaddaqa (Form II of صَدَقَ), to believe, credit; 'he believed'
عَالِيَةُ: ʿāliya, lofty, high (fem. act. part. of عَلَا); nom. construct
عَبَّتْ: ʿabbat (from عَبَّ, to heap, ladle up), 'she heaped, piled'
عَذْبٍ: ʿadhb, sweet, pleasant (of speech); gen. indef.
عَزَبًا: ʿazab, unmarried, a bachelor; acc. indef. (predicate of كَانَ)
عَلْمَانِيًّا: printed thus, describing the peaches; possibly a misprint for عُمَانِيًّا, 'Omani', but kept and read as printed; acc. indef.
عُثْمَانِيًّا: ʿuthmāniyyan, Ottoman (nisba adj. from عُثْمَان); acc. indef., describing quinces
عُيُونٌ: ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of عَيْن); nom. indef.
