فَالْتَفَتَتْ: فَـ + الْتَفَتَتْ — fa-, then (conj.) + iltafatat (Form VIII of لَفَتَ, to turn), she turned
فَأَتَتِ: فَـ + أَتَتِ — fa-, then (conj.) + atat, she came
فَأَعْطَتْهُ: فَـ + أَعْطَتْ + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + aʿṭat, she gave + -hu, him; 'so she gave him'
فَبَانَ: فَـ + بَانَ — fa-, then (conj.) + bāna, to appear, become visible; 'then there appeared'
فَبَيْنَا: فَـ + بَيْنَا — fa-, now (conj.) + baynā, while, as (temporal particle)
فَحَطَّتْهَا: فَـ + حَطَّتْ + هَا — fa-, then (conj.) + ḥaṭṭat, she put + -hā, it (fem.); 'then she put it'
فَطَرَقَتِ: فَـ + طَرَقَتِ — fa-, then (conj.) + ṭaraqat, she knocked
فَقَطَعَ: فَـ + قَطَعَ — fa-, so (conj.) + qaṭaʿa, he cut
فَكَهَانِيٍّ: fakahāniyy, a fruit-seller (nisba from فَاكِهَة, fruit); gen. indef.
فَوَقَفَتِ: فَـ + وَقَفَتِ — fa-, then (conj.) + waqafat, she stopped, stood
فَوَقَفَتْ: فَـ + وَقَفَتْ — fa-, then (conj.) + waqafat, she stopped, stood
فِحْلَيْ: printed thus, dual construct; almost certainly the stock image فِلْقَتَا رُمَّانٍ, 'two halves of a pomegranate', with letters out of order — kept and read as printed
قَطَايِفَ: qaṭāyif, qatayef — thin stuffed pancakes, a well-known sweet (pl.); gen. indef., diptote
قَفَصَكَ: قَفَص + كَ — qafaṣ, basket + -ka, your; 'your basket'
قَفَصِهِ: قَفَص + هِ — qafaṣ, basket + -hi, his; 'his basket'
قَلْبَ: qalb, heart — here 'kernel, shelled nut' (قَلْب فُسْتُق, 'shelled pistachio'); acc. construct
قِرْطَاسِ: qirṭās, a paper wrapper; construct gen.
قِزِّيزَ: qizzīz, a small glass flask or jar; acc. construct
كَاللُّؤْلُؤِ: كَـ + الـ + لُؤْلُؤِ — ka-, like (prep.) + al-, the + luʾluʾ, pearl; 'like the pearl'
كَالْمَرْجَانِ: كَـ + الـ + مَرْجَان — ka-, like (prep.) + al-, the + marjān, coral; 'like coral'
كَامِلَةِ: kāmila, complete, perfect (fem. act. part. of كَمَلَ); gen. construct
كَأَنَّهُمَا: كَـ + أَنَّ + هُمَا — ka-, as (prep.) + anna, that + -humā, the two of them; 'as though the two of them were'
كَخَاتَمِ: كَـ + خَاتَمِ — ka-, like (prep.) + khātam, a seal-ring; construct gen.
كُنْتِي: kunti, you (fem.) were (from كَانَ); the archive writes the fem. 2nd-person ending with a full ي rather than kasra alone, a Middle Arabic/colloquial spelling kept as printed
لَاعِبٍ: lāʿib, playing, sporting (act. part. of لَعِبَ); gen. indef., describing a fluttering ribbon
لَأَتَيْتُ: لَ + أَتَيْتُ — la-, indeed (emphatic particle marking the apodosis of a counterfactual) + ataytu, I would have come, brought; 'I would have brought'
لَحْمٍ: laḥm, meat; gen. indef. (specifying what the pounds are of)
لَيْمُونِيَّهْ: laymūniyya, lemon-flavored (nisba adj. from لَيْمُون, lemon); the archive spells the ending here with ه rather than ة, kept as printed
لِلْغِزْلَانِ: لِـ + الـ + غِزْلَانِ — li-, to, belonging to (prep.) + al-, the + ghizlān, gazelles; 'to the gazelles'
لِلْمِنْقَلِ: لِـ + الـ + مِنْقَلِ — li-, for (prep.) + al-, the + minqal, a portable brazier, roasting-pan; 'fit for roasting'
مَحْشِيَّةٍ: maḥshiyya, stuffed (pass. part. fem. of حَشَا); gen. indef.
مَرُوقَةً: marūqa, an uncertain word for a jar or vessel (perhaps a colloquial or otherwise-unattested form); acc. indef.
مَشْيِكَ: مَشْي + كَ — mashy, walking + -ka, your; 'your walking'
مَوْزٍ: mawz, banana; gen. indef., 'a wrapper of banana-leaf'
مَوْصِلِيٍّ: mawṣiliyy, of Mosul (nisba adj. from الْمَوْصِل, Mosul); gen. indef.
مُرَابِيًّا: murābiyyan, an uncertain adjective describing lemons, perhaps 'preserved, candied' (cf. مُرَبَّى, a fruit preserve); acc. indef.
مُزَرْكَشٍ: muzarkash, brocaded, embroidered with gold thread; gen. indef.
مُشَبَّكٍ: mushabbak, a lattice-shaped fried sweet soaked in syrup; gen. indef.
مُشَيَّدَةُ: mushayyada, firmly built, well-founded (pass. part. of شَيَّدَ); nom. construct
مُصَفَّحٌ: muṣaffaḥ, plated, sheathed (pass. part. of صَفَّحَ); nom.
مُلَبَّجٍ: an uncertain word, tentatively 'softly folded, rounded'; gen. indef., describing the belly
مُلَفَّعَةٌ: mulaffaʿa, wrapped, enveloped (pass. part. of لَفَّعَ); nom. indef.
مُمَسَّكٍ: mumassak, musk-scented (pass. part. of مَسَّكَ); gen. indef.
مُنْكِيًا: printed thus; almost certainly a slip for مُتَّكِئًا, 'leaning' (see the note on this sentence), and kept as printed
نَاعِمَةِ: nāʿima, soft, delicate (fem. act. part. of نَعُمَ); gen. construct
نَسْرِينًا: nasrīn, eglantine, wild rose; acc. indef.
نَهَارَ: nahār, day; acc. construct, in the exclamation يَا نَهَارَ السَّعَادَةِ, 'O day of happiness'
وَاتَّبِعْنِي: وَ + اتَّبِعْنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ittabiʿnī, follow me!
وَاعْتِدَالٍ: وَ + اعْتِدَالٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + iʿtidāl, symmetry, evenness; gen. indef.
وَاقِفٌ: wāqif, standing (act. part. of وَقَفَ); nom. indef.
وَالْأُقْحُوَانِ: وَ + الـ + أُقْحُوَانِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + uqḥuwān, chamomile; gen.
وَالْحَمَّالُ: وَ + الـ + حَمَّالُ — wa-, and, while (conj.) + al-, the + ḥammāl, porter; nom.
وَالْغِزْلَانَ: وَ + الـ + غِزْلَانَ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ghizlān, gazelles; acc.
وَأَجْرُكَ: وَ + أَجْرُ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ajr, wage + -ka, your; 'and your wage'
وَأَدَارَتِ: وَ + أَدَارَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + adārat (Form IV of دَارَ), she turned back, turned aside
وَأَصَابِعَ: وَ + أَصَابِعَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṣābiʿ, 'fingers' (a finger-shaped pastry, pl. of إِصْبَع); acc. indef., diptote
وَأَقْرَاصٍ: وَ + أَقْرَاصٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + aqrāṣ, discs, rounds, pl. of قُرْص; gen. indef.
وَأَمْشَاطِ: وَ + أَمْشَاطِ — wa-, and (conj.) + amshāṭ, combs, pl. of مِشْط; construct gen.
وَبَطْنٍ: وَ + بَطْنٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + baṭn, belly; gen. indef.
وَبَهَاءٍ: وَ + بَهَاءٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + bahāʾ, splendor, radiance; gen. indef.
وَتَبِعَهَا: وَ + تَبِعَهَا — wa-, and (conj.) + tabiʿahā, he followed her
وَتَشَرَّعَتِ: وَ + تَشَرَّعَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + tasharraʿat (Form V), it (fem., the pair of panels) swung open wide
وَجَمَالٍ: وَ + جَمَالٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + jamāl, loveliness; gen. indef.
وَجَمَالِهَا: وَ + جَمَال + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + jamāl, loveliness + -hā, her; 'and her loveliness'
وَجْهِهَا: وَجْه + هَا — wajh, face + -hā, her; 'her face'
وَحَصًا: وَ + حَصًا — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaṣan, pebbles, grains (of incense); acc. indef., printed here with a plain alif rather than the usual alif maqṣūra
وَحَطَّتِ: وَ + حَطَّتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaṭṭat, she put, set down
وَحَطَّتْهُ: وَ + حَطَّتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaṭṭat, she put + -hu, it; 'and she put it'
وَخَلِّ: وَ + خَلِّ — wa-, and (conj.) + khalli, imper. of خَلَّى, 'leave off!'
وَخُدُودٍ: وَ + خُدُودٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + khudūd, cheeks, pl. of خَدّ; gen. indef.
وَدَقَّتْ: وَ + دَقَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + daqqat, she knocked
وَرْدٍ: ward, rose; gen. indef. construct, 'water of rose'
وَسُرَّةٍ: وَ + سُرَّةٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + surra, navel; gen. indef.
وَسُنَيْنَاتٍ: وَ + سُنَيْنَاتٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + sunaynāt, little teeth (diminutive pl. of سِنّ); gen. indef.
وَشُفَيْهَاتٍ: وَ + شُفَيْهَاتٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + shufayhāt, little lips (diminutive pl. of شَفَة); gen. indef.
وَصَابُونِيَّةٍ: وَ + صَابُونِيَّةٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣābūniyya, a soap-shaped sweet (nisba from صَابُون, soap); gen. indef.
وَصَدْرٍ: وَ + صَدْرٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣadr, breast, chest; gen. indef.
وَعَنْبَرًا: وَ + عَنْبَرًا — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿanbar, ambergris; acc. indef.
وَعُنُقٍ: وَ + عُنُقٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿunuq, neck; gen. indef.
وَعُودًا: وَ + عُودًا — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿūd, aloeswood; acc. indef.
وَعُيُونٍ: وَ + عُيُونٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿuyūn, eyes; gen. indef.
وَقُدَّامَهَا: وَ + قُدَّامَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + quddāma, before, in front of (prep.) + -hā, it; 'and before it'
وَكَمَالٍ: وَ + كَمَالٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + kamāl, perfection; gen. indef.
وَلَفَّتْهُ: وَ + لَفَّتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + laffat, she wrapped + -hu, it; 'and she wrapped it'
وَلُقَيْمَاتِ: وَ + لُقَيْمَاتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + luqaymāt, little morsels (diminutive pl. of لُقْمَة); construct gen.
وَمَاءَ: وَ + مَاءَ — wa-, and (conj.) + māʾ, water; acc. construct
وَمَيْمُونِيَّهْ: وَ + مَيْمُونِيَّهْ — wa-, and (conj.) + maymūniyya, 'the fortunate one', a sweet-name; the ending is printed with ه rather than ة, kept as printed
وَمِسْكًا: وَ + مِسْكًا — wa-, and (conj.) + misk, musk; acc. indef.
وَنَهْدَيْنِ: وَ + نَهْدَيْنِ — wa-, and (conj.) + nahdayni, two breasts (dual of نَهْد)
شمسِ: شَمْس, sun (f.); 'sun of the palaces' (genitive after إلى)
القصورِ: الـ + قَصْر (pl. قُصُور) — qaṣr, palace; al-, the: 'of the palaces'
وبدرِها: و + بَدْر + ها — wa-, and (conj.) + badr, full moon (m.) + -hā, her/its; 'and her full moon'
خزامتِها: خِزَامَة + ها — khizāma, lavender / fragrant herb (f.) + -hā, her; 'her fragrance'
وبهجةِ: و + بَهْجَة — wa-, and (conj.) + bahja, splendor/radiance (f.); 'and the splendor of'
زهرِها: زَهْر + ها — zahr, blossom/flower (m.) + -hā, her; 'her blossom'
تلقَ: لقي — talqa, she/you(f.) find/meet (jussive of talqā, from laqiya)
عينُك: عَيْن + ك — ʿayn, eye (f.) + -ka, your; 'your eye'
الجمالِ: الـ + جَمَال — al-, the + jamāl, beauty
لونَها: لَوْن + ها — lawn, color (m.) + -hā, her; 'her color'
شعرِها: شَعْر + ها — shaʿr, hair (m.) + -hā, her; 'her hair'
محمرّةُ: مُحْمَرّ — muḥmarr, reddened/rosy (f. active participle of iḥmarra, 'to turn red')
الوجناتِ: الـ + وَجَنَات (pl. of وَجْنَة) — al-, the + wajanāt, cheeks (f.); 'of the cheeks'
حسنُها: حُسْن + ها — ḥusn, beauty (m.) + -hā, her; 'her beauty'
اسمِها: اِسْم + ها — ism, name (m.) + -hā, her; 'her name'
يحظَ: حظي — yaḥẓa, attains/has the fortune of (subjunctive of yaḥẓā, from ḥaẓiya)
بخبرِها: بِـ + خَبَر + ها — bi-, with, governed by يحظى ('attain to') + khabar, news/report (m.) + -hā, her; 'of news of her'
تَمَايَلَتْ: تمايل — tamāyalat, she swayed (past f., Form V of م-ي-ل)
فَضَحِكَتْ: ف + ضحك — fa-, and then (conj.) + ḍaḥikat, she laughed (past f.)
اردافِها: أَرْدَاف (pl. of رِدْف) + ها — ardāf, hips/buttocks (m.) + -hā, her; 'her hips'
وَلٰكِنِّي: و + لٰكِنَّ + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + lākinna, but (particle) + -ī, I/my; 'but I'
لخصرِها: لِـ + خَصْر + ها — li-, for, governed by بكيت ('weep for') + khaṣr, waist (m.) + -hā, her; 'for her waist'
عَقْلَهُ: عَقْل + ه — ʿaql, mind/reason (m.) + -hu, his; 'his mind'
وَلُبَّهُ: و + لُبّ + ه — wa-, and (conj.) + lubb, wit/inmost core (m.) + -hu, his; 'and his wits'
وَكَادَ: و + كاد — wa-, and (conj.) + kāda, he nearly (did) (verb of imminence)
الْقَفَصُ: الـ + قَفَص — al-, the + qafaṣ, basket/cage (m., nom.); 'the basket'
يَقَعَ: وقع — yaqaʿa, it fall (subjunctive of yaqaʿu, from waqaʿa)
أَبْرَكَ: أَبْرَك, more blessed (elative of baraka/bāraka, acc.)
الْبَوَّابَةُ: الـ + بَوَّابَة — al-, the + bawwāba, doorkeeper/portress (f., nom.); 'the doorkeeper'
الشُّوَشْكَاشَةُ: الـ + شُوَشْكَاشَة — al-, the + shūshkāsha, marketing-girl (f., nom.); an obscure loanword for the household servant who does the shopping, one of the three sisters, named by her role rather than a personal name (the archive spells this servant-title four ways across the night: شوشكاشة، خوشكاشة، خوشكاشة، خشكاشة — same person throughout)
ادْخُلِي: دخل — udkhulī, enter! (imperative f.sg. of dakhala)
وَحُطِّي: و + حطي — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥuṭṭī, take down!/unload! (imperative f.sg. of ḥaṭṭa)
الْمِسْكِينِ: الـ + مِسْكِين — al-, the + miskīn, poor/wretched (m., gen.); 'the poor'
فَدَخَلَتِ: ف + دخلت — fa-, and (conj.) + dakhalat, she entered (past f.)
وَمَشَوْا: و + مشوا — wa-, and (conj.) + mashaw, they walked (past 3pl.)
اِنْتَهَوْا: انتهى — intahaw, they arrived/came to an end (past 3pl., Form VIII of نهى)
مُهَنْدَسِيَّةٍ: muhandasiyya, well-engineered/architectural (f. adj. from handasa, 'geometry/engineering', indef. gen.)
مَاحِيَةٍ: māḥiya, whitewashed (f. active participle of maḥā, 'erase/plaster', indef. gen.)
ذَاتِ: dhāti, possessing/having (f. construct of dhāt, '[one] having')
تَرَاكِيبَ: tarākīb, fittings/fixtures (pl. of tarkīb, 'assemblage', indef. acc.)
عُقُودَاتٍ: و + عقودات — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿuqūdāt, arches/vaultings (pl. of ʿaqd, indef. gen.)
سَدَلَاتٍ: و + سدلات — wa-, and (conj.) + sadalāt, drapings/hangings (pl. of sadla, from sadala 'let hang down', indef. gen.)
خَرَسَانَاتٍ: و + خرسانات — wa-, and (conj.) + kharasānāt, [uncertain word — perhaps raised stone/masonry platforms] (indef. gen.)
مُرْخِيَاتٌ: murkhiyāt, let-down/hanging (f.pl. active participle of arkhā, 'let down')
الْقَاعَهِ: الـ + قاعه — al-, the + qāʿa, hall (f., gen.); the edition here spells قاعة with ه instead of the usual ة
مَلَانَةٌ: malāna, full (f.; a Middle-Arabic form of Classical mumtali'a/malā, 'full of')
الْقَاعَةِ: الـ + قاعة — al-, the + qāʿa, hall (f., gen.)
الْعَرْعَرِ: الـ + عرعر — al-, the + ʿarʿar, juniper(-wood)
بِالْجَوْهَرِ: بِـ + الـ + جوهر — bi-, with (prep., instrumental after مرصّع 'studded with') + al-, the + jawhar, jewel/gem
مُرْخِي: murkhī, hung/let down (participle of arkhā; the edition spells it with ي rather than the expected alif maqṣūra)
أَزْرَارُهَا: أَزْرَار (pl. of زِرّ) + ها — azrār, buttons/toggles (m.) + -hā, its; 'its buttons'
الْبُنْدُقِ: الـ + بندق — al-, the + bunduq, hazelnut(s)
وَأَكْبَرَ: و + أكبر — wa-, and (conj.) + akbar, larger/bigger (elative)
دَاخِلِهَا: دَاخِل + ها — dākhil, interior/inside (m.) + -hā, its; 'from within it'
بِطَلْعَةٍ: بِـ + طلعة — bi-, with (prep.) + ṭalʿa, countenance/appearance (f., indef. gen.)
مُضِيَّةٍ: muḍiyya, radiant/shining (f., indef. gen.; a variant spelling of muḍī'a, without the hamza)
وَأَخْلَاقٍ: و + أخلاق — wa-, and (conj.) + akhlāq, character/manners (pl. of khuluq, indef. gen.)
فَيْلَسُوفِيَّةٍ: faylasūfiyya, philosophic (f. adj. from faylasūf, 'philosopher', indef. gen.)
بِخِلْقَةٍ: بِـ + خلقة — bi-, with (prep.) + khilqa, form/build (f., indef. gen.)
قَمَرِيَّةٍ: qamariyya, moon-like (f. adj. from qamar, 'moon', indef. gen.)
بَابِلِيَّةٍ: bābiliyya, Babylonian (f. adj., indef. gen.; evoking Babylon's legendary sorcery — bewitching eyes)
مَحْنِيَّةٍ: maḥniyya, arched/bent (f. passive participle of ḥanā, indef. gen.)
أَلِفِيَّةٍ: alifiyya, alif-like/straight (f. adj. from the letter alif, indef. gen.)
عَنْبَرِيَّةٍ: ʿanbariyya, ambergris-scented (f. adj. from ʿanbar, 'ambergris', indef. gen.)
عَقِيقِيَّةٍ: ʿaqīqiyya, carnelian(-colored) (f. adj. from ʿaqīq, 'carnelian', indef. gen.)
سُكَّرِيَّةٍ: sukkariyya, sugary/sweet (f. adj. from sukkar, 'sugar', indef. gen.)
يُخْجِلُ: خجل — yukhjilu, puts to shame/embarrasses (impf. of akhjala, Form IV)
نُورُهُ: نُور + ه — nūr, light (m.) + -hu, its; 'its light'
الْمُضِيَّةَ: الـ + مضية — al-, the + muḍiyya, radiant (f. acc., agreeing with الشمس)
كَأَنَّهَا: كَأَنَّ + ها — ka'anna, as though (particle) + -hā, she; 'as though she'
الْكَوَاكِبِ: الـ + كواكب — al-, the + kawākib, stars (pl. of kawkab)
الْعُلْوِيَّةِ: الـ + علوية — al-, the + ʿulwiyya, celestial/heavenly (f. adj. from ʿulw, 'height')
مُجَلِّيَةٌ: mujalliya, resplendent, one displayed at her unveiling (f. active participle of jallā, Form II)
لِيَّةٌ: obscure/uncertain word, kept exactly as printed (see note) — perhaps a compositor's corruption of another noun continuing this list of similes

تبسّمَ: تبسم — tabassama, he/it smiled (past; here of the mouth, 'smiled to reveal...')
لولوٍ: printed variant of لُؤْلُؤ, 'pearl' (kept exactly as printed — already marked, indef. gen.)
بردٍ: barad, hail(stones) (m., indef. gen.; a stock image for white teeth)
اقاحِ: uqāḥ, camomile — a white flower, another stock image for white teeth (kept exactly as printed — already marked)
طرّةٍ: ṭurra, forelock/fringe of hair (f., indef. gen.)
كالليلِ: كَـ + الليل — ka-, like (prep.) + al-layl, the night; 'like the night'
مسبولةٍ: masbūla, let down/flowing (f. passive participle of sabala, indef. gen.)
تخجلُ: خجل — tukhjilu, puts to shame (impf. 3f. of akhjala, Form IV; parallel to يخجل above)
ضوءَ: ḍaw', light (m., acc.; object of تخجل)
الصباحِ: الـ + صباح — al-, the + ṣabāḥ, morning
فَنَهَضَتِ: ف + نهضت — fa-, and (conj.) + nahaḍat, she rose up (past f.)
أَخَوَاتِهَا: أَخَوَات (pl. of أُخْت) + ها — akhawāt, sisters (f.) + -hā, her; 'her sisters'
وُقُوفُكُمْ: وُقُوف + كم — wuqūf, standing (m., verbal noun of waqafa) + -kum, your; 'your standing'
حُطُّوا: حُطّ — ḥuṭṭū, take down!/unload! (imperative m.pl. of ḥaṭṭa)
فَجَاءَتِ: ف + جاءت — fa-, and (conj.) + jā'at, she came (past f.)
الْخُوشْكَاشَةُ: الـ + خُوشْكَاشَة — al-, the + khūshkāsha, marketing-girl (f., nom.); a spelling variant of الشوشكاشة above, same person, same role-title
قُدَّامُ: quddāmu, in front (indeclinable adverb of place, takes damma when 'cut off' from a following genitive)
وَالْبَوَّابَةُ: و + البوابة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-bawwāba, the doorkeeper (f., nom.)
وَسَاعَدَتْهُمُ: و + ساعدتهم — wa-, and (conj.) + sāʿadat, she helped (past f.) + -hum, them; 'and helped them'
وَحَطُّوا: و + حطوا — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaṭṭū, they took down (past 3m.pl.)
وَأَفْرَغُوا: و + أفرغوا — wa-, and (conj.) + afraghū, they emptied out (past 3m.pl., Form IV of faragha)
وَوَضَعُوا: و + وضعوا — wa-, and (conj.) + waḍaʿū, they put/placed (past 3m.pl.)
مَحَلِّهِ: مَحَلّ + ه — maḥall, place (m.) + -hi, its; 'its place'
وَأَعْطَوُا: و + أعطوا — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿṭawu, they gave (past 3m.pl., Form IV of aʿṭā)
الْحَمَّالَ: الـ + حمال — al-, the + ḥammāl, porter (m., acc.)
تَوَجَّهْ: توجه — tawajjah, be off!/go on your way! (imperative m.sg. of tawajjaha)
الصَّبَايَا: الـ + صبايا — al-, the + ṣabāyā, girls (pl. of ṣabiyya)
وَالطَّبَايِعِ: و + الطبايع — wa-, and (conj.) + al-ṭabāyiʿ, natures/temperaments (colloquial pl. of ṭabīʿa)
الْحِسَانِ: الـ + حسان — al-, the + ḥisān, beautiful/fine (pl. adj., agreeing with الطبايع)
وَالْفَوَاكِهِ: و + الفواكه — wa-, and (conj.) + al-fawākih, the fruits (pl. of fākiha)
وَالْمَشْمُومَاتِ: و + المشمومات — wa-, and (conj.) + al-mashmūmāt, sweet-scented herbs/flowers (pl. passive participle of shamma, 'to smell')
وَغَيْرِ: و + غير — wa-, and (conj.) + ghayr, other than
فَقَانَتْ: printed thus for فَقَالَتْ, 'she said' (see note — the ن is an apparent misprint for ل, kept as printed)
كَأَنَّكَ: كَأَنَّ + ك — ka'anna, as though (particle) + -ka, you; 'as though you'
اِسْتَقْلَيْتَ: استقل — istaqlayta, you deemed [it] too little (past 2m.sg.; a Middle-Arabic spelling of Classical istaqlalta)
الْأُجْرَةَ: الـ + أجرة — al-, the + ujra, fee/wage (f., acc.)
اِلْتَفَتَتْ: التفت — iltafatat, she turned (past f., Form VIII of ل-ف-ت)
أُخْتِهَا: أُخْت + ها — ukht, sister (f.) + -hā, her; 'her sister'
أَعْطِيهِ: أعطى + ه — aʿṭī, give! (imperative f.sg. of aʿṭā) + -hi, him/it; 'give him'
آخَرَ: ākhar, another (m., acc.; already spelled with the hamza character in the edition, kept as printed)
سِتِّي: sittī, my lady (colloquial form of Classical sayyidatī)
اِسْتَقْلَيْتُ: استقل — istaqlaytu, I deemed [it] too little (past 1sg.; same Middle-Arabic spelling as above)
وَأُجْرَتِي: و + أجرة + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + ujra, fee/wage (f.) + -ī, my; 'and my wage'
تُسَاوِي: ساوى — tusāwī, is worth/equals (impf. 3f. of sāwā)
اِشْتَغَلَ: اشتغل — ishtaghala, became occupied (past, Form VIII of shaghala)
وَسِرِّي: و + سر + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + sirr, secret/inmost mind (m.) + -ī, my; 'and my inmost mind'
يُونِسُكُمْ: أنس — yūnisukum, gives you company (impf. of ānasa, Form IV; printed without the expected hamza-seat ؤ of Classical يؤنسكم)
وَأَنْتُمْ: و + أنتم — wa-, and (conj.) + antum, you (m.pl.)
الْمَأْدُبَةَ: الـ + مأدبة — al-, the + ma'duba, banquet/feast (f., acc.)
يَطِيبُ: طاب — yaṭību, is pleasant/sweet (impf. of ṭāba)
بِالرِّجَالِ: بِـ + الـ + رجال — bi-, with (prep.) + al-, the + rijāl, men
قِسِيِّ: قِسِيّ — qisiyy, bows (pl. of qaws, construct)
بَرَزَتْ: بَرَزَتْ — barazat, 'she came forth, emerged' (past f.)
خَزَائِنَ: خَزَائِنَ — khazāʾin, cupboards/cabinets (pl. of khizāna, indef. acc./gen.)
نَكْهَتٍ: نَكْهَتٍ — nakha, 'scent, breath' (f., indef. gen.; printed with ت rather than the expected ة)
شُفَيْفَاتٍ: شُفَيْفَاتٍ — shufayfāt, 'little lips' (diminutive pl. of shafa, 'lip', indef. gen.)
تَوَقَّفَ: تَوَقَّفَ — tawaqqafa, 'he held back, stopped' (past, Form V of و ق ف)
عُيُونٍ: عُيُونٍ — ʿuyūn, 'eyes' (pl. of ʿayn, indef. gen.)
خَطَرَتْ: خَطَرَتْ — khaṭarat, 'she swaggered, walked with a slow swaying gait' (past f., from خطر)
أَخْلَاقٍ: akhlāq, 'character, disposition' (pl. of khuluq, indef. gen.)
أَما: أَ + مَا — interrogative hamza + mā (not); 'do you not see...?' (rhetorical)
أَربَعاً: arbaʿah, four; here accusative indefinite ('four things')
لِلَّهوِ: لِـ + الـ + لَهْو — li-, for (prep.) + lahw, amusement, pleasure (m.); 'for pleasure'
قَل: qalla, to be few, be rare (here printed 'qal', without the shadda); 'rarely'
جَمَعَت: jamaʿa, to gather, come together (perf. 3rd f.sg. jamaʿat, agreeing with arbaʿan)
وَافَقَتها: وَافَقَتْ + هَا — wāfaqat (form III of wafaqa, 'to match, agree with') + -hā, them (f.); 'and matching them'
المَشمُومِ: الـ + مَشْمُوم — al- + mashmūm, that which is smelled, a fragrance (pass. part. of shamma, to smell)
اَربَعَة: arbaʿah, four (here printed اَربَعَة, with plain alif and no hamza sign, unlike أَربَعاً above)
مَنشُورٌ: manshūr, lit. 'unfolded, spread out' (pass. part. of nashara); here the name of a fragrant flower, perhaps a variant spelling of منثور, narcissus/scattered blossom
يَحسُنُ: ḥasuna, to be good, fair, fitting (imperf. yaḥsunu, 'is fine')
الَّا: illā, except, only (here printed اَلَّا, without the hamza-kasra sign)
بِاَربَعَة: بِـ + أَربَعَة — bi-, with, by (prep.) + arbaʿah, four; 'by four things'
مَعشُوقٌ: maʿshūq, beloved (pass. part. of ʿashiqa, to love passionately)
دِينَارُ: dīnār, a gold coin (loanword, ultimately from Latin denarius)
ثَلٰثَةٌ: thalāthah, three (here defectively spelled ثلثة, missing the medial alif; pointed here with a dagger alif to keep the correct rasm)
وَتَحْتَاجُونَ: وَ + تَحْتَاجُونَ — wa-, and + taḥtājūna (form VIII of ḥ-w-j, 'to need'), you need
رَابِعٍ: rābiʿ, fourth (ordinal); genitive indefinite after ilā
وَيَكُونُ: وَ + يَكُونُ — wa-, and + yakūnu (kāna, to be), he should be
لِلْأَسْرَارِ: وَ + لِـ + الـ + أَسْرَار — wa-, and + li-, for (prep., marking the predicate) + al- + asrār, pl. of sirr, secret (m.); 'and for the secrets'
كَاتِمًا: kātim, one who conceals, keeps (act. part. of katama, to conceal); predicate of yakūnu
سَمِعُوا: samiʿa, to hear (perf. 3rd m.pl. samiʿū); 'they heard'
أَعْجَبَهُمْ: أَعْجَبَ + هُمْ — aʿjaba, to please, delight (form IV of ʿajiba) + -hum, them; 'it pleased them'
وَضَحِكُوا: وَ + ضَحِكُوا — wa-, and + ḍaḥikū (ḍaḥika, to laugh), they laughed
بِذَلِكَ: بِـ + ذَلِكَ — bi-, with (prep.) + dhālika, that; 'with that'
بَنَاتٌ: banāt, girls (irregular pl. of bint); indefinite predicate
نَخَافُ: khāfa, to fear (imperf. 1st pl. nakhāfu); 'we fear'
نُودِعَ: awdaʿa, to entrust, deposit (form IV of wadaʿa) (here imperf. subj. 1st pl. nūdiʿa, 'we entrust', after an elided an)
السِّرَّ: الـ + سِرّ — al- + sirr, secret (m.); accusative object
يَحْفَظُهُ: يَحْفَظُ + هُ — yaḥfaẓu (ḥafiẓa, to keep, guard) + -hu, it; 'keeps it'
قَرَأْنَا: qaraʾa, to read (perf. 1st pl. qaraʾnā); 'we have read'
الْأَخْبَارِ: الـ + أَخْبَار — al- + akhbār, pl. of khabar, report, account (m.); 'the reports'
قَالَهُ: قَالَ + هُ — qāla, to say + -hu, it; 'he said it'
الثَّمَّامِ: al-Thammām, a proper name; genitive, second term of the construct 'Ibn al-Thammām'
صُنِ: ṣāna, to guard, protect (imperative 2nd m.sg., here with a connecting kasra: ṣuni)
جَهلَك: جَهْل + كَ — jahl, ignorance (m.) + -ka, your; printed thus, though the sense ('guard the secret with all your might') suggests جُهْد, jahd, effort, may be the word intended
وَلا: وَ + لَا — wa-, and + lā, not
تُودِعهُ: تُودِعْ + هُ — tūdiʿ (awdaʿa, to entrust, form IV; here jussive after lā) + -hu, it; 'do not entrust it'
فَمَن: فَ + مَنْ — fa-, for + man, whoever
اَودَعَ: awdaʿa, to entrust, deposit (form IV of wadaʿa); perf. 3rd m.sg.
ضَيَّعَه: ضَيَّعَ + هُ — ḍayyaʿa, to lose, waste (form II of ḍāʿa) + -hu, it
أَطْلَعَ: aṭlaʿa, to let (someone) see, inform (form IV of ṭalaʿa, to appear, rise)
اسْتَوْجَبَ: istawjaba, to deserve, earn (form X of wajaba, to be due, obligatory)
الذُّلَّ: الـ + ذُلّ — al- + dhull, humiliation, disgrace (m.); accusative object
جَبْهَتِهِ: جَبْهَة + هِ — jabhah, forehead, brow (f.) + -hi, his
وَحَيَائَهُمْ: وَ + حَيَاء + هُمْ — wa-, and + ḥayāʾ, shyness, modesty (m.) + -hum, their
قَرَأْتُ: qaraʾa, to read (perf. 1st sg. qaraʾtu); 'I have read'
وَطَالَعْتُ: وَ + طَالَعْتُ — wa-, and + ṭālaʿtu (ṭālaʿa, to study, peruse, form III), I studied
التَّوَارِيخَ: الـ + تَوَارِيخ — al- + tawārīkh, pl. of tārīkh, history, chronicle; accusative object
أَظْهَرْتُ: aẓhara, to show, reveal (form IV of ẓahara); perf. 1st sg.
وَأَخْفَيْتُ: وَ + أَخْفَيْتُ — wa-, and + akhfaytu (akhfā, to conceal, form IV of khafiya), I concealed
الْقَبِيحَ: الـ + قَبِيح — al- + qabīḥ, the foul, the ugly (thing); accusative object
وَالشَّاعِرُ: وَ + الـ + شَاعِر — wa-, and + al- + shāʿir, poet; nominative subject
كَلَامِهِ: كَلَام + هِ — kalām, speech (m.) + -hi, his; genitive after fī
وَالسِّرُّ: وَ + الـ + سِرّ — wa-, and + al- + sirr, the secret; nominative subject
خِيَارِ: khiyār, the best (of); genitive, construct with al-nās
مَكْتُومُ: maktūm, kept, concealed (pass. part. of katama); predicate
السِّرُّ: الـ + سِرّ — al- + sirr, the secret; nominative subject
ضَاعَتْ: ḍāʿa, to be lost (perf. 3rd f.sg. ḍāʿat); 'were lost'
مَفَاتِيحُهُ: مَفَاتِيح + هُ — mafātīḥ, pl. of miftāḥ, key (m.) + -hu, its
وَالْبَابُ: وَ + الـ + بَاب — wa-, and + al- + bāb, door; nominative subject
مَخْتُومُ: makhtūm, sealed (pass. part. of khatama, to seal)
الْبَنَاتُ: الـ + بَنَات — al- + banāt, the girls; nominative subject
وَالنِّظَامَ: وَ + الـ + نِظَام — wa-, and + al- + niẓām, arrangement, rhyme-scheme; accusative object, conjoined with al-shiʿr
أَبَاحَ: abāḥa, to disclose, reveal, make permissible (form IV of bāḥa)
قُلْنَ: qāla, to say (perf. 3rd f.pl. qulna); 'they [f.] said'
أَنَّنَا: أَنَّ + نَا — anna, that (subordinating particle) + -nā, we; 'that we'
غَرِمْنَا: gharima, to incur a loss, an expense (perf. 1st pl. gharimnā); 'we spent, we were out'
الْمَقَامِ: الـ + مَقَام — al- + maqām, place, station, gathering (m.); genitive after ʿalā
جُمْلَةً: jumlah, a sum, a total (f.); accusative
فَهَلْ: فَ + هَلْ — fa-, so + hal, is there? (interrogative particle)
تَعَارَفْنَا: taʿārafa, to become acquainted with one another (form VI of ʿarafa, to know); perf. 1st pl., 'we became acquainted'
فَنَحْنُ: فَ + نَحْنُ — fa-, for, so + naḥnu, we
نَدَعُكَ: نَدَعُ + كَ — nadaʿu (wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let) + -ka, you; 'we let you'
وَتَصِيرُ: وَ + تَصِيرُ — wa-, and + taṣīru (ṣāra, to become), you become
نَدِيمَنَا: نَدِيم + نَا — nadīm, boon-companion, drinking-companion (m.) + -nā, our
وَتُشْرِفُ: وَ + تُشْرِفُ — wa-, and + tushrifu (ashrafa ʿalā, form IV, 'to look out over, gaze upon'), you gaze upon
وُجُوهَنَا: وُجُوه + نَا — wujūh, pl. of wajh, face (m.) + -nā, our
الصِّبَاحَ: الـ + صِبَاح — al- + ṣibāḥ, fair, radiant (pl. of ṣabīḥ); accusative, describing wujūhanā

تُوزَنَ: wazana, to weigh (pass. subj. tūzana); 'is weighed out'
أَلَا: alā, now then, indeed (particle calling for attention, introducing the question that follows)
سَمِعْتَ: samiʿa, to hear (perf. 2nd m.sg. samiʿta); 'you heard'
الْمَثَلِ: الـ + مَثَل — al- + mathal, proverb, saying (m.); genitive, construct with ṣāḥib
حَبَّهٍ: ḥabbah, a grain, a seed (f.); here spelled with plain ه instead of ة; genitive after bilā. The proverb puns on ḥabbah (a grain) echoing ḥubb/maḥabbah, love
حَبَّهً: ḥabbah, a grain (f., spelled with ه as above); accusative object of tusāwī
رُوحْ: rāḥa, to go (here a colloquial imperative 'go!', spelled with a full wāw as in spoken usage, rather than the Classical ruḥ)
الْخَوْشْكَاشَةُ: الـ + خَوْشْكَاشَة — al-, the + khawshkāsha, marketing-girl (nom.); another spelling variant of الشوشكاشة above, same person, same role-title (not a personal name)
كُفُّوا: kaffa, to stop, desist (imperative 2nd m.pl. kuffū); 'stop! leave off!'
قَصَّرَ: qaṣṣara, to fall short, be lacking (form II of qaṣura)
غَيْرَهُ: غَيْر + هُ — ghayr, other (than) + -hu, him; 'someone other than him'
طَوَّلَ: ṭawwala, to prolong (form II of ṭāla, to be long)
رُوحَهُ: رُوح + هُ — rūḥ, soul, spirit (m., used idiomatically for 'oneself') + -hu, his
مَهْمَا: وَ + مَهْمَا — wa-, and + mahmā, whatever
أُوزِنُهُ: أُوزِنُ + هُ — ūzinu (awzana, form IV of wazana, 'to weigh out, pay') + -hu, it; 'I will pay it out'
وَشَكَرَ: وَ + شَكَرَ — wa-, and + shakara, he thanked
صَاحِبَةُ: ṣāḥibah, mistress of, the one in charge of (f. of ṣāḥib); nominative, construct with al-sarīr
بِشَرْطٍ: بِـ + شَرْط — bi-, with, on (prep.) + sharṭ, a condition; genitive indefinite
يَسْأَلَ: saʾala, to ask (subj. yasʾala, after an lā)
عَمَّا: عَنْ + مَا — ʿan, about (prep.) + mā, what; 'about what'
يَعْنِيهِ: يَعْنِي + هِ — yaʿnī (ʿanā, to concern) + -hi, him; 'concerns him'
وَإِنْ: وَ + إِنْ — wa-, and + in, if
تَفَاضَلَ: tafāʿala-pattern verb from f-ḍ-l (form VI); here apparently 'to overstep, presume' — an uncertain reading; the sense the context calls for, though the verb form is unusual
يُضْرَبْ: ḍaraba, to strike (pass. jussive yuḍrab); 'he is beaten' (apodosis of the conditional)
الرَّأْسِ: الـ + رَأْس — al- + raʾs, head (m.); genitive after ʿalā
وَالْعَيْنِ: وَ + الـ + عَيْن — wa-, and + al- + ʿayn, eye (f.); genitive
لِسَانٍ: lisān, tongue (m.); genitive indefinite after bilā
وَشَدَّتْ: وَ + شَدَّتْ — wa-, and + shaddat (shadda, to tie, bind), she bound
وَسَطَهَا: وَسَط + هَا — wasaṭ, middle, waist (m.) + -hā, her
وَصَفَّتِ: وَ + صَفَّتِ — wa-, and + ṣaffati (ṣaffa, form II, to line up, arrange), she arranged
الْقَنَانِيَ: الـ + قَنَانِي — al- + qanānī, pl. of qinnīnah, a flask, bottle (f.); accusative
وَرَوَّقَتِ: وَ + رَوَّقَتِ — wa-, and + rawwaqati (rawwaqa, form II, to clarify, strain a liquid), she strained
الْمُدَامَ: الـ + مُدَام — al- + mudām, wine; accusative object
وَعَمِلَتِ: وَ + عَمِلَتِ — wa-, and + ʿamilati (ʿamila, to make, do), she made
الْخُضْرَةَ: الـ + خُضْرَة — al- + khuḍrah, greenery, a relish of fresh herbs (f.); accusative object
جَانِبٍ: jānib, a side (m.); genitive indefinite after ʿalā, 'on/to one side'
لِلْأَسْرَارِ: لِـ + الـ + أَسْرَار — pl. of سِرّ, 'secret'; li- marks the object of كَاتِم ('keeper of'): 'and a keeper of secrets'
أَحْضَرَتْ: أَحْضَرَتْ — form IV of حَضَرَ, aḥḍara, to bring/fetch; 'she brought'
قَدَّمَتِ: قَدَّمَتْ — form II of قَدِمَ, qaddama, to present/serve (+ i, helper vowel before al-); 'she served'
أُخْتَاهَا: أُخْتَا + هَا — ukht, sister (f., dual nom. أُخْتَا) + -hā, her; 'her two sisters'
بَيْنَهُنَّ: بَيْنَ + هُنَّ — bayna, between/among (prep.) + -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'among them'
قَدَّمَتْ: قَدَّمَتْ — form II of قَدِمَ, qaddamat, she presented/served
بَاطِيَةَ: بَاطِيَة — bāṭiya, flagon/decanter (f.); 'the flagon of' (acc., construct)
الْمُدَامِ: الـ + مُدَام — mudām, wine (m.); 'the wine' (gen., second term of construct)
أَوَّلَ: أَوَّل — awwal, first (ordinal); 'a first' (acc., construct with what follows)
شَرِبَتْهُ: شَرِبَتْ + هُ — shariba, to drink + -hu, it (m.); 'she drank it'
نَاوَلَتْ: نَاوَلَتْ — form III of نول, nāwala, to hand/pass to someone; 'she handed'
أُخْتَهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f.) + -hā, her; 'her sister' (acc.)
نَاوَلَتِ: نَاوَلَتْ — she handed (+ i, helper vowel before al-)
اِشْرَبْ: اِشْرَبْ — imper. of شَرِبَ (hamzat waṣl); ishrab, 'drink!' (2 m. sg.)
مُتَّسِعاً: مُتَّسِع + اً — muttasiʿ, ample/abundant (act. part. of form VIII اِتَّسَعَ) + -an; 'abundantly'
بِالْعَوافِي: بِـ + الـ + عَوافِي — bi-, with/in (prep., governed by the sense 'drink in...') + ʿawāfī, pl. of ʿāfiya, health, wellbeing; 'in good health'
الشُّرْبَ: الـ + شُرْب — shurb, drinking (verbal noun of شَرِبَ); 'the drink' (acc.)
لِلدَّاءِ: لِـ + الـ + دَاء — li-, for (prep., 'a cure for'; governed by شَافِي) + dāʾ, illness/disease (m.); 'for illness'
شَافِي: شَافٍ — shāfin, healing, a cure (act. part. of شَفَى); printed without tanwīn; 'a cure'
خَدَمَ: خَدَمَ — khadama, to serve; here, to make a gesture of homage
الْكَاسَ: الـ + كَاس — kās, cup (f., variant spelling of كَأْس); 'the cup' (acc.)
اَخٍ: أَخٍ — akh, brother (m.); 'a brother' (gen. indef., printed without the hamza mark)
طَاهِرِ: طَاهِر — ṭāhir, pure, clean (act. part. of طَهُرَ); 'pure of' (gen., construct)
الْاَصْلِ: الْأَصْل — aṣl, origin, stock (m.); 'the origin' (gen.; printed without the hamza mark)
مَنْسُوباً: مَنْسُوب + اً — mansūb, attributed, traced (pass. part. of نَسَبَ) + -an; 'traced'
فَالرَّاحُ: فَـ + الـ + رَاح — fa-, for/now (conj.) + rāḥ, wine (m.); 'for the wine'
كَالرِّيحِ: كَـ + الـ + رِيح — ka-, like (prep.) + rīḥ, wind (f.); 'like the wind'
طَابَتْ: طَابَتْ — ṭāba, to become good/sweet; 'it became sweet'
وَتَنْتُنْ: وَ + تَنْتُنْ — wa-, and + tantunu, imperf. of نَتُنَ, it stinks; 'and it stinks'
الْجِيَفِ: الـ + جِيَف — jīfa, carrion, carcass (f., pl. جِيَف); 'the carrion'
تَشْرَبِ: تَشْرَبْ — jussive of شَرِبَ, after the prohibitive لَا; 'drink not'
يَدَيْ: يَدَيْ — yaday, the two hands of (dual construct of يَد); 'the two hands of'
رَشًا: رَشَأ — rashaʾ, young gazelle (m.); 'a young gazelle' (acc. indef.; printed without the hamza mark)
يَبْكِيكَ: يَبْكِي + كَ — yabkī, imperf. of form IV أَبْكَى, he/it makes weep + -ka, you; 'makes you weep'
رِقَّةِ: رِقَّة — riqqa, tenderness, delicacy (f.); 'the tenderness of'
وَيُبْكِيهَا: وَ + يُبْكِي + هَا — wa-, and + yubkī, makes weep + -hā, her/it; 'and makes her weep'
إِنْشَادِهِ: إِنْشَاد + هِ — inshād, reciting (verbal noun of form IV أَنْشَدَ) + -hi, his; 'his recitation'
أَيْدِيَهُمْ: أَيْدِيَ + هُمْ — aydī, hands (pl. of يَد) + -hum, their; 'their hands' (acc.)
تَمَايَلَ: تَمَايَلَ — form VI of مَيْل, tamāyala, to sway/reel
الدِّمَاءِ: الـ + دِمَاء — dimāʾ, bloods (pl. of دَم); 'blood[s]' [i.e. every kind of blood]
حَرَامٌ: حَرَام — ḥarām, forbidden; 'is forbidden' (predicate, nom. indef.)
شُرْبُهُ: شُرْبُ + هُ — shurb, drinking (verbal noun) + -hu, its; 'its drinking' (subject)
فَاسْقِنِيهَا: فَـ + اِسْقِنِي + هَا — fa-, so (conj.) + isqinī, imper. of سَقَى with -nī, 'give me to drink!' + -hā, it; 'so give it to me to drink'
فِدًى: فِدًى — fidan, a ransom (m., indecl.); 'a ransom'
لِعَيْنَيْكَ: لِـ + عَيْنَيْ + كَ — li-, for (prep., 'a ransom for...') + ʿaynay, the two eyes of (dual) + -ka, your; 'for your two eyes'
غَزَالٍ: غَزَال — ghazāl, gazelle (m.); 'a gazelle' (gen. indef., vocative sense)
وَطَارِفِي: وَ + طَارِف + ي — wa-, and + ṭārif, newly-acquired [wealth] (act. part. of طَرَفَ) + -ī, my; 'and my new-gained [wealth]'
وَتَلِيدِي: وَ + تَلِيد + ي — wa-, and + talīd, inherited, long-held [wealth] + -ī, my; 'and my inherited [wealth]'
مَلَأَتِ: مَلَأَتْ — malaʾat, she filled (+ i, helper vowel before al-)
نَاوَلَتْهَا: نَاوَلَتْ + هَا — nāwalat, she handed + -hā, it/to her; 'she handed it to her'
لِأُخْتِهَا: لِـ + أُخْت + هَا — li-, to (prep.) + ukht, sister (f.) + -hā, her; 'to her sister'
الْوُسْطَى: الـ + وُسْطَى — wusṭā, middle (f. of أَوْسَط); 'the middle [sister]'
فَأَخَذَتْهَا: فَـ + أَخَذَتْ + هَا — fa-, so (conj.) + akhadhat, she took + -hā, it; 'so she took it'
شَكَرَتْهَا: شَكَرَتْ + هَا — shakarat, she thanked + -hā, her; 'she thanked her'
لِصَاحِبَةِ: لِـ + صَاحِبَة — li-, to (prep., governed by ناولت, 'handed to') + ṣāḥiba, mistress, owner (f.); 'to the mistress of'
كَأْسًا: كَأْس + اً — kaʾs, cup (f.) + -an (acc. indef.); 'a cup'
فَقَبَّلَ: فَـ + قَبَّلَ — fa-, so (conj.) + qabbala, he kissed; 'so he kissed'
هَاتِهَا: هَاتِ + هَا — hāti, bring! (imper., f. addressee) + -hā, it; 'bring it'
بِاللهِ: بِـ + اللهِ — bi-, by (prep., oath) + Allāh, God; 'by God'
كُوْسٍ: كُوس — kūs, cups (coll. pl., variant of كَأْس/كَاس); 'cups' (gen. indef.)
مُتْرَعَاتِ: مُتْرَعَات — mutraʿāt, filled to the brim (pass. part. pl. f. of form IV أَتْرَعَ); 'brimful'
وَاسْقِنِيْ: وَ + اِسْقِنِي — wa-, and + isqinī, imper. of سَقَى with -nī, 'give me to drink!'; 'and give me to drink'
بِكَاسٍ: بِـ + كَاس — bi-, with (prep.) + kās, cup (f.); 'with a cup'
اِنَّهَا: إِنَّ + هَا — inna, indeed + -hā, it; 'indeed it' (printed without the hamza mark)
صَاحِبَةِ: صَاحِبَة — ṣāḥiba, mistress, owner (f.); 'the mistress of'
عَبْدُكِ: عَبْد + كِ — ʿabd, slave, servant (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your slave'
وَمَمْلُوكُكِ: وَ + مَمْلُوك + كِ — wa-, and + mamlūk, one owned, a bondsman (pass. part. of مَلَكَ) + -ki, your (f.); 'and your bondsman'
خَدَّامُكِ: خَدَّام + كِ — khaddām, servant (intensive noun of خَادِم) + -ki, your (f.); 'your servant'
عَبِيدِكَ: عَبِيد + كَ — ʿabīd, slaves (pl. of عَبْد) + -ka, your (as printed, m.); 'your slaves'
بِجُودِكَ: بِـ + جُود + كَ — bi-, of/to (prep.; governed by مُعْتَرِف, 'confessing to') + jūd, bounty, generosity (m.) + -ka, your; 'your bounty'
وَالِاحْسَانِ: وَ + الـ + إِحْسَان — wa-, and + iḥsān, kindness, beneficence (m., hamzat waṣl after wa-, so unpointed for hamza); 'and [your] kindness'
مُعْتَرِفٌ: مُعْتَرِف — muʿtarif, confessing, acknowledging (act. part. of form VIII اِعْتَرَفَ); 'confessing' (nom. indef.)
أَيَدْخُلُ: أَ + يَدْخُلُ — a-, interrogative particle + yadkhulu, imperf. of دَخَلَ, he enters; 'may he enter?'
ذَاتَ: ذَاتَ — dhāta, possessor of (f. construct, vocative); 'O possessor of'
الْمَحَاسِنِ: الـ + مَحَاسِن — maḥāsin, graces, good qualities (pl.); 'the graces'
كَيْ: كَيْ — kay, so that, in order to (conj.)
يَرَى: يَرَى — yarā, imperf. of رَأَى, he sees
جَمَالَكِ: جَمَال + كِ — jamāl, beauty (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your beauty'
إِنِّي: إِنَّ + ي — inna, indeed + -ī, I; 'indeed I'
وَالْهَوَى: وَ + الـ + هَوَى — wa-, and + hawā, passion, love (m.); 'and passion'
مُنْصَرِفٌ: مُنْصَرِف — munṣarif, turned away, diverted (act. part. of form VII اِنْصَرَفَ); 'turned away' (nom. indef.)
نَفْسًا: نَفْس + اً — nafs, self (f.) + -an (acc. of specification); 'in yourself'
وَاشْرَبْ: وَ + اِشْرَبْ — wa-, and + ishrab, imper. of شَرِبَ, 'drink!'; 'and drink'
هَنِيًا: هَنِيء + اً — hanīʾ, wholesome, pleasant + -an; printed here without the medial hamza it carries elsewhere in this scene ('hanīʾan' in verse), a Middle Arabic simplification kept as printed; 'pleasantly'
وَعَافِيَةً: وَ + عَافِيَة + اً — wa-, and + ʿāfiya, health, wellness (f.) + -an; 'and healthfully'
مَجَارِيَ: مَجَارِيَ — majāriya, the courses/channels of (pl. of مَجْرًى); 'the courses of' (acc.)
وَتَرَنَّمَ: وَ + تَرَنَّمَ — wa-, and + tarannama, form V, to hum, warble a tune; 'and he hummed'
شِبْهَ: شِبْهَ — shibh, likeness, semblance of (m.); 'in the likeness of' (acc.)
خَدَّيْهَا: خَدَّيْ + هَا — khadday, the two cheeks of (dual of خَدّ) + -hā, her; 'her two cheeks'
مُعَتَّقَةً: مُعَتَّقَة — muʿattaqa, aged, matured [wine] (pass. part. f. of عَتَّقَ) + -an; 'aged wine' (acc.)
صِرْفاً: صِرْف + اً — ṣirf, pure, unmixed + -an; 'pure' (acc., repeated for emphasis)
فَقَبَّلْتُهَا: فَـ + قَبَّلْتُ + هَا — fa-, so (conj.) + qabbaltu, I kissed + -hā, it; 'so I kissed it'
ضَاحِكَةٌ: ضَاحِكَة — ḍāḥika, laughing (act. part. f. of ضَحِكَ); 'laughing' (nom. indef.)
تَسْقِي: تَسْقِي — tasqī, imperf. of سَقَى, you give to drink
خُدُودَ: خُدُود — khudūd, cheeks (pl. of خَدّ); 'the cheeks of' (acc., construct)
لِلنَّاسِ: لِـ + الـ + نَاس — li-, to/for (prep.) + nās, people; 'to the people'
اشْرَبِي: اِشْرَبِي — ishrabī, imper. of شَرِبَ (f. addressee); 'drink!'
فَهِيَ: فَـ + هِيَ — fa-, for (conj.) + hiya, it/she; 'for it'
دَمْعِي: دَمْع + ي — damʿ, tear(s) (m.) + -ī, my; 'my tears'
وَحُمْرَتُهَا: وَ + حُمْرَة + هَا — wa-, and + ḥumra, redness (f.) + -hā, its; 'and its redness'
وَطَابَتْهَا: وَ + طَابَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + ṭābat, it became sweet + -hā, its [sweetness]; 'and its sweetness'
أَنْفَاسِي: أَنْفَاس + ي — anfās, breaths (pl. of نَفَس) + -ī, my; 'my breath'
مُجِيبَةً: مُجِيبَة — mujība, answering, replying (act. part. f. of form IV أَجَابَ) + -an (hāl); 'answering'
صَاحِ: صَاحِ — ṣāḥi, vocative of صَاحِب, 'O friend!'
أَجْلِي: أَجْل + ي — ajl, sake (m.) + -ī, my; 'my sake' [مِنْ أَجْلِي, 'for my sake']
اسْتَعِينِيهَا: اِسْتَعِينِي + هَا — istaʿīnī, imper. of form X اِسْتَعَانَ (f. addressee), 'seek help!' + -hā, with it; 'help yourself with it'
الْعَيْنَيْنِ: الـ + عَيْنَيْنِ — ʿaynayn, the two eyes (dual of عَيْن); 'the eyes'
وَالرَّاسِ: وَ + الـ + رَاس — wa-, and + rās, colloquial spelling of رَأْس, head (m.); 'and the head'
فَأَخَذَتِ: فَـ + أَخَذَتْ — fa-, so (conj.) + akhadhat, she took (+ i, helper vowel before al-); 'so she took'
وَشَرِبَتْهُ: وَ + شَرِبَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + sharibat, she drank + -hu, it; 'and drank it'
يَشْرَبُونَ: يَشْرَبُونَ — yashrabūna, imperf. of شَرِبَ, they drink
وَسَطِهِمْ: وَسَط + هِمْ — wasaṭ, midst, middle (m.) + -him, their; 'their midst'
وَغِنَاءٍ: وَ + غِنَاء — wa-, and + ghināʾ, singing (m.); 'and singing'
وَأَشْعَارٍ: وَ + أَشْعَار — wa-, and + ashʿār, poems (pl. of شِعْر); 'and poems'
وَمُوَشَّحَاتٍ: وَ + مُوَشَّحَات — wa-, and + muwashshaḥāt, strophic songs (pl. of مُوَشَّحَة); 'and strophic songs'
هِرَاشٍ: هِرَاش — hirāsh, scuffling, roughhousing (verbal noun of form III هَارَشَ); 'scuffling' (gen. indef.)
وَعَضٍّ: وَ + عَضّ — wa-, and + ʿaḍḍ, biting (m.); 'and biting'
وَفَرْكٍ: وَ + فَرْك — wa-, and + fark, rubbing (m.); 'and rubbing'
وَلَمْسٍ: وَ + لَمْس — wa-, and + lams, touching (m.); 'and touching'
وَخِرَاعٍ: وَ + خِرَاع — wa-, and + khirāʿ, wanton play, most likely standing for خَلَاعَة (dissoluteness); 'and wanton play'
تُلَقِّمُهُ: تُلَقِّمُ + هُ — tulaqqimu, imperf. of form II لَقَّمَ, she feeds morsels to + -hu, him; 'she feeds him'
تَلْكُمُهُ: تَلْكُمُ + هُ — talkumu, imperf. of لَكَمَ, she strikes with the fist + -hu, him; 'she cuffs him'
تَلْطِمُهُ: تَلْطِمُ + هُ — talṭimu, imperf. of لَطَمَ, she slaps + -hu, him; 'she slaps him'
بِالْمَشْمُومِ: بِـ + الـ + مَشْمُوم — bi-, with (prep.) + mashmūm, sweet-smelling herb, lit. 'that which is smelled' (pass. part. of شَمَّ); 'with sweet-smelling herbs'
يَخْدُمُهُ: يَخْدُمُ + هُ — yakhdumu, imperf. of خَدَمَ, she serves + -hu, him; 'she serves him'
أَلَذِّ: أَلَذِّ — aladhdh, most delightful (elative of لَذِيذ); 'the most delightful of'
قَاعِدٌ: قَاعِد — qāʿid, sitting (act. part. of قَعَدَ); 'sitting' (nom. indef.)
حُورِ: حُور — ḥūr, houris, wide-eyed maidens (pl., f. of أَحْوَر); 'the houris of' (gen., construct)
كَذَلِكَ: كَـ + ذَلِكَ — ka-, like (prep.) + dhālika, that; 'thus'
لَعِبَتِ: لَعِبَتْ — laʿibat, it played (+ i, helper vowel before al-)
رُوسِهِمْ: رُوس + هِمْ — rūs, colloquial/defective spelling of classical رُؤُوس (pl. of رَأْس), heads, printed here with the hamza dropped, as with هَنِيًا above + -him, their; 'their heads'
عَنَّوْلَهُمْ: عَنَّ (it occurred, impersonal verb) + لَهُمْ (لِـ + هُم, to them); the edition fuses these into one unspaced word, apparently 'عنّ لهم', 'it occurred to them' — see note.
تَحَكَّمَ: تَحَكَّمَ — Form V of حكم; 'it gained mastery, took control (over)'.
قَامَتِ: قَامَتْ — root ق و م; 'she rose, stood up' (with helping kasra before a following hamzat al-waṣl)
تَجَرَّدَتْ: تَجَرَّدَتْ — Form V of ج ر د; 'she stripped herself bare'
أَرْخَتْ: وَ + أَرْخَتْ — Form IV of رخو/رخي; 'and she let down, loosened'.
أَرْمَتْ: وَ + أَرْمَتْ — Form IV أرمى, a variant of رمى, 'throw'; 'and she cast, threw'.
الْبُحَيْرَةِ: الـ + بُحَيْرَة (dim. of بَحْر, 'sea'); 'the pool, the small lake' (genitive after في).
وَبَطْبَطَتْ: وَ + بَطْبَطَتْ — a colloquial, sound-suggestive verb; 'and she splashed/paddled about'.
وَتَغَلَّتْ: وَ + تَغَلَّتْ — Form V of غلي, 'boil, seethe'; 'and she made [the water] froth'.
أَعْضَاهَا: أَعْضَاء (pl. of عُضْو, 'limb, member' — medial hamza dropped in this Middle Arabic spelling) + هَا; 'her limbs'.
رُوحَهَا: رُوح + هَا; lit. 'her spirit' — idiom for 'herself'.
اسْمُ: ism(u) — hamzat-waṣl noun 'name' (construct, nominative); no hamza sign is written since the initial alif is elidable.
أَشَارَتْ: وَ + أَشَارَتْ — Form IV of شور; 'and she pointed, gestured'.
رَحِمَكِ: رَحِم + كِ; 'your (f.) womb' — the porter's first, semi-decorous guess.
تَسْتَحِي: Form X of حيي; 'you feel shame, are ashamed'.
مَسَكَتْهُ: مَسَكَتْ + هُ — مسك, 'grasp, seize' + 3ms obj. suffix; 'she seized him'
تَصُكُّهُ: تَصُكُّ + هُ — صكّ, 'strike, cuff'; 'she strikes him'.
فَرْجُكِ: فَرْج + كِ; 'your (f.) vulva' — the porter's second guess.
فَسَكَّتَهُ: فَ + سَكَّتَهُ — Form II of سكت, 'silence'; printed with a single ت (grammatically masculine, 'he silenced him') though the subject is the woman — see note. 'And she struck him quiet.'
كُسُّكِ: كُسّ + كِ; 'your (f.) cunt' — the porter's third guess.
ضَرَبَتْهُ: ضَرَبَتْ + هُ — ضرب, 'hit, strike' + 3ms obj. suffix; 'she struck him'
زُنْبُورُكِ: زُنْبُور + كِ; 'your (f.) hornet' — the porter's fourth, nonsensical guess.
فَنَزَلَتْ: فَ + نَزَلَتْ — نزل, 'come down'; 'and she came down [upon him]'.
بِاسْمٍ: بِـ + اسْمٍ (indefinite genitive of hamzat-waṣl اسم); 'with/by a name'.
زَادُوهُ: زَادُوا + هُ — زاد, 'increase'; 'they gave him more (of)'.
جَعَلُوهُ: جَعَلُوا + هُ — جعل, 'make' + 3ms obj. suffix; 'they made him [into]'
عِنْدَكُنَّ: عِنْدَ + كُنَّ; 'with you (f.pl.), in your reckoning'.
الْجُسُورِ: الـ + جُسُور (pl. of جِسْر, 'bridge, causeway'); 'the canals/bridges' (genitive) — see note at حَبَقُ الْجُسُورِ.
دَوَّرُوا: Form II of دور; 'they turned round, passed around'.
خَلَعَتْ: خَلَعَتْ — خلع, 'take off, remove'; 'she took off [her clothes]'
أَوْمَتْ: وَ + أَوْمَتْ — Form IV of ومأ (medial hamza elided in this spelling, cf. أَوْمَى below); 'and she gestured'.
حِرِّهَا: حِرّ + هَا; 'her cunt' — the plain anatomical term, distinct from فَرْج.
صَكَّتْهُ: صَكَّتْ + هُ — صكّ, 'strike, cuff' + 3ms obj. suffix; 'she struck him'
نَدَوْلَكِ: Obscure; apparently a further, garbled guess in the porter's rapid-fire list of names. No confident reading of the printed letters is possible; kept as given and left untranslated — see note.
فَالثَّلَاثَةُ: فَ + الـ + ثَلَاثَة; 'and the three' (i.e. the three women).
ضَحِكُوا: ḍaḥikū — 'they laughed'; masculine plural form used loosely for the three women, as recurs in this passage.
قَلَبُوا: qalabū — 'they turned over, fell over' (masc. pl. form, see ضَحِكُوا).
نَزَلُوا: نَزَلُوا — 'they came down [upon him]' (masc. pl. form used for the women's actions, see the register note on ضَحِكُوا)
سَكًّا: sakkan — 'a striking' (indefinite accusative, cognate of صَكّ, kept as printed with س — see note at فَسَكَّتَهُ).
يَتَنَادَمُونَ: Form VI of ندم/munādama; 'they drink together as companions'.
يَتَأَوَّهُ: Form V of أوه; 'he groans, sighs'.
أَكْتَافِهِ: وَ + أَكْتَاف (pl. of كَتِف, 'shoulder') + هِ; 'and his shoulders'.
فَدَارَتِ: فَ + دَارَتِ — دار, 'go round'; 'and it went round'.
لَمَحَتْهُمْ: لَمَحَتْ + هُمْ — لمح, 'catch sight of, glance at'; 'she glanced at them'.
فَمَسَكَ: فَ + مَسَكَ; 'and he seized, took hold of'.
مَرَجَهَا: مَرَجَهَا — precise sense uncertain (see note); taken as 'he shook/worked it', the porter bracing his neck for more blows
أَكْنَافِي: وَ + أَكْنَاف (pl. of كَنَف, 'side, flank') + ي; 'and my sides'.
تَعَرَّتِ: Form V of عري; 'she stripped bare'.
وَأَلْقَتْ: وَ + أَلْقَتْ — Form IV of لقي; 'and she cast, threw'.
وَاغْتَسَلَتْ: وَ + اغْتَسَلَتْ — Form VIII of غسل, hamzat waṣl; 'and she washed herself'.
إِلَيْهِمَا: إِلَى + هِمَا; 'at the two of them' (dual) — sits oddly with the singular عريانة that follows, possibly a slip for إليها, kept as printed.
فِلْقَةُ: filqatu — 'a split piece, a fragment of' (construct).
كَالْبَدْرِ: كَـ + الـ + بَدْر; 'like the full moon'.
بَدَرَ: badara — 'it appeared in fullness, shone forth'.
وَالصُّبْحِ: وَ + الـ + صُبْح (genitive, parallel to كالبدر); 'and the morning'.
أَسْفَرَ: Form IV of سفر; 'it grew bright, dawned'.
الثِّقَالِ: pl. of ثَقِيل, 'heavy'; 'heavy' (genitive, agreeing with الأرداف).
تَتَرَجْرَجُ: Form V-type reduplicated verb of رجّ, 'shake, quiver'; 'it quivers, wobbles'.
قِسْتِ: qista — 'you (f.) measured' (from قاس, verse form, copied as printed).
قَدَّكِ: قَدّ + كِ; 'your (f.) figure' (verse form, copied as printed).
الرَّطِيبِ: al-raṭībi — 'the moist, tender' (verse form, copied as printed).
حَمَّلْتِ: Form II of حمل; 'you (f.) loaded, burdened' (verse form, copied as printed).
وَعُدْوَانَا: وَ + عُدْوَانًا; 'and transgression, wrong' (verse form, copied as printed).
فَالْغُصْنُ: فَ + الـ + غُصْن; 'for the bough' (verse form, copied as printed).
يُلْقَى: passive of لقي; 'is found, is encountered' (verse form, copied as printed).
مُتَّسِقًا: Form VIII participle of وسق; 'well-ordered, in leaf' (indefinite accusative; verse form, copied as printed).
يُلْقَاكِ: يُلْقَى + كِ; 'you are found, one finds you' (verse form, copied as printed).
عُرْيَانَا: ʿuryānā — 'naked' (accusative with alif maqṣūra-style verse ending; verse form, copied as printed).
هَنِهَا: هَن + هَا; 'her thing' — a vague pro-form used as a euphemism for the genitals.
سُوَيْدِي: diminutive of أَسْوَد + ي; 'my little dark one', an affectionate nickname for the porter.
ذِهْ: colloquial demonstrative used dismissively; 'no, not this'.
سِمْسِمُ: simsimu — 'sesame' (bare, without article, in the porter's second guess).
وَسَكَّتَهُ: وَ + سَكَّتَهُ — see فَسَكَّتَهُ above; 'and she struck him quiet'.
أَبُومَنْصُورٍ: proper name, 'Abu Mansur' — the archive prints أبو and منصور as one unspaced word; a Cairo caravanserai's name pressed into service as a fanciful pet-name — see note.
وَرَأَوْهُ: وَ + رَأَوْا + هُ — رأى, 'see'; 'and they saw him'.
الْخَشْكَاشَةِ: الـ + خَشْكَاشَة — al-, the + khashkāsha, marketing-girl (gen.); another spelling variant of الشوشكاشة above, same person, same role-title (not a personal name)
أَوْمَى: awmā — Form IV of ومأ (medial hamza elided in this spelling); 'he gestured'.
سِتَّاتِي: سِتَّات (colloq. pl. of سِتّ, 'lady') + ي; 'my ladies'.
انْقَلَبُوا: Form VII of قلب, hamzat waṣl; 'they fell over, turned over'.
بِقُولُ: بِـ (colloquial progressive/habitual proclitic) + قُولُ (reduced imperfect of قال, expected يَقُولُ); colloquial for 'he says, keeps saying', kept as printed.
الْمَقْشُورُ: الـ + مَقْشُور — Form I passive participle (pattern مفعول) of قشر, 'peel'; 'the peeled, hulled'.
اَهْ: ah — interjection, 'ah!' (printed with plain alif, without the madda of the more familiar آه spelling).
يُومَا: The edition prints this fused, ي و م ا; understood as a colloquial contraction of يَا مَا, the exclamatory 'how...!' (as in يا ما تستحي, 'how shameless you are!'), rather than as separate words.
وَسِيقَانَهُ: وَ + سِيقَان (pl. of سَاق, 'shin, leg') + هُ; 'and his shins, his legs'.
أَوْزَارًا: pl. of وِزْر, 'burden, sin'; indefinite accusative (verse form, copied as printed).
أَحْسَنُ: elative of حسن; 'more/most beautiful' (verse form, copied as printed).
وَأَنْتِ: وَ + أَنْتِ; 'and you' (f., verse form, copied as printed).
—: An em dash in the printed text, marking the shift into verse before the porter recites.
أَرْخَتْ: أَرْخَتْ — Form IV of ر خ ي, 'let down, loosen'; 'she let down [her hair]'
أَرْمَتْ: أَرْمَتْ — Form IV of ر م ي, 'throw, cast'; here 'she threw [herself]' (colloquial for رَمَتْ)
أَشَارَتْ: أَشَارَتْ — Form IV of ش و ر, 'point, gesture'; 'she pointed/gestured'
أَوْمَتْ: أَوْمَتْ — أومى/أومأ with the medial hamza elided in this edition's spelling, 'gesture, point'; 'she gestured [toward]'
أَكْنَافِي: أَ + كَنَف (pl. أَكْنَاف) + ي — 'my sides, my flanks'
وَصَارَتْ: وَ + صَارَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣārat, 'she became' (past f.)
وَتَجَرَّدَتْ: وَ + تَجَرَّدَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tajarradat, 'she stripped herself bare' (Form V of ج ر د, past f.)
وَلَعِبَتْ: وَ + لَعِبَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + laʿibat, 'she played' (past f.)
وَأَشَارَتْ: wa-, and (conj.) + ashārat, 'she pointed, gestured' (Form IV of ش و ر, past f.)
أَتِمِّي: أَتَمَّ (form IV of ت م م), fem. imperative — atamma-yutimmu, to complete; 'complete!'
يَبْلُغُنِي: يَبْلُغُ + نِي — balagha-yablughu, to reach + -nī, me; 'it reaches me'
الْبَنَاتِ: الـ + بَنَات (pl. of بِنْت) — bint, girl (f.); 'the girls'
خَازُوقُكَ: خَازُوق + كَ — khāzūq, stake/skewer (vulgar slang for penis, m.) + -ka, your; 'your stake'
يَعْنُقُ: ʿanaqa-yaʿnuqu (form I), 3rd m.sg. pres. — to embrace; here of the porter play-embracing each sister in turn
اشْتَفَى: اِشْتَفَى (form VIII of ش ف ي), 3rd m.sg. past — ishtafā-yashtafī, to be satisfied; 'he was satisfied'
مِنْهُنَّ: مِنْ + هُنَّ — min, of (prep.) + -hunna, them (f.pl.); 'of them'
يَتَضَاحَكُونَ: تَضَاحَكَ (form VI of ض ح ك) + ونَ — taḍāḥaka-yataḍāḥaku, to laugh together, 3rd m.pl. pres.; 'they laugh together'
أَخِينَا: أَخ + ينَا — akh, brother (m.) + -nā, our (Middle Arabic vocative, for classical أَخَانَا); 'our brother'
الْكَسُورُ: الـ + كَسُور (printed thus; expected adj. الكَسِير, 'broken-down', kept as archived) — 'the broken-down [one]'
يَرْعِي: يَرْعَى (ر ع ي; archive spells the final vowel with plain yāʾ, not alif maqṣūra), 3rd m.sg. pres. — raʿā-yarʿā, to graze; 'he grazes'
وَيَسُفُّ: وَ + يَسُفُّ — saffa-yasuffu, to sniff/gulp up dry food, 3rd m.sg. pres.; 'and he gulps down'
السِّمْسِمَ: الـ + سِمْسِم, accusative object — simsim, sesame (m.); 'the sesame'
الْمَقْشُورَ: الـ + مَقْشُور — maqshūr, peeled (pass. part. of قَشَرَ); 'the peeled'
وَيَبَاتُ: وَ + يَبَاتُ (colloquial-shaped, cf. بَاتَ-يَبِيتُ) — bāta-yabītu, to spend the night; 'and he spends the night'
مُنَادَمَتِهِمْ: مُنَادَمَة + هِمْ — munādama (masdar of form III نَادَمَ), carousing (f.) + -him, their; 'their carousing'
كَذَٰلِكَ: كَـ + ذَٰلِكَ — ka-, like (prep.) + dhālika, that; 'thus'
وَالْبَسْ: وَ + اِلْبَسْ, masc. sg. imperative — labisa-yalbasu, to wear/put on; 'and put on!'
زَرْمُوجَتَكَ: زَرْمُوجَة + كَ — zarmūja, soft riding-boot (Persian loanword, f.) + -ka, your; 'your boots'
وَتَوَجَّهْ: وَ + تَوَجَّهْ (form V of و ج ه), masc. sg. imperative — tawajjaha-yatawajjahu, to set off; 'and set off!'
وَأَوْرِينَا: وَ + أَوْرِ + نَا — awrā-yūrī (form IV of و ر ي), to show, imperative + -nā, us (Middle Arabic retains the stem vowel, classical would be أَرِنَا); 'and show us!'
عَرْضَ: ʿarḍ, breadth (m.), accusative construct; 'the breadth of'
أَكْتَافِكَ: أَكْتَاف (pl. of كَتِف) + كَ — katif, shoulder (m.) + -ka, your; 'your shoulders'
وَاللَّٰهِ: وَ + اللَّٰهِ — wa-, by (oath particle) + Allāh, God; 'by God'
خُرُوجُ: khurūj, going-out (masdar of خَرَجَ, m.), construct; 'the going-out of'
الرُّوحِ: الـ + رُوح, genitive — rūḥ, soul (f.); 'the soul'
خُرُوجِي: خُرُوج + ي — khurūj, going-out (m.) + -ī, my; 'my going-out'
عِنْدِكُمْ: عِنْدَ + كُمْ — ʿinda, with (prep.) + -kum, you (pl.); 'from among you'
دَعُونَا: دَعَا (د ع و), masc. pl. imperative + -nā, us — daʿā-yadaʿu, to leave/let be; 'let us!'
نَصِلِ: وَصَلَ (و ص ل), 1st pl. jussive (after imperative) — waṣala-yaṣilu, to join; 'let us join'
بِالنَّهَارِ: بِـ + الـ + نَهَار — bi-, with (prep.) + nahār, day (m.); 'with the day'
وَغَدَاةَ: وَ + غَدَاة, accusative of time — ghadāt, morning (f.); 'and in the morning'
سَبِيلِهِ: سَبِيل + هِ — sabīl, way (m.) + -hi, his; 'his way'
الْخَشْكَاشَةُ: proper name/nickname — Khushkasha, epithet of the second sister, distinct from the doorkeeper (nom.); (cf. الخوشكاشة below, same person)
بِحَيَاتِي: بِـ + حَيَاة + ي — bi-, by (prep.) + ḥayāh, life (f.) + -ī, my; 'by my life'
عَلَيْكُمْ: عَلَى + كُمْ — ʿalā, upon (prep.) + -kum, you (pl.); 'upon you' (i.e. 'I adjure you')
دَعُوهُ: دَعَا + هُ, masc. pl. imperative — daʿā, to leave + -hu, him; 'leave him!'
يُقَامُ: أَقَامَ (form IV), pass. 3rd m.sg. pres. — uqīma-yuqāmu, to be made to stay; 'let him be kept'
نَجْتَمِعَ: اِجْتَمَعَ (form VIII of ج م ع), 1st pl. subjunctive — ijtamaʿa-yajtamiʿu, to gather; 'we gather'
تَبَاتُ: بَاتَ-تَبَاتُ (colloquial-shaped), 2nd m.sg. pres. — bāta-yabītu, to spend the night; 'you spend the night'
بِشَرْطِ: بِـ + شَرْط — bi-, on (prep.) + sharṭ, condition (m.); 'on condition of'
وَمَهْمَا: وَ + مَهْمَا — mahmā, whatever (cond. particle); 'and whatever'
رَأَيْتَ: رَأَى-تَرَى (ر أ ي), 2nd m.sg. past (archive already marks this hamza) — ra'ā-yarā, to see; 'you see'
سَبَبِهِ: سَبَب + هِ — sabab, cause (m.) + -hi, its; 'its cause'
وَاقْرَأِ: وَ + اِقْرَأْ, masc. sg. imperative (archive already marks the root-final hamza) — qara'a-yaqra'u, to read; 'and read!'
الْكِتَابَةَ: الـ + كِتَابَة, accusative object — kitāba, writing (f.); 'the writing'
مَكْتُوبًا: maktūb, written (pass. part. of كَتَبَ), accusative; 'written'
بِمَاءِ: بِـ + مَاء, construct (archive already marks this hamza) — bi-, in (prep.) + mā', water (m.); 'in the water of'
يَتَكَلَّمْ: تَكَلَّمَ (form V of ك ل م), 3rd m.sg. jussive — takallama-yatakallamu, to speak; 'speaks'
يُرْضِيهِ: أَرْضَى (form IV of ر ض ي) + هِ — arḍā-yurḍī, to please + -hi, him; 'pleases him'
أَشْهِدُوا: أَشْهَدَ (form IV of ش ه د), masc. pl. imperative — ashhada-yushhidu, to call to witness; 'bear witness!'
يَعْنِينِي: يَعْنِي + نِي — ʿanā-yaʿnī, to concern + -nī, me; 'concerns me'
وَجَهَّزَتْ: وَ + جَهَّزَتْ (form II of ج ه ز) — jahhaza-yujahhizu, to prepare, 3rd f.sg. past; 'and she prepared'
مَأْكُولًا: مَأْكُول, accusative — ma'kūl, something eaten/food (pass. part. of أَكَلَ); 'food'
فَأَكَلُوا: فَـ + أَكَلَ, 3rd m.pl. past — akala-ya'kulu, to eat; 'and they ate'
أَوْقَدُوا: أَوْقَدَ (form IV of و ق د), 3rd m.pl. past — awqada-yūqidu, to light; 'they lit'
الشُّمُوعَ: الـ + شُمُوع (pl. of شَمْع), accusative — shamʿ, candle (m.); 'the candles'
وَالْقَنَادِيلَ: وَ + الـ + قَنَادِيل (pl. of قِنْدِيل), accusative — qindīl, lamp (m.); 'and the lamps'
وَغَرَسُوا: وَ + غَرَسَ, 3rd m.pl. past — gharasa-yaghrisu, to plant/set into; 'and they set into'
الْعَنْبَرَ: الـ + عَنْبَر, accusative — ʿanbar, ambergris (m.); 'the ambergris'
وَالْعُودَ: وَ + الـ + عُود, accusative — ʿūd, aloeswood (m.); 'and the aloeswood'
بِمُذَاكَرَةِ: بِـ + مُذَاكَرَة — mudhākara (masdar of form III ذَاكَرَ), mutual talk (f.); 'with the conversation of'
الْأَحْبَابِ: الـ + أَحْبَاب (pl. of حَبِيب) — ḥabīb, beloved friend (m.); 'the loved ones'
غَيَّرُوا: غَيَّرَ (form II of غ ي ر), 3rd m.pl. past — ghayyara-yughayyiru, to change; 'they had changed'
الْمَقَامَ: الـ + مَقَام, accusative — maqām, station/place (m.); 'the gathering-place'
بِغَيْرِهِ: بِـ + غَيْر + هِ — bi-, for (prep.) + ghayr, other (m.) + -hi, its; 'for another'
وَصَفُّوا: وَ + صَفَّ, 3rd m.pl. past — ṣaffa-yaṣuffu, to arrange in a row; 'and they had set out'
الْمَشْرُوبَ: الـ + مَشْرُوب, accusative — mashrūb, drink (pass. part. of شَرِبَ); 'the drink'
الْأَكْلِ: الـ + أَكْل — akl, eating (masdar of أَكَلَ, m.); 'the eating'
نُقْلٍ: nuql, indef. gen. — dessert, sweetmeats served alongside drink (m.)
وَخِدَاعٍ: وَ + خِدَاع, indef. — khidāʿ, teasing/banter (lit. 'deception', m.); 'and jesting'
يُدَقُّ: دَقَّ-يُدَقُّ, pass. 3rd m.sg. pres. — daqqa-yudaqqu, to knock; 'is being knocked'
يَنْخَرِمْ: اِنْخَرَمَ (form VII of خ ر م), 3rd m.sg. jussive — inkharama-yankharimu, to be disrupted; 'was disrupted'
نِظَامُهُمْ: نِظَام + هُمْ — niẓām, order (m.) + -hum, their; 'their order'
بِوَاحِدَةٍ: بِـ + وَاحِدَة, indef. — after إِذَا of surprise, بِـ marks what appears (idhā... bi-, 'and behold, [there was] one of them'); wāḥida, one (f.); 'one'
انْفَرَدَتْ: اِنْفَرَدَ (form VII of ف ر د), 3rd f.sg. past — infarada-yanfaridu, to go off alone; 'went alone'
عَادَتْ: عَادَ, 3rd f.sg. past — ʿāda-yaʿūdu, to return; 'she returned'
كَمَلَ: كَمَلَ (ك م ل), 3rd m.sg. past — kamala-yakmulu, to be complete; 'is complete'
صَفَانَا: صَفّ + نَا — ṣaff, row/rank (m.) + -nā, our; 'our row'
مَحْلُوقِينَ: مَحْلُوق + ينَ — maḥlūq, shaven (pass. part. of حَلَقَ), m.pl. accusative; 'shaven'
الذُّقُونَ: الـ + ذُقُون (pl. of ذَقَن), accusative — dhaqan, chin (m.); 'the chins'
وَالرُّوسَ: وَ + الـ + رُوس (defective spelling of رُؤُوس, pl. of رَأْس, missing its hamza letter, kept as archived), accusative — ra's, head (m.); 'and the heads'
وَالْحَوَاجِبَ: وَ + الـ + حَوَاجِب (pl. of حَاجِب), accusative — ḥājib, eyebrow (m.); 'and the eyebrows'
بِالْعَيْنِ: بِـ + الـ + عَيْن — bi-, in (prep.) + ʿayn, eye (f.); 'in the eye'
الشِّمَالِ: الـ + شِمَال — shimāl, left/north (noun used for 'the left [one]'); 'the left'
أَعْجَبِ: أَعْجَب — aʿjab, more/most wondrous (elative of عَجِيب); 'most wondrous of'
الِاتِّفَاقِ: الـ + اِتِّفَاق — ittifāq, coincidence (masdar of form VIII اتَّفَقَ, m.); 'the coincidence'
حَضَرُوا: حَضَرَ (ح ض ر), 3rd m.pl. past — ḥaḍara-yaḥḍuru, to arrive/be present; 'they had arrived'
الْآنَ: الـ + آنَ (archive already marks this hamza, with madda) — al-āna, now (adv.); 'just now'
وَحَالَةُ: وَ + حَالَة — ḥāla, state (f.); 'and the state of'
ظَاهِرَةٌ: ẓāhira, visible (act. part. of ظَهَرَ, f.); 'visible'
دُخُولِهِمْ: دُخُول + هِمْ — dukhūl, entering (masdar of دَخَلَ, m.) + -him, their; 'their entering'
بَلَدَنَا: بَلَد + نَا — balad, city (m.) + -nā, our; 'our city'
وَأَمَّا: وَ + أَمَّا — ammā, as for (particle); 'and as for'
دَقِّ: daqq, knocking (masdar of دَقَّ, m.), construct; 'the knocking of'
فَإِنَّهُمْ: فَـ + إِنَّ + هُمْ — fa-, for (particle) + inna, indeed (emphatic) + -hum, they; 'for indeed they'
يَبَاتُوا: بَاتَ (colloquial-shaped, cf. يَبِيتُوا), 3rd m.pl. — 'they might spend the night'
يُعْطِينَا: أَعْطَى-يُعْطِي (form IV of ع ط و) + نَا — aʿṭā-yuʿṭī, to give + -nā, us; 'will give us'

نِقْمَتِهِ: نِقْمَة + ـهِ — niqma, vengeance, wrath (f., gen., second term of idāfa) + -hi, his; 'his vengeance'
هَارُونُ: هَارُون — Hārūn, Harun (proper n., m., nom.); 'Harun'
وَالْآخَرُ: وَ + الـ + آخَر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ākhar, other, another (m., nom.); 'and the other'
وَالْحَمَّالِ: وَ + الـ + حَمَّال — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ḥammāl, porter (m., gen.); 'and the porter'
وَالْغِنَا: وَ + الـ + غِنَا — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ghinā, singing (m.); spelled here without the Classical final hamza (al-ghināʾ), one more of this copy's regular hamza-dropping spellings; 'and the singing'
وَأَجْلَسُوهُمْ: وَ + أَجْلَسُوهُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ajlasūhum, to seat (verb IV, perf. 3mp) + hum, them; 'and they seated them'
وَأَهْلًا: وَ + أَهْلًا — wa-, and (conj.) + ahlan, welcome (fixed greeting, masdar acc.); 'and welcome' (marḥaban wa-ahlan, a doubled greeting formula)
وَأُرِيدُكَ: وَ + أُرِيدُكَ — wa-, and (conj.) + urīdu, to want (verb IV, impf. 1cs) + -ka, you; 'and I want you'
وَبَخُورٍ: وَ + بَخُور — wa-, and (conj.) + bakhūr, incense (m., gen. indef.); 'and incense'
وَبِعْنَا: وَ + بِعْنَا — wa-, and (conj.) + biʿnā, to sell (verb I hollow, perf. 1cp); 'and we sold'
وَتَأَسَّفُوا: وَ + تَأَسَّفُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾassafū, to feel regret, be moved with pity (verb V, perf. 3mp, used loosely for the sisters); 'and they were moved with pity'
وَتَأَخَّرُوا: وَ + تَأَخَّرُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾakhkharū, to hold back, hang back (verb V, perf. 3mp); 'and they held back'
وَثَلٰثِ: وَ + ثَلٰثِ — wa-, and (conj.) + thalāthi, three (f. numeral, gen., idāfa; edition prints without the medial alif, pointed with the dagger alif); 'and three'
وَجَعْفَرٌ: وَ + جَعْفَرٌ — wa-, and (conj.) + Jaʿfarun, Jafar (proper n., nom.); 'and Jafar'
وَجَنْكًا: وَ + جَنْكًا — wa-, and (conj.) + jankan, a Persian harp (m., acc. indef.); 'and a harp'
وَحَمْلَقَ: وَ + حَمْلَقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥamlaqa, to stare, goggle, glare (quadriliteral verb, perf. 3ms); 'and he glared'
وَخَدَمُوا: وَ + خَدَمُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + khadamū, to serve, pay respect (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they paid respect'
وَخَدَمُوهُمْ: وَ + خَدَمُوهُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + khadamūhum, to serve (verb I, perf. 3mp) + hum, them; 'and they served them'
وَدَارَ: وَ + دَارَ — wa-, and (conj.) + dāra, to go round, circulate (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and it went round'
وَرَاحَتْ: وَ + رَاحَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + rāḥat, to go, depart (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'and she went'
وَرَحَّبُوا: وَ + رَحَّبُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + raḥḥabū, to welcome (verb II, perf. 3mp); 'and they welcomed'
وَرَدْتُمْ: وَ + وَرَدْتُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + waradtum, to arrive, come (verb I, perf. 2mp); 'and you arrived'
وَزِيرُهُ: وَزِير + ـهُ — wazīr, vizier, chief minister (m., nom.) + hu, his; 'his vizier'
وَشَقَّ: وَ + شَقَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + shaqqa, to cross, cut through (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he crossed'
وَشُمُوعٍ: وَ + شُمُوع — wa-, and (conj.) + shumūʿ, pl. of shamʿa, candle (f., gen. indef.); 'and candles'
وَطَرَقَ: وَ + طَرَقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭaraqa, to knock (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he knocked'
وَطَلَبُوا: وَ + طَلَبُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭalabū, to ask for, request (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they called for'
وَعَزَمَ: وَ + عَزَمَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿazama, to resolve; here عَزَمَ عَلَى, to invite (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and [a merchant] invited'
وَعَلَيْهِمُ: وَ + عَلَى + ـهِمُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿalā, upon (prep.) + himu, them (helping -u before a following hamzat al-waṣl); 'and upon them'
وَغَنَّوْا: وَ + غَنَّوْا — wa-, and (conj.) + ghannaw, to sing (verb II, perf. 3mp); 'and they sang'
وَفَتَحَتِ: وَ + فَتَحَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + fataḥati, to open (verb I, perf. 3fs; -i helping vowel before al-); 'and she opened'
وَفَوَاكِهَ: وَ + فَوَاكِهَ — wa-, and (conj.) + fawākih, pl. of fākiha, fruit (f. pl., diptote, gen./acc. indef.); 'and fruits'
وَقَامُوا: وَ + قَامُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + qāmū, to rise (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp); 'and they rose'
وَقَدَّمَ: وَ + قَدَّمَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qaddama, to set before, serve (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he set before [us]'
وَقَدَّمُوا: وَ + قَدَّمُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + qaddamū, to set before, serve (verb II, perf. 3mp); 'and they set before [them]'
وَقَعَّدُوهُمْ: وَ + قَعَّدُوهُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + qaʿʿadūhum, to seat (verb II, perf. 3mp) + hum, them; 'and they seated them'
وَلَكُمُ: وَ + لِـ + ـكُمُ — wa-, and (conj.) + li-, for, to (prep., 'you shall have') + kumu, you (helping -u before a following hamzat al-waṣl); 'and yours be'
وَلَنَا: وَ + لِـ + ـنَا — wa-, and (conj.) + li-, for (prep., 'we have') + nā, us; 'and we have'
وَمَسْرُورٌ: وَ + مَسْرُورٌ — wa-, and (conj.) + Masrūrun, Masrur (proper n., nom.); 'and Masrur'
وَمَقَامٍ: وَ + مَقَامٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + maqām, abode, dwelling-place (m., gen. indef.); 'and an abode'
وَمُدَامٍ: وَ + مُدَامٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + mudām, wine (m., gen. indef.); 'and wine'
وَنَخْشَى: وَ + نَخْشَى — wa-, and (conj.) + nakhshā, to fear (verb I, impf. 1cp); 'and we fear'
وَنَرَى: وَ + نَرَى — wa-, and (conj.) + narā, to see (verb I, subj. 1cp); 'and [that] we see'
وَنَسْمَعَ: وَ + نَسْمَعَ — wa-, and (conj.) + nasmaʿa, to hear (verb I, subj. 1cp); 'and [that] we hear'
وَنُقْلٍ: وَ + نُقْلٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + nuql, sweetmeats, dried fruit and nuts served with wine (m., gen. indef.); 'and sweetmeats'
وَهَنَّأُوا: وَ + هَنَّأُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + hannaʾū, to wish [someone] joy of, congratulate (verb II, perf. 3mp, governs بِـ); 'and they wished [them] joy'
وَيَسْمَعُ: وَ + يَسْمَعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yasmaʿu, to hear (verb I, impf. 3ms, coordinated with the preceding masdar بِتَفَرُّجٍ as a second purpose); 'and to hear'
يَتَجَدَّدُ: تَجَدَّدَ — tajaddada, to arise anew, be renewed (verb V, impf. 3ms); 'arises'
يَتَنَكَّرُ: تَنَكَّرَ — tanakkara, to disguise oneself (verb V, impf. 3ms); 'he disguises himself'
يَدْخُلُونَ: دَخَلَ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, impf. 3mp); 'they enter'
يَرْضِيكُمْ: أَرْضَى — arḍā, to please, satisfy (verb IV, impf. 3ms) + kum, you (pl.); 'pleases you'
يَعْنِيكُمْ: عَنَى — ʿanā, to concern (verb I, impf. 3ms) + kum, you (pl.); 'concerns you'
يُصِيبَنَا: أَصَابَ — aṣāba, to befall, strike (verb IV hollow, subj. 3ms after أَنْ) + nā, us; 'befall us'
يُطْرَقُ: طَرَقَ — ṭaraqa, to knock (verb I, pass. impf. 3ms); 'is knocked, is being knocked upon'
لِلشَّرَابِ: لِـ + الـ + شَرَاب — bi-/li-, for (prep., here of purpose) + sharāb, drink/wine (m.); 'for the drink'
وَالْمُنَادَمَةِ: وَ + الـ + مُنَادَمَة — munādama (Form III maṣdar of nādama), convivial drinking-companionship (f.); 'and the conviviality'
الثَّلٰثَةِ: الـ + ثَلَاثَة — thalātha, three (num.); 'the three' (gen.; defective spelling missing the medial alif, marked with a dagger alif)
الْقَرَنْلِيَّةِ: الـ + قَرَنْلِيَّة — qaranliyya (archive's spelling, for qalandariyya), qalandars, wandering dervishes (coll.); 'the qalandars' (gen.)
فَوَجَدَهُمْ: فَـ + وَجَدَ + هُمْ — wajada, to find (v.) + -hum, them; 'then he found them'
عُورًا: عُور — pl. of أَعْوَر aʿwar, one-eyed (adj.); 'one-eyed' (acc. indef., 2nd object of wajada)
فَتَحَيَّرَ: فَـ + تَحَيَّرَ — taḥayyara (Form V of ḥāra), to be bewildered (v.); 'then he was bewildered'
وَأَخَذُوا: وَ + أَخَذَ + و ا — akhadha, to take (v.); here 'akhadha fī', to fall to/take up (idiom with fī); 'and they fell to'
لِلْخَلِيفَةِ: لِـ + الـ + خَلِيفَة — li-, to (prep.) + khalīfa, caliph (m.); 'to the caliph'
اشْرَبْ: اِشْرَبْ — imperative of شَرِبَ/يَشْرَبُ shariba/yashrabu, to drink (v.); 'drink!' (hamzat waṣl)
عَازِمٌ: عَازِم — active participle of عَزَمَ عَلَى ʿazama ʿalā, to resolve/intend (v.); 'resolved' (nom. indef., predicate)
الْحَجِّ: الـ + حَجّ — ḥajj, pilgrimage (m.); 'the pilgrimage' (gen., after ʿalā)
وَقَدَّمَتْ: وَ + قَدَّمَتْ — qaddama (Form II of qadima), to set out/serve (v.); 'and she set out'
سُفْرَةً: سُفْرَة — sufra, dining-cloth/leather mat (f.); 'a dining-cloth' (acc. indef.)
مُزَرْكَشَةً: مُزَرْكَشَة — passive participle of زَرْكَشَ zarkasha (quadriliteral), embroidered/brocaded (adj.); 'embroidered' (acc. indef.)
وَأَقْعَدَتْ: وَ + أَقْعَدَتْ — aqʿada (Form IV of qaʿada), to set/place (v.); 'and she placed'
بَاطِيَةً: بَاطِيَة — bāṭiya, large bowl/basin (f., loanword); 'a bowl' (acc. indef.)
صِينِيَّةً: صِينِيَّة — ṣīniyya, Chinese/porcelain (adj., from al-Ṣīn, 'China'); 'china' (acc. indef.)
وَقَلَبَتْ: وَ + قَلَبَتْ — qalaba, to turn out/pour (v.); 'and she poured'
وَأَدْخَلَتْ: وَ + أَدْخَلَتْ — adkhala (Form IV of dakhala), to insert/put in (v.); 'and she put in'
جُمْحَةَ: جُمْحَة — jumḥa, a lump/chunk (f.); 'a lump of' (acc., construct)
وَأَبْلُوجَ: وَ + أَبْلُوجَ — ablūj, sugar-loaf/cone of refined sugar (m., loanword, vocalization uncertain); 'and a loaf of'
فَشَكَرَهَا: فَـ + شَكَرَ + هَا — shakara, to thank (v.) + -hā, her; 'then he thanked her'
لَأَجْزِيهَا: لَـ + أَجْزِي + هَا — la-, indeed/surely (emphatic particle) + ajzī (imperfect of جَزَى jazā), to reward/repay (v.) + -hā, her; 'I shall surely reward her'
غَدَاةِ: غَدَاة — ghadāt, morning/morrow (f.); 'the morning of' (gen., construct)
اشْتَغَلُوا: اِشْتَغَلَ + و ا — ishtaghala (Form VIII of shaghala), to be busy/occupied (v.); 'they busied themselves' (hamzat waṣl)
بِمُنَادَمَتِهِمْ: بِـ + مُنَادَمَة + هِمْ — bi-, with (prep.) + munādama, conviviality (f.) + -him, their; 'with their conviviality'
السِّتُّ: الـ + سِتّ — sitt, lady, mistress of the house (f., colloquial); 'the lady' (nom.)
وَخَدَمَتْهُمْ: وَ + خَدَمَتْ + هُمْ — khadama, to serve (v.) + -hum, them; 'and she served them'
بِيَدِ: بِـ + يَد — bi-, by (prep.) + yad, hand (f.); 'by the hand of'
أُخْتِي: أُخْت + ي — ukht, sister (f.) + -ī, my; 'my sister'
نَقْضِي: نَقْضِي — 1pl. imperfect of قَضَى qaḍā, to discharge/settle (v.); 'we discharge, let us discharge'
دَيْنَنَا: دَيْن + نَا — dayn, debt/due (m.) + -nā, our; 'our due' (fig., a ritual obligation)
الْأُخْتَانِ: الـ + أُخْتَانِ — dual of ukht, sister (f.); 'the two sisters' (nom.)
قُدَّامَهُمْ: قُدَّامَ + هُمْ — quddāma, in front of (prep.) + -hum, them; 'before them'
وَذٰلِكَ: وَ + ذٰلِكَ — dhālika, that (dem. pron.); 'and that'
عَزَلَتِ: عَزَلَتْ — ʿazala, to set aside/clear away (v.); 'she cleared away'
وَرَمَتِ: وَ + رَمَتْ — ramā, to throw (v.); 'and she threw out'
الْقُشُورَ: الـ + قُشُور — pl. of قِشْرَة qishra, peel/rind (f.); 'the peelings' (acc.)
وَغَيَّرَتِ: وَ + غَيَّرَتْ — ghayyara (Form II), to change (v.); 'and she changed'
وَعَزَلَتْ: وَ + عَزَلَتْ — ʿazala, to clear away (v.); 'and she cleared'
وَسَطَ: وَسَطَ — wasaṭ, middle/center (m.); 'the middle of' (acc., construct)
وَأَطْلَعَتِ: وَ + أَطْلَعَتْ — aṭlaʿa (Form IV of ṭalaʿa), to bring up/lead up (v.); 'and she brought up'
الْإِيوَانِ: الـ + إِيوَان — īwān, vaulted hall/iwan (m., Persian loan); 'the iwan' (gen.)
صُفَّةٍ: صُفَّة — ṣuffa, raised bench/dais (f.); 'a bench' (gen. indef.)
وَجَعْفَرًا: وَ + جَعْفَرًا — Jaʿfar, proper name (the vizier); 'and Jaʿfar' (acc.)
وَمَسْرُورًا: وَ + مَسْرُورًا — Masrūr, proper name (the caliph's attendant); 'and Masrūr' (acc.)
وَصَرَخَتْ: وَ + صَرَخَتْ — ṣarakha, to cry out (v.); 'and she cried out'
مَوَدَّتُكَ: مَوَدَّة + كَ — mawadda, affection/regard (f.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your affection' (nom.)
وَشَدَّ: وَ + شَدَّ — shadda, to tighten/gird (v.); 'and he girded'
وَسَطَهُ: وَسَط + هُ — wasaṭ, waist/middle (m.) + -hu, his; 'his waist'
تُرِيدِي: تُرِيدِي — 2f.sg. imperfect of أَرَادَ arāda (Form IV), to want (v.); 'you want' (colloquial, dropping the classical -na)
قِفْ: قِفْ — imperative of وَقَفَ waqafa, to stand/stop (v.); 'stand still!'
مَكَانَكَ: مَكَان + كَ — makān, place (m.) + -ka, your; 'your place'
وَنَصَبَتْ: وَ + نَصَبَتْ — naṣaba, to set up/erect (v.); 'and she set up'
خُوشْكَانَةً: خُوشْكَانَة — khūshkāna, store-closet/cabinet (f., Persian loan; sense uncertain); 'a closet' (acc. indef.)
سَاعِدْنِي: سَاعِدْ + نِي — sāʿid, imperative of سَاعَدَ sāʿada (Form III), to help (v.) + -nī, me; 'help me!'
كَلْبَتَيْنِ: كَلْبَتَيْنِ — dual of كَلْبَة kalba, she-dog/bitch (f.); 'two bitches' (acc.)
سُودًا: سُودًا — pl. of أَسْوَد aswad, black (adj.); 'black' (acc. indef.; irregular agreement with the dual, see note)
رِقَابِهِمْ: رِقَاب + هِمْ — pl. of رَقَبَة raqaba, neck (f.) + -him, their (m.pl.); 'their necks' (irregular m.pl. pronoun for the pair, see note)
جَنَازِيرُ: جَنَازِير — pl. of جِنْزِير janzīr, chain (m., loanword); 'chains' (nom.)
خُذْهُمْ: خُذْ + هُمْ — imperative of أَخَذَ akhadha, to take (v.) + -hum, them; 'take them!'
فَأَخَذَهُمُ: فَـ + أَخَذَ + هُمُ — akhadha, to take (v.) + -hum, them; 'then he took them'
وَشَمَّرَتْ: وَ + شَمَّرَتْ — shammara (Form II of shamara), to tuck up/bare (v.); 'and she bared'
مِعْصَمِهَا: مِعْصَم + هَا — miʿṣam, wrist (m.) + -hā, her; 'her wrist'
قَدِّمْ: قَدِّمْ — imperative of قَدَّمَ qaddama (Form II), to bring forward (v.); 'bring forward!'
فَقَدَّمَهَا: فَـ + قَدَّمَ + هَا — qaddama, to bring forward (v.) + -hā, her; 'then he brought her forward'
وَجَرَّهَا: وَ + جَرَّ + هَا — jarra, to drag/pull (v.) + -hā, her; 'and he dragged her'
وَالْكَلْبَةُ: وَ + الـ + كَلْبَة — kalba, she-dog (f.); 'while the bitch' (nom.)
وَتَحَرَّكَتْ: وَ + تَحَرَّكَتْ — taḥarraka (Form V of ḥaraka), to move (v.); 'and it moved'
رَأْسُهَا: رَأْس + هَا — raʾs, head (m.) + -hā, her; 'her head' (nom.)
فَنَزَلَتِ: فَـ + نَزَلَتْ — nazala, to come down/descend (v.); 'then she came down'
رَأْسِهَا: رَأْس + هَا — raʾs, head (m.) + -hā, her; 'her head' (gen.)
تَصْرُخُ: تَصْرُخُ — 3f.sg. imperfect of صَرَخَ ṣarakha, to cry out (v.); 'she screams'
تَضْرِبُهَا: تَضْرِبُ + هَا — taḍribu (ḍaraba), to strike (v.) + -hā, her; 'she strikes her'
كَلَّتْ: كَلَّتْ — kalla, to grow weary (v.); 'grew weary'
سَوَاعِدُهَا: سَوَاعِد + هَا — pl. of سَاعِد sāʿid, forearm (m.) + -hā, her; 'her arms' (nom.)
فَرَمَتِ: فَـ + رَمَتْ — ramā, to throw (v.); 'then she threw'
وَضَمَّتِ: وَ + ضَمَّتْ — ḍamma, to embrace/gather (v.); 'and she clasped'
لِصَدْرِهَا: لِـ + صَدْر + هَا — li-, to (prep.) + ṣadr, breast/chest (m.) + -hā, her; 'to her breast'
وَمَسَحَتْ: وَ + مَسَحَتْ — masaḥa, to wipe (v.); 'and she wiped'
دُمُوعَ: دُمُوع — pl. of دَمْعَة damʿa, tear (f.); 'the tears of' (acc., construct)
الْكَلْبَةِ: الـ + كَلْبَة — kalba, she-dog (f.); 'the bitch' (gen., construct)
وَبَاسَتْ: وَ + بَاسَتْ — bāsa (colloquial for Classical qabbala), to kiss (v.); 'and she kissed'
رَأْسَهَا: رَأْس + هَا — raʾs, head (m.) + -hā, her; 'her head' (acc.)
خُذِيهَا: خُذِي + هَا — 2f.sg. imperative of أَخَذَ akhadha, to take (v.) + -hā, her; 'take her!' (fem. form though addressed to the porter, see note)
وَهَاتِ: وَ + هَاتِ — hāti, m.sg. imperative of the defective verb hāta, 'bring/give'; 'and bring!'
فَجَابَهَا: فَـ + جَاب + هَا — jāba (colloquial contraction of جَاءَ بِـ jāʾa bi-), to bring (v.) + -hā, her; 'then he brought her'
