ثَانِيَةً: thāniyatan — second (adj., f., acc., agreeing with bidla)
زِيدِينِي: زِيدِي + ـنِي — zāda, to increase, add (I, imper. 2fs) + 1cs; 'add for me, give me more'
أَوْفِي: awfī — pay in full, discharge (imper. 2fs of IV awfā); the preceding وَ is printed as its own detached token at the line-end above
الصَّوْتِ: الـ + صَوْت — ṣawt, voice, sound (m., gen. after hādhā in apposition)
فَأَحْضَرَتِ: فَ + أَحْضَرَتِ — aḥḍara, to bring, produce (IV, perf. 3fs)
مَتـى: matā — when? (interrogative adv.); the kashida before the ى is typographic only
الصُّلُودُ: الـ + صُلُود — ṣulūd, aversion, cold turning-away (m. masdar of ṣalada, nom.)
الْجَفَا: الـ + جَفَا — jafā, harshness, unkind estrangement (m.); pausal spelling for al-jafāʾ
اَدْمُعِي: أَدْمُع + ـِي — admuʿ, tears (m. pl. of damʿ) + 1cs; 'my tears'; printed without the hamza sign
الْهَجْرَ: الـ + هَجْر — hajr, estrangement, separation (m., acc.)
لِيْ: لِـ + ـِي — li-, to, for (prep.) + 1cs; 'against me'
مُتَعَمِّدَا: mutaʿammidā — mutaʿammid, deliberate, intentional (act. part. of V taʿammada; acc. of state, pausal spelling for mutaʿammidan)
حَاسِدِيْ: حَاسِد + ـِي — ḥāsid, envier, rival (act. part. of ḥasada) + 1cs; 'my envier'
فَقَدِ: فَـ + قَدِ — fa-, so (conj.) + qad, indeed (particle)
اَنْصَفَ: anṣafa — to deal justly (IV of naṣafa); printed without the hamza sign
الْخَؤُونُ: الـ + خَؤُون — khaʾūn, treacherous (intensive adj. of khāna, to betray; nom.); the one word in this passage the edition prints with the hamza sign
لِعَاشِقٍ: لِـ + عَاشِقٍ — li-, for (prep.) + ʿāshiq, a lover (act. part. of ʿashiqa, gen. indef.)
سَهْراً: sahran — sahar, wakefulness (m., acc. of state); 'sleepless'
هَوَاهَا: هَوَى + ـهَا — hawā, passion, love (m.) + 3fs; 'love of her'
مُدْنَفَا: mudnafā — mudnaf, sick, wasted with love (pass. part. of IV adnafa; acc. of state, pausal spelling for mudnafan)
رِفْقًا: rifqan — rifq, gentleness (m., acc. of exhortation); 'be gentle!'
اَضَرَّ: aḍarra — to harm (IV of ḍarra); printed without the hamza sign
بِيَ: بِـ + ـيَ — bi-, by, through (prep.) + 1cs; 'to me'
مَالِكِيْ: مَالِك + ـِي — mālik, owner, master (act. part. of malaka) + 1cs; 'my master' (the beloved as the lover's owner)
آنَ: āna — the time has come (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms, of āna yaʾīnu); printed with the madda as the edition has it
تَتَعَطَّفَا: tataʿaṭṭafā — taʿaṭṭafa, to show tenderness, relent (V, subjunctive 2ms, pausal spelling for tataʿaṭṭafa)
فَلِمَنْ: فَـ + لِـ + مَنْ — fa-, so (conj.) + li-, to, for (prep.) + man, who(m) (rel./interrog. pron.); 'to whom, then'
اُبِيحُ: ubīḥu — abāḥa, to make lawful, lay open, disclose (IV, imperf. 1cs); printed without the hamza sign
صَبَابَتِيْ: صَبَابَة + ـِي — ṣabāba, ardent passion (f.) + 1cs; 'my passion'
قَاتِلِيْ: قَاتِل + ـِي — qātil, killer, slayer (act. part. of qatala) + 1cs; 'my killer' (epithet for the cruel beloved)
خَيْبَةَ: khaybata — khayba, disappointment, frustrated hope (f., acc. in an exclamatory construction, 'what disappointment for...')
الشَّاكِيْ: الـ + شَاكِي — shākī, one who complains (act. part. of shakā)
الْوَفَا: الـ + وَفَا — wafā, faithfulness, loyalty (m.); pausal spelling for al-wafāʾ
يَزِيلُ: yazīlu — azāla, to remove, make vanish (IV, imperf. 3ms); here used with an unstated subject, of the beloved's doing
وَجْدِيْ: وَجْد + ـِي — wajd, passion, rapture (m.) + 1cs; 'my passion'
عَبْرَتِيْ: عَبْرَة + ـِي — ʿabra, a tear (f.) + 1cs; 'my tear(s)'
اَيَّامُ: ayyāmu — ayyām, days (m. pl. of yawm, nom.); printed without the hamza sign
الصُّدُودِ: الـ + صُدُود — ṣudūd, estrangement, turning-away (m. masdar of ṣadda, gen.)
فَيُخْلِفَا: fa-yukhlifā — fa-, so (conj.) + yukhlifa, to break one's word, fail to keep faith (IV of khalafa, subjunctive 3ms, pausal spelling for yukhlifa)
مُسْلِمِيْنَ: muslimīna — Muslim, believer (act. part. of aslama, m. pl., voc.)
خُلُّوا: khullū — khallā, to leave alone, abandon (II imper. m. pl.); 'leave [me] to'
بِثَارِ: بِـ + ثَارِ — bi-, with (prep.) + thār, blood-vengeance, retribution (m., gen.)
مُتَيَّمٍ: mutayyamin — mutayyam, one enslaved by love, love-smitten (pass. part. of II tayyama, gen. indef.)
اَلِفَ: alifa — to become accustomed to (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed without the hamza sign
رَبْعُ: rabʿu — rabʿ, dwelling-place, abode (m., nom.); the classic deserted-campsite image applied to 'patience'
صَبْرِهِ: صَبْر + ـهِ — ṣabr, patience (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'his patience'
عَفَا: ʿafā — to be effaced, worn away (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَحِلُّ: yaḥillu — ḥalla, to be lawful, permitted (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
مُنْيَتِيْ: مُنْيَة + ـِي — munya, wish, heart's desire (f.) + 1cs; 'my heart's desire'
بَعْلِيْ: بَعْل + ـِي — baʿl, husband, lord, master (m.) + 1cs; 'my husband'/'my lord'
غَيْرِيْ: غَيْر + ـِي — ghayr, other (than) (m.) + 1cs; 'someone other than I'
بِالْوِصَالِ: بِـ + الـ + وِصَالِ — bi-, with (prep.) + wiṣāl, union, being-joined (m., gen.)
مُشَرَّفَا: musharrafā — musharraf, honored, ennobled (pass. part. of II sharrafa; acc. of state, pausal spelling for musharrafan)
لِاَيِّ: لِـ + أَيِّ — li-, for (prep.) + ayy, which, what (interrog./indef. adj., gen.); printed without the hamza sign; 'for what'
دَعَةٍ: daʿatin — daʿa, ease, comfort, repose (f., gen. indef.)
بِالْجِوَارِ: بِـ + الـ + جِوَارِ — bi-, in (prep.) + jiwār, nearness, proximity (m., gen.)
تَلَذُّذًا: talādhdhudhan — talādhdhudh, taking pleasure, relishing (masdar of V taladhdhadha, acc. of purpose); pausal spelling for talādhdhudhan
اَهْوَاهُ: ahwāhu — ahwā, to love (IV of hawiya, imperf. 1cs) + 3ms; 'whom I love'; printed without the hamza sign
يَتَكَلَّفَا: yatakallafā — yatakallafa, to go to the trouble, burden himself (V of kallafa, subjunctive 3ms, pausal spelling for yatakallafa)
قَصِيدَتَهَا: قَصِيدَة + ـهَا — qaṣīda, ode, poem (f., acc.) + 3fs; 'her poem'
أَثْوَابِهَا: أَثْوَاب + ـهَا — athwāb, garments (m. pl. of thawb; gen. after fī) + 3fs; 'her garments'
الذَّيْلِ: الـ + ذَيْل — dhayl, hem, skirt (m., gen.)
وَشَقَّتْهَا: وَ + شَقَّتْ + ـهَا — shaqqa, to tear (I, perf. 3fs) + 3fp (referring to athwāb); 'and tore them'
ضَرْبُ: ḍarbu — ḍarb, a blow, a striking (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْقَارِعِ: الـ + قَارِع — qāriʿ, one who strikes, knocks (act. part. of qaraʿa; m., gen.)
الْفَرَنْلِيَّةُ: الـ + فَرَنْلِيَّة — faranliyya, the qalandars, printed spelling of the group elsewhere called al-qarandaliyya (f. collective, nom.); see the note
لَيْتَنَا: لَيْتَ + ـنَا — layta, would that (particle of wishing) + 1cp; 'would that we'
دَخَلْنَا: dakhalnā — dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 1cp)
وَكُنَّا: وَ + كُنَّا — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, perf. 1cp)
نِمْنَا: nimnā — nāma, to sleep (verb I hollow, perf. 1cp)
تَعَكَّرَ: taʿakkara — to become turbid, troubled (verb V of ʿakira)
مُقَامُنَا: مُقَام + ـنَا — muqām, sojourn, stay (m., nom.) + 1cp; 'our stay'
يَقْطَعُ: yaqṭaʿu — qaṭaʿa, to cut (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
سِرُّنَا: سِرّ + ـنَا — sirr, secret; here, inner self, heart (m., nom.) + 1cp; 'our heart'
الْأَمْرِ: الـ + أَمْر — amr, matter, affair (m., gen.)
الْمَوْضِعَ: الـ + مَوْضِع — mawḍiʿ, place, location (m., acc.)
فَيَكُونُ: فَ + يَكُونُ — yakūnu, kāna, to be (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); 'then it must be'
خَبَرَهُمْ: خَبَر + ـهُمْ — khabar, story, news (m., acc.) + 3mp; 'their story'
غَمَزَ: ghamaza — to wink at, signal, nudge (verb I)
وَسَأَلَهُ: وَ + سَأَلَ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and he asked him'; the edition already prints the hamza here
الْأَحْوَالِ: الـ + أَحْوَال — aḥwāl, circumstances, states (m. pl. of ḥāl, gen.)
كُلُّنَا: كُلّ + ـنَا — kull, all, every (m., nom.) + 1cp; 'all of us'
بِالْهَوَى: بِـ + الـ + هَوَى — bi-, in (prep.) + hawā, passion, love (m., gen.)
سَوِيٌّ: sawiyyun — sawiyy, equal, alike (adj., nom. indef.)
نَشْوًا: nashwan — apparently a masdar-like form read as 'by upbringing, by growing-up' (see the note); acc. of specification
وَعُمْرِي: وَ + عُمْر + ـِي — ʿumr, life, age (m.) + 1cs; idiomatic 'in my life, ever'
تَعَادِي: taʿādī — taʿādā, to be mutually strange to one another (masdar of VI of ʿadā); see the note
عَجَبٌ: ʿajabun — ʿajab, a wonder, an astonishing thing (m., nom. indef.)
حَسِبْنَا: ḥasibnā — ḥasiba, to think, reckon (verb I, perf. 1cp)
نَرَاكَ: narāka — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 1cp; the medial hamza drops in this stem) + 2ms; 'we see you'
نَظِيرَنَا: نَظِير + ـنَا — naẓīr, equal, counterpart (m., acc.) + 1cp; 'our equal'
سَبْعَةُ: sabʿatu — sabʿa, seven (cardinal number, nom.; governs the following gen. pl.)
رِجَالٍ: rijālin — rijāl, men (m. pl. of rajul, gen. indef.)
ثَلٰثَةُ: thalāthatu — thalātha, three (cardinal number, nom.; governs the following gen. pl.); the edition's defective spelling ثلثة for ثلاثة is pointed with the dagger alif
نِسَاءٍ: nisāʾin — nisāʾ, women (f. pl., gen. indef.); already printed with the hamza
فَاسْأَلُوهُمْ: فَ + اسْأَلُوا + ـهُمْ — saʾala, to ask (I, imper. 2mp) + 3mp; 'so ask them'; the edition already prints the hamza here
حَالِهِمْ: حَال + ـهِمْ — ḥāl, state, condition (m., gen.) + 3mp; 'their state'
يُجِيبُونَا: yujībūnā — ajāba, to answer (IV, imperf. 3mp) + 1cp; 'they answer us'
طَوْعًا: ṭawʿan — ṭawʿ, willing compliance (m., acc. of manner); 'willingly'
أَجَابُونَا: ajābūnā — ajāba, to answer (IV, perf. 3mp) + 1cp; 'they will answer us' (perfect used for a certain future); printed without the hamza sign
وَاتَّفَقَ: وَ + اِتَّفَقَ — ittafaqa, to agree (VIII of wafaqa); the initial alif is hamzat waṣl and carries no hamza sign
الْجَمِيعُ: الـ + جَمِيع — jamīʿ, all, the whole (m., nom.)
رَأْيٌ: raʾyun — raʾy, opinion, judgment (m., nom. indef.); printed without the hamza sign
دَعُوهُمْ: daʿūhum — daʿā, to leave, let be (I imper. 2mp) + 3mp; 'leave them'
ضُيُوفٌ: ḍuyūfun — ḍuyūf, guests (m. pl. of ḍayf, nom. indef.)
وَشَرَطُوا: وَ + شَرَطُوا — sharaṭa, to stipulate, impose a condition (verb I, perf. 3mp)
شَرْطًا: sharṭan — sharṭ, a condition, stipulation (m., acc. indef.)
قَبِلْنَا: qabilnā — qabila, to accept (verb I, perf. 1cp)
شَرْطَهُمْ: شَرْط + ـهُمْ — sharṭ, condition (m., acc.) + 3mp; 'their condition'
فَالْأَوْلَى: فَ + الـ + أَوْلَى — fa-, so (conj.) + awlā, more fitting, preferable (elative adj., f./invariable predicate); not the ordinal al-ūlā 'the first' used earlier in this slice, though spelled the same
سُكَاتُنَا: سُكَات + ـنَا — sukāt, silence (m. masdar, nom.) + 1cp; 'our silence'
الْقَلِيلُ: الـ + قَلِيل — qalīl, little, a small amount (adj. used as noun, nom.; subject of baqiya)
وَكُلٌّ: وَ + كُلٌّ — kull, each, every (one) (m., nom. indef.)
يَمْضِي: yamḍī — maḍā, to go, proceed (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
سَاعَةٌ: sāʿatun — sāʿa, an hour, a moment (f., nom. indef.)
نُحْضِرُهُمْ: نُحْضِرُ + ـهُمْ — aḥḍara, to bring, produce (IV, imperf. 1cp) + 3mp; 'we bring them'
وَتَسْأَلُهُمْ: وَ + تَسْأَلُ + ـهُمْ — saʾala, to ask (I, imperf. 2ms) + 3mp; 'and you ask them'; printed without the hamza sign
قِصَّتِهِمْ: قِصَّة + ـهِمْ — qiṣṣa, story (f., gen.) + 3mp; 'their story'
مُغْضَبًا: mughḍaban — mughḍab, angered (pass. part. of IV aghḍaba; acc. of state)
خَبَرِهِمْ: خَبَر + ـهِمْ — khabar, story, news (m., gen.) + 3mp; 'their story'
فَلْنَدَعِ: فَ + لْـ + نَدَعِ — fa-, so (conj.) + li-, the lām of the jussive of exhortation + nadaʿ, daʿā, to leave (I, jussive 1cp); 'so let us leave'
الْقَرَنْدَلِيَّةَ: الـ + قَرَنْدَلِيَّة — qarandaliyya, the qalandars, the wandering dervishes (f. collective, acc.)
يَسْأَلُوهُمْ: يَسْأَلُوا + ـهُمْ — saʾala, to ask (I, jussive/subjunctive 3mp, nūn dropped before the suffix) + 3mp; 'let them ask them'; the edition already prints the hamza here
بِرَأْيٍ: بِـ + رَأْيٍ — bi-, extra bāʾ reinforcing the negation (prep.) + raʾy, opinion (m., gen. indef.); printed without the hamza sign
فَتَفَاوَضُوا: فَ + تَفَاوَضُوا — tafāwaḍa, to confer, discuss together (VI of fāwaḍa, perf. 3mp)
وَكَثُرَ: وَ + كَثُرَ — kathura, to become much, numerous (verb I, perf. 3ms)
بَيْنَهُمُ: بَيْنَ + ـهُمُ — bayna, between, among (prep.) + 3mp; 'among them'
الْقَالُ: الـ + قَال — qāl, 'saying' (masdar-like noun of qāla, nom.); with al-qīl, a set doublet for idle chatter
وَالْقِيلُ: وَ + الـ + قِيل — qīl, 'being-said' (nom.); see al-qāl above
فِيمَنْ: فِي + مَنْ — fī, about (prep.) + man, who (rel./interrog. pron.)
يَسْأَلُهُمْ: يَسْأَلُ + ـهُمْ — saʾala, to ask (I, imperf. 3ms) + 3mp; 'he asks them'; the edition already prints the hamza here
قَبْلُ: qablu — before, first, beforehand (adv., indeclinable -u when used absolutely)
جَمَاعَةُ: jamāʿatu — jamāʿa, company, group (f., nom., voc.); 'O company'
لِأَيِّ: لِـ + أَيِّ — li-, for (prep.) + ayy, which, what (interrog. adj., gen.); printed without the hamza sign
تَفُوشُوا: tafūshū — a colloquial verb, 'to make a fuss, wrangle noisily' (imperf. 2mp); see the note
هَؤُلَاءِ: hāʾulāʾi — these (invariable dem. pron., mabnī); the edition prints its medial hamza-on-wāw as plain wāw, supplied here as a combining mark, and keeps its own final hamza on the line
الْجَمَاعَةَ: الـ + جَمَاعَة — jamāʿa, group, company (f., acc. as the subject of inna, in apposition to hāʾulāʾi)
يُحِبُّونَ: yuḥibbūna — aḥabba, to love, wish (IV, imperf. 3mp)
تُحَدِّثِيهِمْ: تُحَدِّثِي + ـهِمْ — ḥaddatha, to tell, narrate to (II, subjunctive 2fs, nūn dropped before the suffix) + 3mp; 'that you tell them'
بِخَبَرِ: بِـ + خَبَرِ — bi-, of (prep.) + khabar, story, news (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
قِصَّتُهُمْ: قِصَّة + ـهُمْ — qiṣṣa, story (f., nom.) + 3mp; 'their story'
تُعَاقِبِيهِمْ: تُعَاقِبِي + ـهِمْ — ʿāqaba, to punish (III, 2fs, nūn dropped) + 3mp; 'you punish them'
وَتَعُودِي: وَ + تَعُودِي — ʿāda, to return, go back (I, 2fs, nūn dropped); 'and you go back to'
وَتَبُوسُهُمْ: وَ + تَبُوسُ + ـهُمْ — colloquial bāsa, to kiss (here spelled without the 2fs ي that the three verbs just before it carry, unlike تُحَدِّثِيهِمْ, تُعَاقِبِيهِمْ, وَتَعُودِي) + 3mp; 'and you kiss them' (Classical qabbala)
وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ: وَ + أَخْبِرْ + ـهُمْ — akhbara, to tell, inform (IV, imper. 2ms) + 3mp; 'and tell them' (masculine-form imperative addressed to the lady; see the note)
فَإِنْ: fa-in — fa-, so (conj.) + in, if (conditional particle)
قٰلَ: qāla — to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); the edition's defective spelling قل for قال is pointed with the dagger alif
وَعَرَضَهَا: و + عَرَضَ + هَا — ʿaraḍa, to display, offer (v.); 'and she displayed/offered it'
بِالْمَتَاجِرِ: بِـ + الـ + مَتَاجِر — bi-, in (prep., place of an action) + al-, the + matājir (pl. of matjar), markets; 'in the markets'
الرِّجَالِ: الـ + رِجَال — rajul (pl. rijāl), man; 'the men'
سِوَارُكُمْ: سِوَار + كُمْ — siwār, bracelet (m.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your bracelet'
لِلضُّيُوفِ: لِـ + الـ + ضُيُوف — li-, to (prep., indirect object) + al-ḍuyūf, the guests (pl. of ḍayf); 'to the guests'
جَعْفَرَ: Jaʿfar, proper name (diptote, hence fatḥa with no tanwīn); 'Jaʿfar'
سَكَتَ: sakata, to fall silent, say nothing (v.); 'was silent'
أٰذَيْتُمُونِي: أٰذَى (Form IV of أذي) + تُمُو + نِي — āthā, to hurt, injure (v.) + -tumū-, you (m.pl., past) + -nī, me; 'you (pl.) hurt me'
ضُيُوفَنَا: ضُيُوف + نَا — ḍuyūf (pl. of ḍayf), guests + -nā, our; 'our guests'
الْأَذِيَّةَ: الـ + أَذِيَّة — adhiyya, hurt, injury (f., verbal noun related to ādhā, used here as cognate accusative); 'the hurt'
الْبَالِغَةَ: الـ + بَالِغَة — bāligha, reaching its full extent, utter, thorough (active participle of balagha, f.); 'the utmost, thorough'
أَنَّا: أَنَّ + نَا (contracted, shadda standing for the doubled nūn) — anna, that (particle) + -nā, we; 'that we'
شَرَطْنَا: شَرَطَ + نَا — sharaṭa, to stipulate, set as a condition (v.) + -nā, we; 'we stipulated'
كَنَاكُمْ: [archive spelling; not a recognizable Classical word — most likely a misprint for كَفَاكُمْ, 'was that enough for you,' from كَفَى + كُمْ; see note] + كُمْ, you (pl.); 'was that not enough for you'
أَدْخَلْنَاكُمْ: أَدْخَلَ (Form IV of dakhala) + نَا + كُمْ — adkhala, to bring in, admit (v.) + -nā, we + -kum, you (pl.); 'we admitted you'
مَنْزِلَنَا: مَنْزِل + نَا — manzil, house, dwelling (m.) + -nā, our; 'our house'
وَأَطْعَمْنَاكُمْ: و + أَطْعَمَ (Form IV of ṭaʿima) + نَا + كُمْ — aṭʿama, to feed (v.) + -nā, we + -kum, you (pl.); 'and we fed you'
زَادَنَا: زَاد + نَا — zād, provisions, food for a journey (m.) + -nā, our; 'our provisions'
الذَّنْبُ: الـ + ذَنْب — al-dhanb, the fault, the blame; 'the blame'
أَوْصَلَكُمْ: أَوْصَلَ (Form IV of waṣala) + كُمْ — awṣala, to bring, deliver, lead (v.) + -kum, you (pl.); 'brought you'
إِلَيْنَا: إِلَى + نَا — ilā, to (prep.) + -nā, us; 'to us'
شَمَّرَتْ: شَمَّرَ (Form II) — shammarat, she tucked up, bared (her sleeve) (v.); 'she bared/tucked up'
وَضَرَبَتِ: و + ضَرَبَتْ — ḍarabat, she struck (v., before a following hamzat-waṣl word); 'and she struck'
ضَرَبَاتٍ: ضَرَبَة (pl. ضَرَبَات) — ḍarba, a strike, blow (f.); 'strikes, blows'
عَجِّلُوا: عَجَّلَ (Form II) — ʿajjala, to hurry, hasten (v., imperative pl.); 'hurry!'
خُرُسْتَانَةٍ: khurustāna(tin), closet, storeroom (f.); not a Classical word — a non-classical/dialectal term, see note; 'of a closet'
قَلْ: [archive spelling; grammatically unclear here — most likely a misprint for قَدْ, 'already, indeed' (particle marking a completed action); see note]
فُتِحَ: فَتَحَ (passive) — futiḥa, was opened (v., passive); 'had been opened'
وَبِأَيْدِيهِمْ: و + بِـ + أَيْدِي + هِمْ — bi-, in (prep., marking location: 'in their hands') + aydī (pl. of yad), hands + -him, their; 'and in their hands'
مَسْلُولَةٌ: مَسْلُولَة — maslūla, drawn (of a blade) (passive participle of salla, to draw a blade, f.); 'drawn'
كَتِّفُوا: كَتَّفَ (Form II) — kattafa, to bind someone's arms, pinion (v., imperative pl.); 'bind!'
الْكَثِيرِينَ: الـ + كَثِيرِين — kathīr (pl. kathīrīn), many, much, numerous (adj.); 'the many, the ones who talk so much'
وَارْبِطُوا: و + ارْبِطُوا — rabaṭa, to tie, bind (v., imperative pl., hamzat waṣl so no hamza sign); 'and tie!'
بَعْضَهُمْ: بَعْض + هُمْ — baʿḍ, some, part (m.) + -hum, of them; 'some of them'
بِبَعْضٍ: بِـ + بَعْضٍ — bi-, to (prep.) + baʿḍ, some; 'to some other'
الْمُخَدَّرَةُ: الـ + مُخَدَّرَة — mukhaddara, secluded lady, one kept behind the khidr-curtain (passive participle of khaddara, f.); 'the secluded lady'
اُرْسُمِي: رَسَمَ — ursumī, decree!, prescribe! (v., imperative f., bureaucratic sense here: 'give the order'); 'decree!'
أَمْهِلُوهُمْ: أَمْهَلَ (Form IV of mahala) + هُمْ — amhala, to grant respite, give time (v., imperative pl.) + -hum, them; 'give them respite!'
أَسْأَلَهُمْ: سَأَلَ + هُمْ — saʾala, to ask (v., subjunctive after ḥattā) + -hum, them; 'I may ask them'
ضَرْبِ: ḍarb, striking (m., construct, verbal noun of ḍaraba); 'the striking of'
سِتْرَ: sitr, covering, veil, protection (m., construct, part of a stock exclamation); 'covering'
تَقْتُلِينِي: قَتَلَ + نِي — qatala, to kill (v., f., negative imperative/jussive) + -nī, me; 'you kill me'
بِذَنْبِ: بِـ + ذَنْبِ — bi-, for, because of (prep., marking cause) + dhanb, fault (m., construct); 'for the fault of'
غَيْرِي: غَيْر + ي — ghayr, other (than) (m., construct) + -ī, my/me; 'someone other than me'
وَالْجَمِيعُ: و + الْجَمِيعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-jamīʿ, everyone; 'and everyone'
أَخْطَأُوا: أَخْطَأَ (Form IV) — akhṭaʾa, to err, do wrong (v.); 'they erred'
وَدَخَلُوا: و + دَخَلُوا — dakhala, to enter (v.); 'and entered'
لَيْلَتُنَا: لَيْلَة + نَا — layla, night (f.) + -nā, our; 'our night'
طَيِّبَةً: طَيِّبَة — ṭayyiba, good, pleasant (adj., f.); 'good, pleasant'
سَلِمْنَا: سَلِمَ + نَا — salima, to be safe, unharmed (v.) + -nā, we; 'we had been safe'
أَخْرَبُوهَا: أَخْرَبَ (Form IV of kharaba) + هَا — akhraba, to ruin, lay waste to (v.) + -hā, it; 'they would ruin it'
اَحْسَنَ: أَحْسَنَ (elative of ḥasuna) — aḥsana, how excellent, how fine (exclamatory elative); the archive prints this without the hamza sign (bare alif + fatḥa only), kept exactly as printed since it already carries a mark; 'how fine is'
الْقَادِرِ: الـ + قَادِر — qādir, capable, one with power (active participle of qadara); 'the capable one'
سِيَّمَا: [with لا] — lā siyyamā, especially, all the more so (fixed idiom); 'especially'
نَاصِرِ: nāṣir, helper, protector (active participle of naṣara); 'a helper'
بِحُرْمَةِ: بِـ + حُرْمَةِ — bi-, by (prep., marking an oath/adjuration) + ḥurma, sanctity, inviolability (f., construct); 'by the sanctity of'
الْوُدِّ: الـ + وُدّ — wudd, love, affection (m.); 'the affection'
بَيْنَنَا: بَيْنَ + نَا — bayna, between (prep.) + -nā, us; 'between us'
تُفْسِدِ: أَفْسَدَ (Form IV of fasada) — tufsidi, you spoil, corrupt (v., jussive with lā); 'spoil!'
الْاَوَّلَ: الـ + اَوَّلَ — al-awwal, the first, the former (m.); the archive prints the alif without the hamza sign, kept exactly as printed; 'the former'
بِالْاٰخِرِ: بِـ + الـ + اٰخِرِ — bi-, with (prep.) + al-ākhir, the last, the latter (m.); the archive's own mark over the alif is kept exactly as printed; 'with the latter'
ضَحِكَتِ: ضَحِكَ — ḍaḥikat, she laughed (v., before a following hamzat-waṣl word); 'she laughed'
الذَّنْبِ: الـ + ذَنْبِ — al-dhanb, the fault, the sin (m., genitive here after فِي); 'the fault' (cf. الذَّنْبُ, nominative, above)
أَنَّهُمْ: أَنَّ + ـهُمْ — anna, that (particle introducing a subordinate clause, governs the accusative) + hum, they/them (3mp); 'that they'
النَّبَّاذِ: الـ + نَبَّاذ — nabbādh, wine-seller, vintner (intensive noun from نَبِيذ/نَبَذَ, wine; m., gen.); 'the wine-seller('s house)'
الْأَغْنَامَ: الـ + أَغْنَام — ghanam, sheep, flock (m. pl. أَفْعَال, acc.); 'the sheep' (object of ذَبَحَ)
الْإِكْرَامِ: الـ + إِكْرَام — ikrām, honoring, generous treatment (verbal noun IV of كَرُمَ; m., gen.)
الْجَمَاعَةِ: الـ + جَمَاعَة — jamāʿa, group, company, assembly (f., gen.)
الْحَادِيَةَ: الـ + حَادِيَة — ḥādiya, the first-element of a compound ordinal (f.), used with عَشَرَ for 'eleventh'; 'the eleventh (night)' — the compound is treated as frozen, as the edition prints عشر without the expected agreeing تاء
الْخَوَلُ: الـ + خَوَل — khawal, servants, retinue, household slaves (m. coll., nom.)
الْخَوْشَكَاشَةُ: الـ + خَوْشَكَاشَة — al-Khawshakāsha, name/nickname of one of the three sisters (nom. subject)
الْفَاكِهَانِيِّ: الـ + فَاكِهَانِيّ — fākihānī, fruiterer, fruit-seller (nisba noun from فَاكِهَة, fruit; m., gen.)
الْقَرَنْدَلِيُّ: الـ + قَرَنْدَلِيّ — qarandalī, a qalandar, wandering dervish (m. sg., nom.)
الْمَكْرُوهُ: الـ + مَكْرُوه — makrūh, something disliked, harm, mischief (pass. part. I of كَرِهَ; m., nom.)
الْهَزْلُ: الـ + هَزْل — hazl, jesting, jocularity (m., nom.)
اِعْتَبَرَ: iʿtabara — to take heed, learn a lesson (verb VIII of عَبَرَ, perf. 3ms); the initial alif is hamzat waṣl and carries no hamza sign
أَخُوهُ: أَخُو + هُ — akh, brother (m., nom., construct form before a pronoun suffix) + -hu, his; 'his brother'
أَخْبِرُونِي: أَخْبِرُوا + ـنِي — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV of خَبَر, imper. 2mpl) + 1cs object; 'inform me!'
أَخْبِرْهَا: أَخْبِرْ + هَا — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, imper. 2ms) + 3fs object; 'inform her!'
أَرُوحُ: arūḥu — rāḥa, to go, depart (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs); 'I will go'
أَزُورُ: azūru — zāra, to visit (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs); 'I visit'
أَسْمَعَ: asmaʿa — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 1cs after حَتَّى of purpose); 'that I may hear'
أَشْهُرًا: ashhuran — shahr, month (m. pl. أَفْعُل, acc. indef., adverbial accusative of duration); 'for [several] months'
أَعْمَارِكُم: أَعْمَار + ـكُم — ʿumr, life, lifetime (m. pl. أَفْعَال, gen.) + 2mpl suffix; 'your lives'
أَعْوَرُ: aʿwar — one-eyed, blind in one eye (elative-pattern adj. of عَوِرَ; m., nom.)
أَقْبَلَتْ: aqbalat — aqbala, to come forward, advance, approach (verb IV of قَبِلَ, perf. 3fs)
أَكَابِرَ: akābir — akbar/kabīr, great one, notable (m. broken pl. أَفَاعِل, acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the great ones of'
أَنْتُم: antum — you (m. pl., indep. pers. pron.)
أُمِّي: أُمّ + ـي — umm, mother (f.) + 1cs suffix; 'my mother'
إِخْوَةٌ: ikhwa — akh, brother (m. broken pl., nom. indef. as predicate); 'brothers'
بَيْتِ: bayt — house (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
بِخَبَرِكُم: بِـ + خَبَر + ـكُم — bi-, of, concerning (prep., marking the content of the telling) + khabar, news, tidings (m.) + 2mpl suffix; 'of your news'
بِلَادٍ: bilād — land, country (f. pl., gen. indef.)
تَجَارَيْتُم: tajāraytum — tajārā, to get on together, deal evenly with one another (verb VI of جَرَى, perf. 2mpl); here, 'you would have fared/gotten on [with us]' — the exact nuance is uncertain
تَسْتَأْهِلُ: tastaʾhilu — istaʾhala, to deserve, be worthy of (verb X of أَهْل, imperf. 3fs); 'she deserves'
حَدِيثٌ: ḥadīth — happening, occurrence, story (m., nom. indef.)
حَلْقِ: ḥalq — shaving (verbal noun I of حَلَقَ, m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
حَمَّالٌ: ḥammāl — porter, carrier (intensive noun of حَمَلَ, m., nom. indef.)
حِكَايَتَهُ: حِكَايَة + هُ — ḥikāya, story, tale (f., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his story'
خَدَمًا: khadaman — khadam, servants (m. coll., acc. indef.)
ذَقْنِي: ذَقْن + ـي — dhaqn, chin (m., gen.) + 1cs suffix; 'my chin'
رَأْسِكَ: رَأْس + ـكَ — raʾs, head (m., gen. after عَلَى) + 2ms suffix; 'your head' (hamza supplied; the edition prints bare 'راسك')
رُفَقَائِي: رُفَقَاء + ي — rafīq, companion (m. pl. رُفَقَاء, gen.) + 1cs suffix; 'my companions'
عَدِيدَةً: ʿadīda — numerous, many (adj. f. sg., acc., agreeing with a non-human plural)
عَزِيزِينَ: ʿazīzīna — ʿazīz, dear, honored, of standing (adj. m. sound pl., acc./gen.)
عِنْدَةُ: عِنْدَ + ةُ — ʿinda, at, with (adv., here its own frozen adverbial accusative, unprompted by a preposition) + -hu, him (the pronoun spelled with a tāʾ marbūṭa rather than ه, a Middle Arabic habit); 'at his place'
عِنْدِةِ: عِنْدِ + ةِ — ʿinda, at, with (adv., gen. after مِنْ) + -hi, him (the pronoun again spelled with a tāʾ marbūṭa); 'from his place'
غَلِطَا: ghaliṭā — ghaliṭa, to err, blunder, make a mistake (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'the two of them erred' — the reference and precise sense of this clause are uncertain
غَيْظِهَا: غَيْظ + هَا — ghayẓ, rage, vexation (m., gen.) + 3fs suffix; 'her rage'
فَالْتَفَتَتِ: فَـ + اِلْتَفَتَتِ — fa-, so (conj.) + iltafatat, to turn round, turn toward (verb VIII of لَفَتَ, perf. 3fs; initial alif is hamzat waṣl, no hamza sign; final -i is a helping vowel before the following ال)
فَأَكْرَمَنِي: فَـ + أَكْرَمَ + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + akrama, to honor, treat generously (verb IV of كَرُمَ, perf. 3ms) + 1cs object; 'so he honored me'
فَأَوَّلُ: فَـ + أَوَّلُ — fa-, so, then (conj.) + awwal, first (m., nom.); 'so the first (to...)'
فَزَعَقَ: فَـ + زَعَقَ — fa-, so (conj.) + zaʿaqa, to shout, cry out (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فُقَرَاءُ: fuqarāʾ — faqīr, poor man (m. pl. فُعَلاء, nom. indef.; a diptote pattern, hence no tanwīn nūn sound though the mark is written)
قَلَعْتُ: qalaʿtu — qalaʿa, to pluck out, uproot, tear out (verb I, perf. 1cs)
قَوْمِكُم: قَوْم + ـكُم — qawm, people, folk (m., gen.) + 2mpl suffix; 'your people'
كَبِرْنَا: kabirnā — kabira, to grow up, grow older (verb I, perf. 1cpl); 'we grew up'
كُنْتُم: kuntum — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, perf. 2mpl); 'you were'
لَصَارَتْ: لَـ + صَارَتْ — la-, indeed, then (emphatic particle answering لَوْ) + ṣārat, to become (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'it would (indeed) become'
لَهُم: لِـ + ـهُم — li-, to, for (prep.) + 3mpl suffix; 'to them'
لِوَاحِدٍ: لِـ + وَاحِدٍ — li-, to (prep.) + wāḥid, one (m., gen. indef.); 'to one (of them)'
مَجِيئِهِ: مَجِيء + هِ — majīʾ, coming, arrival (verbal noun I of جَاءَ, m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his coming'
مَعَكُم: مَعَ + ـكُم — maʿa, with (prep.) + 2mpl suffix; 'with you'
مَلِكً: malikan — malik, king (m., acc. indef. as predicate of كَانَ); the edition omits the supporting alif normally written to carry tanwīn fatḥa, kept exactly as printed
مَلِّسْ: mallis — mallasa, to smooth, wipe (verb II of مَلَسَ, imper. 2ms); a colloquial idiom for 'be off, go your way' (lit. 'wipe [your hand over your head]')
مَوْلَاتَنَا: مَوْلَاة + نَا — mawlāh, mistress, lady (f. of مَوْلَى) + 1cpl suffix; 'our mistress'
مِنْكُم: مِنْ + ـكُم — min, from, among (prep.) + 2mpl suffix; 'from/among you'
مِنْهُم: مِنْ + ـهُم — min, from, among (prep.) + 3mpl suffix; 'from/among them'
وَابْنُ: وَ + اِبْنُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ibn, son (m., nom.; hamzat waṣl, no hamza sign); 'and a son (of)'
وَالثَّالِثَ: وَ + الـ + ثَالِث — wa- + al- + thālith, third (m., acc.); 'and the third'
وَالْجِدُّ: وَ + الـ + جِدّ — wa- + al- + jidd, earnestness, seriousness (m., nom.)
وَالْعَطَّارِ: وَ + الـ + عَطَّار — wa- + al- + ʿaṭṭār, perfumer, spice- or grocer (intensive noun from عِطْر, perfume; m., gen.)
وَأَعْوَامٌ: وَ + أَعْوَام — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿwām, years (m. pl. أَفْعَال of عَام, nom. indef.); 'and years'
وَأَقْعُدُ: وَ + أَقْعُدُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aqʿudu, qaʿada, to sit, stay (verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'and I stay'
وَأَمْرٌ: وَ + أَمْرٌ — wa-, and (conj.) + amr, matter, affair (m., nom. indef.); 'and a matter'
وَأَيَّامٌ: وَ + أَيَّام — wa-, and (conj.) + ayyām, days (m. irreg. pl. of يَوْم, nom. indef.); 'and days'
وَإِلَّا: وَ + إِلَّا — wa-, and (conj.) + illā, otherwise, or else; 'or else'
وَحَاكِمٌ: وَ + حَاكِمٌ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥākim, ruler, governor (act. part. I of حَكَمَ, m., nom. indef.); 'and a ruler'
وَحَسَّنَ: وَ + حَسَّنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥassana, to make good, embellish, smooth over (verb II of حَسُنَ, perf. 3ms)
وَذَبَحَ: وَ + ذَبَحَ — wa-, and (conj.) + dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَرَوَّقَ: وَ + رَوَّقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + rawwaqa, to filter, decant (wine) (verb II of رَاقَ, perf. 3ms)
وَرُحْ: وَ + رُحْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ruḥ, rāḥa, to go (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms); 'and go!'
وَسَأَلْتُ: وَ + سَأَلْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + saʾaltu, saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I asked'
وَعِبَادٍ: وَ + عِبَادٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿibād, servants, subjects, slaves (m. pl. of عَبْد, gen. indef.)
وَقَلْعِ: وَ + قَلْعِ — wa-, and (conj.) + qalʿ, plucking out, uprooting (verbal noun I of قَلَعَ, m., gen.)
وَقْتٌ: waqt — time, a time (m., nom. indef.)
وَلَدَتْنِي: وَلَدَتْ + نِي — waladat, to give birth to, bear (verb I of وَلَدَ, perf. 3fs) + 1cs object; 'she bore me'
وَمَضَتْ: وَ + مَضَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + maḍat, to pass, elapse (verb I of مَضَى, perf. 3fs)
وَمِنْهُ: وَ + مِنْ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + min, from (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'and from him'
وَوُلِدَ: وَ + وُلِدَ — wa-, and (conj.) + wulida, walada, to bear, give birth to (verb I passive, perf. 3ms); 'and there was born'
وَيَرُوحُ: وَ + يَرُوحُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yarūḥu, rāḥa, to go, depart (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
وُلِدْتَ: wulidta — walada, to bear (verb I passive, perf. 2ms); 'you were born'
يَحِلَّ: yaḥilla — ḥalla, to alight, befall, come to rest (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after أَنْ)
يُمَلِّسُ: yumallisu — mallasa, to smooth, wipe (verb II of مَلَسَ, imperf. 3ms); the same colloquial idiom as مَلِّسْ, 'he wipes [his head], i.e. takes himself off'
الْأَوَّلُ: الـ + أَوَّل — awwal, first, former (m., nom.)
إِلَيْكَ: إِلَى + كَ — ilā, to/toward (prep.) + -ka, you (m.sg. suffix); 'to you'
مُهِمَّةٌ: مُهِمَّة — participle of أَهَمَّ (IV, 'to matter, be important'); 'important, pressing'; nominative adjective agreeing with حَاجَة
وَأُرِيدُ: وَ + أُرِيدُ — wa-, and (conj.) + urīdu, I want (impf. of أَرَادَ, IV); 'and I want'
تُخَالِفَنِي: تُخَالِفَ + نِي — tukhālifa, you oppose (subj. impf. of خَالَفَ, III, 'to oppose') + -nī, me (obj. suffix); 'you oppose me'
أَفْعَلَهُ: أَفْعَلَ + هُ — afʿala, I do (subj. impf. of فَعَلَ, I) + -hu, it; 'I do it'
بِالْأَيْمَانِ: بِـ + الـ + أَيْمَان — bi-, with, by (prep.; اسْتَوْثَقَ بِـ = 'to bind oneself by [an oath]') + al-, the + aymān, oaths (pl. of يَمِين); 'with the oaths'
وَخَلْفَهُ: وَ + خَلْفَ + هُ — wa-, and + khalfa, behind (prep./adv.) + -hu, him; 'and behind him'
مُتَزَيِّنَةٌ: مُتَزَيِّنَة — active participle of تَزَيَّنَ (V, 'to adorn oneself'); 'adorned'; nominative adjective
مُطَيَّبَةٌ: مُطَيَّبَة — passive participle of طَيَّبَ (II, 'to perfume'); 'perfumed'; nominative adjective
وَعَلَيْهَا: وَ + عَلَى + هَا — wa-, and + ʿalā, upon (prep.) + -hā, her; 'and upon her'
الْحُلَلِ: الـ + حُلَل — al-, the + ḥulal, robes, fine garments (pl. of حُلَّة); genitive after مِنَ
مَبْلَغًا: مَبْلَغ — mablagh, sum, amount (m.); accusative object of يُسَاوِي
إِلَيَّ: إِلَى + ي — ilā, to (prep.) + -ya, me (1sg. suffix, doubled ي); 'to me'
وَالْمَرْأَةُ: وَ + الْمَرْأَة — wa-, and (here introducing a circumstantial clause, 'while...') + al-marʾah, the woman (f.); nominative subject of the ḥāl-clause
الْمَرْأَةَ: الـ + مَرْأَة — al-, the + marʾah, woman; accusative object of خُذْ
وَاسْبِقْنِي: وَ + اسْبِقْ + نِي — wa-, and + isbiq, precede! go ahead of! (imper. of سَبَقَ, I) + -nī, me
الْجَبَّانَةِ: الـ + جَبَّانَة — al-, the + jabbānah, graveyard, cemetery (f.); genitive after عَلَى
الْفُلَانِيَّةِ: الـ + فُلَانِيَّة — al-, the + fulāniyyah, such-and-such, so-and-so (adj. from فُلَان, a placeholder name); genitive agreeing with الْجَبَّانَةِ
وَصَفَهَا: وَصَفَ + هَا — waṣafa, he described (perf. of وَصَفَ, I, root و-ص-ف — its initial و is a root letter, not the conjunction) + -hā, her/it; 'he described it'
فَعَرَفْتُهَا: فَ + عَرَفْتُ + هَا — fa-, so + ʿaraftu, I knew, recognized (perf. of عَرَفَ, I) + -hā, her/it; 'so I knew it'
التُّرْبَةِ: الـ + تُرْبَة — al-, the + turbah, tomb-enclosure, burial-ground (f.); genitive after إِلَى
وَانْتَظِرْ: وَ + انْتَظِرْ — wa-, and + intaẕir, wait! (imper. of Form VIII, root ن-ظ-ر)
يُمْكِنْنِي: يُمْكِنْ + نِي — yumkin, it is possible (juss. impf. of أَمْكَنَ, IV, after لَمْ) + -nī, for/to me; written with two separate ن's (verb-final + suffix), not a doubled letter; 'it was not possible for me'
الْمُخَالَفَةُ: الـ + مُخَالَفَة — al-, the + mukhālafah, opposing, contradiction (verbal noun of خَالَفَ, III); nominative subject of يُمْكِنْ
أَقْدِرْ: أَقْدِرْ — aqdir, I am able (juss. impf. of قَدَرَ, I, after لَمْ)
أَرُدَّ: أَرُدَّ — arudda, I refuse, repel (subj. impf. of رَدَّ, I, doubled root ر-د-د, dependent on أَقْدِرْ)
سُؤَالَهُ: سُؤَال + هُ — suʾāl, request, asking (m., verbal noun of سَأَلَ) + -hu, his; 'his request'
الْيَمِينِ: الـ + يَمِين — al-, the + yamīn, oath (m.); genitive after لِأَجْلِ
حَلَفْتُهُ: حَلَفْتُ + هُ — ḥalaftu, I swore (perf. of حَلَفَ, I) + -hu, it; 'I had sworn it'
فَأَخَذْتُ: فَ + أَخَذْتُ — fa-, so + akhadhtu, I took (perf. of أَخَذَ, I)
التُّرْبَةَ: الـ + تُرْبَة — al-, the + turbah, tomb-enclosure; accusative object of دَخَلْتُ
وَإِيَّاهَا: وَ + إِيَّا + هَا — wa-, and + iyyā-, disjunctive/independent object-pronoun stem + -hā, her; coordinated with أَنَا, together 'she and I'
طَاسَةٌ: طَاسَة — ṭāsah, basin, bowl (f.); indefinite nominative
وَكِيسٌ: وَ + كِيس — wa-, and + kīs, bag, purse (m.); indefinite nominative
جِبْسٌ: جِبْس — jibs, plaster, gypsum (m.); indefinite nominative
وَقَدُومٌ: وَ + قَدُوم — wa-, and + qadūm, adze, mattock (m., a heavy digging/hewing tool); indefinite nominative
الْقَدُومَ: الـ + قَدُوم — al-, the + qadūm, adze; accusative object of أَخَذَ
وَجَاءَ: وَ + جَاءَ — wa-, and + jāʾa, he came
قَبْرٍ: قَبْر — qabr, grave (m.); indefinite genitive after إِلَى
فَفَكَّهُ: فَ + فَكَّ + هُ — fa-, so + fakka, he undid, took apart (perf. of فَكَّ, I, doubled root ف-ك-ك) + -hu, it; 'so he took it apart'
وَنَقَلَ: وَ + نَقَلَ — wa-, and + naqala, he moved, transferred (perf. of نَقَلَ, I)
أَحْجَارَهُ: أَحْجَار + هُ — aḥjār, stones (pl. of حَجَر) + -hu, its; accusative object of نَقَلَ; 'its stones'
نَاحِيَةِ: نَاحِيَة — nāḥiyah, side, direction (f.); genitive after إِلَى, first term of a construct with التُّرْبَةِ
بَحَثَ: بَحَثَ — baḥatha, he dug, searched (perf. of بَحَثَ, I)
بِالْقَدُومِ: بِـ + الـ + قَدُوم — bi-, with (prep., instrumental) + al-, the + qadūm, adze; 'with the adze'
أَرْضِ: أَرْض — arḍ, ground, earth (f.); genitive, first term of a construct with الْقَبْرِ
الْقَبْرِ: الـ + قَبْر — al-, the + qabr, grave; genitive, second term of the construct with أَرْضِ
انْكَشَفَ: انْكَشَفَ — inkashafa, it was uncovered, revealed (perf. of Form VII, root ك-ش-ف)
طَابَقٍ: طَابَق — ṭābaq, slab, covering, trapdoor (m.); indefinite genitive after عَنْ
حَدِيدٍ: حَدِيد — ḥadīd, iron (m.); indefinite genitive adjective agreeing with طَابَقٍ
فَشَالَهُ: فَ + شَالَ + هُ — fa-, so + shāla, he lifted, raised (perf. of شَالَ, I) + -hu, it; 'so he lifted it'
تَحْتِهِ: تَحْتَ + هِ — taḥta, beneath (prep.) + -hi, it; 'beneath it'
سُلَّمٌ: سُلَّم — sullam, ladder, staircase (m.); indefinite nominative
مَعْقُودٌ: مَعْقُود — passive participle of عَقَدَ (I, 'to tie, knot, vault'); 'fastened, built, vaulted' — the exact sense (masonry stair? spiral stair?) is uncertain; nominative adjective
الْمَرْأَةِ: الـ + مَرْأَة — al-, the + marʾah, woman; genitive after إِلَى
دُونَكِ: دُونَ + كِ — dūna + -ki, you (f.); the idiom دونك/دونكِ, lit. 'below/at-your-disposal-you', means 'here, take it — it is yours'
تَخْتَارِي: تَخْتَارِي — takhtārī, you choose (impf. of اخْتَارَ, VIII, root خ-ي-ر); Middle Arabic drops the classical feminine ending ن (takhtārīna)
الْمَرْأَةُ: الـ + مَرْأَة — al-, the + marʾah, woman; nominative subject of نَزَلَتْ
السُّلَّمِ: الـ + سُلَّم — al-, the + sullam, ladder, staircase; genitive after مِنْ
تَمَامُ: تَمَام — tamām, completion (m.); nominative, first term of a construct with الْمَعْرُوفِ
الْمَعْرُوفِ: الـ + مَعْرُوف — al-, the + maʿrūf, kindness, favor (participle of عَرَفَ used as a noun); genitive, second term; تمام المعروف, 'the rest/completion of the favor [I ask]'
نَزَلْتُ: نَزَلْتُ — nazaltu, I go down (perf. of نَزَلَ, I, with future sense after إِذَا)
الْمَوْضِعِ: الـ + مَوْضِع — al-, the + mawḍiʿ, place, spot (m.); genitive after فِي
الطَّابَقَ: الـ + طَابَق — al-, the + ṭābaq, slab, trapdoor; accusative object of رُدَّ
وَرُدَّ: وَ + رُدَّ — wa-, and + rudda, put back!
التُّرَابَ: الـ + تُرَاب — al-, the + turāb, earth, dust (m.); accusative object of رُدَّ
الطَّابَقِ: الـ + طَابَق — al-, the + ṭābaq, slab; genitive after عَلَى
وَهٰذَا: وَ + هٰذَا — wa-, and + hādhā, this (m. demonstrative)
الْجِبْسُ: الـ + جِبْس — al-, the + jibs, plaster; nominative predicate
الْكِيسِ: الـ + كِيس — al-, the + kīs, bag; genitive after فِي
الْمَاءُ: الـ + مَاء — al-, the + māʾ, water; nominative predicate
الطَّاسَةِ: الـ + طَاسَة — al-, the + ṭāsah, basin; genitive after فِي
اِعْجِنْ: اِعْجِنْ — iʿjin, knead! (imper. of عَجَنَ, I)
الْجِبْسَ: الـ + جِبْس — al-, the + jibs, plaster; accusative object of اِعْجِنْ
الْقَبْرَ: الـ + قَبْر — al-, the + qabr, grave; accusative object of لَبِسَ
أَوَّلًا: أَوَّلًا — awwalan, at first, formerly (accusative adverb)
دَائِرِ: دَائِر — dāʾir, ring, circuit (participle of دَارَ used as a noun, 'that which goes around'); genitive, first term of a construct with الْأَحْجَارِ
الْأَحْجَارِ: الـ + أَحْجَار — al-, the + aḥjār, stones (pl. of حَجَر); genitive, second term
يَرَاهَا: يَرَى + هَا — yarā, he sees (impf. of رَأَى, I) + -hā, her/it; 'he sees it'
فَتْحٌ: فَتْح — fatḥ, an opening, a breach (m.); indefinite nominative predicate
وَبَطْنُهُ: وَ + بَطْنُ + هُ — wa-, and + baṭnu, the interior/belly of (m., nominative) + -hu, its; 'and its interior'
أَعْمَلُ: أَعْمَلُ — aʿmalu, I work (impf. of عَمِلَ, I)
حَاجَتِي: حَاجَة + ي — ḥājah, need (f.) + -ī, my; 'my need'
أَوْحَشَ: أَوْحَشَ — awḥasha, he made [someone] desolate, bereft (perf. of Form IV, root و-ح-ش); in the negative optative لا أوحش الله, 'may God not make [me] desolate,' a fixed parting-blessing
وَرَدَّيْتُ: وَ + رَدَّيْتُ — wa-, and + raddaytu, I put back (perf. of رَدَّ, I, doubled root ر-د-د); Middle Arabic gives it a weak-verb-style ending -aytu in place of the classical geminate رَدَدْتُ, 'radadtu'
وَفَعَلْتُ: وَ + فَعَلْتُ — wa-, and + faʿaltu, I did (perf. of فَعَلَ, I)
أَمَرَنِي: أَمَرَ + نِي — amara, he ordered (perf. of أَمَرَ, I) + -nī, me; 'he ordered me'
الْقَبْرُ: الـ + قَبْر — al-, the + qabr, grave; nominative subject of بَقِيَ
خُمَارِ: خُمَار — khumār, the fog/languor of intoxication, a hangover-daze (m.); genitive after فِي, first term of a construct with سَكْرَانَ
وَرَجَعْتُ: وَ + رَجَعْتُ — wa-, and + rajaʿtu, I returned (perf. of رَجَعَ, I)
وَالْقَنَصِ: وَ + الـ + قَنَص — wa-, and + al-, the + qanaṣ, the chase, pursuit of game (m.); genitive, coordinated with الصَّيْدِ
فَنِمْتُ: فَ + نِمْتُ — fa-, so + nimtu, I slept (perf. of نَامَ, I)
أَصْبَحَ: أَصْبَحَ — aṣbaḥa, to become, to enter upon (a time of day) (verb IV, root ص-ب-ح, perf. 3ms); 'the morning came, it became morning'
تَفَكَّرْتُ: تَفَكَّرْتُ — tafakkartu, to ponder, reflect (verb V, root ف-ك-ر, perf. 1cs); 'I pondered'
اللَّيْلَهَ: الـ + لَيْلَه — al-, the (article) + laylah, night (f., spelled here with هـ for ة); accusative of time; read al-laylata, 'during the night'
الْمَاضِيَةَ: الـ + مَاضِيَة — al-, the (article) + māḍiyah, past, bygone (f. sg. active participle of مَضَى); accusative, agreeing with اللَّيْلَة
ابْنِ: ابْن — ibn, son (m.); genitive, as in ابْنُ عَمٍّ 'cousin,' lit. 'son of a paternal uncle'
وَطَاوَعْتُهُ: وَ + طَاوَعْتُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭāwaʿtu, to comply with, go along with (verb III, root ط-و-ع, perf. 1cs) + -hu, him (3ms obj.); 'and I complied with him'
فَالْتَفَتُّ: فَـ + الْتَفَتُّ — fa-, so (conj.) + iltafattu, to turn around, turn one's attention (verb VIII, root ل-ف-ت, perf. 1cs)
فَخَرَجْتُ: فَـ + خَرَجْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + kharajtu, to go out (verb I, perf. 1cs)
الْمَقَابِرِ: الـ + مَقَابِر — al-, the (article) + maqābir, graves, tombs (m. pl. of مَقْبَرَة); genitive after إِلَى
وَالْجَبَّانَةِ: وَ + الـ + جَبَّانَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the (article) + jabbānah, burial-ground, cemetery (f.); genitive, coordinated with الْمَقَابِرِ
وَفَتَّشْتُ: وَ + فَتَّشْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + fattashtu, to search (verb II, root ف-ت-ش, perf. 1cs)
أَعْرِفْهَا: أَعْرِفْ + هَا — aʿrif, to know, recognize (verb I, root ع-ر-ف, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ) + -hā, it/her (3fs obj.); 'I did not recognize it'
أَزَلْ: أَزَلْ — azal, to cease (verb I, root ز-و-ل, imperf. 1cs jussive); لَمْ أَزَلْ, 'I did not cease,' idiomatically 'I kept on'
أَدُورُ: أَدُورُ — adūru, to go around, turn (verb I, root د-و-ر, imperf. 1cs); predicate of لَمْ أَزَلْ
تُرْبَةً: تُرْبَةً — turbatan, grave-plot (f.), accusative; repeated (تُرْبَةً تُرْبَةً) for a distributive sense, 'plot by plot'
وَقَبْرًا: وَ + قَبْرًا — wa-, and (conj.) + qabran, grave (m.), accusative; repeated for distributive sense
قَبْرًا: قَبْرًا — qabran, grave (m.), accusative; second of the pair قَبْرًا قَبْرًا, 'grave by grave'
أَهْتَدِ: أَهْتَدِ — ahtadi, to be guided, find one's way (verb VIII, root ه-د-ي, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ)
آكُلْ: آكُلْ — ākul, to eat (verb I, root أ-ك-ل, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ); the person-prefix hamza and the root's own hamza contract into the long ā spelled with madda here
أَشْرَبْ: أَشْرَبْ — ashrab, to drink (verb I, root ش-ر-ب, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ)
أَعْلَمُ: أَعْلَمُ — aʿlamu, to know (verb I, root ع-ل-م, imperf. 1cs)
حَالًا: حَالًا — ḥālan, state, condition (m./f.), accusative object of أَعْلَمُ
فَاغْتَمَمْتُ: فَـ + اغْتَمَمْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + ightamamtu, to be grieved (verb VIII, root غ-م-م, perf. 1cs; hamzat waṣl)
غَمًّا: غَمًّا — ghamman, grief, sorrow (m.), accusative of specification
لَيْلَتِي: لَيْلَة + ي — laylah, night (f.) + -ī, my (1cs suffix); accusative object, 'my night'
مَهْمُومًا: مَهْمُومًا — mahmūman, care-worn, anxious (m. sg. passive participle of هَمَّ), accusative of state (ḥāl)
فَجِئْتُ: فَـ + جِئْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + jiʾtu, to come (verb I, root ج-ي-أ, perf. 1cs); the edition prints the root's hamza on yāʾ (ئ), kept as printed
أُفَكِّرُ: أُفَكِّرُ — ufakkiru, to ponder, think (verb V, root ف-ك-ر, imperf. 1cs)
فَعَلَهُ: فَعَلَ + هُ — faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (3ms obj.); 'he did it'
سَمَاعِي: سَمَاع + ي — samāʿ, hearing, listening (m., verbal noun of سَمِعَ) + -ī, my (1cs suffix); 'my listening'
دُرْتُ: دُرْتُ — durtu, to go around, circle (verb I, root د-و-ر, perf. 1cs)
التُّرَبِ: الـ + تُرَب — al-, the (article) + turab, grave-plots (m. pl. of تُرْبَة); genitive after فِي
وَدُمْتُ: وَ + دُمْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + dumtu, to remain, continue (verb I, root د-و-م, perf. 1cs)
فَزَادَ: فَـ + زَادَ — fa-, so (conj.) + zāda, to increase (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْوَسْوَاسُ: الـ + وَسْوَاس — al-, the (article) + waswās, whispering, obsessive doubt (m., verbal noun of وَسْوَسَ); nominative subject of زَادَ
كِدْتُ: كِدْتُ — kidtu, to nearly do, be about to (verb I, root ك-و-د, perf. 1cs); كِدْتُ أَنْ, 'I nearly…'
أَجُنَّ: أَجُنَّ — ajunna, to go mad (verb I, root ج-ن-ن, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after أَنْ)
أَجِدْ: أَجِدْ — ajid, to find (verb I, root و-ج-د, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ)
فَرَجًا: فَرَجًا — farajan, relief, deliverance (m.), accusative object of أَجِدْ
دُونَ: دُونَ — dūna, short of, without, other than (prep.)
سَافَرْتُ: سَافَرْتُ — sāfartu, to travel, journey (verb III, root س-ف-ر, perf. 1cs)
أَبِي: أَب + ي — ab, father (m.) + -ī, my (1cs suffix); 'my father'
فَسَاعَةَ: فَـ + سَاعَةَ — fa-, so (conj.) + sāʿata, hour, moment (f.), accusative of time; 'at the moment of'
وُصُولِي: وُصُول + ي — wuṣūl, arrival (m., verbal noun of وَصَلَ) + -ī, my (1cs suffix); 'my arrival'
جَمَاعَةٌ: جَمَاعَةٌ — jamāʿatun, group, party (f.); nominative subject of نَهَضَ
وَكَتَّفُونِي: وَ + كَتَّفُوا + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + kattafū, to pinion, bind the arms of (verb II, root ك-ت-ف, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'and they pinioned me'
سُلْطَانِ: سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan, ruler (m.); genitive, construct with الْمَدِينَةِ
خَدَمُ: خَدَم — khadamu, servants (m. pl. of خَادِم); nominative predicate
وَغِلْمَانِي: وَ + غِلْمَان + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + ghilmān, pages, young servants (m. pl. of غُلَام) + -ī, my (1cs suffix); 'and my pages'
فَلَحِقَنِي: فَـ + لَحِقَ + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + laḥiqa, to overtake, catch up with (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'so it overtook me'
خَوْفٌ: خَوْفٌ — khawfun, fear (m.); nominative subject of فَلَحِقَنِي
زَائِدٌ: زَائِدٌ — zāʾidun, excessive, extra (m. sg. active participle of زَادَ); nominative adjective, agreeing with خَوْفٌ
تُرَى: تُرَى — turā, might it be seen (verb I, root ر-أ-ي, imperf. 3fs passive); يَا تُرَى, fixed exclamation, 'I wonder…'
وَأَسْأَلُ: وَ + أَسْأَلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + asʾalu, to ask (verb I, root س-أ-ل, imperf. 1cs); used here for immediate intention, 'and I will ask'
مَسَكُونِي: مَسَكُوا + نِي — masakū, to seize, lay hold of (verb I, root م-س-ك, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'they seized me'
يَرُدُّوا: يَرُدُّوا — yaruddū, to return, give back (verb I, root ر-د-د, imperf. 3mp jussive after لَمْ)
عَلَىَّ: عَلَى + ي — ʿalā, upon (prep.) + -ī/-ya, me (1cs suffix); رَدَّ عَلَيَّ, 'to answer me'; the edition spells عَلَيَّ with the letter ى in place of a word-final يّ
حِينٍ: حِينٍ — ḥīnin, a while, a time (m.); genitive after بَعْدَ
خَادِمًا: خَادِمًا — khādiman, a servant (m. sg. active participle of خَدَمَ), accusative predicate of كَانَ
أَبَاكَ: أَب + كَ — ab, father (m.) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); accusative, subject of the نّ-clause; 'your father'
غَدَرَ: غَدَرَ — ghadara, to betray, deal treacherously (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الزَّمَانُ: الـ + زَمَان — al-, the (article) + zamān, time, fortune (m.); nominative subject of غَدَرَ
وَخَامَرَ: وَ + خَامَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + khāmara, to conspire, plot (verb III, root خ-م-ر, perf. 3ms)
وَقَتَلَهُ: وَ + قَتَلَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (3ms obj.); 'and he killed him'
نَتَرَقَّبُ: نَتَرَقَّبُ — nataraqqabu, to watch for, await (verb V, root ر-ق-ب, imperf. 1cp)
بِأَمْرِهِ: بِـ + أَمْر + هِ — bi-, by (prep.) + amr, order, command (m.) + -hi, his (3ms suffix); 'by his order'
فَأَخَذُونِي: فَـ + أَخَذُوا + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + akhadhū, to take, seize (verb I, root أ-خ-ذ, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'so they seized me'
غَائِبٌ: غَائِبٌ — ghāʾibun, absent (m. sg. active participle of غَابَ); nominative predicate
سَمِعْتُهَا: سَمِعْتُ + هَا — samiʿtu, to hear (verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hā, it/her (3fs obj.); 'I heard it'
تَمَثَّلْتُ: تَمَثَّلْتُ — tamaththaltu, to present oneself, stand (verb V, root م-ث-ل, perf. 1cs); تَمَثَّلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ, 'to stand before someone'
وَبَيْنَ: وَ + بَيْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + bayna, between (prep.)
عَدَاوَةٌ: عَدَاوَةٌ — ʿadāwatun, enmity, hostility (f.); nominative subject of كَانَ
قَدِيمَةٌ: قَدِيمَةٌ — qadīmatun, old, ancient (f. sg. adj.); nominative, agreeing with عَدَاوَةٌ
وَسَبَبُ: وَ + سَبَبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + sababu, cause, reason (m.); nominative, topicalized
الْعَدَاوَةِ: الـ + عَدَاوَة — al-, the (article) + ʿadāwah, enmity (f.); genitive, construct with سَبَبُ
مُولَعًا: مُولَعًا — mūlaʿan, fond, enamored (m. sg. passive participle of أَوْلَعَ), accusative predicate of كُنْتُ
بِطَائِرٍ: بِـ + طَائِرٍ — bi-, (marking what suddenly appears, after وَإِذَا) + ṭāʾirin, a bird (m. sg. active participle of طَارَ), indefinite genitive; 'and behold, a bird'
فَأَرَدْتُ: فَـ + أَرَدْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + aradtu, to want, wish (verb IV, root ر-و-د, perf. 1cs)
أَضْرِبَ: أَضْرِبَ — aḍriba, to strike, shoot (verb I, root ض-ر-ب, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after أَنْ)
الطَّيْرَ: الـ + طَيْر — al-, the (article) + ṭayr, bird (m. collective); accusative object of أَضْرِبَ
بِالْبُنْدُقَةِ: بِـ + الـ + بُنْدُقَة — bi-, with (prep., marking what suddenly appears after وَإِذَا) + al-, the (article) + bunduqah, pellet (f. sg. of بُنْدُق); 'and behold, the pellet'
أَخْطَأَتْ: أَخْطَأَتْ — akhṭaʾat, to miss, err, go astray (verb IV, root خ-ط-أ, perf. 3fs)
عَيْنِ: عَيْن — ʿayn, eye (f.); genitive, construct with الْوَزِيرِ
قَلَعْتُهَا: قَلَعْتُ + هَا — qalaʿtu, to pull out, put out, gouge out (verb I, root ق-ل-ع, perf. 1cs) + -hā, it/her (3fs obj., referring to الْعَيْن, 'the eye'); 'I put it (the eye) out'
بِالْقَضَا: بِـ + الـ + قَضَا — bi-, by (prep.) + al-, the (article) + qaḍā, decree (m., here spelled without the final hamza of الْقَضَاء); 'by decree'
وَالْقَدَرِ: وَ + الـ + قَدَرِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the (article) + qadar, destiny, fate (m.); genitive, coordinated with الْقَضَا
الْمَاضِيَةِ: الـ + مَاضِيَة — al-, the (article) + māḍiyah, past, bygone (f. sg. adj.); genitive, agreeing with الْأَمْثَالِ
مَشَيْنَاهَا: مَشَيْنَا + هَا — mashaynā, to walk (verb I, root م-ش-ي, perf. 1cp) + -hā, them/it (3fs obj., referring to خُطًى, 'paces'); 'we walked them'
خُطًا: خُطًا — khuṭan, paces, steps (m./f. pl. of خُطْوَة), accusative object; printed without its final alif maqṣūra dot-pattern, as خُطًى usually appears
مَشَاهَا: مَشَا + هَا — mashā, to walk (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, them/it (3fs obj.); 'he walked them'
مَنِيَّتُهُ: مَنِيَّة + هُ — maniyyah, death, fate (f.) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); nominative predicate of كَانَتْ; 'his death'
بِاَرْضٍ: بِـ + اَرْضٍ — bi-, in (prep.) + arḍin, land, earth (f., indef. gen.; the edition points the vowel a hamza would carry but omits the hamza sign, copied here exactly as printed); two senses in this poem's two occurrences: (1) locative, 'in a land'; (2) 'in place of / in exchange for a land'
اَرْضٍ: اَرْضٍ — arḍin, land, earth (f.), indefinite genitive; here too printed with the hamza's vowel but not its sign
سِوَاهَا: سِوَى + هَا — siwā, other than (noun used as prep.) + -hā, it (3fs suffix, referring to أَرْض); 'other than it'
اِنْقَلَعَتْ: اِنْقَلَعَ — inqalaʿa, to be plucked out, torn out (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'it (f.) was plucked out'
عَيْنُ: ʿayn, eye (f., nom.; construct, 'the eye of…')
يَتَكَلَّمَ: takallama/yatakallamu — to speak (verb V, imperf. 3ms subj., complement of يَقْدِرْ with أَنْ omitted); 'to speak'
مُكَتَّفٌ: كَتَّفَ → مُكَتَّف — mukattaf, bound/pinioned at the arms (pass. part. of form II كَتَّفَ, nom. indef.); 'bound'
عُنُقِي: عُنُق + ي — ʿunuq, neck (gen.) + -ī, my; 'my neck'
بِأَيِّ: بِـ + أَيِّ — bi-, by, for (prep., marking the interrogative complement of the verb 'to kill for…') + ayyi, which, what (interrog., gen. after بِـ); 'for what'
عَيْنِهِ: عَيْن + ـهِ — ʿayn, eye (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his eye'
الْمَقْلُوعَةِ: الـ + مَقْلُوعَة — maqlūʿa, plucked-out (pass. part. of قَلَعَ, f., gen.); 'the plucked-out one'
فَعَلْتُهُ: فَعَلْتُ + ـهُ — faʿaltu (faʿala/yafʿalu, to do; perf. 1cs) + -hu, it; 'I did it'
خَطَأً: khaṭaʾ, error, mistake (m., indef. acc.); 'by mistake'
فَعَلْتَهُ: فَعَلْتَ + ـهُ — faʿalta (faʿala, perf. 2ms) + -hu, it; 'you did it'
أَفْعَلُهُ: أَفْعَلُ + ـهُ — afʿalu (faʿala/yafʿalu, imperf. 1cs) + -hu, it; 'I do it'
قَدِّمُوهُ: قَدِّمُوا + ـهُ — qaddimū (qaddama, form II, to bring forward; imper. 2mp) + -hu, him; 'bring him forward!'
فَقَدَّمُرْنِي: فَـ + قَدَّمُرْنِي — fa-, so + [apparently a misprint for qaddamūnī] (qaddama, form II of ق‑د‑م, to bring forward; perf. 3mp) + -nī, me; the printed ر stands where و is expected; 'so they brought me forward'
فَمَدَّ: فَـ + مَدَّ — fa-, so + madda/yamuddu, to extend, stretch out (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'so he extended'
أُصْبُعَهُ: أُصْبُع + ـهُ — uṣbuʿ, finger (acc.) + -hu, his; 'his finger'
الْيُمْنَى: الـ + يُمْنَى — yumnā, the right (f. adj., counterpart of أَيْمَن); 'the right one'
قَلَعَهَا: قَلَعَ + ـهَا — qalaʿa (qalaʿa/yaqlaʿu, to pluck out, tear out; perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (f.); 'he plucked it out'
أَعْوَرَ: aʿwar, one-eyed (adj., colour/defect pattern أَفْعَل, acc. predicate); 'one-eyed'
نَرَوْنِی: [apparently a misprint for] تَرَوْنِي — tarawnī (raʾā/yarā, to see; imperf. 2mp) + -nī, me; 'you (all) see me' — the printed ن stands where تـ is expected
كَتَفَنِي: كَتَفَ + نِي — kataf(a) (verb I, to bind the arms behind the back; perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he pinioned me'
وَحَطَّنِي: وَ + حَطَّ + نِي — wa-, and + ḥaṭṭa (ḥaṭṭa/yaḥuṭṭu, to put down, place; perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he put me'
لِلْسَّيَّافِ: لِـ + الـ + سَيَّاف — li-, to, for (prep., marks the addressee of قال) + al- (assimilated before the sun letter س, shown by the shadda) + sayyāf, swordsman, executioner (m., gen.); 'to the executioner'
وَأَشْهِرْ: وَ + أَشْهِرْ — wa-, and + ashhir (ashhara, form IV of ش‑ه‑ر, to draw, unsheathe; imper. 2ms); 'and draw!'
حُسَامَكَ: حُسَام + ـكَ — ḥusām, sword, blade (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your sword'
وَخُذْهُ: وَ + خُذْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + khudh (akhadha, irregular imper. 2ms, drops the hamza; to take) + -hu, him; 'and take him'
وَاِذْهَبْ: وَ + اِذْهَبْ — wa-, and + idhhab (dhahaba/yadhhabu, to go; imper. 2ms); 'and go'
بَرِّ: barr, open country, mainland (m., gen.; construct, 'the open country of…')
وَاُقْتُلْهُ: وَ + اُقْتُلْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + uqtul (qatala/yaqtulu, to kill; imper. 2ms) + -hu, him; 'and kill him'
وَدَعِ: وَ + دَعِ — wa-, and + daʿi (wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let alone; imper. 2ms, with the helping kasra before the following al-); 'and leave!'
الْوُحُوشَ: الـ + وُحُوش — wuḥūsh, wild beasts (pl. of waḥsh, m., acc.)
وَالطُّيُورَ: وَ + الـ + طُيُور — wa-, and + al- + ṭuyūr, birds (pl. of ṭayr, m., acc.)
تَأْكُلُهُ: تَأْكُلُ + ـهُ — taʾkulu (akala/yaʾkulu, to eat; imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the collective الوحوش والطيور) + -hu, him; 'it/they eat him'
وَأَخْرَجَنِي: وَ + أَخْرَجَ + نِي — wa-, and + akhraja (form IV of خ‑ر‑ج, to take out; perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he took me out'
مُكَتَّفُ: mukattaf, bound, pinioned (pass. part. of form II كَتَّفَ, nom.; construct, 'bound of…')
الْيَدَيْنِ: الـ + يَدَيْن — yadayn, the two hands (dual of yad, gen.)
مَغْلُولُ: maghlūl, fettered, shackled (pass. part. of غَلَّ, nom.; construct, 'fettered of…')
الرِّجْلَيْنِ: الـ + رِجْلَيْن — rijlayn, the two feet (dual of rijl, gen.)
يَعْصِبَ: yaʿṣiba — ʿaṣaba/yaʿṣibu, to bind, blindfold (imperf. 3ms subj. after أَنْ); 'to blindfold'
فَبَكَيْتُ: فَـ + بَكَيْتُ — fa-, so + bakaytu (bakā/yabkī, to weep; perf. 1cs); 'so I wept'
بُكَاءًا: bukāʾ, weeping (m., indef. acc.); the extra alif after the tanwīn is the regular spelling for accusative tanwīn on a noun ending in hamza-on-the-line; 'a weeping'
أَبْكَيْتُهُ: أَبْكَيْتُ + ـهُ — abkaytu (form IV of ب‑ك‑ي, to make weep; perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'I made him weep'
وَنَظَرْتُ: وَ + نَظَرْتُ — wa-, and + naẓartu (naẓara/yanẓuru, to look; perf. 1cs); 'and I looked'
أَنْشَدْتُ: وَ + أَنْشَدْتُ — wa-, and + anshadtu (form IV of ن‑ش‑د, to recite verse; perf. 1cs); 'and I recited'
الْأَبْيَاتَ: الـ + أَبْيَات — abyāt, verses, lines of poetry (broken pl. of bayt, acc.)
حَسِبْتُكُمْ: حَسِبْتُ + كُمْ — ḥasibtu (ḥasiba/yaḥsibu, to reckon, suppose; perf. 1cs) + -kum, you (pl.); 'I reckoned you'
دِرْعًا: dirʿ, coat of mail, armour (f., indef. acc.); 'a coat of mail'
لِتَمْنَعُوا: لِـ + تَمْنَعُوا — li-, so that (purpose-lām + subj.) + tamnaʿū (manaʿa/yamnaʿu, to prevent, ward off; imperf. 2mp subj.); 'so that you might ward off'
سِهَامَ: sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm, acc.; construct, 'the arrows of…')
الْعِدَا: الـ + عِدَا — ʿidā, enemies (collective pl. of ʿaduww); 'the enemies'
فَكُنْتُمْ: فَـ + كُنْتُمْ — fa-, but, so + kuntum (kāna, perf. 2mp); 'but you became, were'
نِصَالَهَا: نِصَال + ـهَا — niṣāl, arrowheads, blades (pl., acc.) + -hā, their (f.); 'their arrowheads'
ارْتَجِيكُمْ: اِرْتَجِي + كُمْ — artajī (irtajā, form VIII of ر‑ج‑و, to hope for; imperf. 1cs) + -kum, you (pl.); 'I hope in you'
مُلِمَّةٍ: mulimma, misfortune, calamity (used as noun from the part. of alamma; f., indef. gen.)
اَعْوَزَتْ: aʿwazat — aʿwaza, form IV of ع‑و‑ز, to be in need of, lack (perf. 3fs); 'it (f.) lacked'
شِمَالَهَا: شِمَال + ـهَا — shimāl, the left hand (m., acc.) + -hā, its (f.); 'its left'
دَعُوا: daʿū — wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let alone (imper. 2mp); 'leave!'
قِصَّةَ: qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., acc.; construct, 'the story of…')
الْعُذَّالِ: الـ + عُذَّال — ʿudhdhāl, those who blame, the reproachers (active part. pl. of ʿadhala, gen.)
بِمَعْزِلٍ: بِـ + مَعْزِلٍ — bi-, at, in (prep., idiomatically 'apart, aside') + maʿzil, a place apart (m., indef. gen.); together 'apart, at a remove'
وَخَلُّوا: وَ + خَلُّوا — wa-, and + khallū (khallā, form II of خ‑ل‑و, to leave, let; imper. 2mp); 'and let!'
يَرْمُوا: yarmū — ramā/yarmī, to throw, cast (imperf. 3mp, jussive-looking after the imperative خَلُّوا); 'let them throw'
نِبَالَهَا: نِبَال + ـهَا — nibāl, arrows, darts (pl., acc.) + -hā, their (f.); 'their arrows'
تَنْصُرُونِي: تَنْصُرُونَ + ي — tanṣurūna (naṣara/yanṣuru, to help, aid; imperf. 2mp) + -nī, me; 'you help me'
سَكَتُّمْ: sakattum — sakata/yaskutu, to be silent (perf. 2mp); 'you were silent'
وَإِخْوَانٍ: وَ + إِخْوَانٍ — wa-, and + ikhwān, brothers (broken pl. of akh, indef. gen.); 'and brothers'
حَسِبْتُهُمْ: حَسِبْتُ + هُمْ — ḥasibtu (ḥasiba, to reckon; perf. 1cs) + -hum, them; 'I reckoned them'
دُرُوعاً: durūʿ, coats of mail (pl. of dirʿ, indef. acc.)
فَكَانُوهَا: فَـ + كَانُوا + هَا — fa-, so + kānū (kāna, perf. 3mp) + -hā, it (f.; durūʿ is referred to as f. collective); 'and they became it'
لِلْاَعَادِي: لِـ + الـ + أَعَادِي — li-, for, belonging to (prep., 'in the service of') + al- + aʿādī, enemies (broken pl. of ʿaduww, gen.); 'for the enemies'
وَظَنَنْتُهُمْ: وَ + ظَنَنْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ẓanantu (ẓanna/yaẓunnu, to think, suppose; perf. 1cs) + -hum, them; 'and I thought them'
سِهَاماً: sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm, indef. acc.)
صَائِبَاتٍ: ṣāʾibāt, true-aimed, accurate (active part. f. pl. of ṣāba, indef. gen.)
شِعْرِي: شِعْر + ي — shiʿr, poem, verse (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my poem'
سَيَّافَ: sayyāf, executioner (m., acc.; predicate of كَانَ; construct, 'executioner of…')
أَبِي: أَب + ي — ab, father (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my father'
الْإِحْسَانُ: الـ + إِحْسَان — iḥsān, kindness, benefaction (verbal noun of form IV أَحْسَنَ, nom.)
مَأْمُورٌ: maʾmūr, commanded, one under orders (pass. part. of أَمَرَ, nom. indef.)
فُزْ: fuz — fāza/yafūzu, to attain, escape safely (with something); imper. 2ms; 'save yourself, escape'
بِعُمْرِكَ: بِـ + عُمْر + ـكَ — bi-, with (prep., marking the means of فُزْ) + ʿumr, life, lifetime (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'with your life'
تَجْعَلْ: tajʿal — jaʿala/yajʿalu, to make, put (imperf. 2ms juss. after لَا); 'you make'
فَتَهْلَكَ: فَـ + تَهْلَكَ — fa-, lest (introducing a result clause after a negative imperative) + tahlaka (halaka/yahliku, to perish; imperf. 2ms subj.); 'lest you perish'
وَتُهْلِكَنِي: وَ + تُهْلِكَ + نِي — wa-, and + tuhlika (form IV of ه‑ل‑ك, to destroy; imperf. 2ms subj.) + -nī, me; 'and destroy me'
وَنَفْسَكَ: وَ + نَفْس + ـكَ — wa-, and + nafs, self, soul (f., acc.) + -ka, your; 'and your soul'
صِبْتَ: ṣibta — ṣāba/yaṣību, to strike, befall (perf. 2ms); 'you were struck by, you met with'
تَنْعَى: tanʿā — naʿā/yanʿī, to mourn, announce a death (imperf. 3fs, agreeing with الدَّار); 'it (f.) mourns'
بَنَاهَا: بَنَى + ـهَا — banā (banā/yabnī, to build; perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (f.); 'built it'
فَانَّكَ: فَـ + اَنَّ + ـكَ — fa-, for, indeed (conj.) + anna, that, indeed (particle; printed without its hamza mark) + -ka, you; 'for indeed you'
وَاجِدٌ: wājid, one who finds (active part. of wajada, nom. indef.)
اَرْضاً: أَرْضاً — arḍan, a land (f., indef. acc.; printed without the hamza mark)
تَجِدْ: tajid — wajada/yajidu, to find (imperf. 2ms juss. after لَمْ); 'you find'
نَفْساً: nafsan, a soul, self (f., indef. acc.)
عَجِبْتُ: ʿajibtu — ʿajiba/yaʿjabu, to marvel, be amazed (perf. 1cs); 'I marvelled'
بِدَارِ: بِـ + دَارِ — bi-, in (prep.) + dār, house (f., gen.; construct, 'in a house of…'); 'in a house of'
وَاَرْضُ: وَ + أَرْضُ — wa-, and + arḍu (arḍ, land; f., nom.; printed without the hamza mark; construct, 'the earth of…')
وَاسِعَةٌ: wāsiʿa, wide, vast (adj. f., indef. nom.)
فَلَاهَا: فَـ + لَاهَا — fa-, so + lāhā, obscure (perhaps a form meaning 'shun it, forsake it'?) + -hā, it (f.); the reading is uncertain — the word looks chosen chiefly for the rhyme (see note on the verse)
تَبْعَثْ: tabʿath — baʿatha/yabʿathu, to send (imperf. 2ms juss. after لَا); 'you send'
رَسُولَكَ: رَسُول + ـكَ — rasūl, messenger (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your messenger'
لِلنَّفْسِ: لِـ + الـ + نَفْسِ — li-, to, for (prep., 'belonging to') + al- (assimilated before the sun letter ن) + nafs, self, soul (f., gen.); 'for the self'
نَاصِحَةٌ: nāṣiḥa, an adviser, counselor (active part. f., indef. nom.)
خَلَاهَا: خَلَا + ـهَا — khalā, apart from, other than (exceptive prep./particle) + -hā, it (f.); 'apart from itself'
غَلُظَتْ: ghaluẓat — ghaluẓa/yaghluẕu, to become thick, strong (perf. 3fs); 'it (f.) grew thick, strong'
رِقَابُ: riqāb, necks (broken pl. of raqaba, nom.; construct, 'the necks of…')
الْأُسْلِ: الـ + أُسْل — usl, spear-shafts, lances (poetic collective, gen.)
بِأَنْفُسِهَا: بِـ + أَنْفُس + ـهَا — bi-, by, with (prep., marking means, 'by themselves') + anfus, selves (pl. of nafs) + -hā, their (f.); 'by themselves'
تَوَلَّتْ: tawallat — tawallā/yatawallā, form V, to turn away (perf. 3fs); 'it (f.) turned away'
عَنَاهَا: عَنَى + ـهَا — ʿanā (ʿanā/yaʿnī, to concern, trouble, weary; perf. 3ms) + -hā, it/them (f.); 'wearied it/them'
وَهَانَ: وَ + هَانَ — wa- + hāna, to become easy (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَلْعُ: qalʿ — the plucking-out, extraction (verbal noun, m., nom.)
بِنَجَاتِي: بِـ + نَجَاة + ـِي — bi-, with (prep.) + najāh, deliverance (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'with my deliverance'
وَسَافَرْتُ: وَ + سَافَرْتُ — wa- + sāfara, to travel, journey (verb III, perf. 1cs)
فَدَخَلْتُ: فَ + دَخَلْتُ — fa- + dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 1cs)
وَأَعْلَمْتُهُ: وَ + أَعْلَمْتُ + ـهُ — wa- + aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'and I informed him'
قَلْعِ: qalʿ — plucking-out, extraction (verbal noun, m., gen. after min)
وَغَمًّا: وَ + غَمّ — wa- + ghamm, grief (m., acc. indef.)
غَمِّي: غَمّ + ـِي — ghamm, grief (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my grief'
فَإِنَّ: فَ + إِنَّ — fa-, for (conj.) + inna, indeed, verily (particle putting its subject in the acc.)
عَمِّكَ: عَمّ + ـكَ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m.) + 2ms poss.; ibn ʿammika, 'your paternal cousin'
عَالِمٌ: ʿālim — one who knows, a knower (act. part., m., nom. indef.)
يُخْبِرْنِي: يُخْبِرْ + ـنِي — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, impf. jussive 3ms yukhbir, after lam) + 1cs obj.; 'he informs/informed me'
بِخَبَرِهِ: بِـ + خَبَر + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + khabar, news (m.) + 3ms poss.; 'with news of him'
وَبَكَي: وَ + بَكَى — wa- + bakā, to weep (verb I, perf. 3ms); the edition spells this final-weak verb with dotted yāʾ where Classical orthography uses alif maqṣūra (بكى); read here as bakā
أُغْمِيَ: ughmiya — to be overcome, made to faint (verb IV أَغْمَى, pass. perf. 3ms); ughmiya ʿalayhi, 'he fainted'
فَحَزِنْتُ: فَ + حَزِنْتُ — fa- + ḥazina, to grieve (verb I, perf. 1cs)
فَأَرَادَ: فَ + أَرَادَ — fa- + arāda, to want, intend (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
يَحُطَّ: yaḥuṭṭa — to put, lay down (verb I ḥaṭṭa, impf. subjunctive 3ms, after an)
فَرَآهَا: فَ + رَآهَا — fa- + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and he saw it'
بِرُوحِكَ: بِـ + رُوح + ـكَ — bi-, by (prep.) + rūḥ, soul, spirit (f.) + 2ms poss.; 'by your soul'
يُمْكِنِي: يُمْكِنُ + ـِي — amkana, to be possible (verb IV, impf. 3ms yumkinu) + 1cs obj.; the edition drops the geminate نّ expected before the suffix (يُمْكِنِّي); 'it is possible for me'
وَلَدُهُ: وَلَد + ـهُ — walad, son (m.) + 3ms poss.; 'his son'
فَأَعْلَمْتُهُ: فَ + أَعْلَمْتُ + ـهُ — fa- + aʿlamtu, I informed (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I informed him'
اِبْنِهِ: اِبْن + ـهِ — ibn, son (m.) + 3ms poss.; 'his son'
أِرِنِي: أَرِ + ـنِي — arā, to show (verb IV, imper. 2ms ari) + 1cs obj.; 'show me'
مَكَانَهَا: مَكَان + ـهَا — makān, place (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'its place'
رُحْتُ: ruḥtu — I went (verb I rāḥa, perf. 1cs)
مِرَارًا: mirār — times, repeatedly (m. pl., acc. adverbial)
وَعَمِّي: وَ + عَمِّي — wa- + ʿammī, my uncle; 'and my uncle'
وَشِمَالًا: وَ + شِمَال — wa- + shimāl, the left (side) (m., acc. adverbial)
فَرِحْنَا: فَرِحَ + ـنَا — fariḥa, to rejoice (verb I, perf. 1cp naḥnu); 'we rejoiced'
وَإِيَّاهُ: وَ + إِيَّا + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + iyyā-, particle used to coordinate an independent object pronoun + 3ms suffix; 'and he' (lit. 'and him')
وَشَلْنَا: وَ + شَلْنَا — wa- + shāla, to lift, carry off, clear away (verb I, colloquial, perf. 1cp)
رَفَعْنَا: رَفَعَ + ـنَا — rafaʿa, to lift, raise (verb I, perf. 1cp)
الطَّابِقَ: الـ + طَابِق — al- + ṭābiq, here the flagstone or slab covering the vault (m., acc.)
وَنَزَلْتُ: وَ + نَزَلْتُ — wa- + nazala, to descend, go down (verb I, perf. 1cs)
دَرَجَةً: darajat — a step, degree (f., acc. indef., specifier after the numeral)
وَصَلْنَا: وَ + وَصَلْنَا — wa- + waṣala, to arrive (verb I, perf. 1cp)
بِدُخَانٍ: بِـ + دُخَان — bi-, [marking what appears] (prep., after the idhā of surprise) + dukhān, smoke (m., gen. indef.); 'there was smoke'
غَشَى: ghashā — to cover, envelop, overspread (verb I, perf. 3ms; the edition spells this final-weak verb with alif maqṣūra, the fatḥa-type pattern)
أَبْصَارَنَا: أَبْصَار + ـنَا — abṣār, sights, eyesight (m. pl. of baṣar) + 1cp poss.; 'our sights'
يَخْجَلُ: yakhjalu — he is ashamed, feels shame (verb I khajila, impf. 3ms)
قَائِلُهَا: قَائِل + ـهَا — qāʾil, sayer, speaker (act. part., m.) + 3fs poss.; 'its speaker'
مَشَيْنَا: mashaynā — we walked (verb I mashā, perf. 1cp)
بِقَاعَةٍ: بِـ + قَاعَةٍ — bi-, in (prep.) + qāʿah, hall, chamber (f., gen. indef.)
مَلَانَةٍ: malānat — full (adj., f., gen. indef.); the colloquial form of the adjective, without the root hamza of Classical malʾā/mumtaliʾa
دَقِيقًا: daqīq — flour (m., acc.; specifying what the hall was full of)
الْحُبُوبِ: الـ + حُبُوب — al- + ḥubūb, grains (m. pl. of ḥabb, gen.)
وَالْمَأْكُولِ: وَ + الـ + مَأْكُول — wa- + al- + maʾkūl, food, that which is eaten (pass. part. I akala, m., gen.)
بِشَخَّانَةٍ: بِـ + شَخَّانَةٍ — bi-, with (prep.) + shakhkhānah (f., gen. indef.); an obscure word, not in the standard lexicons — perhaps a canopy or curtain over the couch, or a heating-vessel (root sh-kh-n, 'to warm')
مُرْخَاةٍ: murkhāt — let down, lowered (pass. part. IV arkhā, f., gen. indef.)
فَوَجِلَ: فَ + وَجِلَ — fa- + wajila, to be terrified, afraid (verb I, perf. 3ms)
اِبْنُهُ: اِبْن + ـهُ — ibn, son (m., nom.) + 3ms poss.; 'his son'
صَارَا: ṣārā — the two of them became (verb I ṣāra, perf. 3md)
مُتَعَانِقَيْنِ: mutaʿāniqayn — embracing one another (act. part. VI taʿānaqa, m. dual, acc.)
أُلْقِيَا: ulqiyā — the two of them were thrown, cast (verb IV alqā, pass. perf. 3md)
تَسْتَاهِلُ: tastāhilu — you deserve [it] (verb X, impf. 2ms; the colloquial form of Classical tastaʾhilu)
خِنْزِيرُ: khinzīr — pig, swine (m., nom., in address/vocative)
عَذَابُ: ʿadhāb — punishment, torment (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
الْآخِرَةِ: الـ + آخِرَة — al- + ākhirah, the hereafter, the next life (f., gen.)
أَشَدُّ: ashaddu — more severe, more intense (comparative adj., nom.)
وَأَقْوَى: وَ + أَقْوَى — wa- + aqwā, stronger, more powerful (comparative adj.)
الْقَرَنْدَلِيَّ: الـ + قَرَنْدَلِيّ — qarandalī, Qalandar, wandering dervish (m., acc.; subject of أَنَّ) — a Persian loanword treated as a declinable nisba noun
لِلصَّبِيَّةِ: لِـ + الـ + صَبِيَّة — ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f., gen.); li-, to (prep., marking the addressee of قَالَ)
وَالْجَمَاعَةُ: وَ + الـ + جَمَاعَة — jamāʿa, company, group (f., nom.; subject of a circumstantial clause with يَسْمَعُونَ)
يَسْمَعُونَ: samiʿa/yasmaʿu — to hear, listen (verb I, imperf. 3mp); plural verb with the collective الجماعة
وَالْخَلِيفَةُ: وَ + الـ + خَلِيفَة — khalīfa, caliph, vicegerent (m., nom.)
ضَرَبَ: ḍaraba — to strike, beat (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَلَدَهُ: وَلَد + ـهُ — walad, son, child (m., acc.) + 3ms; 'his son'
بِالزَّرْبُونِ: بِـ + الـ + زَرْبُون — zarbūn, shoe, slipper (m., gen.; a Middle Arabic/Ottoman-derived loanword); bi-, with (prep., instrumental)
فُحِّمَ: fuḥḥima — was charred, turned to coal (pass., verb II of faḥm, 'charcoal'; perf. 3ms)
سُوِّدَ: suwwida — was blackened (pass., verb II of aswad/sawād, 'black'; perf. 3ms)
فِعْلِهِ: فِعْل + ـهِ — fiʿl, deed, act (m., gen. after مِنْ) + 3ms; 'his deed'
وَحَزِنْتُ: وَ + حَزِنْتُ — ḥazina, to grieve (verb I, perf. 1cs)
زَوِّلْ: zawwil — remove, dispel! (imper. 2ms, verb II of zāla, 'to depart, cease'; causative, taking a direct object)
قَلْبِكَ: قَلْب + ـكَ — qalb, heart (m., gen. after عَنْ) + 2ms
غُصَّةً: ghuṣṣa — a choking lump, distress (f., acc.; object of زَوِّلْ)
لَقَدِ: لَـ + قَدِ — la-, indeed (emphatic particle) + qad (marks a completed perfect)
وَخَاطِرِي: وَ + خَاطِر + ـي — khāṭir, thought, mind (m., nom., coordinated with سِرِّي) + 1cs
وَاغْتَمَيْتُ: وَ + اِغْتَمَيْتُ — ightamā/ightamma, to be grieved, distressed (verb VIII, perf. 1cs; this text's spelling of Classical اغْتَمَمْتُ, the geminate root's second radical written with a yāʾ)
وَلَدِكَ: وَلَد + ـكَ — walad, son (m., gen. after عَلَى) + 2ms
وَلَدُكَ: وَلَد + ـكَ — walad, son (m., nom.; subject of بَقِيَ) + 2ms
كَفَاهُمْ: كَفَى + ـهُمْ — kafā, to suffice, be enough for (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.
ضَرَبْتَهُ: ضَرَبْتَ + ـهُ — ḍaraba, to strike (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.
صِغَرِهِ: صِغَر + ـهِ — ṣighar, smallness, childhood (m., gen. after مِنْ) + 3ms
بِحُبِّ: بِـ + حُبّ — ḥubb, love (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., governed by مُولَعٌ بِـ, 'infatuated with')
أُخْتِهِ: أُخْت + ـهِ — ukht, sister (f., gen.) + 3ms; hamza supplied, edition prints bare اخته
أَنْهَاهُ: أَنْهَى + ـهُ — nahā, to forbid (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; hamza supplied, edition prints bare انهاه
دُولْ: dūl — these (colloquial Egyptian demonstrative, pl.; not Classical هَؤُلَاءِ, kept as printed)
صِغَارٌ: ṣighār — young ones, children (pl. of ṣaghīr, m., nom.; predicate of an implied 'they are')
كَبِرَا: kabira — to grow up, become older (verb I, perf. 3md)
الْقَبِيحُ: الـ + قَبِيح — qabīḥ, foul, ugly (adj. used substantively, m., nom.; subject of وَقَعَ)
وَسَمِعْتُ: وَ + سَمِعْتُ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 1cs)
أُصَدِّقْ: ṣaddaqa/yuṣaddiqu — to believe, deem true (verb II, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ); hamza supplied, edition prints bare اصدق
فَمَسَكْتُهُ: فَ + مَسَكْتُ + ـهُ — masaka, to seize, take hold of (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
وَزَجَرْتُهُ: وَ + زَجَرْتُ + ـهُ — zajara, to rebuke, reprove (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
زَجْرًا: zajr — a rebuking, reproof (verbal noun, m., acc.; cognate accusative of زَجَرَ)
بَلِيغًا: balīgh — eloquent, forceful, vehement (adj., m., acc.; modifying زَجْرًا)
الْخُدَّامُ: الـ + خُدَّام — khādim, servant (m. broken pl., nom.; subject of قَالُوا, following the verb — see n on this unit)
احْذَرْ: iḥdhar — beware! (imper. 2ms of ḥadhira, 'to be wary')
الْقَبِيحَةِ: الـ + قَبِيحَة — qabīḥ, foul, ugly (adj., f. sg. agreeing with the non-human pl. الفعال, gen.)
فَعَلَهَا: فَعَلَ + ـهَا — faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَتَبْقَى: وَ + تَبْقَى — baqiya/tabqā, to remain (verb I, imperf. 2ms)
بِالْمَعِيرَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مَعِيرَة — maʿīra, reproach, taunting (f., gen.; a Middle Arabic nominal form beside مُعَايَرَة); bi-, in (prep., marking the state one remains in)
وَالنُّقْصَانِ: وَ + الـ + نُقْصَان — nuqṣān, deficiency, diminishment (m., gen., coordinated with المعيرة)
وَتَشِيعُ: وَ + تَشِيعُ — shāʿa/tashīʿu, to spread abroad, become known (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
أَخْبَارُنَا: أَخْبَار + ـنَا — khabar, news (m. pl., nom.; subject of تَشِيعُ) + 1cp
الرُّكْبَانِ: الـ + رُكْبَان — rākib, rider (m. pl., gen.); 'the riders, travelers'
وَإِيَّاكَ: وَ + إِيَّاكَ — iyyā-, independent object-pronoun base + 2ms; used in the warning formula إِيَّاكَ أَنْ, 'beware lest'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare اياك
تَصْدُرَ: ṣadara/taṣduru — to proceed, issue forth (verb I, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after أَنْ)
الْفِعَالُ: الـ + فِعَال — fiʿāl, deeds (broken pl. of fiʿl, nom.; subject of تَصْدُرَ)
أَسْخَطُ: sakhiṭa/askhaṭu — to be angry, wrathful (verb I, imperf. 1cs); hamza supplied, edition prints bare اسخط
وَأَقْتُلُكَ: وَ + أَقْتُلُ + ـكَ — qatala/aqtulu, to kill (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; hamza supplied, edition prints bare واقتلك
وَحَجَبْتُهُ: وَ + حَجَبْتُ + ـهُ — ḥajaba, to seclude, veil, screen off (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
وَحَجَبْتُهَا: وَ + حَجَبْتُ + ـهَا — ḥajaba, to seclude (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj.
تُحِبُّهُ: تُحِبُّ + ـهُ — aḥabba/yuḥibbu, to love (verb IV, imperf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.
أَعْمَالَهُمَا: أَعْمَال + ـهُمَا — ʿamal, deed (m. pl., acc.; object of زَيَّنَ) + 3md
حَجَبْتُهُمَا: حَجَبْتُ + ـهُمَا — ḥajaba, to seclude (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3md obj.
فِعْلًا: fiʿl — deed, act; here an accusative-of-manner adverb, 'indeed, in fact' (see n on this unit for the difficulty of this reading)
وَسَوَّاهُ: وَ + سَوَّى + ـهُ — sawwā, to level, make ready, fashion (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
الْمَأْكُولَ: الـ + مَأْكُول — maʾkūl, food (pass. part. of akala, 'to eat', m., acc.); hamza supplied, edition prints bare الماكول
تَرَاهُ: تَرَى + ـهُ — raʾā/tarā, to see (verb I, imperf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.
