فَأَشَرْنَا: فَـ + أَشَرْنَا — ashāra, to point, gesture, signal (verb IV, perf. 1cp); with ilā and bi-
بِالْأَصَابِعِ: بِـ + الـ + أَصَابِع — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + aṣābiʿ, fingers (m. pl. of iṣbaʿ; gen.); hamza supplied, edition prints bare بالاصابع
وَقُلْنَا: وَ + قُلْنَا — wa-, and + qāla, to say (verb I, perf. 1cp)
رُسُلُ: rusul — envoys, messengers (m. pl. of rasūl, nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
تُؤْذُونَا: تُؤْذُو + نَا — tuʾdhū, you (pl.) harm (imperf. 2mp jussive of IV ādhā) + 1cp obj.; 'do not harm us'; the edition already prints the hamza
لَسْنَا: lasnā — we are not (perf. 1cp of laysa)
أَرْضِهِ: أَرْض + ـهِ — arḍ, land (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'his land'
بَعْضَ: baʿḍ — some, part (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْغِلْمَانِ: الـ + غِلْمَان — ghilmān, servant-boys, pages (m. pl. of ghulām; gen.)
وَهَرَبَ: وَ + هَرَبَ — wa-, and + haraba, to flee (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْبَاقُونَ: الـ + بَاقُونَ — bāqūn, the remaining ones (act. part. pl. of baqiya; m., nom.)
انْجَرَحْتُ: injaraḥtu — I was wounded, cut (verb VII, perf. 1cs of jaraḥa); hamzat waṣl, unmarked
جُرْحًا: jurḥ — a wound (m., acc. as the cognate-type object of injaraḥtu)
بَلِيغَةً: balīgh(a) — grievous, severe (adj. of balagha; acc.); the edition prints the feminine ending though jurḥ is masculine, see n on this sentence
وَاشْتَغَلَتْ: وَ + اشْتَغَلَتْ — wa-, and + ishtaghalat, it/she became occupied, busied itself (verb VIII, perf. 3fs of shaghala); hamzat waṣl, unmarked
الْعَرَبُ: الـ + عَرَب — ʿarab, the Arabs, the raiders (coll. n., nom. as subject)
بِالْمَالِ: بِـ + الـ + مَال — bi-, with (prep.) + māl, money, property (m., gen.)
وَالْهَدَايَا: وَ + الـ + هَدَايَا — wa-, and + hadāyā, gifts (f. pl. of hadiyya, gen.)
أَدْرِي: adrī — I know (imperf. 1cs of daraytu darā)
عَزِيزًا: ʿazīz — mighty, dear, powerful (m., acc. as predicate of kuntu)
ذَلِيلًا: dhalīl — abject, lowly, humbled (m., acc. as predicate of ṣirtu)
سِرْتُ: sirtu — I journeyed, traveled (perf. 1cs of sāra, hollow verb); here preceded by an isolated وَ, the archive's own line-final token (P82L05/L06), kept unjoined — see n on the opening sentence of this tale
رَاسَ: rās — head, top (colloquial for Classical raʾs, without the hamza; m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); see n on مَلِّسْ عَلَى رَاسَكَ above
فَأَوَيْتُ: فَـ + أَوَيْتُ — awaytu, I took shelter, took refuge (perf. 1cs of awā); with ilā
مَغَارَةٍ: maghāra — a cave (f., gen. with tanwīn)
أَمِينَةٍ: amīna — secure, trustworthy, safe (f., gen.; adj. of madīna); hamza supplied, edition prints bare امينة
حَصِينَةٍ: ḥaṣīna — fortified, well-defended (f., gen.; adj. of madīna)
الشِّتَاءُ: الـ + شِتَاء — shitāʾ, winter (m., nom. as subject); the edition already prints its final hamza
بِبَرْدِهِ: بِـ + بَرْد + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + bard, cold (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'with its cold'
وَأَقْبَلَ: وَ + أَقْبَلَ — wa-, and + aqbala, to come, approach, draw near (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
الرَّبِيعُ: الـ + رَبِيع — rabīʿ, spring (the season; m., nom. as subject)
بِوَرْدِهِ: بِـ + وَرْد + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + ward, rose(s) (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'with its roses'
وَأَطْلَعَتْ: وَ + أَطْلَعَتْ — wa-, and + aṭlaʿat, it put forth, brought out (verb IV, perf. 3fs of ṭalaʿa); see n on this sentence for the subject
أَزْهَارَهَا: أَزْهَار + ـهَا — azhār, flowers, blossoms (m. pl. of zahr, acc.) + 3fs; 'its blossoms'
وَتَدَفَّقَتْ: وَ + تَدَفَّقَتْ — wa-, and + tadaffaqat, it gushed, flowed freely (verb V, perf. 3fs of dafaqa)
أَنْهَارُهَا: أَنْهَار + ـهَا — anhār, rivers (m. pl. of nahr, nom.) + 3fs; 'its rivers'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare انهارها
وَتَغَرَّدَتْ: وَ + تَغَرَّدَتْ — wa-, and + taghurradat, it warbled, sang (verb V, perf. 3fs of gharrada)
أَطْيَارُهَا: أَطْيَار + ـهَا — aṭyār, birds (m. pl. of ṭāʾir/ṭayr, nom.) + 3fs; 'its birds'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare اطيارها
مَدِينَةٌ: madīna — a city (f., nom.; topic of the verse)
لِسَاكِنِهَا: لِـ + سَاكِن + ـهَا — li-, for (prep.) + sākin, dweller, inhabitant (act. part. of sakana; m., gen.) + 3fs; 'for its dweller'
مُرَوَّعٌ: murawwaʿ — one made afraid, terrified (pass. part. of II rawwaʿa; m., nom.; the thing negated by mā)
وَالْأَمَانُ: وَ + الـ + أَمَان — wa-, and + amān, safety, security (m., nom. as subject)
صَاحِبُهَا: صَاحِب + ـهَا — ṣāḥib, companion, owner (m., nom.; predicate) + 3fs; 'its companion'
كَأَنَّهَا: كَأَنَّ + ـهَا — kaʾanna, as though, as if (particle, putting its subject in the acc.) + 3fs; 'as though it'
جَنَّةٌ: janna — a garden, paradise-garden (f., nom.; predicate of kaʾanna)
مُزَخْرَفَةٌ: muzakhrafa — adorned, embellished (pass. part. of II zakhrafa; f., nom.; adj. of janna)
لِأَهْلِهَا: لِـ + أَهْل + ـهَا — li-, for (prep.) + ahl, people, folk (m., gen.) + 3fs; 'for its people'
بَدَتْ: badat — it appeared, became visible (perf. 3fs of badā)
عَجَائِبُهَا: عَجَائِب + ـهَا — ʿajāʾib, wonders, marvels (f. pl. of ʿajība, nom.) + 3fs; 'its wonders'
فَرِحْتُ: fariḥa, to rejoice, be glad (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I rejoiced'
بِوُصُولِي: بِـ + وُصُول + ـي — bi-, at (prep.) + wuṣūl, arrival (verbal noun of waṣala) + 1s suffix; 'at my arrival'
تَعِبْتُ: taʿiba, to grow weary, tired (verb I, perf. 1cs)
الْمَشْيِ: الـ + مَشْي — mashy, walking (verbal noun of mashā; m., gen.)
وَعَلَانِيَ: وَ + عَلَا + ـنِيَ — wa-, and + ʿalā, to overcome, come over (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'and ... came over me'
الْهَمُّ: الـ + هَمّ — hamm, care, worry, grief (m., nom.)
الِاصْفِرَارُ: الـ + اِصْفِرَار — iṣfirār, paleness, turning yellow (verbal noun of iṣfarra, verb IX; m., nom.); coordinated, with the preceding وَ, with الْهَمُّ
فَتَغَيَّرَتْ: فَـ + تَغَيَّرَتْ — fa-, so + taghayyarat (taghayyara, to change, verb V, perf. 3fs); 'so it changed'
أَسْلُكُ: asluku — salaka, to take (a path), go along (verb I, impf. 1cs)
فَاجْتَزْتُ: فَـ + اجْتَزْتُ — fa-, so + ijtāza, to pass by, traverse (verb VIII of jāza, perf. 1cs); 'so I passed by'
خَيَّاطًا: khayyāṭ — tailor (intensive noun of profession, pattern faʿʿāl, from khāṭa, 'to sew'; m. acc. indef.)
وَرَحَّبَ: وَ + رَحَّبَ — wa-, and + raḥḥaba, to welcome (verb II, perf. 3ms)
وَانْبَسَطَ: وَ + انْبَسَطَ — wa-, and + inbasaṭa, to be open, expansive, cheerful (verb VII of basṭ, perf. 3ms); 'and he was open (with me)'
آنَسَنِي: آنَسَ + ـنِي — ānasa, to make friendly, put at ease (verb IV of uns, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'he put me at ease'
وَسَأَلَنِي: وَ + سَأَلَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'and he asked me'
غُرْبَتِي: غُرْبَة + ـي — ghurba, estrangement, exile, being a stranger (f.) + 1s suffix; 'my exile'
فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ: فَـ + أَخْبَرْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I told him'
أَوَّلِهِ: أَوَّل + ـهِ — awwal, first, beginning (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'its beginning'
فَاغْتَمَّ: فَـ + اغْتَمَّ — fa-, so + ightamma, to grieve, be distressed (verb VIII of ghamm, perf. 3ms); 'so he grieved'
لِأَجْلِي: لِـ + أَجْل + ـي — li-, for (prep.) + ajl, sake (m.) + 1s suffix; 'for my sake'
تُظْهِرْ: tuẓhir — aẓhara, to show, reveal (verb IV, impf. 2ms jussive after لَا)
مَلِكِ: malik, king (m., gen., first term of construct)
وَإِنَّهُ: وَ + إِنَّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + inna, indeed (particle) + 3ms suffix, subject of the following predicate; 'and indeed he'
أَكْبَرُ: أَكْبَر — akbar, greater/greatest (elative of kabura; m. nom., predicate of إِنَّ); 'the greatest of'
أَعْدَاءِ: أَعْدَاء — ʿaduww/aʿdāʾ, enemy/enemies (m. broken pl., gen.; made definite by the following construct, so it takes the regular case ending rather than the diptote fatḥa); 'the enemies of'
أَبِيكَ: أَبِي + ـكَ — ab, father (m., one of the 'five nouns', oblique/gen. stem abī) + 2ms suffix; 'your father'
أَحْضَرَ: aḥḍara — to bring, cause to be present (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
وَمَشْرُوبًا: وَ + مَشْرُوبًا — wa-, and + mashrūb, something drunk, a drink (pass. part. of shariba; m., acc. indef.); 'and a drink'
فَأَكَلْتُ: فَـ + أَكَلْتُ — fa-, so + akaltu (akala, perf. 1cs); 'so I ate'
وَأَكَلَ: وَ + أَكَلَ — wa-, and + akala (to eat, perf. 3ms); 'and he ate'
وَتَحَادَثْتُ: وَ + تَحَادَثْتُ — wa-, and + taḥādatha, to converse together (verb VI of ḥadīth, perf. 1cs); 'and I conversed'
وَأَفْرَدَ: وَ + أَفْرَدَ — wa-, and + afrada, to set apart, single out (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he set aside'
حَانُوتِهِ: حَانُوت + ـهِ — ḥānūt, shop, stall (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his shop'
وَأَتَانِي: وَ + أَتَى + ـنِي — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; أَتَى بِـ = 'to bring'; 'and he brought me'
احْتَاجَ: iḥtāja — to need, be in need of (verb VIII of ḥāja, perf. 3ms; construed with ilā); printed as 3ms though the sense wants 1cs, see the note on this unit
وَلِحَافٍ: وَ + لِحَاف — wa-, and + liḥāf, coverlet, quilt (m., gen. indef.); 'and a coverlet'
فَأَقَمْتُ: فَـ + أَقَمْتُ — fa-, so + aqāma, to stay, remain (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'so I stayed'
ثَلَاثَةَ: thalātha, three (f.-form number counting a m. noun, by the polarity rule; acc. adverbial); thalāthata ayyāmin = 'three days'
تَكْتَسِبُ: taktasibu — iktasaba, to earn, gain (verb VIII of kasaba, impf. 2ms)
فَقِيهٌ: faqīh — jurist, one learned in fiqh (n. of relation to fiqh; m. nom. indef.)
كَاتِبٌ: kātib — scribe, writer (act. part. of kataba; m. nom. indef.)
حَاسِبٌ: ḥāsib — reckoner, accountant (act. part. of ḥasaba; m. nom. indef.)
خَطَّاطٌ: khaṭṭāṭ — calligrapher (intensive noun of profession, pattern faʿʿāl, from khaṭṭa; m. nom. indef.)
صَنْعَتُكَ: صَنْعَة + ـكَ — ṣanʿa, craft, trade (f., nom.) + 2ms suffix; 'your craft'
كَاسِدَةٌ: kāsida — unsalable, at a standstill, in no demand (act. part. of kasada; f., nom.)
بِلَادِنَا: بِلَاد + ـنَا — bilād, country, land (f. pl.) + 1pl suffix; 'our country'
مَدِينَتِنَا: مَدِينَة + ـنَا — madīna, city (f., gen.) + 1pl suffix; 'our city'
الْكَسْبِ: الـ + كَسْب — kasb, earning, gain, livelihood (m., gen.)
ذَكَرْتُهُ: ذَكَرْتُ + ـهُ — dhakara, to mention, recall (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'I mentioned it'
شُدَّ: shudda — shadda, to tie, gird, tighten (verb I doubled, imper. 2ms); 'gird!'
وَسَطَكَ: وَسَط + ـكَ — wasaṭ, waist, middle (m., acc.) + 2ms suffix; 'your waist'
وَخُذْ: وَ + خُذْ — wa-, and + khudh (akhadha, to take; irregular imper. 2ms dropping the root hamza); 'and take!'
وَحَبْلًا: وَ + حَبْلًا — wa-, and + ḥabl, rope (m., acc. indef.); 'and a rope'
وَاحْتَطِبْ: وَ + احْتَطِبْ — wa-, and + iḥtaṭaba, to gather firewood (verb VIII of ḥaṭab, imper. 2ms); 'and gather firewood!'
تَتَقَوَّتُ: tataqawwatu — taqawwata, to nourish oneself, subsist (verb V of qūt, impf. 2ms); 'you subsist'
يُفَرِّجَ: yufarrija — farraja, to relieve, dispel distress (verb II, impf. 3ms subjunctive after أَنْ)
تُعَرِّفْهُمْ: تُعَرِّفْ + ـهُمْ — ʿarrafa, to make known, acquaint (verb II, impf. 2ms jussive after لَا) + 3mp obj.; 'make yourself known to them'
بِنَفْسِكَ: بِـ + نَفْس + ـكَ — bi-, with, of (prep.) + nafs, self, soul (f.) + 2ms suffix; 'of yourself' (with ʿarrafa bi-, 'make known of')
يَقْتُلُوكَ: يَقْتُلُوا + ـكَ — yaqtulū (qatala, to kill, impf. 3mp jussive, jawāb al-ṭalab) + 2ms obj.; 'they will kill you'
وَسَلَّمَنِي: وَ + سَلَّمَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + sallama, to hand over, deliver (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'and he handed me over'
الْحَطَّابِينَ: الـ + حَطَّابِين — ḥaṭṭāb, woodcutter (m. sound pl., gen.; intensive noun of profession, pattern faʿʿāl); 'the woodcutters'
وَأَوْصَاهُمْ: وَ + أَوْصَى + ـهُمْ — awṣā, to charge, commend, instruct (verb IV of waṣiyya, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.; 'and he charged them'
احْتَطَبْتُ: iḥtaṭaba — to gather firewood (verb VIII of ḥaṭab, perf. 1cs); 'I gathered firewood'
نَهَارِي: نَهَار + ـي — nahār, daytime (m., acc. adverbial) + 1s suffix; 'my day'
فَأَتَيْتُ: فَـ + أَتَيْتُ — fa-, and so + ataytu (atā, perf. 1cs); 'and so I came'
بِحِمْلٍ: بِـ + حِمْل — bi-, with (prep.) + ḥiml, load, burden (m., gen. indef.); 'with a load'
فَبِعْتُهُ: فَـ + بِعْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + biʿtu (bāʿa, to sell, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I sold it'
بِنِصْفِ: بِـ + نِصْف — bi-, for (prep., of price) + niṣf, half (m., gen.); 'for half of'
بِبَعْضِهِ: بِـ + بَعْض + ـهِ — bi-, with, off (prep.) + baʿḍ, part (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'off part of it'
وَأَبْقَيْتُ: وَ + أَبْقَيْتُ — wa-, and + abqā, to leave, keep back (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'and I kept back'
بَعْضَهُ: بَعْض + ـهُ — baʿḍ, part, some (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'part of it'
مِلَّةَ: milla, religious community, creed (f., acc.); printed here where مُدَّة, 'a period, space of time', is meant — see the note on this unit
وَاسْتَغْرَقْتُ: وَ + اسْتَغْرَقْتُ — wa-, and + istaghraqa, to become immersed, go deep into (verb X of gharaqa, perf. 1cs); 'and I plunged deep'
غَوْطَةَ: ghawṭa, hollow, wooded dell, low tract with many trees (f., acc. indef.)
أَشْجَارٍ: أَشْجَار — shajar/ashjār, trees (m. broken pl. of shajara; gen. indef.)
الْغَوْطَةَ: الـ + غَوْطَة — ghawṭa, hollow, dell (f., acc., now definite); 'the hollow'
أَصْلَ: أَصْل — aṣl, root, base (m., acc., first term of construct); 'the root of'
غَلِيظَةٍ: ghalīẓa, thick, stout (adj., f., gen. indef.); agreeing with شَجَرَة
فَحَفَرْتُ: فَـ + حَفَرْتُ — fa-, so + ḥafartu (ḥafara, to dig, perf. 1cs); 'so I dug'
حَوْلَهَا: حَوْلَ + ـهَا — ḥawla, around (adv./prep.) + 3fs suffix; 'around it'
وَأَزَلْتُ: وَ + أَزَلْتُ — wa-, and + azāla, to remove, take away (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'and I removed'
فَعَثَرَتِ: فَـ + عَثَرَتِ — fa-, then + ʿatharat (ʿathara, to stumble, strike upon, verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with الْفَأْسُ; -i linking vowel before the article); 'then it (f.) struck upon'
فَنَظَّفْتُ: فَـ + نَظَّفْتُ — fa-, so + naẓẓaftu (naẓẓafa, to clean, verb II, perf. 1cs); 'so I cleaned'
فَكَشَفْتُهُ: فَـ + كَشَفْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + kashafa, to uncover, reveal (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I uncovered it'
أَسْفَلِ: أَسْفَل — asfal, lowest, bottom (elative of safula; m. gen., first term of construct); 'the bottom of'
فَدَخَلْتُهُ: فَـ + دَخَلْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I entered it'
أَحْسَنِ: أَحْسَن — aḥsan, better/best (elative of ḥasuna, 'to be good'; m. gen., first term of construct); 'the best of'
مُشَيَّدَةَ: mushayyada — well-built, firmly raised (pass. part. of shayyada, verb II; f., acc.); see the note on this unit's gender agreement
صَبِيَّةً: ṣabiyya, young girl, maiden (f., acc. indef.)
كَالدُّرَّةِ: كَـ + الـ + دُرَّة — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + durra, pearl (f., gen.); 'like the pearl'
السَّنِيَّةِ: الـ + سَنِيَّة — saniyy(a), lofty, radiant, sublime (adj., f., gen.); agreeing with الدُّرَّة
تَنْفِي: tanfī — nafā, to banish, drive away, deny (verb I defective, impf. 3fs)
وَغَمٍّ: وَ + غَمّ — wa-, and + ghamm, sorrow, distress (m., gen. indef.); 'and sorrow'
وَبَلِيَّهْ: وَ + بَلِيَّة — baliyya, affliction, calamity (f.); printed with ـه for the tāʾ marbūṭa, see the note on this unit; 'and an affliction'
كَلَامُهَا: كَلَام + ـهَا — kalām, speech, words (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her speech'
يَشْفِي: yashfī — shafā, to heal, cure (verb I defective, impf. 3ms)
الْكُرُوبَ: الـ + كُرُوب — karb/kurūb, distress, anguish (m. pl., acc.)
وَيَتْرُكُ: وَ + يَتْرُكُ — wa-, and + yatruku (taraka, to leave, impf. 3ms); 'and leaves'
الْعَاقِلَ: الـ + عَاقِل — ʿāqil, sensible, rational (act. part. of ʿaqala; m., acc.); 'the sensible man'
اللَّبِيبَ: الـ + لَبِيب — labīb, intelligent, sagacious (adj., m., acc.); agreeing with الْعَاقِلَ
مَسْلُوبْ: maslūb — plundered, robbed, stripped (pass. part. of salaba; here printed without the expected accusative ending, see the note on this unit)
خُمَاسِيَّةَ: خُمَاسِيَّة — khumāsiyya, five-part(ed), of five spans (rel. adj. from khamsa, 'five'; f. acc.); idiom for a tall, well-proportioned figure
قَاعِدَةَ: qāʿida — lit. sitting, firmly-based (act. part. of qaʿada; f., acc.); idiom for a firm, well-set bosom
نَاعِمَةَ: nāʿima — soft, smooth, delicate (adj., f., acc.)
مُشْرِقَةَ: mushriqa — radiant, shining (act. part. of ashraqa, verb IV; f., acc.)
مَلِيحَةَ: malīḥa, pretty, comely, lovely (adj., f., acc.)
الْكَوْنِ: الـ + كَوْن — kawn, being, form, existence (m., gen.); 'form, shape'
أَشْرَقَ: ashraqa — to shine forth, rise radiantly (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
وَجْهُهَا: وَجْه + ـهَا — wajh, face (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her face'
لَيْلِ: layl, night (m., gen., first term of construct); layli al-dhawāʾibi = 'the night of the locks'
الذَّوَائِبِ: الـ + ذَوَائِب — dhuʾāba/dhawāʾib, forelock, lock of hair (f. pl., gen.); 'the locks of hair'
وَلَمَعَ: وَ + لَمَعَ — wa-, and + lamaʿa, to gleam, flash, shine (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and gleamed'
ثَغْرُهَا: ثَغْر + ـهَا — thaghr, mouth, opening (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her mouth'
صَفَحَاتِ: صَفْحَة/صَفَحَات — ṣafḥa, surface, flat expanse (f. pl., gen., first term of construct); 'the surfaces of'
التَّرَائِبِ: الـ + تَرَائِب — tarība/tarāʾib, collarbone, upper breastbone (f. pl., gen.); 'the collarbones, the bosom'
دُجُوجِيَّةُ: dujūjiyya — dark as night, raven-black (rel./intensive adj. from دُجَى, 'darkness'; f., nom., first term of construct); with الْفَرْعَيْنِ, 'dark of the two locks'
الْفَرْعَيْنِ: الـ + فَرْعَيْنِ — farʿ, branch, lock of hair (m. dual, gen.); 'the two locks'
مَهْضُومَةُ: mahḍūma — lit. digested, wasted thin (pass. part. of haḍama; f., nom., first term of construct); idiom for a slender waist
الْحَشَا: الـ + حَشَا — ḥashā, belly, inside (m., gen.)
كَثِيبَةُ: kathība — dune-like, full and rounded (adj. from kathīb, 'sand dune'; f., nom., first term of construct)
بَانِيَةُ: bāniya — firmly built, well-shaped (act. part. of banā, 'to build'; f., nom., first term of construct)
اَرْبَعَةٌ: arbaʿa, four (f.-form number, counting a m. pl. by the polarity rule; nom. indef., subject of the following relative clause)
اجْتَمَعَتْ: ijtamaʿat — ijtamaʿa, to gather, come together (verb VIII, perf. 3fs, agreeing with أَرْبَعَة)
قَطُّ: qaṭṭu — never, (not) at all (adv., used with a negated perfect); here reinforcing the negation in مَا اجْتَمَعَتْ
اِذًا: idhan — then, in that case (particle); its force here is obscure, apparently reinforcing قَطُّ, 'never, at all' — possibly a corruption of أَبَدًا, see the note on this unit; printed with no points at all, vocalised here like prose
الّا: illā — except, but (exceptive particle); printed with the shadda alone and no hamza, as often in vocalised print
عَلى: ʿalā — on, upon, against (prep.); here 'at the cost of' (printed with a single mark, less fully pointed than عَلَى elsewhere in this slice, but already pointed all the same and so kept exactly as printed)
مَهجَتي: مُهْجَة + ي — muhja, heart's blood, the vital spirit (f.) + 1s suffix; 'my heart's blood'
وسَفكِ: وَ + سَفْك — wa-, and + safk, shedding, spilling (verbal noun of safaka; m., gen., coordinated with مَهْجَتِي)
دَمي: دَم + ي — dam, blood (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my blood'
ضَوءُ: ḍawʾ, light, brightness (m., nom., first term of construct)
ولَيلُ: وَ + لَيْل — wa-, and + layl, night (m., nom., first term of construct); coordinated with ضَوْءُ
طُرَّتِه: طُرَّة + ـه — ṭurra, forelock, lock of hair (f., gen.) + 3ms suffix (printed 'his', though the poem describes a woman — probably for طُرَّتِهَا, 'her forelock'; see the note on this unit); 'her forelock'
ووَردُ: وَ + وَرْد — wa-, and + ward, rose(-red hue) (m., nom., first term of construct)
خَلٍ: khāl (printed defectively without the alif — see the note on this unit) — mole, beauty-spot (m., gen. indef.)
وضَوى: وَ + ضَوًى — wa-, and + ḍawan, leanness, sickly thinness (m. invariable noun, first term of construct)
جِسم: jism, body (m.; printed without a case ending, see the note on this unit)
سَجَدْتُ: سَجَدَ + تُ — sajada, to prostrate oneself; 1st sg. perfect, 'I prostrated'
لِخَالِقِهَا: لِـ + خَالِق + هَا — li-, to (prep., marking the object of سجد) + khāliq, creator (act. part. of خَلَقَ) + hā, her; 'to her Creator'
أَبْدَعَ: أَبْدَعَ — abdaʿa, to devise, fashion admirably (form IV of بدع); 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'He fashioned'
فِيهِمَا: فِي + هِمَا — fī, in (prep.) + 3rd dual suffix; 'in the two of them'
تَكُونُ: تَكُونُ — takūnu, to be (imperfect of كَانَ); 2nd m. sg., 'you are'
إِنْسِيٌّ: إِنْسِيّ — insiyy, human (relative adj. from إِنْس, 'mankind')
أَوْصَلَكَ: أَوْصَلَ + كَ — awṣala, to bring, convey (form IV of وصل); 3rd m. sg. perfect + 2nd m. sg. object suffix, 'brought you'
خَمْسَةً: خَمْسَة — khamsa, five; accusative, first part of the compound numeral 'twenty-five'
إِنْسِيًّا: إِنْسِيّ + ـًا — insiyy, human; indefinite accusative, object of رأيت
فَوَقَدْ: ف + و + قَدْ — fa-, and + wa-, and + qad, already, indeed (particle marking completed action); two conjunctions stacked before qad, 'and indeed'
وَجَدْتُتْ: وَجَدَ + تُ (+ stray ت) — wajada, to find; 1st sg. perfect, printed with an extra, unexplained ت; 'I found'
لِكَلَامِهَا: لِـ + كَلَام + هَا — li-, to/for (prep., marking what the quality belongs to) + kalām, speech (m.) + hā, her; 'to/for her speech'
عُذُوبَةً: عُذُوبَة — ʿudhūba, sweetness (f., verbal noun of عَذُبَ, 'to be sweet'); accusative predicate of وجدت
بِمَجَامِعِ: بِـ + مَجَامِع — bi-, by/with (prep., marking what was seized, in the idiom أَخَذَ بِـ 'to take hold of') + majāmiʿ, gathering-places (pl. of مَجْمَع); 'by the gathering-places of'
سَيِّدَتِي: سَيِّدَة + ي — sayyida, lady, mistress (f. of سَيِّد) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my lady'
مَنَازِلِي: مَنَازِل + ي — manāzil, stations, degrees (pl. of مَنْزِل) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my stations'
لَهَابِ: لَهَاب — lahāb, a blazing, intense flame (intensive noun from لَهَب, 'flame'); genitive, 'of the blazing'
وَغَمِّي: و + غَمّ + ي — wa-, and + ghamm, grief, distress (m.) + 1st sg. suffix; 'and my grief'
وَحَكَيْتُ: و + حَكَيْتُ — ḥakā, to recount, narrate; 1st sg. perfect, 'and I recounted'
الْآخِرِ: الـ + آخِر — ākhir, last, final (m.); 'the last, the end'
فَصَعُبَ: ف + صَعُبَ — ṣaʿuba, to become difficult, hard; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'so it grew hard'
أُعْلِمُكَ: أُعْلِمُ + كَ — aʿlama, to inform (form IV of عَلِمَ); 1st sg. imperfect + 2nd m. sg. object suffix, 'I inform you'
بِقِصَّتِي: بِـ + قِصَّة + ي — bi-, of/with (prep., marking the object of أُعْلِمُ) + qiṣṣa, story (f.) + 1st sg. suffix; 'of my story'
أَفِيتَامُوسَ: أَفِيتَامُوس — Afītāmūs, proper name, the princess's father; genitive/apposition, an indeclinable foreign name
جَزِيرَةِ: جَزِيرَة — jazīra, island (f.); construct, 'the Isle of'
زَوَّجَنِي: زَوَّجَ + نِي — zawwaja, to marry (someone) to (someone) (form II of زوج) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'he married me'
فَلَيْلَةَ: ف + لَيْلَةَ — fa-, then + layla, night (f.); accusative of time, 'then on the night of'
زِفَافِي: زِفَاف + ي — zifāf, wedding, nuptials (m.) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my wedding'
خْتَطَفَنِي: اِخْتَطَفَ + نِي — ikhtaṭafa, to snatch away, abduct (form VIII of خطف); printed without its initial alif (see the note on this sentence) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'he snatched me away'
جِرْجِيسُ: جِرْجِيس — Jirjīs, proper name, the efrit; nominative, predicate of اسمه
رِجْمُوسَ: رِجْمُوس — Rijmūs, proper name, the efrit's father; genitive
خَالَةِ: خَالَة — khāla, maternal aunt (f.); construct, 'the maternal aunt of'
إِبْلِيسَ: إِبْلِيس — Iblīs, the Devil (proper name); genitive
فَطَارَ: ف + طَارَ — ṭāra, to fly; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'so he flew'
وَالْحُلِيِّ: و + الـ + حُلِيّ — wa-, and + ḥuliyy, jewelry, ornaments (pl. of حَلْي)
وَالْقُمَاشِ: و + الـ + قُمَاش — wa-, and + qumāsh, cloth, fabric (m.)
وَالْمَتَاعِ: و + الـ + مَتَاع — wa-, and + matāʿ, goods, furnishings (m.)
وَالطَّعَامِ: و + الـ + طَعَام — wa-, and + ṭaʿām, food (m.)
وَالشَّرَابِ: و + الـ + شَرَاب — wa-, and + sharāb, drink (m.)
يَأْتِينِي: يَأْتِي + نِي — yaʾtī, to come (imperfect of أَتَى) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'he comes to me'
يَنَامُ: يَنَامُ — yanāmu, to sleep (imperfect of نَامَ); 'he sleeps'
لَيْلَةً: laylatan — layla, night (f., acc., adverbial of time); 'a night'
لِحَالِ: لِـ + حَال — li-, to (prep.) + ḥāl, state (m.); construct, in the idiom لِحَالِ سَبِيلِهِ, 'on his way'
لِأَنَّهُ: لِـ + أَنَّ + هُ — li-, because (prep. governing the causal clause) + anna, that + 3rd m. sg. suffix; 'because he'
أَخَذَنِي: أَخَذَ + نِي — akhadha, to take; 3rd m. sg. perfect + 1st sg. object suffix, 'he took me' (printed twice; see the note on this sentence)
رِضًى: رِضًى — riḍan, consent, contentment (m.; a maqṣūr noun spelled invariantly with tanwīn fatḥa over the final ى regardless of case)
وَعَاهَلَ: و + عَاهَلَ — printed for the expected عَاهَدَ, 'he made a covenant' (form III of عهد); 3rd m. sg. perfect (see the note on this sentence)
أَوْ: أَوْ — aw, or (disjunctive); printed already pointed in the verse, with precomposed hamza on alif as the edition has it
أَلْمِسَ: أَلْمِسَ — almisa, to touch (1st sg. subjunctive of لَمَسَ); 'that I touch'
السَّطْرَيْنِ: الـ + سَطْرَيْنِ — saṭrayn, two lines (dual of سَطْر, oblique); 'the two lines'
الْمَكْتُوبَيْنِ: الـ + مَكْتُوبَيْنِ — maktūbayn, written (dual pass. part. of كَتَبَ, oblique); 'the written'
أُشِيلُ: أُشِيلُ — ushīlu, to lift, raise (colloquial verb, imperfect of شَالَ, in place of Classical أَرْفَعُ); 'I lift'
وَأَرَاهُ: و + أَرَى + هُ — wa-, and (in the idiom مَا…إِلَّا وَ) + arā, to see (1st sg. imperfect of رَأَى) + 3rd m. sg. object suffix; 'than I see him'
تُقِيمَ: تُقِيمَ — tuqīma, to stay, reside (subjunctive of أَقَامَ, form IV of قام); 'you stay'
وَتَنْصَرِفَ: و + تَنْصَرِفَ — tanṣarifa, to depart, leave (subjunctive of اِنْصَرَفَ, form VII of صرف); 'and you depart'
بِيَوْمٍ: بِـ + يَوْم — bi-, by (prep., measure of difference) + yawm, day (m.); 'by a day'
حَبَّذَا: حَبَّذَا — ḥabbadhā, how excellent a thing! (fixed exclamatory particle of approval)
صَحَّتِ: صَحَّتْ — ṣaḥḥat, to prove true, sound; 3rd f. sg. perfect of صَحَّ
الْأَحْلَامُ: الـ + أَحْلَام — aḥlām, dreams (pl. of حُلْم); nominative subject
وَنَهَضَتْ: و + نَهَضَتْ — nahaḍat, to rise, get up; 3rd f. sg. perfect
أَقْدَامِهَا: أَقْدَام + هَا — aqdām, feet (pl. of قَدَم) + 3rd f. sg. suffix; 'her feet'
فَمَسَكَتْنِي: ف + مَسَكَتْ + نِي — masaka, to seize, take hold of; 3rd f. sg. perfect + 1st sg. object suffix, 'so she took hold of me'
وَأَدْخَلَتْنِي: و + أَدْخَلَتْ + نِي — adkhalat, to bring in (3rd f. sg. perfect, form IV of دخل) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'and she brought me in'
مُقَنْطَرٍ: مُقَنْطَر — muqanṭar, arched, vaulted (pass. part. of the quadriliteral قَنْطَرَ)
وَانْتَهَتْ: و + اِنْتَهَتْ — intahat, to arrive at last (3rd f. sg. perfect, form VIII of اِنْتَهَى)
قَلَعَتْ: قَلَعَتْ — qalaʿat, to take off, remove; 3rd f. sg. perfect, 'she took off'
ثِيَابِي: ثِيَاب + ي — thiyāb, clothes (pl. of ثَوْب) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my clothes'
فَغَسَلَتْ: ف + غَسَلَتْ — ghasalat, to wash; 3rd f. sg. perfect
فَجَلَسَتْ: ف + جَلَسَتْ — jalasat, to sit; 3rd f. sg. perfect
وَأَجَاسَتْنَى: و + أَجَاسَتْ + نَى — printed for the expected أَجْلَسَتْنِي, 'she seated me' (causative, form IV of جَلَسَ) + 1st sg. object suffix, here spelled with a final ى in place of ي (see the note on this sentence)
جَانِبِهَا: جَانِب + هَا — jānib, side (m.) + 3rd f. sg. suffix; 'her side'
بِسُكَّرٍ: بِـ + سُكَّر — bi-, with (prep.) + sukkar, sugar (m.); 'with sugar(-syrup)'
وَسَقَتْنِي: و + سَقَتْ + نِي — saqā, to give to drink; 3rd f. sg. perfect + 1st sg. object suffix, 'and she gave me to drink'
وَتَحَادَثْنَا: و + تَحَادَثْنَا — taḥādathnā, to converse together; 1st pl. perfect (form VI of حدث)
وَاسْتَرِحْ: و + اِسْتَرِحْ — istariḥ, rest! (2nd m. sg. imperative, form X of رَاحَ)
نَسِيتُ: نَسِيتُ — nasītu, I forgot (1st sg. perfect of نَسِيَ; printed twice, see the note on this sentence)
اسْتَيْقَظْتُ: اِسْتَيْقَظْتُ — istayqaẓtu, I awoke (1st sg. perfect, form X of يقظ)
وَجَدْتُهَا: وَجَدْتُ + هَا — wajadtu, I found + 3rd f. sg. object suffix; 'I found her'
تَكْبِسُ: تَكْبِسُ — takbisu, to press, knead (3rd f. sg. imperfect of كَبَسَ)
رِجْلِي: رِجْل + ي — rijl, leg, foot (f.) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my leg'
فَدَعَوْتُ: ف + دَعَوْتُ — daʿawtu, I called, invoked (1st sg. perfect of دَعَا); 'so I prayed, invoked blessing'
نَتَحَادَثُ: نَتَحَادَثُ — nataḥādathu, we converse (1st pl. imperfect, form VI); circumstantial, 'conversing'
ضَيِّقَةَ: ضَيِّقَة — ḍayyiqa, narrow, straitened (f. adj. of ضَيِّق); accusative predicate
وَحْدِي: وَحْد + ي — waḥd, alone + 1st sg. suffix; 'alone'
يُؤْنِسُنِي: يُؤْنِسُ + نِي — yuʾnisu, to keep company, comfort (imperfect, form IV of أَنِسَ) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'keep me company'
فَالْحَمْدُ: ف + الـ + حَمْد — fa-, so + al-ḥamd, the praise (m., verbal noun of حَمِدَ); 'so praise'
أَرْسَلَكَ: أَرْسَلَ + كَ — arsala, to send (form IV of رَسِلَ) + 2nd m. sg. object suffix; 'sent you'
فَعَمَدَتْ: ف + عَمَدَتْ — ʿamadat, to go purposefully to; 3rd f. sg. perfect of عَمَدَ
خُرُسْتَانَ: خُرُسْتَان — khurustān, a store-closet, pantry (uncertain word; see the note on this sentence)
وَأَخْرَجَتْ: و + أَخْرَجَتْ — akhrajat, to bring, take out; 3rd f. sg. perfect, form IV of خَرَجَ
شَرَابًا: شَرَاب — sharāb, wine, drink (m.); indefinite accusative
مَخْتُومًا: مَخْتُوم — makhtūm, sealed (pass. part. of خَتَمَ)
خُضْرَةً: خُضْرَة — khuḍra, a green (thing), greenery (f.); indefinite accusative, probably a green cloth spread for the wine
فَأَخَذَتْ: ف + أَخَذَتْ — akhadhat, to take; 3rd f. sg. perfect
عَلِمْنَا: عَلِمْنَا — ʿalimnā, we knew (1st pl. perfect of عَلِمَ)
قُدُومَكُمْ: قُدُوم + كُمْ — qudūm, coming, arrival (m., verbal noun of قَدِمَ) + 2nd pl. suffix; 'your coming'
لَنَشَرْنَا: لَـ + نَشَرْنَا — la-, verily (emphatic particle introducing the apodosis of law) + nasharnā, we would have strewn, scattered (1st pl. perfect of نَشَرَ)
مُهْجَةَ: مُهْجَة — muhja, the heart's blood, the life-essence (f.); construct, accusative object
سَوَادَ: سَوَاد — sawād, blackness (m.); construct, accusative, coordinated with مُهْجَةَ
الْعُيُونِ: الـ + عُيُون — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of عَيْن); genitive; idiom سَوَادُ الْعُيُونِ, 'the black of the eyes', i.e. the pupils
وَفَرَشْنَا: و + فَرَشْنَا — farashnā, we would have spread (1st pl. perfect of فَرَشَ)
خُدُودَنَا: خُدُود + نَا — khudūd, cheeks (pl. of خَدّ) + 1st pl. suffix; 'our cheeks'
لِلِقَاكُمْ: لِـ + لِقَاء + كُمْ — li-, for (prep., purpose) + liqāʾ, meeting (verbal noun of لَقِيَ) + 2nd pl. suffix; 'for meeting you'
لِيَكُونَ: لِـ + يَكُونَ — li-, so that (purpose particle governing the subjunctive) + yakūna, it be (subjunctive of كَانَ); 'that it might be'
الْمَسِيرُ: الـ + مَسِير — masīr, journey, passage (m., verbal noun of سَارَ); nominative subject
الْجُفُونِ: الـ + جُفُون — jufūn, eyelids (pl. of جَفْن); genitive
شَعْرِهَا: شَعْر + ـهَا — shaʿr, hair (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'her hair' — distinct from شِعْر 'poetry' later in this slice: identical consonants, different vowels
شَكَرْتُهَا: شَكَرَ + تُ + هَا — shakara, to thank (verb I) + 1cs perf. + 3fs obj.; 'I thanked her'
تَمَكَّنَتْ: تَمَكَّنَ (form V of makana, 'to become firmly established') + تْ (3fs); 'it became firmly established'
مَحَبَّتُهَا: مَحَبَّة + ـهَا — maḥabba, love, affection (f., verbal noun of aḥabba) + 3fs poss.; 'her love', i.e. love for her
ذَهَبَ: dhahaba — dhahaba, to go, depart (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'it went, departed'
مُنَادَمَةٍ: مُنَادَمَة — munādama, boon-companionship, intimate conversation (f., verbal noun of III nādama 'to keep company drinking/conversing'; gen. after فِي)
فَبِتُّ: فَـ + بِتُّ — fa- + bittu (bāta, to spend the night; verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'and I spent the night'
مِثْلَهَا: مِثْل + ـهَا — mithl, like, similar (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'its like'
وَأَصْبَحْنَا: وَ + أَصْبَحْنَا — aṣbaḥa, to become; here a 'sister of kāna' followed by an imperfect predicate, giving 'we went on doing X'; 1st pl. perf.
نَصِلُ: naṣilu — waṣala, to continue, keep up (verb I; here impf. 1st pl., predicate of aṣbaḥnā); 'we continue, keep up'
السُّرُورَ: الـ + سُرُور — surūr, joy, delight (m., acc., object of naṣilu)
فَسَكِرْتُ: فَـ + سَكِرْتُ — fa- + sakirtu (sakira, to become drunk; verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I became drunk'
سُكْرًا: sukran — sukr, drunkenness (m., acc., cognate object of sakirtu); 'a drunkenness' (intensifying)
أَتَمَايَلُ: atamāyalu — tamāyala (form VI, 'to sway to and fro'; impf. 1cs, ḥāl); 'swaying'
أُطْلِعُكِ: أُطْلِعُكِ — uṭliʿu (aṭlaʿa, form IV of ṭalaʿa, 'to bring up, bring out'; impf. 1cs) + 2fs obj.; 'I bring you up'
تَحْتِ: taḥti — taḥt, beneath, under (adv./prep., gen., first term of iḍāfa)
وَأُرِيحُكِ: وَ + أُرِيحُكِ — wa- + urīḥu (arāḥa, form IV of rāḥa, 'to give rest, relieve'; impf. 1cs) + 2fs obj.; 'and I relieve you'
اِقْنَعْ: iqnaʿ — qaniʿa, to be content, satisfied (verb I; imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl with helping kasra); 'be content!'
وَاُسْكُتْ: وَ + اُسْكُتْ — wa- + uskut (sakata, to be silent; imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl with helping ḍamma); 'and be silent!'
أَيَّامٍ: أَيَّامٍ — ayyām (pl. of yawm), days (m. pl., gen. indef., second term of iḍāfa/tamyīz after the numeral)
وَتِسْعَةُ: وَ + تِسْعَةُ — wa- + tisʿa, nine (num., nom., subject); 'and nine'
لَكْ: لَكْ — obscure; the letters as printed give only ل ك. Perhaps an echo of the لَكِ 'to/for you' two words earlier, or an elliptical, dialectal لٰكِنْ 'but' marking her change of heart; kept exactly as printed rather than emended.
غَلَبَ: ghalaba — ghalaba, to overcome, prevail over (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'it overcame'
السَّاعَةَ: الـ + سَاعَةَ — sāʿa, hour (f., acc., adverbial); idiomatic 'now, at once' ('the hour' for 'this very hour')
أَكْسِرُ: أَكْسِرُ — aksiru (kasara, to break; verb I, impf. 1cs); 'I shall break'
الْقُبَّةَ: الـ + قُبَّةَ — qubba, dome, cupola (f., acc., object)
النَّقْشُ: الـ + نَقْشُ — naqsh, inscription, engraving (m., nom.)
الْمَكْتُوبُ: الـ + مَكْتُوبُ — maktūb, written (m., nom.; pass. part. of kataba); in apposition to النَّقْش, 'the written [inscription]'
وَدَعِي: وَ + دَعِي — wa- + daʿī (2fs imperative of وَدَعَ, 'to leave, let'); here a self-exhorting imperative, 'and let…'
يَجِيءُ: yajīʾu — jāʾa, to come (verb I; impf. 3ms); 'he comes' — the edition itself prints this hamza (ء), kept as printed
أَقْتُلَهُ: أَقْتُلَهُ — aqtula (qatala, to kill; impf. 1cs subjunctive after ḥattā) + 3ms obj.; 'that I may kill him'
فَإِنِّي: فَإِنِّي — fa- + innī (fa-, and so + inna, emphatic particle + 1cs suffix); 'for indeed I…'
مُعَوَّدٌ: muʿawwadun — ʿawwada, to accustom (form II; pass. part., m., nom.); 'accustomed' — the masc. form, though the speaker is a woman; this text does not always mark gender agreement on such predicates
بِقَتْلِ: بِـ + قَتْلِ — bi-, with, at (prep.; مُعَوَّد بِـ 'accustomed to' governs its complement with بِـ) + qatl, killing (verbal noun of qatala, gen.); 'at killing'
أَلْتَفِتْ: أَلْتَفِتْ — altafit (iltafata, form VIII, 'to turn one's attention, heed'; impf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ, hamza written as a bare alif per the edition's habit); 'I did not heed'
اِصْفَرَّتْ: iṣfarrat — iṣfarra (form IX, 'to turn pale/yellow'; hamzat waṣl with fixed kasra) + fs ending; 'it/she turned pale' — agrees with the implied 'she' rather than with the grammatically masculine noun لَوْن
لَوْنُهَا: لَوْن + ـهَا — lawn, colour (m., nom.) + 3fs poss.; 'her colour'
إِنَّ: inna — emphatic particle introducing a nominal clause, 'indeed, verily' (governs the following noun in the accusative)
يَنْبَغِي: yanbaghī — inbaghā (form VII of baghā, 'to be fitting, proper'; impf. 3ms, impersonal); 'it is fitting, one ought'
أَنْ: an — subordinating particle introducing a subjunctive clause, 'that, to' (here after yanbaghī)
تَصُونَ: taṣūna — ṣāna, to guard, protect (verb I hollow; impf. 2ms subjunctive after an); 'that you (should) guard'
نَفْسِكَ: نَفْس + ـكَ — nafs, self, soul (f., gen.) + 2ms poss.; 'your soul' (second term of the iḍāfa هَلَاكُ نَفْسِكَ, 'the destruction of your soul')
لِلْفِرَاقِ: لِـ + الـ + فِرَاق — li-, for, toward (prep.; ṭālib 'seeking' governs its object with لِـ) + firāq, separation, parting (m., gen.); 'for parting'
بِخَيْلِهِ: بِـ + خَيْل + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep. of accompaniment) + khayl, horses, cavalry (coll.) + 3ms poss.; 'with his horses'
سَابِقًا: sābiqan — sābiq, outstripping, swift (act. part. of sabaqa; m., acc., adj./ḥāl qualifying خَيْله); 'outrunning'
عِتَاقُ: ʿitāqun — ʿitāq, thoroughbred, noble-bred (pl. of ʿatīq, here predicate/apposition, nom.); 'thoroughbred (ones)'
اِصْبِرْ: iṣbir — ṣabara, to be patient, endure (verb I; imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl with helping kasra); 'be patient!'
فَطَبْعُ: فَـ + طَبْعُ — fa-, for (conj.) + ṭabʿ, nature, disposition (m., nom.; first term of iḍāfa); 'for the nature of'
غَدْرٌ: ghadrun — ghadr, treachery, perfidy (m., nom., predicate); '(is) treachery'
وَآخِرُ: وَ + آخِرُ — wa- + ākhir, end, last (m., nom.; first term of iḍāfa); 'and the end of' — the edition itself prints this hamza/madda precomposed (آخر), kept as printed
الصُّحْبَةِ: الـ + صُحْبَةِ — ṣuḥba, companionship, fellowship (f., gen.)
الْفِرَاقُ: الـ + فِرَاقُ — firāq, separation, parting (m., nom., predicate)
شِعْرِهَا: شِعْر + ـهَا — shiʿr, verse, poetry (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'her verse' — same consonants as شَعْرِهَا 'her hair' earlier in the slice, disambiguated only by the vowels we supply
رَفَعَتِ: rafaʿati — rafaʿa, to lift, raise (verb I; perf. 3fs, kasra before the following hamzat waṣl); 'she lifted'
رَفْعًا: rafʿan — rafʿ, a lifting, raising (verbal noun of rafaʿa; m., acc., cognate object of rafaʿat)
قَوِيًّا: qawiyyan — qawiyy, strong, powerful (adj., m., acc.); 'powerful, mighty'
الثَّالِثَةَ: الـ + ثَالِثَة — thālith, third (ordinal adj., f., acc.)
الْفَرَنْجِيَّ: الـ + فَرَنْجِيّ — faranjī, Frank, European (m., acc., subject of أَنَّ); printed here where الْعِفْرِيتُ, 'the efrit,' is expected — see the sentence note
رَقَصَتِ: رَقَصَ + تْ — raqaṣa, to dance (verb, past 3fs)
الْقُبَّةُ: الـ + قُبَّة — qubba, dome, domed chamber (f., nom.)
رَقْصًا: raqṣ — a dance (m., acc. as cognate object of رَقَصَتْ)
وَالْأَقْطَارُ: وَ + الـ + أَقْطَار — quṭr (pl. أَقْطَار), region, quarter of the sky/horizon (m. pl., nom.); 'and the horizons'
أَظْلَمَتْ: أَظْلَمَ + تْ — aẓlama (form IV of ظَلِمَ/ظَلَام), to grow dark (verb, past 3fs)
وَأَرْعَدَتْ: وَ + أَرْعَدَ + تْ — arʿada (form IV), to thunder (verb, past 3fs)
وَأَبْرَقَتْ: وَ + أَبْرَقَ + تْ — abraqa (form IV), to flash with lightning (verb, past 3fs)
وَهَزْهَزَتِ: وَ + هَزْهَزَ + تْ — hazhaza (reduplicated quadriliteral), to shake violently (verb, past 3fs)
وَأَطْبَقَتِ: وَ + أَطْبَقَ + تْ — aṭbaqa (form IV of طَبِقَ), to close up, shut tight (verb, past 3fs)
الْكَسْرُ: الـ + كَسْر — kasr, a break, fracture (m., nom.); obscure here, taken by sense for something like 'wits, senses' — see the sentence note
رَاسِي: رَاس + ـي — rās, colloquial spelling of رَأْس, head (m.) + 1cs; 'my head'
حَذَّرْتُكَ: حَذَّرَ + تُ + كَ — ḥadhdhara (form II of حَذِرَ), to warn (verb, past 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I warned you'
أَذَيْتَنِي: أَذَى + تَ + نِي — adhā (form IV آذى), to harm, injure (verb, past 2ms) + 1cs obj.; 'you have harmed me'
انْجُ: unju — save yourself! (form I imperative of نَجَا, 'to escape, be saved'; the initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl and carries no hamza sign)
وَاطْلُعْ: وَ + اطْلُعْ — uṭluʿ, go up! (form I imperative of طَلَعَ, 'to rise, go up'; hamzat al-waṣl, unmarked)
شِدَّةِ: shidda — intensity, severity (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
خَوْفِي: خَوْف + ـي — khawf, fear (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'my fear'
مَرْكُوبِي: مَرْكُوب + ـي — markūb, a mount, riding-beast (pass. part. of رَكِبَ, m.) + 1cs; 'my mount'
وَفَاسِي: وَ + فَاس + ـي — fās, axe (m.) + 1cs; 'and my axe'
طَلَعْتُ: ṭalaʿtu — I went up, climbed (verb, past 1cs)
دَرَجَتَيْنِ: daraja, step, stair (f., dual acc./gen.); 'two steps'
وَالْتَفَتُّ: وَ + الْتَفَتُّ — iltafattu (form VIII of لَفَتَ), to turn around (verb, past 1cs)
لِأَنْظُرَ: لِـ + أَنْظُرَ — li-, in order to (prep. + subjunctive, purpose clause) + anẓura, that I look (verb, pres. subj. 1cs, from نَظَرَ)
بِالْأَرْضِ: بِـ + الـ + أَرْض — bi-, with (prep.; here after إِذَا of surprise, marking what appears, 'and behold, the earth…') + arḍ, earth, ground (f., gen.)
انْشَقَّتْ: inshaqqat — it split open (verb, past 3fs, form VII of شَقَّ)
ذُو: dhū — possessor of, endowed with (noun, first term of an iḍāfa)
بَشِعٍ: bashiʿ — hideous, repulsive (adj., m., indef. gen.)
الزَّعْجَةُ: الـ + زَعْجَة — zaʿja, commotion, disturbance (f., nom.)
أَزْعَجَتْنِي: أَزْعَجَ + تْ + نِي — azʿaja (form IV of زَعِجَ), to alarm, disturb (verb, past 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'it/she alarmed me'
مُصِيبَتُكِ: مُصِيبَة + ـكِ — muṣība, calamity, misfortune (f., nom.) + 2fs; 'your calamity'
أَصَابَنِي: أَصَابَ + نِي — aṣāba (form IV of صَابَ), to befall, strike (verb, past 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'it befell me'
صَدْرِي: صَدْر + ـي — ṣadr, chest, breast (m.) + 1cs; 'my chest'
ضَاقَ: ḍāqa — it grew tight, narrow (verb, past 3ms)
أَشْرَبَ: ashraba — that I drink (verb, pres. subj. 1cs, from شَرِبَ)
يَشْرَحُ: yashraḥu — it opens, eases (verb, pres. 3ms, from شَرَحَ); with صَدْرِي, 'eases the chest'
فَاسْتَعْمَلْتُ: فَ + اسْتَعْمَلْتُ — istaʿmaltu (form X of عَمِلَ), I used (verb, past 1cs)
وَأَرَدْتُ: وَ + أَرَدْتُ — aradtu, I wanted (verb, past 1cs, form IV)
أَقْضِيَ: aqḍiya — that I fulfil, attend to (verb, pres. subj. 1cs, from قَضَى)
شُغْلًا: shughl — a task, occupation (m., indef. acc.)
فَتَثَاقَلَتْ: فَ + تَثَاقَلَتْ — tathāqalat (form VI of ثَقُلَ), it grew heavy (verb, past 3fs); with عَلَيَّ, 'grew heavy upon me'
الْمَرْكُوبَ: الـ + مَرْكُوب — markūb, mount, riding-beast (pass. part. of رَكِبَ, m., acc.)
وَالنَّاسَ: وَ + الـ + نَاس — nās, people, men (m. pl., acc.)
لِبْسُ: libs — a garb, trace, mark (m., nom.); here 'the touch [of a human]' rather than literal 'clothing' — see the sentence note
الْإِنْسِ: الـ + إِنْس — ins, mankind, human beings (m., gen.)
عِنْدِكِ: عِنْدَ + كِ — ʿinda, at, with, in the presence of (prep./adv.) + 2fs; 'your place'
تَعَلَّقَا: taʿallaqā — the two of them became attached, clung (verb, past 3md, form V of عَلِقَ)
مُحَالٌ: muḥāl — impossible, absurd (adj., m., indef. nom.)
يَنْطَلِي: yanṭalī — it goes down smoothly, is swallowed [as a lie] (verb, pres. 3ms, form VII of طَلَى); idiom, negated 'it will not work'
كُورَةُ: kūra — 'ball' (f., voc.); a term of abuse for a woman, likely short for كُورَةُ زِبْل, 'dung-ball' — see the sentence note
عَرَّاهَا: عَرَّى + هَا — ʿarrā (form II of عَرِيَ), to strip bare (verb, past 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'he stripped her'
وَشَتَمَهَا: وَ + شَتَمَ + هَا — shatama, to curse, revile (verb, past 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and he cursed her'
سِكَكٍ: sikak — sikka (pl. سِكَك), lane, street (f. pl., indef. gen.)
يُعَاقِبُهَا: يُعَاقِبُ + هَا — yuʿāqibu (form III of عَقَبَ), he punishes (verb, pres. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'he punishes her'
وَيُقَرِّرُهَا: وَ + يُقَرِّرُ + هَا — yuqarriru (form II of قَرَّ), he presses for a confession, interrogates (verb, pres. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and interrogates her'
هَانَ: hāna — it was easy (verb, past 3ms, from هَانَ يَهُونُ)
فَطَلَعْتُ: فَ + طَلَعْتُ — ṭalaʿtu, I went up (verb, past 1cs)
أَرْجُفُ: arjufu — I tremble, shake (verb, pres. 1cs, from رَجَفَ)
أَعْلَا: aʿlā — the top of, highest point of (elative noun, first term of an iḍāfa; the archive spells the final long vowel with alif rather than alif maqṣūra, kept as printed)
وَسَتَرْتُهُ: وَ + سَتَرْتُ + هُ — satartu, I covered, concealed (verb, past 1cs, from سَتَرَ) + 3ms obj.; 'and I covered it'
بِالتُّرَابِ: بِـ + الـ + تُرَاب — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + turāb, earth, dust (m., gen.); 'with the earth'
وَحُسْنَهَا: وَ + حُسْن + هَا — ḥusn, beauty (m., acc.) + 3fs; 'and her beauty'
الْمَلْعُونُ: الـ + مَلْعُون — malʿūn, accursed (pass. part. of لَعَنَ, m., nom.)
خَمْسَةٌ: khamsa — five (numeral, f. form, indef. nom.); with وَعِشْرُونَ, 'twenty-five'
بِسَبَبِي: بِـ + سَبَب + ـي — bi-, because of (prep., marks cause) + sabab, cause, reason (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'because of me'
وَافْتَكَرْتُ: وَ + افْتَكَرْتُ — iftakartu (form VIII of فَكَرَ), I recalled, thought of (verb, past 1cs; colloquial, beside the more Classical تَفَكَّرْتُ)
وَمَمْلَكَةً: وَ + مَمْلَكَةً — mamlaka, kingdom, realm (f., indef. acc.); printed without a possessive where sense expects 'my kingdom' — see the sentence note
عَيْشِي: عَيْش + ـي — ʿaysh, life, living (m.) + 1cs; 'my life'
أَنَاكَ: anāka — a rare variant of أَتَاكَ, 'it came to you, brought upon you' (verb, past 3ms, + 2ms obj.)
بِنَكْبَةٍ: بِـ + نَكْبَة — bi-, with (prep., marks the thing brought: 'with a calamity') + nakba, calamity, misfortune (f., indef. gen.)
فَيَوْمًا: فَ + يَوْمًا — yawm, a day (m., acc. adverbial); 'then one day'
وَيَوْمًا: وَ + يَوْمًا — yawm, a day (m., acc. adverbial); 'and one day'
مَشَيْتُ: مَشَى + ـتُ — mashā, to walk, go on foot (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I walked'
رَفِيقِي: رَفِيق + ـي — rafīq, friend, companion (m.) + 1cs; 'my friend'
فَلَقِيتُهُ: فَـ + لَقِيَ + ـتُ + ـهُ — laqiya, to meet, find (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I met/found him'
أَجْلِي: أَجْل + ـي — ajl, sake, cause (m.) + 1cs; with مِنْ, 'for my sake, on my account'
مَقَالِي: مَقَالِي — maqālī, broken pl. of مِقْلَى, frying-pan, griddle (m.); 'griddles'
الِانْتِظَارِ: الـ + اِنْتِظَار — intiẓār, waiting (m., verbal noun of VIII, gen.); with فِي, 'in waiting'
الْبَارِحَةَ: الـ + بَارِحَة — al-bāriḥa, last night (f., acc. of time)
خِفْتُ: خَافَ + ـتُ — khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'I feared'
وَحْشٍ: وَحْش — waḥsh, wild beast (m., gen. indef. after مِنْ)
وَغَيْرِهِ: وَ + غَيْر + ـهِ — ghayr, other than (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'or other'
سَلَامَتِكَ: سَلَامَة + ـكَ — salāma, safety, soundness (f., gen.) + 2ms; 'your safety'
فَشَكَرْتُهُ: فَـ + شَكَرَ + ـتُ + ـهُ — shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I thanked him'
شَفَقَتِهِ: شَفَقَة + ـهِ — shafaqa, kindness, compassion (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'his kindness'
خَلْوَتِي: خَلْوَة + ـي — khalwa, private chamber, cell (f.) + 1cs; 'my chamber'
أَتَفَكَّرُ: أَتَفَكَّرُ — tafakkara/atafakkaru, to reflect, ponder (verb V, imperf. 1cs); 'I reflect'
وَلُمْتُ: وَ + لَامَ + ـتُ — lāma, to blame (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'and I blamed'
وَرَفْضِي: وَ + رَفْض + ـي — rafḍ, rejecting, casting off (m., verbal noun, gen.) + 1cs; 'and my refusal (to leave alone)'
الْحِسَابِ: الـ + حِسَاب — ḥisāb, reckoning, accounting (m., gen.)
