كَأْسَ: kaʾs — cup (f., acc., editorial medial hamza); 'the cup'
وَالرَّدَى: وَ + الـ + رَدَى — radā, destruction, doom (m., gen.); 'and destruction'
تَعْرِفَا: taʿrifā — 'you two know' (dual, dropping the classical final نِ)
صَنِيعَةً: ṣanīʿa — deed, matter (f., indef. acc.); 'a deed'
أُرِيكُمَا: أَرَى/يُرِي + كُمَا — 'to show' (root ر-أ-ي), Form IV imperfect 1cs (editorial hamza) + 2dual obj.; 'I will show you two'
عَاقِبَةَ: ʿāqiba — consequence, outcome (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the consequence of'
فِعَالِكُمَا: فِعَال + كُمَا — fiʿāl, deeds, doings (m. pl., gen.) + 2dual poss.; 'your doings'
قَطَعَهَا: qaṭaʿa/yaqṭaʿu + هَا — 'to cut off, sever' (root ق-ط-ع), Form I perfect 3ms + 3fs obj.; 'he severed it'
أَرْبَعَتَهَا: أَرْبَعَة + هَا — arbaʿa, four (f. cardinal, acc., editorial hamza) + 3fs poss.; 'her four [limbs]'
أَنْظُرُ: naẕara/yanẕuru — 'to look, watch' (root ن-ظ-ر), Form I imperfect 1cs (editorial hamza); 'I look on'
وَأَيْقَنْتُ: وَ + أَيْقَنْتُ — ayqana/yūqinu 'to be certain' (root ي-ق-ن), Form IV perfect 1cs (editorial hamza); 'and I was certain'
بِالْمَوْتِ: بِـ + الـ + مَوْتِ — bi-al-mawt, of death (governed by أَيْقَنَ بِـ, "be certain of"); "of death"
كَالْمُوَدِّعِ: كَـ + الـ + مُوَدِّعِ — ka- 'like' (prep.) + al-muwaddiʿ, 'the one bidding farewell' (m. act. part. of وَدَّعَ, Form II, gen.); 'like the one taking leave'
زَنَيْتِي: zanā/taznī — 'to commit adultery' (root ز-ن-ي), Form I perfect 2fs, colloquial extra -ī; 'you committed adultery'
طَيَّرَ: ṭāra/yuṭayyiru — 'to make fly' (root ط-ي-ر), Form II perfect 3ms; 'he made fly'
رَاسَهَا: rās + هَا — rās, head (m., colloquial for رَأْس, hamza genuinely unpronounced, acc.) + 3fs poss.; 'her head'
شَرْعِنَا: sharʿ + نَا — sharʿ, law, code (m., gen.) + 1cp poss.; 'our law'
زَنَتِ: zanā (3fs perfect, kasra linking before the article); 'she commits adultery'
الزَّوْجَةُ: الـ + زَوْجَة — zawja, wife (f., nom.); 'the wife'
خَطَفْتُهَا: khaṭafa/yakhṭifu + هَا — 'to snatch, abduct' (root خ-ط-ف), Form I perfect 1cs + 3fs obj.; 'I abducted her'
عُرْسِهَا: ʿurs + هَا — ʿurs, wedding (m., gen.) + 3fs poss.; 'her wedding'
تَعْرِفْ: same lemma as (تَعْرِفُ), jussive after لَمْ; 'she knew'
أَجِيئُهَا: same lemma as (أَجِيءُ) + هَا 3fs obj.; the archive already prints this word's medial hamza precomposed on a yāʾ seat (ئ), kept as printed; 'I come to her'
زِيِّ: ziyy — dress, guise (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the guise of'
عَجَمِيٍّ: ʿajamiyy — non-Arab, Persian, foreign (m. adj., indef. gen.); 'foreign'
خَانَتْنِي: khāna/yakhūnu + نِي — 'to betray' (root خ-و-ن), Form I perfect 3fs + 1cs obj.; 'she betrayed me'
قَتَلْتُهَا: qatala + هَا — Form I perfect 1cs; 'I killed her'
أَتَحَقَّقْ: same lemma as (أَتَحَقَّقُ), jussive after لَمْ, editorial hamza; 'I ascertained'
خُنْتَنِي: khāna, Form I perfect 2ms + نِي — 'you wronged me'
أُخْلِيكَ: akhlā/yukhlī — 'to leave, vacate' (root خ-ل-و), Form IV imperfect 1cs (editorial hamza) + 2ms obj.; 'I leave you'
أَتَمَنَّاءْ: probably أَتَمَنَّى, 'I wish' (Form V imperfect 1cs), with a stray extra ء likely from the dittography that also doubles وما and عليك in this line (see note on this sentence); 'I wish'
أَسْحَرُكَ: saḥara/yasḥaru — 'to enchant, cast a spell on' (root س-ح-ر), Form I imperfect 1cs (editorial hamza) + 2ms obj.; 'I enchant you'
صُورَةَ: same lemma as (صُورَةٍ), here accusative in apposition; 'the form of'
قِرْدٍ: qird — ape, monkey (m., indef. gen.); "an ape"
طَمِعْتُ: ṭamiʿa/yaṭmaʿu — 'to hope for, covet' (root ط-م-ع), Form I perfect 1cs, printed twice in the archive with no connective, kept as printed; 'I hoped'
يَعْفُو: ʿafā/yaʿfū — 'to pardon' (root ع-ف-و), Form I imperfect 3ms; 'he pardons'
بِعَفْوِكَ: بِـ + عَفْو + كَ — bi- 'for, on account of' (causal) + ʿafw, pardon (m., gen., maṣdar of عَفَا) + 2ms poss.; 'for your pardoning'
مُسْلِمٍ: muslim — a Muslim (m., indef. gen.); 'a Muslim [man]'
يُؤْذِكَ: آذَى/يُؤْذِي + كَ — 'to harm' (root أ-ذ-ي), Form IV jussive 3ms (editorial hamza on the wāw seat) + 2ms obj.; 'he has not harmed you'
وَتَضَرَّعْتُ: وَ + تَضَرَّعْتُ — taḍarraʿa, Form V perfect 1cs; 'and I implored'
التَّضَرُّعِ: الـ + تَضَرُّعِ — taḍarruʿ, entreaty, supplication (m., gen., maṣdar of تَضَرَّعَ); 'entreaty'
وَبَقِيتُ: وَ + بَقِيتُ — baqiya/yabqā, Form I perfect 1cs; 'and I remained'
يَبْعَلُ: baʿila/yabʿalu — 'to be confounded, at a loss, unable to manage a thing' (root ب-ع-ل; so Lane's Lexicon, aor. يَبْعَلُ), Form I imperfect 3ms; 'it confounds' — see the note on this sentence for why this unemended reading is preferred to a supposed misprint
أُخَيِّرُكَ: khayyara/yukhayyiru — 'to give a choice' (root خ-ي-ر), Form II imperfect 1cs (editorial hamza) + 2ms obj.; 'I give you a choice'
أَلْيَقُ: alyaq — 'more fitting' (comparative of لَائِق, m. nom., editorial hamza); 'more fitting'
فَاُعْفُ: فَـ + اُعْفُ — fa- + uʿfu (imperative of عَفَا; the wasl-alif here takes damma, harmonizing with the u-type imperfect يَعْفُو); 'so pardon!'
الْمَحْسُودُ: الـ + مَحْسُودُ — maḥsūd, 'the Envied [Man]' (m. pass. part. of حَسَدَ, nom.); 'the Envied Man'
الْحَاسِدِ: الـ + حَاسِدِ — ḥāsid, 'the Envier' (m. act. part. of حَسَدَ, gen.); 'the Envier'
اِثْنَىْ: ithnā/ithnay — two (m. dual, gen./acc. construct, hamzat al-waṣl); part of the compound numeral 'twelve' (اِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ)
عَلَىَّ: عَلَى + ي — ʿalā "upon" (prep.) + 1cs suffix (geminated يّ), here spelled with the archive's alif-maqṣūra ى in place of the expected dotted yā (a spelling variant of عَلَيَّ attested elsewhere in this edition); "of me" (as in "make a request of me")
ابْنَتِكَ: اِبْنَة + ـكَ — ibna, daughter (f.) + 2ms suffix; 'your daughter' (initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl)
اتَّصَلَ: اِتَّصَلَ — ittaṣala, to reach, arrive, be connected (verb VIII of و-ص-ل, perf. 3ms; initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl)
اجْتَمَعَ: اِجْتَمَعَ — ijtamaʿa, to meet, come together (verb VIII of ج-م-ع, perf. 3ms; initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl)
الدِّرْهَمِ: الـ + دِرْهَم — dirham, a silver coin (m., gen.); used here as a familiar measure of size
الزَّاوِيَةَ: الـ + زَاوِيَة — zāwiya, hermitage, retreat (f., acc.)
الزَّاوِيَةِ: الـ + زَاوِيَة — zāwiya, hermitage, retreat (f., gen.)
الشَّعْرِ: الـ + شَعْر — shaʿr, hair, fur (m., gen.)
الشَّيْخِ: الـ + شَيْخ — shaykh, elder, holy man (m., gen.)
الصَّالِحُ: الـ + صَالِح — ṣāliḥ, righteous, upright (part./adj., m., nom.)
الصَّخْرَةِ: الـ + صَخْرَة — ṣakhra, a rock (f., gen.)
النُّقْطَةِ: الـ + نُقْطَة — nuqṭa, a spot, dot (f., gen.)
الْأَبْيَضِ: الـ + أَبْيَض — abyaḍ, white (color adj., m., gen.)
الْأَسْوَدُ: الـ + أَسْوَد — aswad, black (color adj., m., nom.)
الْحَاسِدُ: الـ + حَاسِد — ḥāsid, envier (active participle of ḥasada, 'to envy'; m., nom.)
الْفُقَرَاءُ: الـ + فُقَرَاء — fuqarāʾ, the poor, poor brethren (m. pl. of faqīr, nom.)
الْمَحْسُودَ: الـ + مَحْسُود — maḥsūd, the envied one (passive participle of ḥasada; m., acc.)
الْمَحْسُودِ: الـ + مَحْسُود — maḥsūd, the envied one (passive participle of ḥasada; m., gen.)
أَبْرَأَهَا: أَبْرَأَ + هَا — abraʾa, to cure, heal (verb IV of بَرِئَ, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'he would have cured her' (initial hamza supplied; the root-final hamza is printed precomposed in the archive's own أ)
أَذِيَّتِهِ: أَذِيَّة + هِ — adhiyya, molestation, harm (verbal noun of IV آذى, f., gen.) + 3ms; 'his molestation'
أَرْسِلْ: أَرْسِلْ — arsil, send! (verb IV of ر-س-ل, imperative 2ms)
أَرْضًا: أَرْض — arḍ, land, ground (f., acc. indef.)
أَعْيُنِهِمْ: أَعْيُن + هِمْ — aʿyun, eyes (m. pl. of ʿayn, gen.) + 3mp; 'their eyes'
أَكَابِرُ: أَكَابِر — akābir, great ones, magnates (m. pl. of akbar, nom.)
أَكَاشِفُكَ: أَ + كَاشِفٌ + ـكَ — a-, interrogative particle (hamzat al-istifhām) + kāshif, one who reveals (active participle of III kāshafa) + 2ms; 'shall I reveal to you'
أَمَرَهُم: أَمَرَ + هُم — amara, to command (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mp object; 'he commanded them'
أَهْوَنُ: أَهْوَنُ — ahwan, easier, the simplest thing (elative of hawn, m., nom.)
أُبَشِّرُلَكَ: أُبَشِّرُ + لَـ + ـكَ — ubashshiru, I give glad tidings (verb II of ب-ش-ر, imperf. 1cs) + li-, to (prep., dative of the person told) + 2ms; 'I bring you good news' (printed fused with no space, and with no أَنْ linking it to the preceding أُرِيدُ, a colloquial construction)
إِنْشَاءَ: إِنْ + شَاءَ — in, if (conditional particle) + shāʾa, to will, wish (verb I, perf. 3ms); إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ, 'if God wills' — printed fused as one word with no space
بَيْتَيْنِ: بَيْت + ـيْنِ — bayt, house (m.) + dual ending (acc./gen.); 'two houses'
بَيْضَاءُ: بَيْضَاء — bayḍāʾ, white (color adj., f., nom.)
بِابْنَتِهِ: بِـ + اِبْنَة + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep., here marking the thing amiss with someone, 'what is with X' = 'what ails X') + ibna, daughter (f.) + 3ms; 'with/upon his daughter'
بِالرَّحْبِ: بِـ + الـ + رَحْب — bi-, with (prep. of manner) + raḥb, welcome, spaciousness (m., gen.); 'with welcome'
بِالْوُقُوفِ: بِـ + الـ + وُقُوف — bi-, to (prep. governed by أَمَرَ بِـ, 'command to do') + wuqūf, standing, halting (verbal noun of I waqafa, m., gen.); 'to halt'
بِجَارِهِ: بِـ + جَار + ـهِ — bi-, to (prep. governed by اتَّصَلَ بِـ, 'reach, come to') + jār, neighbor (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'to his neighbor'
بِحَائِطٍ: بِـ + حَائِط — bi-, by, with (prep. of accompaniment) + ḥāʾiṭ, wall (m., gen. indef.); 'by a wall'
بِذِكْرِهِ: بِـ + ذِكْر + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep. governed by آنَسَ بِـ, 'cheer, put at ease with') + dhikr, remembrance, invocation of God (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'with his remembrance'
بِعَيْنِهِ: بِـ + عَيْن + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep., instrumental, governed by أَصَابَ بِـ, 'strike, afflict with') + ʿayn, eye (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'with his eye'
بِقَدْرِ: بِـ + قَدْر — bi-, to the amount of (prep. of measure) + qadr, amount, measure (m., gen.); 'the size of'
بِنْتِهِ: بِنْت + ـهِ — bint, daughter, girl (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'his daughter'
تَبْرَأُ: تَبْرَأُ — tabraʾu, she recovers, is cured (verb I of بَرِئَ, imperf. 3fs)
تَزُورُنِي: تَزُورُ + نِي — tazūru, you visit (verb I, imperf. 2ms) + 1cs object; 'you visit me'
تَسْئَلُنِي: تَسْأَلُ + نِي — tasʾalu, you ask (verb I, imperf. 2ms; hamza printed precomposed on a yāʾ-seat, ئ, kept as in the source) + 1cs object; 'you ask me'
تَغَلَّبَ: تَغَلَّبَ — taghallaba, to prevail, get the upper hand (verb V of غ-ل-ب, perf. 3ms)
تَوَلَّعَ: تَوَلَّعَ — tawallaʿa, to become infatuated, become fastened upon (verb V of و-ل-ع, perf. 3ms)
جَارُهُ: جَار + ـهُ — jār, neighbor (m., nom.) + 3ms; 'his neighbor'
جُنُونُ: جُنُون — junūn, madness (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
جِئْتَنَهُ: جِئْتَ + نَ + ـهُ — jiʾta, you came (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms) + epenthetic -na- + 3ms suffix — a colloquial Egyptian fusion standing for Classical جِئْتَ لَهُ, 'you came for it'
جِوَارِهِ: جِوَار + ـهِ — jiwār, neighborhood, vicinity (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'his neighborhood'
حَاسِدِهِ: حَاسِد + ـهِ — ḥāsid, envier (active participle, m., gen.) + 3ms; 'his envier'
حَسَدُهُ: حَسَد + ـهُ — ḥasad, envy (m., nom.) + 3ms; 'his envying [of him]'
خَبَرُهُ: خَبَر + ـهُ — khabar, news, report, fame (m., nom.) + 3ms; 'news of him'
خَلَوَاتِكُمْ: خَلَوَات + ـكُمْ — khalawāt, cells, private retreats (f. pl. of khalwa, gen.) + 2mp; 'your cells'
خَلَوَاتِهِمْ: خَلَوَات + ـهِمْ — khalawāt, cells, retreats (f. pl. of khalwa, gen.) + 3mp; 'their cells'
دَمْلَمَ: دَمْلَم — Damlam, a proper name (father of the jinni Maymūn named here); kept exactly as printed
دَوَاءٌ: دَوَاء — dawāʾ, remedy, cure (m., nom. indef.)
دَوَاءَهَا: دَوَاء + هَا — dawāʾ, cure (m., acc.) + 3fs; 'her cure' (the hamza is printed precomposed, ء, in the archive; kept as printed)
دَوَاءُهَا: دَوَاء + هَا — dawāʾ, cure (m., nom.) + 3fs; 'her cure' (the hamza is printed precomposed, ء, in the archive; kept as printed rather than reseated as ؤ)
ذَنَبِهِ: ذَنَب + ـهِ — dhanab, tail (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'its tail'
رَاسِهَا: رَاس + هَا — rās, head (this text's colloquial spelling of Classical رَأْس, dropping the hamza) + 3fs; 'her head'
رَجُلَانِ: رَجُل + ـَانِ — rajul, man (m.) + dual ending (nom.); 'two men'
رَحَّبَ: رَحَّبَ — raḥḥaba, to welcome (verb II of ر-ح-ب, perf. 3ms)
زَادَ: زَادَ — homograph: (1) zāda, to increase, grow (verb I, hollow root, perf. 3ms); (2) zād, provisions, store of food for a journey (m., bare/indeterminate noun; compare زَادَنَا, the same noun with a suffix) — context decides which.
زَاوِيَةً: زَاوِيَة — zāwiya, hermitage, retreat (f., acc. indef.)
زَاوِيَتِكَ: زَاوِيَة + ـكَ — zāwiya, hermitage (f., gen.) + 2ms; 'your hermitage'
زَعَمُوا: زَعَمُوا — zaʿamū, they alleged, claimed, it is said (verb I, perf. 3mp)
زِيَارَتِهِ: زِيَارَة + ـهِ — ziyāra, visit (verbal noun of III zāra, f., gen.) + 3ms; 'visiting him'
سَاقِيَةٌ: سَاقِيَة — sāqiya, water-drawing (active participle f. of سَقَى, nom. indef.); a well fitted for drawing water
سَاكِنَيْنِ: سَاكِن + ـيْنِ — sākin, dwelling (active participle of سَكَنَ) + dual ending (acc.); 'dwelling' — predicate of كَانَ, printed in the accusative/genitive dual rather than the nominative dual a strict grammar of the predicate would require
سَبْعَ: سَبْعَ — sabʿa, seven (numeral, acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
سِرًّا: سِرّ — sirr, a secret (m., acc. indef.); 'in secret'
شَعَرَاتٍ: شَعَرَات — shaʿarāt, hairs (f. pl. of shaʿra, gen. indef.)
طَالِعًا: طَالِع — ṭāliʿ, coming up, rising (active participle of ṭalaʿa, m., acc.)
طَعَامِهِ: طَعَام + ـهِ — ṭaʿām, food (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'his food'
طَلَعَتِ: طَلَعَتِ — ṭalaʿat, it rose (verb I, perf. 3fs, with a helping vowel before al-)
عَسْكَرِهِ: عَسْكَر + ـهِ — ʿaskar, army (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'his army'
عِبَادَتَهُ: عِبَادَة + ـهُ — ʿibāda, worship, devotion (f., acc.) + 3ms; 'his worship'
غَلَاةٍ: غَلَاة — an obscure form, gen. indef., vocalized here by evident sense as 'presently, shortly'; possibly related to غَدَاة, 'early morning' — see note
فَالْتَقَطُوهُ: فَـ + اِلْتَقَطُوا + ـهُ — fa-, so (conj.) + iltaqaṭū, they picked up, gathered (verb VIII of ل-ق-ط, perf. 3mp; initial alif hamzat al-waṣl) + 3ms; 'so they gathered him up'
فَأَجْلَسَهَا: فَـ + أَجْلَسَ + هَا — fa-, and so + ajlasa, to seat (verb IV of ج-ل-س, perf. 3ms) + 3fs; 'and he seated her'
فَأَخَذَ: فَـ + أَخَذَ — fa-, so + akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'so he took'
فَأَلْقَاهُ: فَـ + أَلْقَى + ـهُ — fa-, so + alqā, to cast, throw (verb IV of ل-ق-ي, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'so he cast him'
فَبَلَغَ: فَـ + بَلَغَ — fa-, so + balagha, to reach (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَتَدَخَّلَ: فَـ + تَدَخَّلَ — fa-, so + tadakhkhala, to enter, go in (verb V of د-خ-ل, perf. 3ms)
فَتَلَقَّاهُ: فَـ + تَلَقَّى + ـهُ — fa-, so + talaqqā, to meet, receive (verb V of ل-ق-ي, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'so he met him'
فَدَفَعَ: فَـ + دَفَعَ — fa-, so + dafaʿa, to push (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَرَحَلَ: فَـ + رَحَلَ — fa-, so + raḥala, to depart, move away (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَعَظُمَ: فَـ + عَظُمَ — fa-, so + ʿaẕuma, to become great (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَفَعَلُوا: فَـ + فَعَلُوا — fa-, so + faʿalū, they did (verb I, perf. 3mp)
فَقُمْ: فَـ + قُمْ — fa-, so + qum, arise! (verb I hollow, imperative 2ms)
فَيَرُوحُ: فَـ + يَرُوحُ — fa-, so, then + yarūḥu, he goes away, departs (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
فَيُبَخِّرُهَا: فَـ + يُبَخِّرُ + ـهَا — fa-, so + yubakhkhiru, he fumigates (verb II of ب-خ-ر, imperf. 3ms) + 3fs; 'so he fumigates her'
قَائِلٌ: قَائِل — qāʾil, a speaker, one who says (active participle of qāla, m., nom. indef.)
قَتَلَهُ: قَتَلَ + ـهُ — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'he killed him'
قَلَّلَ: قَلَّلَ — qallala, to lessen, reduce (verb II of ق-ل-ل, perf. 3ms)
كُلُّهُ: كُلّ + ـهُ — kull, all, whole (m., nom.) + 3ms; 'all of it'
لَأَهْجُرَنَّ: لَـ + أَهْجُرَنَّ — la-, emphatic particle (before the energetic imperfect, reinforcing an oath) + ahjuranna, I will surely forsake (verb I of ه-ج-ر, imperf. 1cs + emphatic nūn); 'I will surely forsake'
لِأَجْلِهِ: لِـ + أَجْل + ـهِ — li-, for (prep. of reason/cause) + ajl, sake (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'for his sake, because of him'
لِبَعْضٍ: لِـ + بَعْضٍ — li-, to (prep., dative of address) + baʿḍ, some, others (m., gen. indef.); 'to others'
لِفُقَرَائِكَ: لِـ + فُقَرَاء + ـكَ — li-, to (prep., dative, governed by قَالَ لِـ, 'say to') + fuqarāʾ, poor brethren (m. pl. of faqīr, gen.) + 2ms; 'to your poor brethren'
لِفُقَرَائِهِ: لِـ + فُقَرَاء + ـهِ — li-, to (prep., dative, governed by قَالَ لِـ, 'say to') + fuqarāʾ, poor brethren (gen.) + 3ms; 'to his poor brethren'
لِلْمَحْسُودِ: لِـ + الـ + مَحْسُود — li-, to, for (prep. of possession, with كَانَ لِـ, 'to have') + maḥsūd, the envied one (m., gen.); 'the envied man had'
لِوَقْتِهَا: لِـ + وَقْت + ـهَا — li-, at, for (prep. of time) + waqt, time, moment (m., gen.) + 3fs; 'at once, that very moment'
مَسْكُونًا: مَسْكُون — maskūn, inhabited (passive participle of سَكَنَ, m., acc.)
مَيْمُونَ: مَيْمُون — Maymūn, a proper name (of the jinni whose 'madness' has taken hold of the princess); kept exactly as printed
مُغَلَّلَةٌ: مُغَلَّلَة — mughallala, fettered, chained (passive participle of II ghallala, f., nom.)
مُكَتَّفَةٌ: مُكَتَّفَة — mukattafa, bound with the hands behind the back, pinioned (passive participle of II kattafa, f., nom.)
مُلْصَقَيْنِ: مُلْصَق + ـيْنِ — mulṣaq, joined, adjoined (passive participle of IV alṣaqa) + dual ending (acc.); 'adjoining' — predicate of كَانَ, printed accusative/genitive dual rather than the nominative dual
نُقْطَةٌ: نُقْطَة — nuqṭa, a spot, dot (f., nom. indef.)
وَآنَسَنَا: وَ + آنَسَ + نَا — wa-, and + ānasa, to cheer, put at ease (verb IV of أ-ن-س, perf. 3ms) + 1cp; 'and he cheered us'
وَاحِدُهُمَا: وَ + وَاحِد + ـهُمَا — wa-, and + wāḥid, one (m., nom.) + 3md; 'one of the two of them'
وَالسَّعَةِ: وَ + الـ + سَعَة — wa-, and + saʿa, ampleness, spaciousness (f., gen.); 'and ampleness'
وَالْمَحْسُودُ: وَ + الْمَحْسُودُ — wa-, and + al-maḥsūd, the envied one (m., nom.); 'and/while the envied man'
وَالْمَسَاكِينُ: وَ + الـ + مَسَاكِين — wa-, and + masākīn, the destitute (m. pl. of miskīn, nom.)
وَامْشِ: وَ + اِمْشِ — wa-, and + imshi, walk! (verb I of م-ش-ي, imperative 2ms; initial alif hamzat al-waṣl)
وَأَبْعَدَ: وَ + أَبْعَدَ — wa-, and + abʿada, to go far, distance oneself (verb IV of ب-ع-د, perf. 3ms)
وَأَخْلَصَ: وَ + أَخْلَصَ — wa-, and + akhlaṣa, to make sincere, purify (verb IV of خ-ل-ص, perf. 3ms)
وَأَذِيَّتُهُ: وَ + أَذِيَّة + ـهُ — wa-, and + adhiyya, molestation (f., nom.) + 3ms; 'and his molestation [of him]'
وَأَرْجُو: وَ + أَرْجُو — wa-, and + arjū, I hope (verb I of ر-ج-و, imperf. 1cs)
وَأَقْعَدُوهُ: وَ + أَقْعَدُوا + ـهُ — wa-, and + aqʿadū, they seated (verb IV of ق-ع-د, perf. 3mp) + 3ms; 'and they seated him'
وَأَنْشَأَ: وَ + أَنْشَأَ — wa-, and + anshaʾa, to build, establish (verb IV of ن-ش-أ, perf. 3ms; initial hamza supplied, the root-final hamza printed precomposed in the archive's own أ)
وَتَبْرِي: وَ + تَبْرِي — wa-, and + tabrī, she recovers — this text's colloquial spelling of Classical تَبْرَأُ, its final hamza replaced by a yāʾ
وَتَحَيَّلَ: وَ + تَحَيَّلَ — wa-, and + taḥayyala, to scheme, work a trick (verb V of ح-ي-ل, perf. 3ms)
تَمَشَّوْا: to walk along; here glossed after the archive's own line-break split of the connective وَ from its verb
وَجَاءَتْهُ: وَ + جَاءَتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + jāʾat, she/it came (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3ms; 'and it/she came to him'
وَجَاءُوا: وَ + جَاءُوا — wa-, and + jāʾū, they came (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَدَوَاءُهَا: وَ + دَوَاء + هَا — wa-, and + dawāʾ, cure (m., nom.) + 3fs; 'and her cure'
وَذَكَا: وَ + ذَكَا — wa-, and + dhakā, to grow sharp-witted/clever, or (of a fire) to blaze up (verb I final-weak, perf. 3ms)
وَزَادَ: وَ + زَادَ — wa-, and + zāda, to increase, grow (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
وَسَكَنَ: وَ + سَكَنَ — wa-, and + sakana, to settle, dwell (verb I, perf. 3ms)
شَاعَ: to spread, become known; here glossed after the archive's own line-break split of the connective وَ from its verb
وَشَالَهُم: وَ + شَالَ + هُم — wa-, and + shāla, to carry, lift (colloquial verb standing for Classical ḥamala, perf. 3ms) + 3mp; 'and he carried them off'
وَعَبَدَ: وَ + عَبَدَ — wa-, and + ʿabada, to worship (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَعَمَّرَ: وَ + عَمَّرَ — wa-, and + ʿammara, to build up, construct (verb II of ع-م-ر, perf. 3ms)
وَقَرَّبَهُ: وَ + قَرَّبَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + qarraba, to bring near (verb II of ق-ر-ب, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and he drew him near'
وَقِرَاءَتِهِ: وَ + قِرَاءَة + ـهِ — wa-, and + qirāʾa, reading, recitation (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'and his recitation'
وَقْتٍ: وَقْت — waqt, time, moment (m., gen. indef.); كُلَّ وَقْتٍ, 'every moment'
وَكُلَّ: وَ + كُلَّ — wa-, and + kull, every (m., acc. adverbial)
وَلَذِيذِ: وَ + لَذِيذ — wa-, and + ladhīdh, sweet, delicious (adj. used as noun, m., gen.); 'and the sweetness of'
وَنَمَا: وَ + نَمَا — wa-, and + namā, to grow, increase (verb I final-weak, perf. 3ms)
وَيُبَالِغُ: وَ + يُبَالِغُ — wa-, and + yubālighu, he goes to excess (verb III of ب-ل-غ, imperf. 3ms)
وَيُصِيبُهُ: وَ + يُصِيبُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + yuṣību, he strikes, afflicts (verb IV of ص-و-ب, imperf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and strikes him'
يَأْتِي: يَأْتِي — yaʾtī, he comes, brings (verb I of أ-ت-ي, imperf. 3ms)
يَحْسُدُ: يَحْسُدُ — yaḥsudu, he envies (verb I of ح-س-د, imperf. 3ms)
يَزْدَادُ: يَزْدَادُ — yazdādu, he increases (verb VIII of ز-ي-د, imperf. 3ms)
يَسْمَعُنَا: يَسْمَعُ + نَا — yasmaʿu, he hears (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 1cp object; 'he hears us'
يَعُودُ: يَعُودُ — yaʿūdu, he returns (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
يَقْصُدُونَ: يَقْصُدُونَ — yaqṣudūna, they make for, head toward (verb I of ق-ص-د, imperf. 3mp)
الْأخَرَ: الـ + آخَر — ākhar, other, another (m., acc.); 'the other' (hamza supplied as a combining mark on the alif; the archive prints bare الاخر, without the madda a fully pointed spelling would show)
أَرْسَلَ: to send; here glossed after the archive's own line-break split of the connective وَ from its verb
وَسَتَرَ: وَ + سَتَرَ — satara, to cover, veil (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he covered'
وَأَخْرَجَ: وَ + اَخْرَجَ — akhraja, to take out, extract (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he took out' (editorially supplied hamza; the edition prints واخرج with a bare alif)
الشَّعَرَ: الـ + شَعَر — shaʿar, hair (m., acc. def.); the cat's hairs mentioned earlier in the tale
وَبَخَّرَهَا: وَ + بَخَّرَ + هَا — bakhkhara, to fumigate, cense (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he fumigated her'
فَصَاحَ: فَـ + صَاحَ — ṣāḥa, to cry out, shriek (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'so it cried out'
وَمَضَى: وَ + مَضَى — maḍā, to go away, depart (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he/it departed'
وَعَقَلَتِ: وَ + عَقَلَتْ — ʿaqalat, she came to her senses, mastered herself (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she came to her senses'
الْبِنْتُ: الـ + بِنْت — bint, girl, daughter (f., nom. def.)
نَفْسِهَا: نَفْس + هَا — nafs, self, soul (f.) + -hā, her; عَقَلَتْ عَلَى نَفْسِهَا, 'she mastered herself'
وَسَتَرَتْ: وَ + سَتَرَتْ — satarat, she covered (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she covered'
الْأَحْوَالُ: الـ + اَحْوَال — aḥwāl, conditions, states (m. pl. of ḥāl, nom. def.); editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints الاحوال with a bare alif)
مَزِيدٍ: مَزِيد — mazīd, increase, more (m., gen. indef.); see مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ under عَلَيْهِ
يَدَيِ: يَد (dual) — yaday-, two hands (f. dual, construct); 'the two hands of'
أَكَابِرِ: اَكَابِر — akābir, the great ones, magnates (m. pl. of kabīr, gen.); editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints اكابر with a bare alif)
نَقُولُونَ: naqūlūna — we say (verb I, imperf. 1pl); carries a non-Classical -ūna ending (Classical would give نَقُول), kept as printed
يَسْتَأْهِلُ: yastāhilu — to deserve (verb X, imperf. 3ms); colloquial (Egyptian-type) for Classical يَسْتَحِقّ/يَسْتَأْهِل, still used in speech today; editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints يستاهل with a bare alif)
اِبْنَتِي: اِبْنَة + ي — ibna, daughter (f.) + -ī, my; 'my daughter' (اِبْنَة is one of the standard nouns of hamzat al-waṣl, so its initial hamza is never marked, even fully vocalised)
يَتَزَوَّجُ: yatazawwaju — he marries (a woman) (verb V, imperf. 3ms); governs بِـ for the woman married (تَزَوَّجَ بِـ); here jussive-like, 'let him marry her'
صَدَقْتُمْ: ṣadaqtum — you (m. pl.) spoke truly, were right (verb I, perf. 2mpl)
زَوَّجَهُ: زَوَّجَ + هُ — zawwaja, to marry (someone) to (someone) (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; governs بِـ for the woman, 'he married him to her'
صِهْرَ: صِهْر — ṣihr, son-in-law (m., acc., predicate of صَارَ)
نَعْمَلُ: naʿmalu — we make, appoint (verb I, imperf. 1pl)
صِهْرَكَ: صِهْر + كَ — ṣihr, son-in-law (m.) + -ka, your; 'your son-in-law'
فَعَمِلُوا: فَـ + عَمِلُوا — ʿamilū, they made, appointed (verb I, perf. 3mpl); 'so they made/appointed'
السُّطَانُ: السُّطَان — as printed, without its lām; a compositor's slip for السُّلْطَان, 'the sultan' (m., nom. def.), pointed as printed rather than restored
مَلِكًا: مَلِك — malik, king (m., acc. indef., predicate)
رَكِبَ: rakiba — to ride, mount (verb I, perf. 3ms)
مَرْكَبَهُ: مَرْكَب + هُ — markab, a mount, riding-beast (m.) + -hu, his; here a horse for a state procession, not a ship, as مركب elsewhere means in this same tale-cycle
مَارًّا: مَارّ — mārr, passing (act. part. of marra, m., acc. indef.)
بِالْمَحْسُودِ: بِـ + الـ + مَحْسُود — bi-, (prep.; after إِذَا of surprise it does not mean 'with' but only marks what suddenly appears, cf. وَإِذَا بِغَزَالَةٍ, 'and behold, a gazelle') + al-Maḥsūd; 'there was al-Maḥsūd'
بِدَسْتِ: بِـ + دَسْت — bi-, at, in (prep.) + dast, seat or session of state (Persian loanword, m.); 'at the seat of'
أُمَرَائِهِ: اُمَرَاء + هِ — umarāʾ, emirs (m. pl. of amīr) + -hi, his; editorially supplied hamza on the initial alif (the edition prints امرائه with a bare alif there; the medial hamza before the suffix is the edition's own)
وَوُزَرَائِهِ: وَ + وُزَرَاء + هِ — wuzarāʾ, viziers (m. pl. of wazīr) + -hi, his; 'and his viziers'
وَأَرْبَابِ: وَ + اَرْبَاب — arbāb, lords, masters (m. pl. of rabb, gen.); 'and the lords of'; editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints وارباب with a bare alif)
فَرَقَعَتْ: فَـ + رَقَعَتْ — raqaʿat, as printed (verb I, perf. 3fs); read here by the sense of the standard idiom وَقَعَتْ عَيْنُهُ عَلَى, 'his eye fell upon' — the archive's ر for و may be a compositor's slip or a genuine variant, kept and pointed as printed rather than corrected
وُزَرَائِهِ: وُزَرَاء + هِ — wuzarāʾ, viziers (m. pl. of wazīr) + -hi, his
بِذٰلِكَ: بِـ + ذٰلِكَ — bi-, (marking the object brought, governed by أَتَى بِـ 'bring') + dhālika, that
تُرَجِّفْهُ: تُرَجِّفْ + هُ — turajjif, you make tremble (verb II of رَجَفَ, jussive after لَا of prohibition, 2ms) + -hu, him; 'you frighten him'
وَأَتَاهُ: وَ + اَتَى + هُ — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms); with بِـ, 'to bring' (أَتَى بِـ, literally 'come with') + -hu, him; 'and he brought him'; editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints واتاه with a bare alif)
بِالْحَاسِدِ: بِـ + الـ + حَاسِد — bi-, (marking the object brought, governed by أَتَى بِـ 'bring') + al-Ḥāsid
جَارِهِ: جَار + هِ — jār, neighbor (m.) + -hi, his; identifies al-Ḥāsid as al-Maḥsūd's own former neighbor
أَعْطُوهُ: اَعْطُوا + هُ — aʿṭū, give! (imper. of أَعْطَى, verb IV, 2mpl) + -hu, him; editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints اعطوه with a bare alif)
أَلْفَ: اَلْف — alf, a thousand (m., acc.); editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints الف with a bare alif)
مِثْقَالٍ: مِثْقَال — mithqāl, a mithqāl, a standard weight of gold or silver coin (m., gen. indef.)
وَعَبُّوا: وَ + عَبُّوا — ʿabbū, load, pack up! (imper. of عَبَّى, verb II, 2mpl); 'and load'
حِمْلًا: حِمْل — ḥiml, a load (m., acc. indef.)
الْمَتْجَرِ: الـ + مَتْجَر — matjar, merchandise, trade-goods (m., gen. def.); from the same root as تِجَارَة, 'commerce'
حَارِسًا: حَارِس — ḥāris, a guard (act. part. of ḥarasa, m., acc. indef.)
يُوصِلُهُ: يُوصِلُ + هُ — yūṣilu, he brings, delivers (verb IV of وَصَلَ, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, him
وَانْصَرَفَ: وَ + اِنْصَرَفَ — inṣarafa, to turn away, depart (verb VII, perf. 3ms); hamzat waṣl, so no hamza mark; 'and he turned away'
عَاقَبَهُ: عَاقَبَ + هُ — ʿāqaba, to punish (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him
حَسَدَهُ: حَسَدَ + هُ — ḥasada, to envy (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him
الْبِدَايَةِ: الـ + بِدَايَة — bidāya, beginning (f., gen. def.)
أَذَاهُ: اَذَى + هُ — adhā, harm, hurt (m., here used both verbally, 'he harmed him' — properly آذَاهُ, verb IV, the edition's spelling collapsing the initial hamza-plus-alif into one alif — and, later in this slice, nominally, 'his harm' i.e. the harm he caused) + -hu, him; editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints اذاه with a bare alif)
أَرَادَ: وَ + اَرَادَ — arāda, to want, wish (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he wanted'; editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints واراد with a bare alif)
يُقَابِلْهُ: يُقَابِلْ + هُ — yuqābil, he repays, requites (verb III of قَابَلَ, jussive after لَمْ, 3ms) + -hu, him; قَابَلَهُ عَلَى, 'to repay him for'
صَفَحَ: ṣafaḥa — to pardon, overlook (verb I, perf. 3ms); with عَنْ, 'to pardon (someone)'
وَعَفَا: وَ + عَفَا — ʿafā, to forgive (verb I, perf. 3ms); takes عَنْ or, as here, لِـ for the person forgiven; 'and he forgave'
أَيَّتُهَا: اَيَّتُهَا — ayyatuhā, O (vocative part., before a f. noun); editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints ايتها with a bare alif)
السَّيِّدَةُ: الـ + سَيِّدَة — sayyida, lady, mistress (f., nom. def.); addresses the lady of the house, as يَا سِتِّي does elsewhere
الْبُكَاءَ: الـ + بُكَاء — bukāʾ, weeping (m., acc. def., cognate-style accusative with بَكَيْتُ); the edition's own hamza, kept as printed
الشَّدِيدَ: الـ + شَدِيد — shadīd, intense, severe (m., acc. def.)
أَنْشَدْتُ: وَ + اَنْشَدْتُ — anshadtu, I recited (verse) (verb IV of نَشَدَ, perf. 1s); 'and I recited'; editorially supplied hamza (the edition prints وانشدت with a bare alif)
وَهَبَ: wahaba — to give, grant; here 'to forgive, pardon' (verb I, perf. 3ms); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
الْجُنَاةَ: الـ + جُنَاة — junāt, offenders, wrongdoers (m. pl. of jānī, acc. def.); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
أَهْلُ: ahl — people, folk (of) (m., nom.); the archive's own precomposed hamza on this verse word, kept as printed
النُّهَى: الـ + نُهَى — nuhā, understanding, sound judgment (m. pl./coll., gen. def.); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
يَهَبُونَ: yahabūna — they give, grant (verb I, imperf. 3mpl); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
لِلْجَانِينَ: لِـ + الـ + جَانِينَ — li-, to, for (prep., marking the recipient of يَهَبُونَ 'grant') + al-jānīn, the offenders (m. pl. of jānī, gen./acc. def.); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
يَجْنُونَهُ: يَجْنُونَ + هُ — yajnūna, they commit (an offense) (verb I, imperf. 3mpl) + -hu, it; copied from the archive's own verse pointing
فَلَقَدْ: فَـ + لَقَدْ — la-qad, indeed, verily (emphatic part.); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
حَوَيْتَ: ḥawayta — you have encompassed, taken in (verb I, perf. 2ms); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
الذُّنُوبِ: الـ + ذُنُوب — dhunūb, sins (m. pl. of dhanb, gen. def.); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
بِأَسْرِهَا: بِـ + أَسْر + هَا — bi-, with, in (prep.) + asr, entirety (m.) + -hā, its; 'in their entirety'; the archive's own precomposed hamza on this verse word, kept as printed
فَاحْوِ: فَـ + اِحْوِ — iḥwi, gather, take in! (imper. of حَوَى, verb I, 2ms); hamzat waṣl, so no hamza mark; copied from the archive's own verse pointing
الصَّفْحِ: الـ + صَفْح — ṣafḥ, pardon, forgiveness (m., gen. def.); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
فُنُونَهُ: فُنُون + هُ — funūn, kinds, varieties (m. pl. of fann) + -hu, its; copied from the archive's own verse pointing
فَمَنِ: فَـ + مَنِ — man, whoever (conditional/rel. pron.); 'so whoever'; copied from the archive's own verse pointing
ابْتَغَى: ibtaghā — to seek, desire (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); hamzat waṣl, so no hamza mark; copied from the archive's own verse pointing
عَفْوَ: عَفْو — ʿafw, pardon (m., acc., object of اِبْتَغَى); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
فَلْيَعْفُ: فَـ + لْـ + يَعْفُ — fa-, so (conj.) + li-, let (jussive particle) + yaʿfu, he forgive (verb I, jussive 3ms); 'so let him forgive'; copied from the archive's own verse pointing
ذَنْبِ: ذَنْب — dhanb, sin, offense (m., gen.); copied from the archive's own verse pointing
دُونَهُ: دُونَ + هُ — dūna, below, beneath (adv./prep.) + -hu, him; copied from the archive's own verse pointing
جَاءَبِي: جَاءَ + بِـ + ي — jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms), here with بِـ, 'to bring' (jāʾa bi-, like أَتَى بِـ, governs بِـ for the thing brought) + -ī, me; the edition prints this as one unspaced word; 'he brought me'
شَفَا: شَفَا — shafā, to cure, heal (verb I, perf. 3ms); the edition spells the final weak radical with plain alif rather than alif maqṣūra (Classical شَفَى), a common non-Classical leveling, kept as printed
أَرَادَ: to want, intend; here glossed after the archive's own line-break split of the connective وَ from its verb
أَنْشَدْتُ: to recite (verse), 1cs perf.; here glossed after the archive's own line-break split of the connective وَ from its verb
أَقْتُلَكَ: أَقْتُلُ + كَ — aqtulu, I kill (verb I, imperf. 1cs, subjunctive after أَنْ) + -ka, you (m.); 'that I kill you'
وَإِمَّا: وَ + إِمَّا — wa, and + immā, or (second member of the immā...immā pair); 'or else'
الْعَفْوُ: الـ + عَفْو — ʿafw, pardon, forgiveness (m., nom.); 'the pardon'
أَسْحَرَكَ: أَسْحَرُ + كَ — asḥaru, I enchant (verb I, imperf. 1cs, subjunctive after أَنْ) + -ka, you (m.); 'that I enchant you'
اقْتَلَعَ: iqtalaʿa — form VIII of ق-ل-ع, 'to tear up, pluck out, wrench away' (perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl, never marked); 'he tore [me] up'
الْجَوِّ: الـ + جَوّ — jaww, air, sky, atmosphere (m., gen.); 'the sky'
تَحْتِي: تَحْتَ + ي — taḥta, beneath (used here as a noun, 'the place beneath') + -ī, me/my; 'beneath me'
قَصْعَةٌ: qaṣʿa — bowl, large dish (f., nom. indef.); 'a bowl'
حَطَّنِي: حَطَّ + نِي — ḥaṭṭa, to set down, put down (verb I geminate, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he set me down'
وَهَمْهَمَ: وَ + هَمْهَمَ — wa, and + hamhama, to murmur, mutter (verb I reduplicated/onomatopoeic, perf. 3ms); 'and he murmured'
وَطَرَشَنِي: وَ + طَرَشَ + نِي — wa, and + ṭarasha, colloquial 'to throw, fling' (not Classical ṭaraḥa; verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he flung [it] at me'
قِرْدًا: qird — ape (m., acc. as the predicate of ṣirtu); 'an ape'
مِائَةِ: miʾa — hundred (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); spelled ماية in the archive, its hamza's seat (a yāʾ) printed without dots; 'a hundred'
وَصَبَرْتُ: وَ + صَبَرْتُ — wa, and + ṣabartu (ṣabara, to bear patiently, endure; verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I bore patiently'
جَوْرِ: jawr — tyranny, oppression, injustice (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the tyranny of'
وَعَلِمْتُ: وَ + عَلِمْتُ — wa, and + ʿalimtu (ʿalima, to know; verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I knew'
الزَّمَانَ: الـ + زَمَان — zamān, time, fortune (m., acc. as the subject of anna); 'time, fortune'
لِأَحَدٍ: لِـ + أَحَدٍ — li-, to, for, belonging to (prep., marking possession) + aḥad, anyone, someone (m., gen. indef.); 'to anyone, [belongs] to no one'
وَقٰلَ: وَ + قٰلَ — wa, and + qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); the edition's defective spelling قل for قال, pointed here with the dagger alif; used as a bare narrative tag ('he said/continued') rather than introducing a new speaker
انْحَدَرْتُ: اِنْحَدَرَ + تُ — inḥadara, form VII of ح-د-ر, 'to descend, go down' (hamzat waṣl, never marked) + -tu, I; 'I descended'
أَسْفَلَ: asfal — below, downward (elative noun/adv. of س-ف-ل; acc.)
مُتَّسِعًا: muttasiʿ — wide, spacious (act. part. of form VIII ittasaʿa, 'to become wide'; m., acc. indef.); 'spacious'
الشَّهْرِ: الـ + شَهْر — shahr, month (m., gen.); 'the month'
فَانْتَهَى: فَـ + انْتَهَى — fa-, so (conj.) + intahā, form VIII of ن-ه-ي, 'to come to an end, arrive at' (hamzat waṣl; perf. 3ms); 'so [the going] brought [me] at last'
السَّيْرُ: الـ + سَيْر — sayr, journeying, going (m., nom.; grammatical subject of intahā); 'the journey'
شَاطِئِ: shāṭiʾ — shore, bank (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); spelled شاطي in the archive, its hamza's seat printed without dots
بِمَرْكَبٍ: بِـ + مَرْكَبٍ — bi-, with (prep.; after idhā anā bi-, marking what suddenly appears) + markab, ship, vessel (m., gen. indef.); 'with a ship'
طَابَ: ṭāba — to become good, pleasant, fair (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'had turned fair'
رِيحُهُ: رِيح + ـهُ — rīḥ, wind (f.) + -hu, its; 'its wind'
طَالِبُ: ṭālib — seeking, one who seeks (act. part. of ṭalaba; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'heading for'
فَاخْتَفَيْتُ: فَـ + اخْتَفَيْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + ikhtafaytu (ikhtafā, form VIII of خ-ف-ي, 'to hide oneself'; hamzat waṣl; perf. 1cs); 'so I hid myself'
الْمَرْكَبُ: الـ + مَرْكَب — markab, ship (m., nom.); 'the ship'
الرُّكَّابِ: الـ + رُكَّاب — rukkāb, passengers, riders (m. pl. of rākib; gen.); 'the passengers'
أَخْرِجُوا: akhrijū — imperative pl. of form IV أَخْرَجَ, 'to cast out, expel' (hamzat qaṭʿ, unlike form I's imperative اُخْرُجْ); 'cast out!'
الْمَشُومَ: الـ + مَشُوم — mashūm, colloquial for 'ill-omened, unlucky' (beside Classical مَشْؤُوم; m., acc.); 'the ill-omened one'
الرَّئِسُ: الـ + رَئِس — this text's short spelling of رَئِيس, raʾīs, 'captain, chief' (dropping the long ī; m., nom.); 'the captain'
نَقْتُلُهُ: نَقْتُلُ + هُ — naqtulu (qatala, to kill; verb I, imperf. 1pl) + -hu, him; 'we will kill him'
الْآخَرُ: الـ + آخَر — ākhar, other, another (adj./noun, m., nom.); 'the other [man]'
اُقْتُلْهُ: اُقْتُلْ + هُ — uqtul, kill! (imperative of qatala; hamzat waṣl) + -hu, him; 'kill him!'
السَّيْفِ: الـ + سَيْف — sayf, sword (m., gen.); 'the sword'
فَمَسَكْتُ: فَـ + مَسَكْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + masaktu (masaka, to seize, take hold of; verb I, perf. 1cs); 'so I seized'
ذَيْلَ: dhayl — hem, skirt (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the hem of'
الرَّئِسِ: الـ + رَئِس — raʾīs (short spelling), captain (m., gen.); 'the captain'
وَسَالَتْ: وَ + سَالَتْ — wa, and + sālat (sāla, to flow, of liquids; verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'and [my tears] flowed'
فَحَنَّ: فَـ + حَنَّ — fa-, so (conj.) + ḥanna, to feel tenderness, compassion (verb I geminate, perf. 3ms; here impersonal, ḥanna ʿalā, 'compassion came over [someone]'); 'so compassion came over'
تُجَّارُ: tujjār — merchants (m. pl. of tājir; nom. as vocative); 'O merchants'
الْقِرْدُ: الـ + قِرْد — qird, ape (m., nom.); 'the ape'
اسْتَجَارَ: istajāra — form X of ج-و-ر, 'to seek refuge, ask for protection' (hamzat waṣl; perf. 3ms); 'he has sought refuge'
أَجَرْتُهُ: أَجَرْتُ + هُ — ajartu (ajāra, form IV of ج-و-ر, 'to grant refuge, protection'; perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'I have granted him protection'
ذِمَامِي: ذِمَام + ـي — dhimām, a pledge of protection, safe-conduct (m.) + -ī, my; 'my safeguard'
أَحَدَ: aḥad — anyone, one (m., acc. after the negative lā); 'no one'
يُعَكِّرُ: yuʿakkiru — ʿakkara, form II, 'to muddy, trouble, disturb' (imperf. 3ms)
يُشَوِّشُ: yushawwishu — shawwasha, form II, 'to confuse, disturb' (imperf. 3ms)
الرَّئِسَ: الـ + رَئِس — raʾīs (short spelling), captain (m., acc. as the subject of inna); 'the captain'
يُحْسِنُ: yuḥsinu — aḥsana, form IV of ح-س-ن, 'to do well, be kind' (imperf. 3ms); yuḥsinu ilā, 'to be kind to'
وَأَقْضِي: وَ + أَقْضِي — wa, and + aqḍī (qaḍā, form I, 'to carry out, fulfill'; imperf. 1cs); 'and I fulfill'
حَوَائِجَهُ: حَوَائِج + ـهُ — ḥawāʾij, needs, errands (irregular pl. of ḥāja) + -hu, his; 'his needs'
كُلَّهَا: كُلَّ + ـهَا — kull, all, every (acc., in apposition) + -hā, them (f. pl., referring to ḥawāʾij); 'all of them'
وَأَخْدُمُهُ: وَ + أَخْدُمُ + هُ — wa, and + akhdumu (khadama, to serve; imperf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'and I serve him'
فَحَبَّنِي: فَـ + حَبَّ + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + ḥabba, to love (verb I, perf. 3ms; beside the commoner form IV aḥabba) + -nī, me; 'so he grew fond of me'
الْمَرْكَبَ: الـ + مَرْكَب — markab, ship (m., acc. as the subject of inna); 'the ship'
الرِّيحُ: الـ + رِيح — rīḥ, wind (f., nom.); 'the wind'
فَرَسَيْنَا: فَـ + رَسَيْنَا — fa-, so (conj.) + rasaynā, this text's spelling of rasawnā (rasā, to anchor; verb I defective, perf. 1pl), its final radical written with yāʾ rather than wāw; 'so we anchored'
وَفِيهَا: وَ + فِي + ـهَا — wa, and + fī, in (prep.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and in it'
عَالَمٌ: ʿālam — literally 'a world', idiomatically 'a multitude, throng of people' (m., nom. indef.)
عَدَدُهُمْ: عَدَد + ـهُمْ — ʿadad, number, count (m.) + -hum, their; 'their number'
وُصُولِنَا: وُصُول + ـنَا — wuṣūl, arrival (m. verbal noun of waṣala) + -nā, our; 'our arrival'
مَرْكَبُنَا: مَرْكَب + ـنَا — markab, ship (m.) + -nā, our; 'our ship'
مَمَالِيكُ: mamālīk — mamluks, royal retainer-slaves (m. pl. of mamlūk; nom. indef.)
جِهَةِ: jiha — direction, side, quarter (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); min jihati, 'on behalf of' (lit. 'from the side of')
فَطَلَعُوا: فَـ + طَلَعُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + ṭalaʿū (ṭalaʿa, to come up, come aboard; verb I, perf. 3mp); 'so they came aboard'
مَرْكَبِنَا: مَرْكَب + ـنَا — markab, ship (m., gen.) + -nā, our; 'our ship'
وَهَنَّوْا: وَ + هَنَّوْا — wa, and + hannaw, this text's colloquial spelling/pronunciation of Classical hannaʾū (hannaʾa, form II, 'to congratulate'; perf. 3mp), dropping the hamza altogether; 'and they congratulated'
التُّجَّارَ: الـ + تُجَّار — tujjār, merchants (m. pl. of tājir; acc.); 'the merchants'
مَلِكُنَا: مَلِك + ـنَا — malik, king (m.) + -nā, our; 'our king'
يُهَنِّئُكُمْ: يُهَنِّئُ + كُمْ — yuhanniʾu (hannaʾa, form II, 'to congratulate'; imperf. 3ms) + -kum, you (pl.); 'wishes you joy'; spelled يهنيكم in the archive, its hamza's seat printed without dots
إِلَيْكُمْ: إِلَى + كُمْ — ilā, to (prep.) + -kum, you (pl.); 'to you'
الدَّرْجَ: الـ + دَرْج — darj, roll, scroll (m., acc.); 'the roll'
الْوَرَقَ: الـ + وَرَق — waraq, paper (m., acc., in apposition with al-darj); 'of paper'
يَكْتُبُ: yaktubu — kataba, to write (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
سَطْرًا: saṭr — a line (of writing) (m., acc. indef.); 'one line'
وَاحِدًا: wāḥid — one (adj., m., acc. indef., agreeing with saṭran); 'a single'
وَأَقْسَمَ: وَ + أَقْسَمَ — wa, and + aqsama, form IV of ق-س-م, 'to swear' (perf. 3ms)
وَحَلَفَ: وَ + حَلَفَ — wa, and + ḥalafa, to swear, take an oath (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْأَيْمَانَ: الـ + أَيْمَان — aymān, oaths (m. pl. of yamīn; acc.); 'the oaths'
الْعِظَامَ: الـ + عِظَام — ʿiẓām, mighty, great (adj., m. pl. acc., agreeing with al-aymān); 'mighty'
بِأَنْ: بِـ + أَنْ — bi-, that (prep. governing the clause after ḥalafa, 'swore that...') + an, that (subordinating particle with the subjunctive); 'that'
يُوَزَّرَ: yuwazzara — form II passive of و-ز-ر, 'to be made vizier' (subjunctive after لَا)
خَطِّهِ: خَطّ + ـهِ — khaṭṭ, handwriting (m.) + -hi, his; 'his hand(writing)'
نَاوَلَ: nāwala — form III of ن-و-ل, 'to hand over, pass to' (perf. 3ms)
دَرْجَ: darj — roll, scroll (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'a roll of'
طُولُهُ: طُول + ـهُ — ṭūl, length (m.) + -hu, its; 'its length'
أَذْرُعٍ: adhruʿ — cubits (m. pl. of dhirāʿ, gen. indef.)
عَرْضِ: ʿarḍ — width, breadth (m., gen.); 'a width of'
آخِرِهِمْ: آخِر + ـهِمْ — ākhir, last, end (m.) + -him, their/them; 'the last of them'
الْقِرْدِ: الـ + قِرْد — qird, ape (m., gen.); 'the ape'
وَخَطَفْتُ: وَ + خَطَفْتُ — wa, and + khaṭaftu (khaṭafa, to snatch; verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I snatched'
أَيْدِيهِمْ: أَيْدِي + ـهِمْ — aydī, hands (irregular pl. of yad) + -him, their; 'their hands'
فَخَافُوا: فَـ + خَافُوا — fa-, so, for (conj.) + khāfū (khāfa, to fear; verb I hollow, perf. 3mp); 'for they feared'
أَقْطَعُهُ: أَقْطَعُ + هُ — aqṭaʿu (qaṭaʿa, to cut, tear; imperf. 1cs) + -hu, it; 'I would tear it'
فَنَهَرُونِي: فَـ + نَهَرُوا + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + naharū (nahara, to rebuke sharply, chide; verb I, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'so they rebuked me sharply'
فَأَشَرْتُ: فَ + أَشَرْتُ — ashāra, to point, gesture, signal (verb IV, hollow root ش-و-ر; 1st sing. perf.); fa-, 'and so, then' (conj.)
أَكْتُبُ: kataba — to write (verb I; 1st sing. impf.); 'I write, I would write'
فَأَشَارَ: فَ + أَشَارَ — ashāra, to point, gesture, signal (verb IV; 3ms perf.); fa-, 'so, then'
الرَّئِيسُ: الـ + رَئِيس — raʾīs, chief, captain (m., nom.); here the ship's captain
خَلْوَةً: khalwa — privacy, seclusion (f., acc. of manner); 'privately, apart'
طَرَدْنَا: ṭarada — to drive away, expel (verb I; 1st pl. perf.); 'we would drive away'
عَنَّا: عَن + ـنَا — ʿan, from, away from (prep.) + 1st pl.; 'from us'
الْكِتابَةَ: الـ + كِتابَة — kitāba, writing (f., acc., specifying what he did well at); 'the writing'
اِتَّخَذْنٰهُ: اِتَّخَذَ + ـنا + ـهُ — ittakhadha, to take, adopt (verb VIII of أخذ; 1st pl. perf.) + 1st pl. + 3ms obj.; 'we would take him, adopt him'
وَإِلَّا: وَ + إِلَّا — illā, otherwise, if not (إِنْ + لا contracted); wa-, 'and'
فَإِنِّي: فَ + إِنَّ + ـي — inna, indeed, verily (assertive particle) + 1st sing.; fa-, 'then'; 'then indeed I'
بِنَهْ: textually obscure and uncertain — the letters do not parse as a standard word; kept and vocalized only minimally (see note on this sentence)
إِنِّي: إِنَّ + ـي — inna, indeed, verily (assertive particle) + 1st sing.; 'indeed I'
مَسَكْتُ: masaka — to seize, take hold of (verb I; 1st sing. perf.); 'I took up'
الْقَلَمَ: الـ + قَلَم — qalam, pen, reed-pen (m., acc.); 'the pen'
وَاِسْتَعْمَلِيتُ: وَ + اِسْتَعْمَلَ + ـيتُ — istaʿmala, to use, employ (verb X of ʿamila; 1st sing. perf., spelled with an extra ي before the ending — a colloquial variant of ـتُ); wa-, 'and'; 'and I used'
الدَّوَاةِ: الـ + دَواة — dawāh, inkstand, inkwell (f., gen. after min)
الرُّقَاعِيَّ: الـ + رُقَاعِيّ — Ruqāʿī, the Ruqʿa script (nisba adj. from رُقْعَة, 'note, patch'; m., acc.); one of the classical Arabic calligraphic hands
الْبَيْتَيْنِ: الـ + بَيْتَيْن — bayt, verse-line, line of poetry (m. dual obl.); 'the two verses'
ش: abbreviation this edition prints for شِعْر, 'poetry, verse' — a rubric introducing the quoted verse, not itself a word of the text
وَكَتَبْتُ: وَ + كَتَبْتُ — kataba, to write (verb I; 1st sing. perf.); wa-, 'and'; 'and I wrote'
بِقَلَمِ: بِـ + قَلَم — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrumental) + qalam, pen (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with, in the pen/hand of...'
الرَّيْحَانِ: الـ + رَيْحان — Rayḥān, the Rayḥānī script (lit. 'sweet basil'; m., gen.); a rounded cursive calligraphic hand
الثُّلُثِ: الـ + ثُلُث — thuluth, a third (m., gen.); the Thuluth script, named for its proportions
النَّسْخِ: الـ + نَسْخ — naskh, copying (m., gen.); the everyday book-hand
الطُّومَهِ: الـ + طُّومَه — this edition's clipped spelling of طُومار, ṭūmār (m., gen.), the grand chancery hand
كَتَبَ: kataba — to write, record (verb I; 3ms perf.)
فَضْلَ: faḍl — excellence, merit, virtue (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
الْكِرَامِ: الـ + كِرام — karīm (pl. كِرام), noble, generous (m. pl., gen.)
وَفَضْلُكَ: وَ + فَضْلُ + ـكَ — faḍl, excellence (m., nom.) + 2ms; wa-, 'and'; 'and your excellence'

لِاَفْوَاهِ: لِـ + اَفْواه — li-, to, at (prep.) + fam (pl. أَفْواه), mouth (m. pl., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'to the mouths of'

اَلَمَ: alam — pain, ache (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa; printed with no hamza mark)

فَقُلْ: فَ + قُلْ — qul, say! (verb I of qāla; 2ms imper.); fa-, 'then'

يُعْجِبْهُ: يُعْجِبْ + ـهُ — aʿjaba, to please (verb IV, juss. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'it did not please him'
خَطُّ: khaṭṭ, handwriting, hand (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
لِلْجَمَاعَةِ: لِـ + الـ + جَمَاعَة — li-, to (prep.) + jamāʿa, group, company (f., gen.); 'to the company'
