الصُّبْحُ: الـ + صُبْح — ṣubḥ, dawn, morning (m., nom.)
بِالدُّجَى: بِـ + الـ + دُجَى — bi-, to, against (prep., completing هَتَفَ بِـ, 'cry out to/against') + dujā, darkness (m., gen.)
الْحَلِيمَ: الـ + حَلِيم — ḥalīm, forbearing, patient, wise (m. adj., acc.)
لَسْتُ: laysa, to not be (defective verb, perf. 1cs)
اَدْرِي: أَدْرِي — daraytu (root د-ر-ي), to know (verb I, impf. 1cs; printed without a hamza sign, as the archive has it); 'I do not know' (with لَسْتُ)
لِرِقَّةٍ: لِـ + رِقَّة — li-, for, because of (prep.) + riqqa, delicacy, fineness (f., gen.)
وَصَفَاءٍ: وَ + صَفَاء — wa-, and + ṣafāʾ, clarity, purity (m., gen.)
كَاسِهَا: كَاس + ـهَا — kās, cup, glass (f., gen.) + 3fs; 'her cup'
اَمِ: أَمِ — am, or (conj., in an alternative question; printed without a hamza sign, as the archive has it)
فَقَرَأَ: فَ + قَرَأَ — fa-, so, then (conj.) + qaraʾa, to read (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'so he read'
فَتَحَسَّرَ: فَ + تَحَسَّرَ — fa- + taḥassara, to sigh in longing or wistful admiration (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he sighed'
الْأَدَبُ: الـ + أَدَب — adab, refinement, culture, good breeding (m., nom.); the hamza is editorial, supplied on the bare alif the edition prints; 'the refinement'
إِنْسَانٍ: insān, human being (m., gen. with tanwīn after fī); the hamza is editorial, supplied on the bare alif the edition prints
لَفَاقَ: لَـ + فَاقَ — la-, indeed (emphatic particle marking the apodosis of a law-conditional) + fāqa, to surpass, excel over (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he would surpass'
عَصْرِهِ: عَصْر + ـهِ — ʿaṣr, age, era (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his age'
وَزَمَانِهِ: وَ + زَمَان + ـهِ — wa- + zamān, time, era (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his time'
رُقْعَةَ: ruqʿa, board, patch, sheet (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'a board of'
شِطْرَنْجٍ: shiṭranj, chess (m., gen. with tanwīn, Persian loanword); 'chess'
تَلْعَبَ: talʿaba, to play (verb I, pres. 2ms subjunctive after أَنْ); 'that you play'
بِرَاسِي: بِـ + رَاسِ + ـي — bi-, with (prep.) + rās, head (m., this text's colloquial spelling of Classical رَأْس, the hamza unwritten) + 1cs suffix; 'with my head'
تَقَلَّمْتُ: taqallamtu, 1cs perf. of a form-V verb built on the archive's own letters ت-ق-ل-م-ت; sense uncertain, probably a slip for تَقَدَّمْتُ, 'I came/stepped forward' (see the note on this sentence)
وَوَضَعْتُ: وَ + وَضَعْتُ — wa- + waḍaʿtu, to put, set out, place (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I set out'
الشِّطْرَنْجَ: الـ + شِطْرَنْج — shiṭranj, chess(board) (m., acc.); 'the chess(board)'
لَعِبْتُ: laʿibtu, to play (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I played'
مَرَّتَيْنِ: marratayni — marra, time, occasion (f., dual acc.); 'twice'
أَغْلِبُهُ: أَغْلِبُ + ـهُ — aghlibu, I overcome, defeat (verb I yaghlibu, pres. 1cs, of غَلَبَ) + 3ms suffix; 'I defeat him'
فَحَارَ: فَ + حَارَ — fa- + ḥāra, to be bewildered, to reel (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'so it reeled'
عَقْلُ: ʿaql, mind, reason (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the mind of'
الدَّوَاةَ: الـ + دَوَاة — dawāh, inkstand, inkwell (f., acc.); 'the inkstand'
وَالْقَلَمَ: وَ + الـ + قَلَم — wa- + qalam, pen, reed-pen (m., acc.); 'and the pen'
الرُّقْعَةِ: الـ + رُقْعَة — ruqʿa, board, sheet (f., gen.); 'the board'
جَيْشَانِ: jaysh, army, host (m., dual nom.); 'two armies' — verse word, copied from the archive already pointed
يَقْتَتِلَانِ: yaqtatilāni, to fight one another (verb VIII, pres. 3m dual, of قَتَلَ); 'the two fight each other' — verse
نَهَارِهِمْ: نَهَار + ـهِمْ — nahār, day(time) (m., gen.) + 3mpl suffix; 'their day'
وَقِتَالُهُمْ: وَ + قِتَال + ـهُمْ — wa- + qitāl, fighting, combat (m., nom.) + 3mpl suffix; 'and their fighting'
زَايِدْ: zāyid, increasing, growing (act. part. of زَادَ, verb I hollow); verse rhyme-word, printed without tanwīn for the end-rhyme, copied as archived
جَنَّ: janna, to grow dark, to cloak (of night/darkness) (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'fell, descended' (of darkness)
نَامَا: nāmā, to sleep (verb I hollow, perf. 3m dual, of نَامَ); 'the two of them slept'
وَاحِدْ: wāḥid — one, a single (adj., m.); verse rhyme-word, printed without tanwīn, copied as archived
قَرَأَ: qaraʾa, to read (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he read'
عَجِبَ: ʿajiba, to marvel, be amazed (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he marveled'
وَطَرِبَ: وَ + طَرِبَ — wa- + ṭariba, to be delighted, moved with pleasure (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and was delighted'
وَلَحِقَهُ: وَ + لَحِقَ + ـهُ — wa- + laḥiqa, to overtake, come over, catch up with (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix; 'and it overtook him'
الِانْبِهَارُ: الـ + اِنْبِهَار — inbihār, astonishment, being dazzled (m., nom., form-VII verbal noun of بَهَرَ); the initial hamza is hamzat al-waṣl, never marked with the editorial hamza sign; 'the astonishment'
لِخَادِمِهِ: لِـ + خَادِم + ـهِ — li-, to (prep., indirect object of qāla) + khādim, servant (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'to his servant'
سِتِّكَ: سِتِّ + ـكَ — sitt, lady, mistress (f., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your lady'
سِتِّالْحُسْنِ: sitt, lady (f., gen.); first term of the name/title سِتّ الْحُسْن, in apposition here
كَلِّمِي: kallimī — speak (to), address! (imperative, verb II, 2fs, of كَلَّمَ, 'to speak to'); here a summons formula, 'speak with the king'
تَجِيءَ: tajīʾa, to come (verb I, pres. 3fs subjunctive after ḥattā, of جَاءَ); 'that she may come'
تَتَفَرَّجُ: tatafarraju, to look on, gaze, be diverted (verb V, pres. 3fs, of فَرَّجَ, here with عَلَى); 'she gazes upon'
تُرْسِلَ: tursila, to send (verb IV, pres. 2ms subjunctive after أَنْ, of أَرْسَلَ); 'that you should send'
تُفَرِّجُنِي: تُفَرِّجُ + ـنِي — tufarrijunī, you show X, make X look (verb II, pres. 2ms, of فَرَّجَ, here with عَلَى) + 1cs object suffix; 'you make me look'
سِتَّالْحُسْنِ: sitt, lady (f., acc., vocative, first term of the name سِتّ الْحُسْن); 'O Lady…'
سِوَى: siwā — except, other than (prep./particle of exception)
الْمَمْلُوكِ: الـ + مَمْلُوك — mamlūk, owned one, page, servant (pass. part. of مَلَكَ, m., gen.); 'the page'
وَالْمُقَدَّمِ: وَ + الـ + مُقَدَّم — wa- + muqaddam, one placed in charge, chamberlain (pass. part. of قَدَّمَ, m., gen.); 'and the chamberlain'
رَبَّاكِي: rabbāki, he raised you (verb II, perf. 3ms, of رَبَّى) + 2fs suffix, with the archive's own extra ي printed after the suffix (see the note on this sentence, cf. عَرَفْتِي below); 'he raised you'
أَبُوكِي: أَبُو + ـكِي — abū, father (construct form of أَب) + 2fs suffix, with the archive's own extra ي printed after the suffix; 'your father'
تُغَطِّي: tughaṭṭī, to cover (verb II, pres. 2fs, of غَطَّى); 'you cover'
وَجْهَكِ: وَجْه + ـكِ — wajh, face (m., acc.) + 2fs suffix; 'your face'
شَابٌّ: shābb, young man (m., nom. with tanwīn); 'a young man'
وَأَبُوهُ: وَ + أَبُو + ـهُ — wa- + abū, father (construct form) + 3ms suffix; the hamza is editorial; 'and his father'
اِسْمُهُ: اِسْم + ـهُ — ism, name (m., nom.; hamzat al-waṣl) + 3ms suffix; 'his name'
أَنْتِيمَارُوسُ: Antīmārūs — proper name: the enchanted prince's own father, king of the Ebony Isles (nom.); the hamza is editorial, supplied on the bare alif the edition prints
جَزَائِرِ: jazāʾir, islands (f. pl. of jazīra, gen., first term of an iḍāfa; the edition already prints this word's medial hamza precomposed, ئ, kept exactly as printed); 'isles of'
أَبَنُوسٍ: abanūs, ebony (m., gen. with tanwīn); the hamza is editorial; 'ebony' — with جَزَائِر, 'the Isles of Ebony'
سَحَرَهُ: سَحَرَ + ـهُ — saḥara, to bewitch, cast a spell on (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix; 'he enchanted him'
إِبْلِيسَ: Iblīs — Satan, the Devil (proper name, gen.); the hamza is editorial, supplied on the bare alif the edition prints
وَقَتَلَ: وَ + قَتَلَ — wa- + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he killed'
أَفْتَامُوسَ: Aftāmūs — proper name: the murdered princess's father (gen.); the hamza is editorial, supplied on the bare alif the edition prints
عَرَفْتِي: ʿaraftī, you knew (verb I, perf. 2fs, of عَرَفَ, with the archive's own extra ي printed after the ending, see the note on this sentence); 'you knew'
صَغِيرَةٌ: ṣaghīra, small, young (adj., f., nom. with tanwīn); 'young'
عَجُوزٌ: ʿajūz, old woman (f., nom. with tanwīn); 'an old woman'
مَاكِرَةٌ: mākira, cunning, crafty (act. part. of مَكَرَ, f., nom. with tanwīn); 'cunning'
سَاحِرَةٌ: sāḥira, sorceress (act. part. of سَحَرَ, f., nom. with tanwīn); 'a sorceress'
فَعَلَّمَتْنِي: فَ + عَلَّمَتْ + ـنِي — fa- + ʿallamat, she taught (verb II, perf. 3fs, of عَلَّمَ) + 1cs object suffix; 'so she taught me'
وَصِنَاعَتَهُ: وَ + صِنَاعَة + ـهُ — wa- + ṣināʿa, craft, art (f., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'and its craft'
حَفِظْتُهُ: حَفِظْتُ + ـهُ — ḥafiẕtu, I memorized (verb I, perf. 1cs, of حَفِظَ) + 3ms suffix; 'I memorized it'
وَأَتْقَنْتُهُ: وَ + أَتْقَنْتُ + ـهُ — wa- + atqantu, I mastered, perfected (verb IV, perf. 1cs, of أَتْقَنَ) + 3ms suffix; 'and I mastered it'
وَحَفِظْتُ: وَ + حَفِظْتُ — wa- + ḥafiẕtu, I memorized (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I memorized'
مِائَةً: miʾa, hundred (f., acc. with tanwīn; the edition prints this word's hamza precomposed, ئ, kept exactly as printed); 'a hundred'
أَبْوَابِهِ: أَبْوَاب + ـهِ — abwāb, chapters, doors (m. pl., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'its chapters'
أَقَلُّ: aqall, least, fewest (elative of قَلِيل/قَلَّ, m., nom.); the hamza is editorial; 'the least'
أُخَلِّي: ukhallī, I turn (X into Y), move, displace (verb II, pres. 1cs, of خَلَّى); the hamza is editorial; 'I could move, turn'
حِجَارَةَ: ḥijāra, stones (f. coll., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the stones of'
وَأَجْعَلُهَا: وَ + أَجْعَلُ + ـهَا — wa- + ajʿalu, I make, turn X into (verb I, pres. 1cs, of جَعَلَ) + 3fs object suffix; the hamza is editorial; 'and I make it'
لُجَّةَ: lujja, depths, a swelling flood (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the depths of'
بَحْرٍ: baḥr, sea (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'a sea'
وَأَجْعَلُ: وَ + أَجْعَلُ — wa- + ajʿalu, I make (verb I, pres. 1cs); the hamza is editorial; 'and I make'
أَهْلَهَا: أَهْل + ـهَا — ahl, people, folk (m., acc.) + 3fs suffix; the hamza is editorial; 'its people'
سَمَكًا: samak, fish (coll., m., acc. with tanwīn); 'fish'
خَلِّصِي: khalliṣī — free, deliver, disenchant! (imperative, verb II, 2fs, of خَلَّصَ)
أَجْعَلَهُ: أَجْعَلَ + ـهُ — ajʿala, I make (verb I, pres. 1cs subjunctive after ḥattā, of جَعَلَ) + 3ms suffix; the hamza is editorial; 'that I may make him'
وَزِيرِي: وَزِير + ـي — wazīr, vizier, minister (m., acc.) + 1cs suffix; 'my vizier'
لَبِيبٌ: labīb, intelligent, sensible (adj., m., nom. with tanwīn); 'intelligent'
وَعَمِلَتْ: وَ + عَمِلَتْ — wa- + ʿamilat, she made, did (verb I, perf. 3fs, of عَمِلَ); 'and she made'
دَائِرَةً: dāʾira, circle (f., acc. with tanwīn; the edition prints this word's medial hamza precomposed, ئ, kept exactly as printed); 'a circle'
الرَّابِعَةَ: الـ + رَابِعَة — rābiʿ, fourth; accusative predicate of كان, 'the fourth'
اَنْقَرَنْدَلِي: a proper name, unanalyzed — kept letter for letter as the archive's اَنْقَرَنْدَلِي; context suggests it may stand for القرندلي, 'the Qalandar' who narrates this frame-tale (see note)
بِالْأَسْمَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + أَسْمَاء — ism, name (pl. أَسْمَاء); 'with the names'; hamza supplied, archive prints bare بالاسماء
الْعِبْرَانِيَّةِ: الـ + عِبْرَانِيَّة — ʿibrāniyya, Hebrew (f. adj.); 'the Hebrew (names)'
وَخَطَّتْ: وَ + خَطَّ (+تْ f.) — khaṭṭa, to draw, trace; 'and she drew'
وَكَتَبَتْ: وَ + كَتَبَ (+تْ f.) — kataba, to write; 'and she wrote'
أَسْمَاءً: أَسْمَاء — asmāʼ, names (pl. of اِسْم); accusative; hamza supplied, archive bare اسماء
وَطِلَّسْمَاتٍ: وَ + طِلَّسْمَات — ṭillasmāt, talismans (pl. of طِلَّسْم); accusative indefinite
وَعَزَمَتْ: وَ + عَزَمَ (+تْ f.) — ʿazama, here used absolutely for performing a magical adjuration/incantation, not the ordinary 'to resolve'
وَقَرَأَتْ: وَ + قَرَأَ (+تْ f.) — qaraʼa, to read, recite; 'and she recited'; hamza already printed in the archive, kept as is
بِالْعِفْرِيتِ: بِـ + الـ + عِفْرِيت — ʿifrīt, efrit, demon; the بِـ after إذا of surprise simply marks what appears
تَلَا: تَلَا — literally 'to follow, recite'; an odd verb for an efrit's sudden appearing — probably a slip or variant for طَلَعَ ('to loom up'), which is used for the same kind of event later in this scene; rendered contextually as 'loomed/appeared'
صِفَتِهِ: صِفَة + هِ — ṣifa, description, form; 'his form'
وَهَيْئَتِهِ: وَ + هَيْئَة + هِ — hayʼa, shape; 'and his shape'; hamza already printed in the archive, kept as is
أَيْدٍ: أَيْدٍ — pl. of يَد, hand; here loosely 'limbs'; hamza supplied, archive bare ايد
وَأَرْحُلٌ: وَ + أَرْحُلٌ — pl. of رَحْل, pack-saddle, baggage; printed with ح where the stock formula elsewhere has أَرْجُل ('legs', with ج) — kept as printed and read by context as 'legs'; hamza supplied
كَالسَّوَارِي: كَـ + الـ + سَوَارِي — pl. of سَارِيَة, column, pillar; 'like columns'
فَفَزِعْنَا: فَ + فَزِعَ + نَا — faziʿa, to be frightened; 'so we were frightened'
أَهْلًا: أَهْلًا — ahlan, '(be) welcome' (from أَهْل, family/kin); hamza supplied; negated here as a taunt, paired with سهلا
سَهْلًا: سَهْلًا — sahlan, '(be at) ease'; paired with أهلا in the ordinary greeting idiom أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا, negated here
فَاِنْقَلَبَ: فَ + اِنْقَلَبَ — inqalaba, Form VII of قَلَبَ, 'to turn/change into'
أَسَدٍ: أَسَد — asad, lion; hamza supplied, archive bare اسد
خَائِنَةُ: خَائِنَة — khāʼina, traitress, f. active participle of خَانَ; vocative
نَقَضْتِ: نَقَضَ + تِ — naqaḑa, to break, violate; 'you (f.) broke'
تَحَالَفْنَا: تَحَالَفَ + نَا, Form VI — taḥālafa, to swear a mutual oath; 'we swore together'
يَتَعَرَّضُ: يَتَعَرَّضُ, Form V of عَرَضَ — taʿarraḑa, to molest, interfere with (governs لـ)
لِلْآخَرِ: لِـ + الـ + آخَر — ākhar, other; the archive's own precomposed hamza-madda (لِلْآخَرِ) is kept as printed
جَاكِ: contracted colloquial for جَاءَكِ — jāʼa, to come; 'it has come to you', kept as printed rather than expanded
فَأَسْرَعَتْ: فَ + أَسْرَعَ + تْ, Form IV of سَرِعَ — asraʿa, to hurry; hamza supplied
وَهَزَّتْهَا: وَ + هَزَّ + تْ + هَا — hazza, to shake; 'and she shook it'
وَهَمْهَمَتْ: وَ + هَمْهَمَ + تْ — hamhama, to murmur, mutter
بِشَفَتَيْهَا: بِـ + شَفَتَيْ + هَا — dual of شَفَة, lip; 'with her two lips'
فَصَارَتِ: فَ + صَارَ + تِ — ṣāra, to become; 'so it became'
مَاضِيًا: مَاضِي — māḑī, sharp, cutting (active participle of مَضَى, 'to pass through, cut through')
رَأْسُهُ: رَأْس + هُ — raʼs, head; 'his head'; hamza supplied, archive bare راسه
وَهَمَّتْ: وَ + هَمَّتْ — hammat, 'she set about, went for' (the verb here governs عَلَى rather than the classically expected بِـ, a shift worth noting once)
اللَّعِينِ: الـ + لَعِين — 'the cursed one' (genitive after على)
فَتَقَاتَلَا: فَ + تَقَاتَلَا, Form VI of قَتَلَ — taqātala, to fight each other; dual, 'the two of them fought'
اِنْقَلَبَتِ: اِنْقَلَبَتِ — 'she/it turned into' (connective kasra links to the following definite article)
وَطَلَبَتْهُ: وَ + طَلَبَ + تْ + هُ — ṭalaba, to pursue, seek; 'and she pursued him'
ذِيبًا: ذِيب — dhīb, wolf; the colloquial spelling without hamza used throughout this passage for classical ذِئْب
أَبْلَقَ: أَبْلَق — ablaq, piebald, pied; hamza supplied
الْقَطَٰ: الـ + قَطَا — 'the sand-grouse'; printed القط, the final alif of قطا dropped just as قال is elsewhere printed قل — pointed here with a dagger alif over the ط to preserve the spelling while reading al-qaṭā
مَغْلُوبًا: مَغْلُوب — maghlūb, overcome, vanquished (pass. part. of غَلَبَ, 'to defeat'); indefinite accusative of state (ḥāl): 'as one overcome, defeated'
حَمْرَةً: حَمْرَة — the edition's spelling for classical حَمْرَاء, 'red' (f.); kept as printed
وَقَعَدَتِ: وَ + قَعَدَ + تِ — qaʿadat, 'it settled, came to rest'
الذِّيبُ: الـ + ذِيب — 'the wolf'; spelled without hamza throughout this passage, evidently the colloquial pronunciation dhīb rather than classical dhiʼb — kept as printed each time it recurs
فَاِرْتَفَعَتْ: فَ + اِرْتَفَعَتْ, Form VIII of رَفَعَ — irtafaʿa, to rise up
الْهَوَاءِ: الـ + هَوَاء — hawāʾ, air (m.), gen.; 'the air'
فَاِنْكَسَرَتْ: فَ + اِنْكَسَرَتْ, Form VII of كَسَرَ — inkasara, to break, shatter
وَاِنْتَشَرَ: وَ + اِنْتَشَرَ, Form VIII of نَشَرَ — intashara, to scatter, spread
وَاِمْتَلَأَتْ: وَ + اِمْتَلَأَتْ, Form VIII of مَلَأَ — imtalaʼa, to become full; the root-final hamza is already printed in the archive (امتلأت), kept as is
أَرْضُ: أَرْض — arḑ, ground, land; hamza supplied
فَاِنْتَفَضَ: فَ + اِنْتَفَضَ, Form VIII of نَفَضَ — intafaḑa, to shake oneself
وَاِلْتَقَطَ: وَ + اِلْتَقَطَ, Form VIII of لَقَطَ — iltaqaṭa, to pick up, gather
يَتْرُكْ: يَتْرُكْ — taraka, to leave; jussive after لم
فَبِالْأَمْرِ: فَ + بِـ + الـ + أَمْر — amr, matter, decree; hamza supplied
الْمُقَدَّرِ: الـ + مُقَدَّر — muqaddar, decreed, fated; passive participle of قَدَّرَ
تَلَارَتْ: printed thus, checked twice against the page; not the expected تَدَارَتْ — an obscure verb, kept exactly as printed and rendered by context as 'rolled/slipped away' (see note)
يَصِيحُ: يَصِيحُ — ṣāḥa, to crow, cry out
وَيُرَفْرِفُ: وَ + يُرَفْرِفُ — rafrafa, to flap, flutter
بِأَجْنِحَتِهِ: بِـ + أَجْنِحَة + هِ — janāḥ, wing (pl. أَجْنِحَة); hamza supplied
وَيُشِيرُ: وَ + يُشِيرُ, Form IV of شَارَ — ashāra, to point, gesture
اِنْقَلَبَ: اِنْقَلَبَ — 'it has turned over' (the reported content after قال)
الْحَبَّةَ: الـ + حَبَّة — ḥabba, seed, grain (f.); accusative: 'the seed'
فَاِنْقَضَّ: فَ + اِنْقَضَّ — inqaḑḑa, to swoop, pounce
لِيَلْتَقِطَهَا: لِـ + يَلْتَقِطَ + هَا — 'in order to snatch it up'
بِالْحَبَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + حَبَّة — 'with the seed' (in the idhā-of-surprise construction, marking what appears)
زَرَقَتْ: زَرَقَتْ — zaraqa, to dart, shoot forth
وَغَارَتْ: وَ + غَارَتْ — ghāra, to sink, dive down
وَعِيَاطًا: وَ + عِيَاط — ʿiyāṭ, shrieking, wailing (colloquial noun)
فَاِرْتَجَفْنَا: فَ + اِرْتَجَفْنَا, Form VIII of رَجَفَ — irtajafa, to tremble, shake
يَخْرُجُ: يَخْرُجُ — kharaja, to come out, go out
وَأَنْفِهِ: وَ + أَنْف + هِ — anf, nose; hamza supplied
خَرَجَتِ: kharajat, 3rd f. sg. past of kharaja, "to go out, come out"; the epenthetic -ti (rather than -at) is the connecting vowel before a following hamza-initial word.
اِنْعَقَدَتْ: اِنْعَقَدَتْ, Form VII of عَقَدَ — inʿaqadat, 'it closed in upon, knotted itself around'
النِّيرَانُ: الـ + نِيرَان — pl. of نَار, fires
وَاِنْحَبَسَ: وَ + اِنْحَبَسَ, Form VII of حَبَسَ — inḥabasa, to be shut in, trapped
فَخَفِينَا: فَ + خَفِينَا — khafiya, to hide (oneself); 'so we hid'
وَأَرَدْنَا: وَ + أَرَدْنَا, Form IV of رَادَ — arāda, to want; hamza supplied
وَخِفْنَا: وَ + خِفْنَا — khāfa, to fear; 'and we feared' — a near-minimal pair with خَفِينَا just before it
أَنْفُسِنَا: أَنْفُس + نَا — anfus, pl. of nafs, self (f.) + 1pl. suffix; hamza supplied; 'ourselves'
الْحَرِيقِ: الـ + حَرِيق — ḥarīq, fire, conflagration (m.), gen.
وَالْهَلَاكِ: وَ + الـ + هَلَاك — halāk, destruction, ruin
التَّحْنَانِيَّ: الـ + تَحْنَانِيّ — probably a misprint/dialectal variant of تَحْتَانِيّ, 'lower' (nisba adj. from تَحْت, 'beneath'); 'his lower [jaw]'
التَّحْنَانِيَّةَ: الـ + تَحْنَانِيَّة — fem. of the same adjective (see التحناني); 'his lower [row of teeth]' — accusative
التَّعَبَ: الـ + تَعَب — taʿab, fatigue, hardship (masc. verbal noun); accusative as cognate object: 'this great tiring'
الرُّمَّانَةِ: الـ + رُمَّانَة — rummāna, pomegranate (f.); genitive: 'of the pomegranate'
السِّحْرِ: الـ + سِحْر — siḥr, magic, sorcery; genitive: 'the sorcery'
الشَّرَارُ: الـ + شَرَار — sharār, sparks (collective noun); nominative: 'the sparks'
اللِّسَانِ: الـ + لِسَان — lisān, tongue; genitive: 'of the tongue' (مربوط اللسان, 'tongue-bound' = speechless)
النِّيرَانِ: الـ + نِيرَان — nīrān, fires (broken plural of nār); genitive: 'the fires'
الْإِسْلَامِ: الـ + إِسْلَام — islām, submission (to God); Islam, the Muslim faith (masdar of أَسْلَمَ); genitive
الْحَقِّ: الـ + حَقّ — al-Ḥaqq, 'the Truth' (a name of God); genitive
الْحَيَوةِ: الـ + حَيَوة — ḥayāh, life (f.); older orthography with wāw standing for the final ā (compare صَلَوة for الصَّلَاة elsewhere in this convention); kept as printed, read ḥayāh; genitive: 'of life'
الْعَظِيمَ: الـ + عَظِيم — ʿaẐīm, great, mighty; accusative (cognate-object modifier): 'great'
الْقَمَرُ: الـ + قَمَر — qamar, the moon; nominative — here apparently used as an admiring exclamation about the princess ('the moon!'), though the reading is uncertain (see note)
الْمَلْعُونِ: الـ + مَلْعُون — malʿūn, cursed, accursed (passive participle of laʿana); genitive: 'the cursed [efrit]'
الْمَوْجُودِينَ: الـ + مَوْجُودِين — mawjūdīn, existing, present (active participle pl. of وُجِدَ, 'to be found'); genitive/accusative pl.: 'existing'
اُخْلُصْ: اُ (wasl) + خْلُصْ — imperative of khalaṣa/yakhluṣu, 'be freed, be released, escape!' (Form I, hamzat al-waṣl, no qaṭʿ hamza)
اِسْتَغَاثَتْ: اِ (wasl) + سْتَغَاثَتْ — istaghāthat, Form X (istafʿala) from gh-w-th, 'she cried out for help' (hamzat al-waṣl)
اِسْمِ: اِ (wasl) + سْم — ism, name (one of the fixed hamzat-al-waṣl nouns); genitive: 'the name of...'
أَتْعَبْنَاهَا: أَ + تْعَبْنَا + هَا — atʿabnāhā, Form IV (afʿala) from taʿiba, 'we tired her out' (+ 1pl. subject, + her)
أَحْرَفَتْ: أَ + حْرَفَتْ — as printed (ḥ-r-f); almost certainly a qāf/fāʾ misprint for أَحْرَقَتْ, 'she burned' (Form IV from ḥaraqa), read accordingly
أَحْرَقَتْ: أَ + حْرَقَتْ — aḥraqat, Form IV from ḥaraqa, 'she burned'
أَسْنَاهُ: أَ + سْنَا + هُ — for asnānahu, 'his teeth' (broken plural of sinn, with the ن of the plural dropped, a colloquial contraction), + his
أَعِيشُ: أَ + عِيشُ — aʿīshu, Form I from ʿ-y-sh, 1st sg. impf., 'I live'
أَعْهَدُ: أَ + عْهَدُ — aʿhadu, Form I from ʿ-h-d, 1st sg. impf., 'I know, I recognize [in him]'
أَفْتَحُ: أَ + فْتَحُ — aftaḥu, Form I from f-t-ḥ, 1st sg. impf., 'I open'
أَلْحِقُونِي: أَ + لْحِقُونِي — Form IV (afʿala) imperative pl. from l-ḥ-q, + object -nī, 'catch up with me!, bring me quickly!'
أَنْكَلِمَ: أَ + نْ + كَلِمَ — Form VII-looking subjunctive from k-l-m, read here for classical أَتَكَلَّمَ, 'that I speak/converse [with him]' (a Middle Arabic construction, أن elided before it)
إِلٰهَ: إِ + لٰه — ilāh, god, a deity; spelled defectively with the dagger alif (compare هذا, ذلك); accusative after لا النافية للجنس: 'no god'
إِنَّا: إِنَّ + نَا — innā, 'verily we' (the Qur'anic formula, Q. 2:156); 'we belong [to God]'
بَارَكَ: بَارَكَ — bāraka, Form III from b-r-k, past 3ms, 'he blessed'
بِالْمَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + مَاء — bi-al-māʾi, 'with the water'
بِتَعَبِ: بِـ + تَعَب — bi-taʿabi, 'with the fatigue of'
بِحَقِّ: بِـ + حَقّ — bi-ḥaqqi, 'by the truth of' (an oath-formula use of بِـ)
بِدِينِ: بِـ + دِين — bi-dīni, 'in/to the religion of'
بِطَاسَةِ: بِـ + طَاسَة — bi-ṭāsati, 'with a bowl of'
بِقَائِلٍ: بِـ + قَائِل — bi-qāʾilin, '[there was] a speaker' (بِـ of the idhā-of-surprise construction; قائل's hamza is printed in the source and kept precomposed)
بِقِتَالِ: بِـ + قِتَال — bi-qitāli, 'to/with the fighting of' (masdar of qātala)
تَسْتَغِيثُ: تَسْتَغِيثُ — tastaghīthu, Form X from gh-w-th, 3fs impf., 'she cries out for help'
تَقْتُلُهُ: تَقْتُلُ + هُ — taqtuluhu, Form I from q-t-l, impf. (2ms or 3fs, identical in form) + him, 'you kill / she kills him', read generically as 'he would be killed'
تَقْلِرُ: تَقْلِرُ — as printed (q-l-r); almost certainly a dāl/lām misprint for تَقْدِرُ, 'is able [against]' (compare قل for قد below), read accordingly
جَمِيلًا: جَمِيل + ًا — jamīlan, a good deed, a kindness (accusative indefinite object)
حَبِّهَا: حَبّ + هَا — ḥabbihā, 'its seed, its grain' (ḥabb + her/its, referring to the pomegranate)
حَرَقْتُهُ: حَرَقْتُ + هُ — ḥaraqtuhu, Form I from ḥ-r-q, 1st sg. past + him, 'I burned him'
حَرْبٌ: حَرْب + ٌ — ḥarbun, a war (nominative indefinite subject)
خَلَاصِ: خَلَاص — khalāṣ, freeing, deliverance (masdar); genitive: 'the freeing of'
رُوحُ: رُوح + ُ — rūḥu, spirit, life (nominative, مضاف): 'the life of...'
سَاعَدَنِي: سَاعَدَ + نِي — sāʿadanī, Form III from s-ʿ-d + me, 'it/he helped me'
شَدِيدٌ: شَدِيد + ٌ — shadīdun, fierce, severe (nominative indefinite adjective)
شَعَرْنَا: شَعَرْنَا — shaʿarnā, Form I from sh-ʿ-r, 1st pl. past, 'we noticed, we perceived'
صَرَخَ: صَرَخَ — ṣarakha, Form I, 'he shrieked, he cried out'
صَفَّ: صَفّ — ṣaff, row, line; accusative (مضاف): 'the row of'
طَرَشَتْنِي: طَرَشَ + تْ + نِي — ṭarashatnī, colloquial ṭarasha, 'to splash/sprinkle' + she + me, 'she sprinkled me'
عَرَفْنَا: عَرَفْنَا — ʿarafnā, Form I from ʿ-r-f, 1st pl. past, 'we knew'
فَاحْتَرَقَ: فَـ + اِحْتَرَقَ — fa-iḥtaraqa, Form VIII from ḥ-r-q, 'so he/it burned'
فَانْتَفَضْتُ: فَـ + اِنْتَفَضْتُ — fa-intafaḍtu, Form VIII from n-f-ḍ, 'so I shook, gave a start'
فَاُبْتُلِينَا: فَـ + اُبْتُلِينَا — fa-ubtulīnā, Form VIII passive from b-l-w, 'so we were afflicted, tested'
فَأَصَابَنَا: فَـ + أَصَابَ + نَا — fa-aṣābanā, Form IV from ṣ-w-b + us, 'so it struck us'
فَأَمْسَكْتُهَا: فَـ + أَمْسَكْتُ + هَا — fa-amsaktuhā, Form IV from m-s-k + it, 'so I seized/caught it'
فَأَيْقَنَّا: فَـ + أَيْقَنَّا — fa-ayqannā, Form IV from y-q-n, 'so we became certain'
فَجَاوَا: فَـ + جَاوَا — fa-jāwā, colloquial spelling without the hamza letter, for fa-jāʾū, 'so they came, they brought'
فَخَلِيفَتِي: فَـ + خَلِيفَة + ي — fa-khalīfatī, 'so my successor, my deputy'
فَرْطِ: فَرْط — farṭ, excess; letting slip, being remiss (masdar); genitive: 'the moment of letting slip'
فَلَحِقَتِي: فَـ + لَحِقَتْ + ي (for لَحِقَتْنِي) — fa-laḥiqatnī, 'so it caught up with me' (the object suffix's نـ is dropped in print)
فَلَحِقَتْهُ: فَـ + لَحِقَتْ + هُ — fa-laḥiqathu, 'so she caught up with, matched him'
قَصَدْنَا: قَصَدْنَا — qaṣadnā, Form I from q-ṣ-d, 1st pl. past, 'we intended'
كَفَرَ: كَفَرَ — kafara, Form I from k-f-r, 'he disbelieved'
كَلَّفْنَاهَا: كَلَّفْنَا + هَا — kallafnāhā, Form II from k-l-f + we + her, 'we charged/burdened her'
كَوْمَ: كَوْم — kawm, heap, mound (m.), acc.; construct: 'a heap of'
لَقَطْتُهَا: لَقَطْتُ + هَا — laqaṭtuhā, Form I from l-q-ṭ + I + it, 'I had picked it up'
لَمَاتَ: لَـ + مَاتَ — la-māta, emphatic lām + māta, 'he would [have] die[d]'
لِوَجْهِ: لِـ + وَجْه — li-wajhi, 'for the sake of, for the face of'
مَرْبُوطُ: مَرْبُوط + ُ — marbūṭu, passive participle of rabaṭa, 'bound, tied' (nominative predicate)
مَيِّتَةٌ: مَيِّتَة + ٌ — mayyitatun, active participle fem. of māta, 'dying, dead' (nominative indefinite predicate)
مُحَمَّدًا: مُحَمَّد + ًا — Muḥammadan, the Prophet's name, accusative
مُعَوَّدَةٌ: مُعَوَّدَة + ٌ — muʿawwadatun, passive participle fem. of ʿawwada (Form II), 'accustomed' (nominative indefinite predicate)
نَظَرْنَا: نَظَرْنَا — naẒarnā, Form I from n-ẓ-r, 1st pl. past, 'we looked'
نَعْمَلَ: نَعْمَلَ — naʿmala, Form I from ʿ-m-l, subjunctive after أن, '[that] we do'
نَفْهَمُهُ: نَفْهَمُ + هُ — nafhamuhu, Form I from f-h-m + it, 'we understand it'
وَالْعِفْرِيتُ: وَـ + الـ + عِفْرِيت + ُ — wa-al-ʿifrītu, 'and the efrit' (nominative, topicalized subject)
وَالْمَاءِ: وَـ + الـ + مَاء — wa-al-māʾi, 'and the water'
وَأَوْنَعَتْ: وَـ + أَوْنَعَتْ — wa-awnaʿat, obscure form (a-w-n-ʿ); perhaps a misprint for أَوْجَعَتْ 'it pained' or أَوْقَعَتْ 'it struck', read here by sense as 'and it damaged/struck'
وَأَيِسْنَا: وَـ + أَيِسْنَا — wa-ayisnā, Form I from a-y-s (a classical variant of ي-ء-س, 'to despair'), 'and we despaired'
وَبِحَقِّ: وَـ + بِـ + حَقّ — wa-bi-ḥaqqi, 'and by the truth of'
وَحَنَكَهُ: وَـ + حَنَك + هُ — wa-ḥanakahu, 'and his jaw, his palate'
وَخَذْلٌ: وَـ + خَذْل + ٌ — wa-khadhlun, 'and a routing, a forsaking' (verbal noun of khadhala)
وَذَقَنَهُ: وَـ + ذَقَن + هُ — wa-dhaqanahu, 'and his chin'
وَلَحِقَ: وَـ + لَحِقَ — wa-laḥiqa, 'and there hit, there caught up with'
لَقْطِ: laqṭ — the picking-up, gathering (verbal noun of laqaṭa, "to pick up"), here genitive after وَقْتَ فَرْطِ الرُّمَّانَةِ وَلَقْطِ حَبِّهَا, "the moment the pomegranate scattered and its seed was picked up".
وَلٰكِنْ: وَـ + لٰكِنْ — wa-lākin, 'but'; لكن spelled defectively (missing the internal alif after لـ), marked with the dagger alif
وَنَسِيتُ: وَـ + نَسِيتُ — wa-nasītu, Form I from n-s-y, 1st sg. past, 'and I forgot'
وَنَفَخَ: وَـ + نَفَخَ — wa-nafakha, Form I from n-f-kh, 'and he blew'
وَنُخَلِّصَهُ: وَـ + نُخَلِّصَ + هُ — wa-nukhalliṣahu, Form II from kh-l-ṣ, subjunctive + him, 'and we free him'
وُجُوهِنَا: وُجُوه + نَا — wujūhinā, 'our faces' (plural of wajh)
يَنْجُو: يَنْجُو — yanjū, Form I from n-j-w, 'he escapes'
يُؤْذِنَا: يُؤْذِ + نَا — yuʾdhinā, Form IV from a-dh-y + us, 'it harms us' (the medial hamza is printed bare as وـ in the source; supplied here as combining hamza on wāw)
فَحَزِنَّا: فَـ + حَزِنَّا — ḥazina, to grieve (I), 1st pl. past; 'and we grieved'
وَتَمَنَّيْتُ: وَ + تَمَنَّيْتُ — tamannā, to wish (V), 1st sg. past; 'and I wished'
يَصِيرُ: يَصِيرُ — ṣāra, to become (I), 3rd m. sg. imperf.
يُرَدُّ: يُرَدُّ — radda, to turn back (I), pass. imperf.; 'is turned back'
ابْنَتَهُ: ابْنَة + هُ — ibna(t), daughter (f.) + -hu, his; acc.
نَتَفَ: نَتَفَ — natafa, to pluck out (I), 3rd m. sg. past
وَلَطَمَ: وَ + لَطَمَ — laṭama, to strike/slap (I), 3rd m. sg. past
أَثْوَابَهُ: أَثْوَاب + هُ — thawb, garment (m.), pl. athwāb + -hu, his; acc.
وَبَكَيْنَا: وَ + بَكَيْنَا — bakā, to weep (I), 1st pl. past
فَجَاءُوا: فَـ + جَاءُوا — jāʾa, to come (I), 3rd m. pl. past (ء kept precomposed as printed)
وَأَرْبَابُ: وَ + أَرْبَاب — rabb, master/lord (m.), pl. arbāb, nom.
فَوَجَدُوا: فَـ + وَجَدُوا — wajada, to find (I), 3rd m. pl. past
وَكَوْمَيْنِ: وَ + كَوْمَيْنِ — kawm, heap (m.), dual acc. kawmayn
دَارُوا: dārū, 3rd m. pl. past of dāra, "to circle, go around".
أَفَاقَ: أَفَاقَ — afāqa, to recover consciousness (IV), 3rd m. sg. past
أَخْبَرَهُمْ: أَخْبَرَ + هُمْ — akhbara, to inform (IV), 3rd m. sg. past + -hum, them
فَعَظُمَتْ: فَـ + عَظُمَتْ — ʿaẕuma, to be(come) great (I), 3rd f. sg. past
مُصِيبَتُهُمْ: مُصِيبَة + هُمْ — muṣība(t), calamity (f.) + -hum, their; nom.
وَأَقَامُوا: وَ + أَقَامُوا — aqāma, to hold/establish (IV), 3rd m. pl. past
الْعَزَاءَ: الـ + عَزَاء — ʿazāʾ, mourning/condolence (m.), acc. (ء kept precomposed as printed)
يَبْنِيَ: يَبْنِيَ — banā, to build (I), 3rd m. sg. subj. (impersonal, 'that [one] build'); edition spells it with dotted yā, hence read active rather than passive 'يُبنى'
ذَرَوْهُ: ذَرَوْ + هُ — dharā/dharaw, to scatter/winnow (I), 3rd m. pl. past + -hu, it
مَرِضَ: مَرِضَ — mariḍa, to fall ill (I), 3rd m. sg. past
مَرَضًا: مَرَض — maraḍ, illness (m.), indef. acc. (cognate object)
أَشْرَفَ: أَشْرَفَ — ashrafa, to be on the verge of (IV), 3rd m. sg. past
وَنَبَتَتْ: وَ + نَبَتَتْ — nabata, to grow/sprout (I), 3rd f. sg. past
لِحْيَتُهُ: لِحْيَة + هُ — liḥya(t), beard (f.) + -hu, his; nom.
فَطَلَبَنِي: فَـ + طَلَبَ + نِي — ṭalaba, to seek/send for (I), 3rd m. sg. past + -nī, me
قَضَيْنَا: قَضَيْنَا — qaḍā, to spend/pass (time) (I), 1st pl. past
زَمَانَنَا: زَمَان + نَا — zamān, time (m.) + -nā, our; acc.
أَهْنَى: أَهْنَى — ahnā, most pleasant (elative of hanīʾ), gen.
آمِنِينَ: آمِنِين — āmin, safe/secure, m. pl. acc. (hāl); ء kept precomposed as printed
نَوَائِبِ: نَوَائِب — nāʾiba(t), calamity (f.), pl. nawāʾib, gen.; ء kept precomposed as printed
أَقْبَلْتَ: أَقْبَلْتَ — aqbala, to advance/come (IV), 2nd m. sg. past
رَأَيْنَاكَ: رَأَيْنَا + كَ — raʾā, to see (I), 1st pl. past + -ka, you
طَلْعَتَكَ: طَلْعَة + كَ — ṭalʿa(t), appearance/rising (f.) + -ka, your; acc.
فَإِحْنَا: فَـ + إِحْنَا — iḥnā, we (dialectal, for Classical naḥnu)
صِرْنَا: صِرْنَا — ṣāra, to become (I), 1st pl. past
بِسَبَبِكَ: بِـ + سَبَب + كَ — bi-, by/because of + sabab, cause (m.) + -ka, your
عَدِمْتُ: عَدِمْتُ — ʿadima, to lose/lack (I), 1st sg. past
أَضْرَاسِي: أَضْرَاس + ي — ḍirs, molar (m.), pl. aḍrās + -ī, my
وَعَلَيْنَا: وَ + عَلَى + نَا — ʿalā, upon + -nā, us
وَالْحَمْدُ: وَ + الـ + حَمْد — ḥamd, praise (m.), nom.
خَلَّصَتْكَ: خَلَّصَتْ + كَ — khallaṣa, to save/rescue (II), 3rd f. sg. past + -ka, you
وَأَهْلَكَتْ: وَ + أَهْلَكَتْ — ahlaka, to destroy (IV), 3rd f. sg. past
وَكَفَى: وَ + كَفَى — kafā, to suffice (I), 3rd m. sg. past
وَعَلَيْكَ: وَ + عَلَى + كَ — ʿalā, upon + -ka, you
بِسَلَامٍ: بِـ + سَلَام — bi-, in/with + salām, peace, indef. gen.
رَأَيْتُكَ: رَأَيْتُ + كَ — raʾā, to see (I), 1st sg. past + -ka, you
أُصَدِّقُ: أُصَدِّقُ — ṣaddaqa, to believe (II), 1st sg. imperf.
أَتَوَجَّهُ: أَتَوَجَّهُ — tawajjaha, to turn/head toward (V), 1st sg. imperf.
وَخَطَرَ: وَ + خَطَرَ — khaṭara, to occur/cross (the mind) (I), 3rd m. sg. past
يُخَلُّونِي: يُخَلُّونَ + نِي — khallā, to leave/let (II), 3rd m. pl. imperf. + -nī, me (double nūn reduced to one, colloquial)
وَسَلَامَتِي: وَ + سَلَامَة + ي — salāma(t), safety (f.) + -ī, my
وَمَشَيْتُ: وَ + مَشَيْتُ — mashā, to walk/journey (I), 1st sg. past
وَاجْتِمَاعِي: وَ + اجْتِمَاع + ي — ijtimāʿ, meeting (m., VIII), + -ī, my (hamzat al-waṣl, no hamza sign)
بِالْخَيَّاطِ: بِـ + الـ + خَيَّاط — khayyāṭ, tailor (m.), gen.
بِالصَّبِيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + صَبِيَّة — ṣabiyya(t), girl (f.), gen.
وَخَلَاصِي: وَ + خَلَاص + ي — khalāṣ, deliverance (m.) + -ī, my
عَبَرَ: عَبَرَ — ʿabara, to pass/cross (I), 3rd m. sg. past
الْمُبْتَدَا: الـ + مُبْتَدَا — mubtadā, beginning (VIII, from ابتدأ; spelled here without the expected hamza, likely leveled to rhyme with المنتهى)
وَالْمُنْتَهَى: وَ + الـ + مُنْتَهَى — muntahā, end (VIII, from انتهى)
أَخْرُجَ: خَرَجَ — ḫaraja, to go out, leave; 1sg. subjunctive after أَنْ: 'that I go out'
وَحَلَقْتُ: وَ + حَلَقْتُ — ḥalaqa, to shave; 1sg. past + 'and': 'and I shaved'
وَلَبِسْتُ: وَ + لَبِسْتُ — labisa, to wear, put on; 1sg. past + 'and': 'and I wore'
مِسْحًا: misḥ, coarse cloth/sackcloth/felt (m.); indefinite accusative object: 'a (garment of) felt'
وَحَطَّيْتُ: وَ + حَطَّيْتُ — (colloquial) ḥaṭṭ, to put/place down; 1sg. past + 'and': 'and I placed'
سِيدِي: uncertain element of the dialectal phrase با سيدي, minimally vocalised; possibly related to سَيِّد ('master') or the name of a felt cap/turban worn in mourning — identity uncertain, see note
وَأَفْتَكِرُ: وَ + أَفْتَكِرُ — (dialectal form VIII) iftakara, to recall, remember; 1sg. present + 'and': 'and I recall'
الْمَصَائِبَ: الـ + مَصَائِب — pl. of مُصِيبَة, calamity/misfortune (f.); accusative object of أفتكر: 'the calamities'
وَقَلْعَ: وَ + قَلْعَ — qalʿ, plucking-out/gouging (m., verbal noun of قَلَعَ); accusative, second coordinate object of أفتكر: 'and the gouging-out (of)'
أَفْتَكِرُ: iftakara, to recall, remember; 1sg. present (bare, second occurrence of the verb in this sentence, after كُلَّ مَا): 'I recall'
وَأُنْشِدُ: وَ + أُنْشِدُ — anšada (form IV), to recite verse; 1sg. present + 'and': 'and I recite' (hamza supplied)
وَأَقُولُ: وَ + أَقُولُ — qāla, to say; 1sg. present + 'and': 'and I say' (hamza supplied)
تَحَيَّرْتُ: تَحَيَّرَ — form V, to be bewildered, at a loss; 1sg. past: 'I have been bewildered'
وَالرَّحْمَنِ: وَ + الـ + رَحْمَن — wa- (oath particle) 'by' + al-Raḥmān, 'the Merciful (God)': 'by the Merciful'
أَمْرِي: أَمْر + ي — amr, affair, matter (m.); with 1sg. suffix: 'my affair'
وَحَالَتْ: وَ + حَالَتْ — ḥāla, to change, come over, befall; 3f.sg. past (agreeing with pl. الْأَحْزَانُ) + 'and': 'and ... came over'
الْأَحْزَانُ: الـ + أَحْزَان — pl. of حُزْن, sorrow, grief (m.); nominative subject: 'the sorrows'
أَدْرِي: دَرَى — darā, to know; 1sg. present: 'I know'
سَأَصْبِرُ: سَـ + أَصْبِرُ — sa- (future particle) + aṣbiru (صَبَرَ, form I, 1sg. present): 'I shall be patient/endure'
يَعْجِزَ: عَجَزَ — ʿajaza, to be unable, be overcome, fail; 3m.sg. subjunctive after حتى: '(until) ... is overcome'
الصَّبْرُ: الـ + صَبْر — ṣabr, patience (m.); nominative subject: 'patience'
وَأَصْبِرُ: وَ + أَصْبِرُ — aṣbiru, 1sg. present of صَبَرَ + 'and': 'and I shall be patient'
يَقْضِيَ: قَضَى — qaḍā, to accomplish, decree, bring to an end; 3m.sg. subjunctive after حتى: '(until) ... accomplishes'
أَتَوَجَّعْ: تَوَجَّعَ — form V, to complain of pain, groan; 1sg. jussive after لم: 'I do not complain'
الظَّمْآنُ: الـ + ظَمْآن — ẓamʾān/ẕamʾān, thirsty (one) (m.); nominative subject: 'the thirsty one'
الْحَرِّ: الـ + حَرّ — ḥarr, heat/hot (m.); genitive, agreeing with الوادي: 'the hot (valley)'
يَعْلَمَ: عَلِمَ — ʿalima, to know; 3m.sg. subjunctive after حتى: '(until) ... knows'
أَمَرَّ: amarr, more/most bitter (elative of مُرّ); accusative here (same form as earlier occurrence): 'more bitter'
الصَّبْرِ: الـ + صَبْر — ṣabr, patience (m.); genitive after مِنَ: 'patience'
شَيْءَ: shayʾ, thing (m.); accusative after لا النافية للجنس: 'nothing'
وَإِنَّمَا: وَ + إِنَّمَا — innamā, 'rather, but indeed, only': 'and yet'
أَمَرُّ: amarr, more/most bitter (elative of مُرّ); nominative here as subject: 'more bitter'
الْأَمْرَيْنِ: الـ + أَمْرَيْن — dual of أَمْر (here used idiomatically for 'the two bitter things/two evils'); genitive after مِنَ: 'the two (bitternesses)'
خَانَنِي: خَانَ — ḫāna, to betray; 3m.sg. past + 1sg. object suffix: 'it betrayed me'
سَرَائِرُ: pl. of سَرِيرَة, inmost secret/inner thought (f.); nominative subject: 'the secrets/inmost thoughts (of)'
تُرْجُمَانُ: turjumān, interpreter, translator (m.); nominative predicate: 'the interpreter (of)'
سَرِيرَتِي: سَرِيرَة + ي — sarīra, inmost thought/inner self (f.) + 1sg. suffix: 'my inmost self'
سِرُّ: sirr, secret (m.); nominative, first term of construct: 'the secret of'
أَنَّ: anna — 'that,' subordinates the following nominal clause after لَوْ
لِلْجِبَالِ: لِـ + الـ + جِبَال — li-, 'to/for' + al- + jibāl, pl. of جَبَل, mountain (m.); dative: 'to the mountains'
لَهَدَمَتْ: لَـ + هَدَمَتْ — la- (emphatic particle marking the apodosis of لَوْ) + hadamat (هَدَمَ, to demolish; 3f.sg. past, agreeing with fem. pl. الجبال): 'would surely have collapsed/been levelled'
وَبِالنَّارِ: وَ + بِـ + الـ + نَار — wa- + bi- + al-nār, fire (f.): 'and with the fire'
أَطْفَاهَا: أَطْفَأَ — form IV, to extinguish; 3m.sg. past + 3f.sg. object suffix: 'it would have quenched it'
وَبِالرِّيحِ: وَ + بِـ + الـ + رِيح — wa- + bi- + al-rīḥ, wind (f.): 'and with the wind'
تَسْرِي: سَرَى — sarā, to travel by night, course, blow; 3f.sg. jussive after لَمْ (agreeing with fem. الريح): 'it would not course/blow'
الْاَقْطَارَ: الـ (article) + أَقْطَار (broken plural of قُطْر, "region, quarter"; pattern أفعال, hamzat al-qaṭʿ), accusative; 'the regions' (object of سافرت).
وَوَرَدْتُ: وَ (and) + وَرَدَ ("to arrive at, come to") + تُ (I); 'and I came to'.
الْاَمْصَارَ: الـ + أَمْصَار (plural of مِصْر, "city"), accusative; 'the cities'.
دَارَ: دَار, "house, abode" (accusative, construct first term); 'دار السلام' = 'Abode of Peace', an epithet of Baghdad.
اَتَوَصَّلُ: أَ (1st sg. present prefix, hamzat al-qaṭʿ) + تَوَصَّلَ (form V of وصل, "to gain access, attain"); 'I might reach'.
اَمِيرِ: أَمِير, "prince, commander" (genitive, construct first term with المؤمنين; hamza supplied); 'commander of'.
وَاُخْبِرُهُ: وَ + أُخْبِرُ (1st sg. present, form IV of خبر, "to inform"; hamza supplied) + هُ ("him"); 'and I inform him'.
اَخِي: أَخ ("brother"; hamza supplied — the edition prints bare اخي) + ي ("my"); 'my brother'.
حَائِرًا: حَائِر (active participle of حار, "to be bewildered, at a loss"), indefinite accusative ḥāl; 'bewildered' (hamza already precomposed in the source and kept as given).
تَحَدَّثْتُ: taḥaddathtu, 1st sg. past of taḥaddatha (form V of ḥadatha), "to converse, talk".
بِاَخِينَا: بِ (marking what suddenly appears, after إذا of surprise) + أَخِي ("brother"; hamza supplied) + نَا ("our"); 'there was our brother'.
اَقْبَلَ: أَقْبَلَ (form IV of قبل, "to come forward, approach"; hamza supplied), past; 'he came upon'.
الْمُبَارَكَةَ: الـ + مُبَارَكَة (fem. passive participle of بارك, "to bless"), accusative agreeing with الليلة; 'the blessed (night)'.
فَتَمَشَّيْنَا: فَ + تَمَشَّى (form V of مشي, "to walk along") + نَا; 'so we walked along'.
الثَّلَاثَةُ: الـ + ثَلَاثَة ("three"), nominative in apposition to نحن; 'the three (of us)'.
اَحَدٌ: أَحَد ("anyone, someone"; hamza supplied), indefinite nominative subject; 'anyone'.
حِكَايَةَ: حِكَايَة ("tale, story"), accusative object of يعرف, construct; 'the tale of'.
اَحَدٍ: أَحَد (hamza supplied), indefinite genitive (idafa with حكاية); 'another's, someone's'.
فَسَاقَتْنَا: فَ + سَاقَتْ (fem. past of سَاقَ, "to drive, lead") + نَا ("us"); 'so it drove us'.
وَدَخَلْنَا: وَ + دَخَلَ ("to enter") + نَا; 'and we entered'.
حِكَايَتَكَ: حِكَايَة ("tale") + كَ ("your", masc.), accusative subject of إنّ; 'your tale'.
غَرِيبَةٌ: غَرِيبَة (fem. of غريب, "strange"), indefinite nominative predicate; 'strange'.
وَاخْرُجْ: وَ + اِخْرُجْ (form-I imperative of خرج, "go out!"; hamzat al-waṣl, no hamza-mark); 'and go out!'.
سَبِيلِكَ: سَبِيل ("way, path") + كَ ("your"); 'your way' — اخرج الى حال سبيلك, idiom for 'go your own way, be off'.
اَخْرُجُ: أَخْرُجُ (1st sg. present of خرج, "I go out"; true hamzat al-qaṭʿ, contrast the imperative's hamzat al-waṣl above); 'I go out'.
اَسْمَعَ: أَسْمَعَ (1st sg. present subjunctive of سمع, "to hear"; hamza supplied); 'I hear'.
اَيَّهَا: أَيُّهَا, vocative particle "O" (hamza supplied); used here in its masculine form though addressing a woman, see note.
الْجَلِيلَةُ: الـ + جَلِيلَة (fem. of جليل, "noble, exalted"), nominative adjective; 'the noble (lady)'.
اَعْجَبُ: أَعْجَب (elative of عجب, "more wondrous, more amazing"; hamza supplied), nominative predicate; 'more amazing'.
وَاَغْرَبُ: وَ + أَغْرَب (elative of غرب, "stranger, more strange"; hamza supplied); 'and stranger'.
لِحَلْقِ: لِ (marking purpose, "for") + حَلْق ("shaving"), genitive; 'for the shaving of'.
جَاءَهُمُ: جَاءَ ("to come") + هُمُ ("them"; damma before a following vowel-initial word); 'came to them'.
وَالْقَدَرُ: وَ + الـ + قَدَر ("destiny, decree"), nominative; 'and destiny'.
جَلَبْتُ: جَلَبَ ("to draw upon oneself, bring about") + تُ; 'I brought, drew'.
الْقَضَاءَ: الـ + قَضَاء ("fate" — here spelled in full, hamza already precomposed in the source), accusative; 'the decree, fate' (contrast القضا above, same word).
وَالْهَمَّ: وَ + الـ + هَمّ ("grief, care"), accusative (coordinated object of جلبت); 'and the grief'.
لِرُوحِي: لِ ("unto, for") + رُوح ("soul") + ي ("my"); 'for my (own) soul'.
اَنِّي: أَنَّ ("that", introducing a subordinate clause; hamza supplied) + ي ("I"; doubled ن with connecting kasra before ي); 'that I'.
وَاَخَذْتُ: وَ + أَخَذَ ("to take"; hamza supplied) + تُ; 'and I took'.
حَكَمْتُ: ḥakamtu, 1st sg. past of ḥakama, "to rule, judge".
وَعَدَلْتُ: وَ + عَدَلَ ("to be just") + تُ; 'and I was just'.
وَاَحْسَنْتُ: وَ + أَحْسَنَ (form IV of حسن, "to do well, excel"; hamza supplied) + تُ; 'and I did well'.
لِلرَّعِيَّةِ: لِ ("to, toward") + الـ + رَعِيَّة ("the subjects, the populace"), genitive; 'to the subjects'.
وَكٰنَتْ: وَ + كَانَتْ (fem. past of كان, "was" — spelled defectively كنت in the source, restored with a dagger alif; see note); 'and (my city) was'.
وَالْبَحْرُ: وَ + الـ + بَحْر, nominative (topic of a nominal sentence); 'and the sea'.
مُتَّسِعٌ: مُتَّسِع (active participle of form VIII اِتَّسَعَ, "to be vast, wide"), indefinite nominative predicate; 'vast'.
جَزَائِرُ: جَزَائِر (plural of جَزِيرَة, "islands"), indefinite nominative subject; 'islands'.
كَثِيرَةٌ: كَثِيرَة — kathīra, fem. of kathīr, many, abundant (adj.), nom. indef.; 'many'
لِلْمَتْجَرِ: لِ + الـ + مَتْجَر ("trade, commerce"), genitive; 'for trade'.
اَصْغَرُ: أَصْغَر (elative of صغير, "smaller"; hamza supplied), nominative adjective; 'smaller'.
لِلْفُرْجَةِ: لِ + الـ + فُرْجَة ("pleasure-outing, excursion"), genitive; 'for pleasure-outings'.
وَمِائَةٌ: وَ + مِائَة ("a hundred"), indefinite nominative numeral; 'and a hundred'.
مُعَدَّةً: مُعَدَّة (fem. passive participle, form II of عَدَّ, "made ready, prepared"), accusative adjective; 'made ready'.
وَالْجِهَادِ: وَ + الـ + جِهَاد ("struggle, combat"), genitive; 'and combat'.
فَاَرَدْتُ: فَ + أَرَدْتُ (form IV of رود, "I wished, wanted"; hamza supplied); 'so I wished'.
اَتَفَرَّجَ: أَتَفَرَّجَ (1st sg. present subjunctive, form V of فرج, "to go looking about, sight-see"; hamza supplied); 'I might go sight-seeing'.
لَيْلَةٌ: لَيْلَة ("a night"), indefinite nominative predicate; 'a night'.
رِيَاحٌ: رِيَاح (plural of رِيح, "winds"), indefinite nominative subject; 'winds'.
مُخْتَلِفَةٌ: مُخْتَلِفَة (active participle, form VIII of خلف, "differing, contrary"), indefinite nominative adjective; 'contrary'.
وَهَاجَ: وَ + هَاجَ ("to surge, to rage"), past; 'and... surged'.
هَيَجَاتٍ: هَيَجَات ("surgings", plural), accusative of specification, indefinite; 'with surgings'.
وَتَلَاطَمَتِ: وَ + تَلَاطَمَتْ (fem. past, form VI of لطم, "to dash against each other"); 'and... clashed together'.
الْاَمْوَاجُ: الـ + أَمْوَاج (plural of مَوْج, "waves"; hamza supplied), nominative subject; 'the waves'.
فَاَيِسْنَا: فَ + أَيِسْنَا (1st pl. past of أَيِسَ, a metathesis-variant of يَئِسَ, "to despair"; hamza supplied); 'so we despaired'.
شَدِيدَةٌ: شَدِيدَة (fem. of شديد, "severe"), indefinite nominative adjective; 'heavy'.
الْمُخَاطِرُ: الـ + مُخَاطِر (active participle, form III of خطر, "one who risks, takes a risk"), nominative subject of ليس; 'the risk-taker'.
بِمَحْمُودٍ: بِ (marks the predicate of ليس) + مَحْمُود ("praiseworthy", passive participle of حمد), indefinite genitive; 'praiseworthy'.
سَلِمَ: سَلِمَ (past, "to be safe, come through unharmed"); 'he comes through safe'.
فَدَعَوْنَا: فَ + دَعَوْنَا (1st pl. past of دعا, "to call upon, to pray"); 'so we called upon'.
اللّٰهَ: اللّٰه ("God"), accusative object; the traditional shadda-plus-dagger-alif spelling of the divine name.
وَابْتَهَلْنَا: وَ + ابْتَهَلْنَا (1st pl. past, form VIII of بهل, "to implore fervently"; hamzat al-waṣl); 'and we implored'.
زَالَتِ: زَالَتْ (fem. past of زَالَ, "to cease"; with لا, "kept on..."), connective kasra before the following ال; 'cease'.
الْاَرْيَاحُ: الـ + أَرْيَاح (rare/dialectal plural of رِيح, "winds", parallel to أَمْوَاج; hamza supplied), nominative subject; 'the winds'.
تَخْتَلِفُ: تَخْتَلِفُ (fem. present, form VIII of خلف, "to vary, differ"); 'kept varying'.
وَالْاَمْوَاجُ: وَ + الـ + أَمْوَاج, nominative (coordinated subject); 'and the waves'.
تَلْتَطِمُ: تَلْتَطِمُ (fem. present, form VIII of لطم, "to dash against each other"); 'kept clashing'.
انْفَجَرَ: اِنْفَجَرَ (past, form VII of فجر, "to break forth"; hamzat al-waṣl); 'broke forth'.
فَهَدَتِ: فَ + هَدَتْ (fem. past, "grew calm, subsided" — spelled without the hamza-letter of Classical هَدَأَتْ, see note) + connective kasra; 'then... grew still'.
اَشْرَقَتِ: أَشْرَقَتْ (fem. past, form IV of شرق, "to shine, to rise"; hamza supplied) + connective kasra; 'rose'.
اَشْرَفْنَا: أَشْرَفْنَا (1st pl. past, form IV of شرف, "to overlook, come in sight of"; hamza supplied); 'we came in sight of'.
وَطَلَعْنَا: وَ + طَلَعْنَا (1st pl. past of طلع, "to go up, come out"); 'and we went up'.
وَطَبَخْنَا: وَ + طَبَخْنَا (1st pl. past of طبخ, "to cook"); 'and we cooked'.
نَأْكُلُهُ: نَأْكُلُ (1st pl. present of أكل, "we eat"; hamza already precomposed in the source and kept as given) + هُ ("it"); '(that) we might eat it'.
فَاَكَلْنَا: فَ + أَكَلْنَا (1st pl. past of أكل, "we ate"; hamza supplied here, unlike the precomposed spelling of نَأْكُلُهُ just above, see note); 'so we ate'.
اَخَذْنَا: أَخَذْنَا (1st pl. past of أخذ, "we took"; hamza supplied); 'we took'.
فَاخْتَلَفَتْ: فَ + اخْتَلَفَتْ (fem. past, form VIII of خلف, "to grow strange, to differ"; hamzat al-waṣl); 'then... grew strange'.
الْمِيَاهُ: الـ + مِيَاه — miyāh, pl. of māʾ, water (f. pl.), nom.; 'the waters'
وَاسْتَغْرَبَ: وَ + اسْتَغْرَبَ (past, form X of غرب, "to find strange"; hamzat al-waṣl); 'and... found strange'.
لِلنَّاظُورِ: لِ + الـ + نَاظُور ("lookout, watchman"), genitive; 'to the lookout'.
اُكْشُفِ: اُكْشُفْ (form-I imperative of كشف, "scan, uncover!"; hamzat al-waṣl, damma harmonising with the present-stem vowel) + connective kasra; 'scan!'.
وَاُطْلُعِ: وَ + اُطْلُعْ (form-I imperative of طلع, "go up, climb!"; hamzat al-waṣl) + connective kasra; 'and go up!'.
الْبِطِّيَّةَ: الـ + بِطِّيَّة (uncertain nautical term, perhaps the masthead look-out post), accusative object; reading and precise sense uncertain, see note.
الْمَسَارِي: الـ + مَسَارِي (plural, perhaps of سَارِيَة "mast" — the mast-ropes, rigging; reading uncertain, see note); 'the rigging'.
النَّاظُورُ: الـ + نَاظُور — nāẕūr, lookout, watchman (m.), nom.; 'the lookout'
لِلرَّئِسِ: لِ + الـ + رَئِس ("captain"), genitive; 'to the captain'.
رَئِسُ: رَئِيس written defectively as رَئِس (the internal يـ of the pattern فَعِيل is omitted) — raʾīs, 'captain, ship's master'; here direct address, 'O captain'
يَمِينِي: يَمِين, yamīn, 'right side' + ي (1st sing. possessive); 'my right'
سَمَكً: سَمَك, samak, 'fish' (collective noun) + accusative tanwīn (the edition omits the usual supporting alif of the accusative ending); object of 'I saw'
فَرَأَيْتُ: فَ 'so, then' + رَأَيْتُ (see above); 'and I saw'
سَوَادًا: سَوَاد, sawād, 'blackness, dark shape' + accusative tanwīn; object of 'I saw'
يَلُوحُ: يَلُوح, from لَاحَ / يَلُوح, 'to appear, gleam, flicker'
وَسَاعَةً: وَ 'and' + سَاعَةً (see above); 'and at another moment'
النَّاظُورِ: الـ + نَاظُور, nāẓūr, 'lookout' (a colloquial agent-noun from نَظَر, 'to watch') + genitive (mudāf ilayh)
أَبْشِرُوا: form IV imperative pl. of بَشِرَ / أَبْشَرَ, 'receive glad tidings, rejoice' (hamza supplied); used with grim irony here, 'take the news of...'
بِهَلَاكِنَا: بِـ 'with' (marks what is 'received') + هَلَاك, halāk, 'destruction, ruin' + نَا 'our'
يَسْلَمْ: jussive of سَلِمَ / يَسْلَم, 'to be safe, escape, survive'
شَرَعَ: شَرَعَ, 'to begin, set about (doing something)'; governs the following imperfect
أَخْبِرْنَا: form IV imperative أَخْبِرْ (from خَبَر, 'news, report') + نَا 'us'; 'tell us' (hamza supplied)
تِهْنَا: تَاهَ / يَتِيه, 'to be lost, go astray' + نَا (1st pl. past)
هَاجَتْ: هَاجَ / يَهِيج, 'to rage, be stirred up' + تْ (fem. agreement with الأرياح, which follows)
الْأَرْيَاحُ: الـ + أَرْيَاح, aryāḥ — a classical broken plural of رِيح, 'wind' (alongside رِيَاح) + nominative (hamza supplied)
هَدَي: probably a phonetic/defective spelling of هَدَأَ, 'to calm, subside' (medial hamza weakened to a glide written يـ); vocalised to preserve the letters actually printed — see note
بُكْرَةَ: بُكْرَة, bukra, 'early morning' + accusative (adverbial, construct with النهار)
وَأَقَمْنَا: وَ + form IV أَقَامَ, 'to stay, remain' + نَا (hamza supplied)
تَائِهِينَ: active participle pl. accusative of تَاهَ, 'wandering, lost' (already spelled with ئ in the source)
يُرْجِعُنَا: form IV of رَجَعَ, يُرْجِعُ 'to bring back, return (something)' + نَا 'us'
قَاصِدِينَ: active participle pl. of قَصَدَ, 'to intend, head for'; predicate of نحن — Classical grammar would want the nominative قَاصِدُونَ here, but this text, like spoken Arabic, levels the sound plural to the oblique-looking ـِين regardless of case; flagged here as the first clear instance
وَأخِرَ: وَ + آخِر, ākhir, 'last, end' + accusative (adverbial; hamza fused with the following long ā, i.e. a madda, is supplied on the bare alif the edition prints)
حَجَرٍ: حَجَر, 'stone, rock' + genitive tanwīn (second term of the construct)
يُسَمَّى: passive-sense form II, 'is named, is called'
حَجَرَ: حَجَر + accusative (predicate complement of 'is called,' construct with المغناطيس)
الْمِغْنَاطِيسِ: الـ + مِغْنَاطِيس (from Greek magnḗtēs via Arabic borrowing), 'the magnet' + genitive
وَتَجُرُّنَا: وَ + تَجُرُّ (جَرَّ / يَجُرّ, 'to drag, pull') + نَا 'us'
فَتَنْشَقُّ: فَ + تَنْشَقُّ (form VII of شَقَّ, 'to split open'); 'so it splits'
مِسْمَارٍ: مِسْمَار, 'nail' + genitive tanwīn (second term of the construct)
يَلْتَصِقُ: form VIII of لَصِقَ, 'to stick, cling, adhere'
رَكَّبَ: form II of رَكِبَ, رَكَّبَ, 'to install, build into, compose' (not form I 'to ride')
الْحَدِيدِ: الـ + حَدِيد, 'iron' + genitive (second term of the construct)
حَدِيدٌ: حَدِيد, 'iron' + nominative tanwīn (subject, delayed after the fronted adverbial predicate)
تَكَسَّرَ: form V of كَسَرَ, تَكَسَّرَ, 'to be smashed, broken to pieces'
مَرَاكِبُ: broken plural of مَرْكَب, 'ships' + nominative (diptote pattern, no tanwīn)
الْأَصْفَرِ: الـ + أَصْفَر, 'yellow' (colour-pattern adjective; hamza supplied) + genitive — takes a normal case vowel here because it is definite
مَعْقُودَةٌ: passive participle fem. of عَقَدَ, 'to tie, vault, raise (a structure)' + nominative tanwīn
أَعْمِدَةٍ: plural of عَمُود, 'pillar, column' + genitive tanwīn (hamza supplied)
الْفَارِسِ: الـ + فَارِس + genitive (second term of the construct)
مُعَلَّقٌ: passive participle of عَلَّقَ, 'hung, suspended' + nominative tanwīn
مَنْقُوشٌ: passive participle of نَقَشَ, 'engraved, inscribed' + nominative tanwīn
أَسْمَاءٌ: plural of اِسْم, 'name' + nominative tanwīn (initial hamza supplied; the final hamza is already in the edition's spelling and is kept as given)
وَطَلَاسِمُ: وَ + طَلَاسِم (plural of طِلَّسْم / طِلْسَم, a borrowed word, 'talisman') + nominative (diptote pattern, no tanwīn)
يُهْلِكُ: imperfect, form IV of هَلَكَ, يُهْلِك, 'destroys, brings to ruin'
الرَّاكِبُ: active participle of رَكِبَ, 'the one who rides, the rider' + nominative (subject, exceptive after إلا)
الْفَرَسِ: الـ + فَرَس, 'horse, mare' (treated here as grammatically feminine) + genitive
فَتَحَقَّقْنَا: فَ + form V تَحَقَّقَ (from حَقَّ, 'to be true'), 'to ascertain, become certain' + نَا
هَالِكِينَ: active participle pl. of هَلَكَ, 'doomed, perishing' — predicate of أنّ; Classical grammar wants the nominative هَالِكُونَ here, but the text again levels the ending to ـِين (see the note at قاصدين)
وَدَّعَ: form II of وَدَعَ, وَدَّعَ, 'to bid farewell to'
وَوَصَّى: وَ + form II of وَصَى, وَصَّى, 'to charge (someone) with instructions, enjoin'
وَسَاقَتْنَا: وَ + سَاقَتْ (سَاقَ / يَسُوق, 'to drive, sweep along'; fem.) + نَا 'us'
اِنْفَكَّتْ: form VII of فَكَّ, اِنْفَكَّ, 'to come apart, be dislodged'
وَطَلَعَتْ: وَ + طَلَعَتْ (fem.), 'and it/they came out, emerged'
وَاشْتَبَكَ: وَ + form VIII of شَبَكَ, اِشْتَبَكَ, 'to interlock, cling fast'
أخِرِ: آخِر, 'end, last part' + genitive (construct with النهار; hamza+madda supplied)
دُرْنَا: دَارَ / يَدُور, 'to circle, go around' + نَا
فَمِنَّا: فَ + مِنْ + نَا, 'so some of us'
وَأَكْثَرُنَا: وَ + أَكْثَر, 'most, the greater part' + نَا 'of us' (hamza supplied)
سَلِمُوا: plural past of سَلِمَ, 'they survived, were safe'
تَوَّهَتْهُم: form II of a root shared with تَاهَ / وَهَى, تَوَّهَ, 'to make lost, bewilder' + تْ (fem.) + هُم 'them'
الْأَمْوَاجُ: plural of مَوْج, 'the waves' + nominative (hamza supplied)
وَاخْتِلَافُ: وَ + form VIII maṣdar of خَلَفَ, اِخْتِلَاف, 'difference, variance' + nominative
فَنَجَّانِي: فَ + form II of نَجَا, نَجَّى, 'to save, rescue' + نِي 'me'
بَلْوَتِي: بَلْوَة, 'trial, affliction' (a variant noun-form of بَلْوَى) + ي 'my'
الْأَلْوَاحِ: plural of لَوْح, 'the planks' + genitive (hamza supplied)
فَضَرَبَتْهُ: فَ + ضَرَبَتْ (fem., agreeing with الريح) + هُ 'it'
فَالْتَصَقَ: form VIII of لَصِقَ, اِلْتَصَقَ, 'to stick, cling fast' (فـ here is the conjunction 'so'; the following اِ is the verb's own hamzat waṣl, not the article)
فَأَصَبْتُ: فَ + form IV of صَابَ/أَصَابَ, يُصِيب, 'to hit upon, find, come upon' + تُ (hamza supplied)
مُتَطَرِّقًا: active participle of تَطَرَّقَ (form V of طَرَقَ), 'winding, that makes its way, passable' + accusative tanwīn
كَهَيْئَةِ: كَـ 'like' (marks the following noun as a comparison) + هَيْئَة, 'form, shape, manner' + genitive (construct with السلالم)
السَّلَالِمِ: plural of سُلَّم, 'the stairs, ladders' + genitive
مَنْقُورَةً: passive participle fem. of نَقَرَ, 'carved, hewn' + accusative tanwīn (agreeing with طريقا, here treated as feminine)
فَسَمَّيْتُ: فَ + سَمَّى, 'to pronounce, invoke (a name)' + تُ — the standing idiom for saying 'In the name of God' before a hazardous undertaking, not simply 'to name'
